HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0001.title: Provide high-resolution bitmap assets for every supported device

statement.en: Provide high-resolution assets for every bitmap image on every supported device.
statement.ja: すべてのbitmap imageについて各supported device向けのhigh-resolution assetを提供する。

conditions: Use @2x for iPadOS and watchOS.
Use @2x and @3x for iOS.
Use @2x or higher for visionOS.
Use @1x and @2x for macOS and tvOS.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0001.review_note: Recovered the full all-image and all-device scope and preserved every platform scale-factor mapping.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0002.title: Include a color profile with every image

statement.en: Include a color profile with every image.
statement.ja: 各imageにcolor profileを含める。

conditions: A color profile helps colors appear as intended on different displays.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0002.review_note: Replaced generic generated wording and recorded the cross-display color-management purpose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0003.title: Always test images on actual devices

statement.en: Always test images on a range of actual supported devices.
statement.ja: imageを実際のsupported device各種で必ずtestする。

conditions: Check for pixelation, stretching, and compression across devices.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0003.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Always directive and recorded the three device-only rendering risks.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0036.title: Identify bitmap scale factors in asset filenames

statement.en: Identify each bitmap asset's scale factor with an @1x, @2x, or @3x filename suffix.
statement.ja: 各bitmap assetのfilenameに@1x、@2x、@3xのsuffixを付けてscale factorを示す。

conditions: Apply as each image is added to the project asset catalog.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0036.review_note: Recovered the asset-catalog filename convention and all three documented suffixes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0037.title: Start image design at the lowest resolution

statement.en: Generally design images at the lowest resolution, then scale them up for high-resolution assets.
statement.ja: 通常は最低resolutionでimageをdesignし、high-resolution asset用に拡大する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0037.review_note: Preserved the source's In general qualification rather than promoting the workflow to MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0038.title: Consider whole-value control points for resizable vector shapes

statement.en: For resizable vector shapes, consider whole-value control points for clean 1x alignment.
statement.ja: resizable vector shapeでは1xで整列するwhole-value control pointを検討する。

conditions: Whole-value 1x positions remain aligned to the raster grid at 2x and 3x.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0038.review_note: Preserved the optional might-want-to strength and the raster-alignment rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0039.title: Consider Apple-recommended formats by image type

statement.en: Consider the recommended file format for each image type.
statement.ja: image typeごとに推奨file formatの使用を検討する。

conditions: Use de-interlaced PNG for bitmap or raster work.
Use an 8-bit palette for PNG graphics that don't need full 24-bit color.
Use optimized JPEG or HEIC for photos.
Use stereo HEIC for stereo or spatial photos.
Use PDF or SVG for flat artwork that requires high-resolution scaling.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0039.review_note: Recorded the complete format table as one optional choice set rather than five unrelated mandates.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0001.title: Give essential information sufficient space

statement.en: Give essential information sufficient space so people can find it immediately.
statement.ja: essential informationに十分なspaceを与え、すぐ見つけられるようにする。

conditions: Keep the most important information immediately visible.
Move secondary information to another area or an additional view.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0001.review_note: Replaced generic generated wording and preserved immediate visibility plus secondary-information placement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0002.title: Use placement to convey relative importance

statement.en: Place items so their position conveys relative importance.
statement.ja: itemの配置によって相対的な重要度を伝える。

conditions: In the current language's reading order, generally place the most important items near the top and leading side.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0002.review_note: Recorded the source's general reading-order placement without turning it into a fixed coordinate rule.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0003.title: Space and group controls for comprehension

statement.en: Provide enough space around controls and group them into logical sections.
statement.ja: controlの周囲に十分なspaceを設け、logical sectionへgroup化する。

conditions: Keep unrelated controls and surrounding content far enough apart to distinguish and understand each control.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0003.review_note: Preserved both spacing and logical grouping plus the unrelated-content crowding risk.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0004.title: Keep adaptive layouts recognizable and consistent

statement.en: Design layouts that adapt gracefully to context changes while remaining recognizably consistent.
statement.ja: context変化へ自然に適応しつつ認識可能な一貫性を保つlayoutを設計する。

conditions: Handle device rotation, window resizing, added displays, and device changes.
Respect system safe areas, margins, and guides; fine-tune view placement with layout modifiers.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0004.review_note: Concretized the context changes and the system layout mechanisms that support adaptability.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0005.title: Prepare layouts for text-size changes

statement.en: Design layouts to respond appropriately to people’s text-size choices.
statement.ja: 利用者のtext-size選択へ適切に応答するlayoutを設計する。

conditions: Support Dynamic Type on iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, visionOS, and watchOS.
For Unity-based games, use Apple's accessibility plug-in to support Dynamic Type.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0005.review_note: Scoped Dynamic Type to the five platforms named by the source and recorded the Unity-specific implementation path.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0006.title: Respect platform display and system features

statement.en: Respect each platform’s key display and system features.
statement.ja: 各platformの主要なdisplay featureとsystem featureを尊重する。

conditions: Use safe areas to avoid obscuring content behind bars, Dynamic Island, camera housings, and other window or device features.
Reposition content as bars and other interactive components change size.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0006.review_note: Recorded safe-area obstruction and dynamic-repositioning outcomes without promoting the general Respect lead.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0025.title: Use progressive disclosure for hidden content

statement.en: Use progressive disclosure to help people discover content that is currently hidden.
statement.ja: progressive disclosureを使い、現在隠れているcontentを発見できるようにする。

conditions: Choose platform-appropriate disclosure controls or partially visible items as discovery cues.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0025.review_note: Repaired the generated wording and preserved platform-specific disclosure alternatives.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0036.title: Group related items

statement.en: Group related items so people can find information quickly.
statement.ja: 関連するitemをgroup化し、情報をすばやく見つけられるようにする。

conditions: Use spacing, background shapes, colors, materials, or separators to communicate grouping.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0036.review_note: Activated the omitted grouping lead and preserved every documented visual grouping technique.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0037.title: Keep content and controls distinct

statement.en: Ensure content and controls remain clearly distinct when visual grouping techniques are used.
statement.ja: visual grouping techniqueを使うときcontentとcontrolを明確に区別できる状態に保つ。

conditions: Grouping may use spacing, background shapes, colors, materials, or separators.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0037.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Ensure clause and bound it to the grouping-technique condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0038.title: Avoid crowding essential information

statement.en: Avoid crowding essential information with nonessential details.
statement.ja: essential informationをnonessential detailで過密にしない。

conditions: Keep the most important information immediately visible.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0038.review_note: Separated the explicit don't clause and retained it at AVOID rather than raising it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0039.title: Extend content to fill its screen or window

statement.en: Extend content to fill its screen or window.
statement.ja: contentをscreenまたはwindow全体へ広げる。

conditions: Account for controls and navigation such as sidebars and tab bars that overlay content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0039.review_note: Activated the omitted full-area lead and recorded the overlaid control layer.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0040.title: Extend backgrounds and full-screen artwork to display edges

statement.en: Ensure backgrounds and full-screen artwork extend to the edges of the display.
statement.ja: backgroundとfull-screen artworkをdisplayの端まで広げる。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0040.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Make sure clause and retained both backgrounds and full-screen artwork.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0041.title: Extend scrollable layouts to device-screen edges

statement.en: Ensure scrollable layouts continue to the bottom and sides of the device screen.
statement.ja: scrollable layoutをdevice screenのbottomとsideまで連続させる。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0041.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit ensure clause and preserved the bottom and both side edges.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0042.title: Use a background extension view beside narrow content

statement.en: When content does not span the full window, use a background extension view beside it.
statement.ja: contentがwindow全体へ広がらない場合は隣にbackground extension viewを使う。

conditions: Create the appearance of content behind the control layer on either side, such as beneath a sidebar or inspector.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0042.review_note: Recovered the conditional background-extension technique and its sidebar and inspector examples.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0043.title: Differentiate controls from content

statement.en: Differentiate controls from content.
statement.ja: controlとcontentを区別する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0043.review_note: Activated the omitted visual-hierarchy lead as a general recommendation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0044.title: Use Liquid Glass to distinguish controls

statement.en: Use Liquid Glass to give controls a distinct, platform-consistent appearance.
statement.ja: Liquid Glassでcontrolへ明確かつplatform間で一貫したappearanceを与える。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0044.review_note: Recovered the material recommendation and limited it to the three platforms named by the source.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0045.title: Use a scroll edge effect between content and controls

statement.en: Use a scroll edge effect instead of a background to transition between content and controls.
statement.ja: backgroundの代わりにscroll edge effectを使いcontentとcontrolの間をtransitionする。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0045.review_note: Recovered the stated background alternative and kept the surrounding three-platform scope.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0046.title: Account for right-to-left reading order

statement.en: Account for right-to-left reading order when placing important items.
statement.ja: important itemを配置するときright-to-leftのreading orderを考慮する。

conditions: Reading order varies by language.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0046.review_note: Recovered the localization-specific placement rule without promoting it beyond the source's take-into-account strength.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0047.title: Align components to communicate hierarchy

statement.en: Align components to improve scanning and communicate organization and hierarchy.
statement.ja: componentを整列し、scanしやすさとorganizationおよびhierarchyを伝える。

conditions: Use alignment and indentation to help people track content and understand information hierarchy.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0047.review_note: Activated the omitted alignment lead and preserved both scanning and hierarchy outcomes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0048.title: Indicate additional hidden collection items

statement.en: Indicate that additional items exist when a collection can’t display everything at once.
statement.ja: collectionですべてを一度に表示できない場合、追加itemの存在を示す。

conditions: The interface cannot show every item in a large collection simultaneously.
Use a platform-appropriate disclosure control or partial-item cue.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0048.review_note: Recovered MUST from the conditional you need to indicate clause and retained both discovery techniques.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0049.title: Adapt to device and system context changes

statement.en: Ensure every app and game adapts when device or system context changes.
statement.ja: deviceまたはsystem contextが変わるとき、すべてのappとgameを適応させる。

conditions: Handle screen sizes, resolutions, and color spaces.
Handle device orientation.
Handle Dynamic Island, camera controls, and other system features.
Handle external displays, Display Zoom, and resizable iPad windows.
Handle Dynamic Type text-size changes.
Handle localization changes in layout direction, formatting, fonts, and text length.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0049.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit needs-to-adapt statement and preserved all six variation groups.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0050.title: Use another adaptation method without system layout tools

statement.en: Use another adaptation method when the interface doesn’t use SwiftUI or Auto Layout.
statement.ja: interfaceでSwiftUIまたはAuto Layoutを使わない場合、別のadaptation methodを使う。

conditions: The app or game does not use SwiftUI or Auto Layout to adapt dynamically.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0050.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit conditional need-to-use-alternative-methods clause.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0051.title: Preview layouts across devices and settings

statement.en: Preview the experience across devices, orientations, localizations, and text sizes.
statement.ja: device、orientation、localization、text sizeを変えてexperienceをpreviewする。

conditions: Test the largest and smallest layouts first.
Preview wide-gamut color on actual devices when possible.
Use Device Hub or simulators to check clipping and other layout issues.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0051.review_note: Activated the omitted preview lead and recorded the test matrix, bounding cases, and device-versus-simulator split.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0052.title: Scale artwork when display changes require it

statement.en: When display changes require it, scale artwork to keep important visual content visible.
statement.ja: display変更で必要な場合、important visual contentを表示し続けるようartworkをscaleする。

conditions: A display aspect-ratio change crops, letterboxes, or pillarboxes artwork.
exceptions: visionOS automatically scales a window as it moves along the z-axis.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0052.review_note: Activated the conditional scale lead, recorded all three fit problems, and preserved the visionOS automatic behavior.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0053.title: Avoid changing artwork aspect ratios

statement.en: Avoid changing artwork’s aspect ratio when adapting to display changes.
statement.ja: display変更へ適応するときartworkのaspect ratioを変えない。

conditions: Scale the artwork instead so important visual content remains visible.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0053.review_note: Separated the explicit don't clause, retained AVOID strength, and recorded the scaling alternative.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0001.title: Make motion optional

statement.en: Make motion optional so people can use the experience without it.
statement.ja: motionをoptionalにし、motionなしでもexperienceを利用できるようにする。

conditions: Offer nonvisual feedback such as haptics or audio where appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0001.review_note: Concretized optionality and recorded the haptic and audio alternatives without duplicating the separate accessibility requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0002.title: Match feedback motion to gestures and expectations

statement.en: Make feedback motion realistic and consistent with people’s gestures and expectations.
statement.ja: feedback motionをrealisticにし、利用者のgestureとexpectationに一致させる。

conditions: Preserve the spatial relationship implied by the gesture, such as reversing the reveal direction to dismiss a view.
In nongame apps, incoherent motion can disorient people.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0002.review_note: Recorded gesture continuity, expected spatial reversal, and the nongame disorientation risk.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0003.title: Keep feedback animations brief and precise

statement.en: Keep feedback animations brief and precisely tied to the action or transition.
statement.ja: feedback animationをbriefにし、actionまたはtransitionへ正確に結びつける。

conditions: Avoid distracting people from gameplay or making them wait to reach content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0003.review_note: Concretized both brevity and action-level precision while preserving the source's Aim strength.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0004.title: Let people cancel motion

statement.en: Let people cancel or interrupt motion.
statement.ja: 利用者がmotionをcancelまたはinterruptできるようにする。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0004.review_note: Preserved the general cancellation recommendation and separated the qualified wait-time warning.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0005.title: Consider animated symbols

statement.en: Consider animated symbols when they suit the feedback.
statement.ja: feedbackに適する場合はanimated symbolを検討する。

conditions: SF Symbols 5 or later can animate SF Symbols and custom symbols.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0005.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the applicable SF Symbols capability.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0006.title: Provide good default game motion on every platform

statement.en: Ensure a game’s motion looks good by default on every supported platform.
statement.ja: gameのmotionを各supported platformでdefaultのまま良好に表示する。

conditions: Use each device's graphics capabilities to choose defaults people can enjoy without changing settings.
Treat 30–60 fps as a typical smooth range, not an unconditional fixed threshold.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0006.review_note: Retained MUST from Make sure, replaced vague generated wording, and preserved the qualified frame-rate range.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0007.title: Let players optimize game visuals

statement.en: Let people customize game visuals to optimize performance or battery life.
statement.ja: performanceまたはbattery lifeを最適化できるようgame visualをcustomize可能にする。

conditions: Consider power-mode choices when the system detects an external power source.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0007.review_note: Recorded both optimization goals and kept automatic external-power modes as an example.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0015.title: Add motion purposefully

statement.en: Add motion only when it supports the experience without overshadowing it.
statement.ja: experienceを損なわず支える場合にだけmotionを加える。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0015.review_note: Activated the omitted purpose lead and preserved the supporting-without-overshadowing balance.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0016.title: Avoid gratuitous or excessive motion

statement.en: Avoid adding motion merely for its own sake or using it excessively.
statement.ja: motionを目的なく追加したり過剰に使ったりしない。

conditions: Gratuitous or excessive animation can distract, disconnect, or physically discomfort people.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0016.review_note: Combined the paragraph's two equivalent discouragements and retained AVOID rather than promoting don't to MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0017.title: Communicate important information without relying on motion

statement.en: Provide a non-motion way to communicate every important piece of information.
statement.ja: すべてのimportant informationにmotionを使わない伝達方法を提供する。

conditions: Never make motion the only communication channel for important information.
Use alternatives such as haptics or audio where appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0017.review_note: Classified the source's essential accessibility outcome as MUST and recorded both non-motion alternatives.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0018.title: Avoid motion in frequent app interactions

statement.en: Generally avoid adding motion to app interactions that occur frequently.
statement.ja: appで頻繁に起きるinteractionへのmotion追加は通常避ける。

conditions: Standard interface elements already include subtle system animation.
Avoid making people repeatedly spend extra time attending to custom-element motion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0018.review_note: Activated the omitted app-specific lead and preserved the generally qualification.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0019.title: Avoid blocking action until animation finishes

statement.en: Avoid making people wait for an animation to finish before they can act.
statement.ja: animationの終了まで利用者がactionできない状態を避ける。

conditions: Apply wherever practicable, especially when people experience the animation more than once.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0019.review_note: Separated the qualified don't clause, retained AVOID strength, and preserved the repeated-animation emphasis.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0001.title: Match tone to the situation

statement.en: Match the app’s tone to the situation in which people encounter the text.
statement.ja: 利用者がtextに接する状況へappのtoneを合わせる。

conditions: Establish the app's voice first.
Account for what people are doing in the physical world and inside the app.
Let the situation influence both wording and on-screen presentation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0001.review_note: Concretized physical, in-app, wording, and presentation context.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0002.title: Write clearly and concisely

statement.en: Use easily understood words that convey the intended meaning with no unnecessary text.
statement.ja: 意図した意味を伝える理解しやすい言葉を使い、不要なtextを省く。

conditions: Use fewer words when possible.
Read text aloud when clarity is uncertain.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0002.review_note: Expanded the vague Be clear lead into understandable wording, correct meaning, and concision.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0003.title: Write for an inclusive audience

statement.en: Write in simple, plain language with accessibility and localization in mind.
statement.ja: accessibilityとlocalizationを考慮し、simpleでplainなlanguageを書く。

conditions: Avoid jargon and gendered terminology.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0003.review_note: Concretized the inclusive-language, accessibility, localization, jargon, and gender scope.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0004.title: Consider each screen’s purpose

statement.en: Consider each screen’s purpose and its place in the information flow.
statement.ja: 各screenの目的とinformation flow内での位置を検討する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0004.review_note: Retained MAY and separated direct hierarchy and readability actions into atomic rules.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0005.title: Use action-oriented language

statement.en: Use active voice and clear labels to help people move between steps and screens.
statement.ja: active voiceとclear labelで利用者がstepやscreen間を進めるようにする。

conditions: Prioritize clarity over cute or clever wording.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0005.review_note: Concretized active voice, navigation, and clarity while separating label-specific rules.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0006.title: Apply capitalization consistently

statement.en: Choose capitalization rules that fit the app’s style and apply them consistently.
statement.ja: appのstyleに合うcapitalization ruleを選び一貫して適用する。

conditions: Choose a style for each UI element type.
Follow component-specific guidance where it exists.
Use title case for a more formal voice or sentence case for a more casual voice as appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0006.review_note: Recorded per-element consistency and the component-specific exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0007.title: Use consistent language throughout multistep flows

statement.en: Give clear guidance and use consistent action language throughout multistep flows.
statement.ja: multistep flow全体でclearなguidanceと一貫したaction languageを使う。

conditions: Use labels such as Get Started to begin, and choose Continue or Next consistently between steps.
A button label can hint at the next step.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0007.review_note: Recorded start, transition, and next-step labeling while separating flow completion.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0008.title: Use possessive pronouns sparingly

statement.en: Use possessive pronouns only when they add necessary context.
statement.ja: 必要なcontextを加える場合にだけpossessive pronounを使う。

conditions: If possessive pronouns are used, keep perspective consistent throughout the app.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0008.review_note: Recorded the context test and perspective consistency.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0009.title: Adapt writing to device use

statement.en: Keep language consistent across devices while adapting text to how each device is used.
statement.ja: device間でlanguageを一貫させつつ各deviceの使われ方へtextを適応する。

conditions: Account for use context, screen size, location, and viewing distance.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0009.review_note: Preserved cross-device consistency and device-specific adaptation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0010.title: Give empty states clear next steps

statement.en: Give every empty state clear next steps.
statement.ja: すべてのempty stateでclearなnext stepを示す。

conditions: Guide people toward actions they can take.
Provide a button or link for the action when possible.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0010.review_note: Recorded actionable guidance and the direct-control option.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0011.title: Write actionable error messages

statement.en: Write error messages that identify the problem without blame and explain how to fix it.
statement.ja: blameせずproblemを示し、修正方法を説明するerror messageを書く。

conditions: Help people avoid errors before showing a message.
Place a necessary message as close to the problem as possible.
Avoid insincere interjections such as oops or uh-oh.
Rethink the interaction when language alone can't resolve a widespread error.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0011.review_note: Consolidated the coherent error-message checklist and excluded the unhelpful example wording.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0012.title: Choose a delivery method that fits the message

statement.en: Choose a message delivery method and tone that fit the situation.
statement.ja: 状況に合うmessage delivery methodとtoneを選ぶ。

conditions: Assess urgency, importance, viewing context, immediate-action needs, and supporting-information needs.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0012.review_note: Recorded all five delivery factors and the matching tone.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0013.title: Keep settings labels practical and clear

statement.en: Use practical, clear labels that help people find settings.
statement.ja: settingを見つけやすくするpracticalでclearなlabelを使う。

conditions: Add an explanation when the label alone is insufficient.
Describe the enabled behavior and let people infer the disabled behavior.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0013.review_note: Recorded explanation fallback and enabled-state description.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0014.title: Label text fields and show useful hints

statement.en: Label text fields clearly and use hint text to show the expected information or format.
statement.ja: text fieldをclearにlabelし、hint textで期待する情報またはformatを示す。

conditions: Place errors beside the field and explain correct input.
Prefer corrective instructions over scolding.
Avoid robotic messages that provide no helpful information.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0014.review_note: Combined the coherent field-label, hint, and adjacent corrective-error checklist.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0015.title: Define the app’s voice

statement.en: Define an app voice that reflects its audience, values, vocabulary, and intended feeling.
statement.ja: audience、value、vocabulary、意図するfeelingを反映するapp voiceを定義する。

conditions: Maintain a list of common terms and use it to keep language consistent.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0015.review_note: Recorded audience, vocabulary, feeling, values, and terminology consistency.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0016.title: Place important information first

statement.en: Place the most important information first on each screen.
statement.ja: 各screenで最もimportantなinformationを最初に配置する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0016.review_note: Recovered the direct information-order rule from supporting prose.

statement.en: Format text to make it easy to read.
statement.ja: textを読みやすくformatする。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0018.title: Consider splitting multiple ideas across screens

statement.en: When text conveys multiple ideas, consider splitting it across screens.
statement.ja: textが複数のideaを伝える場合、screen間への分割を検討する。

conditions: Preserve a coherent information flow between the screens.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0018.review_note: Preserved the source's Consider strength and cross-screen flow.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0019.title: Use verbs for button and link labels

statement.en: Prefer verbs when labeling buttons and links.
statement.ja: buttonとlinkのlabelにはverbを優先する。

conditions: The source describes this as almost always best, not an unconditional grammar rule.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0019.review_note: Recovered label-level guidance and preserved its almost-always qualification.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0020.title: Avoid Click here link labels

statement.en: Avoid using “Click here” as link text.
statement.ja: link textに「Click here」を使うことを避ける。

conditions: Use descriptive link words or phrases.
Descriptive links are especially important for screen-reader users.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0020.review_note: Recovered the accessibility-relevant link-label discouragement without promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0021.title: Build reusable language patterns

statement.en: Build reusable language patterns to keep the app familiar and cohesive.
statement.ja: appをfamiliarかつcohesiveに保つreusableなlanguage patternを作る。

conditions: Reuse established patterns to make future writing easier and more consistent.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0021.review_note: Activated the omitted language-pattern lead and recorded both user and authoring benefits.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0022.title: Indicate when a multistep flow is complete

statement.en: Make it clear when a multistep flow is complete.
statement.ja: multistep flowの完了をclearに示す。

conditions: Use completion language such as Done where appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0022.review_note: Recovered the flow-end state separately from start and transition labels.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0023.title: Avoid ambiguous we language

statement.en: Avoid using “we” when the referent may be unclear.
statement.ja: referentが不明確になり得る場合は「we」を避ける。

conditions: The ambiguity is especially problematic in error messages.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0023.review_note: Recovered the named pronoun warning and its error-message risk.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0024.title: Use correct gesture terms for each device

statement.en: Ensure gesture terminology is correct for each device.
statement.ja: gesture terminologyを各deviceに対して正しくする。

conditions: Use tap rather than click for touch interaction on iPhone and iPad.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0024.review_note: Recovered MUST from Make sure and preserved the touch-device terminology example.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0025.title: Keep text brief on compact and distant displays

statement.en: Keep text brief on small screens and on displays viewed from a distance.
statement.ja: small screenと離れて見るdisplayではtextをbriefにする。

conditions: iPhone and Apple Watch have small screens.
TV text must be large enough to read at a distance.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0025.review_note: Recovered the shared brevity outcome for opposite screen-size reasons.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0026.title: Consider the audience for shared TV messages

statement.en: For messages on a shared TV, consider who the text addresses.
statement.ja: shared TV上のmessageではtextが誰に向けられるかを検討する。

conditions: TVs often occupy common living spaces where several people can see the screen.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0026.review_note: Preserved the source's consider strength and shared-space condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0027.title: Keep empty-state content useful and contextual

statement.en: Ensure empty-state content is useful and fits its context.
statement.ja: empty-state contentをusefulにし、そのcontextへ適合させる。

conditions: An empty state may welcome people, teach the app, or express its voice.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0027.review_note: Recovered MUST from Make sure and retained the allowed empty-state purposes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0028.title: Avoid crucial information in temporary empty states

statement.en: Avoid showing crucial information only in a temporary empty state.
statement.ja: temporaryなempty stateだけにcrucial informationを表示することを避ける。

conditions: The information would disappear when the empty state ends.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0028.review_note: Separated the explicit don't clause and retained AVOID rather than promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0029.title: Link directly to referenced settings

statement.en: When directing someone to a setting, provide a direct link or button.
statement.ja: settingへ案内するときdirect linkまたはbuttonを提供する。

conditions: Do not rely on prose that describes the setting's location.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-WRITING-0029.review_note: Recovered the conditional direct-navigation rule and its prose-location alternative.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0001.title: Use charts to highlight important dataset information

statement.en: Use a chart when its visual prominence helps highlight important information in a dataset.
statement.ja: visual prominenceがdatasetのimportant informationを強調する場合にchartを使う。

conditions: Clearly communicate what people can learn from the data they care about.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0001.review_note: Recorded the prominence condition and the required learning focus.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0002.title: Keep charts simple and reveal details on demand

statement.en: Keep a chart simple and let people reveal additional data or functionality when they want it.
statement.ja: chartをsimpleに保ち、追加dataやfunctionalityを必要時に表示できるようにする。

conditions: Avoid packing in data that obscures relationships or overwhelms the chart.
Offer levels of detail or data subsets that match people's interests.
For complex interactive charts, consider progressively introducing more capable versions.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0002.review_note: Recorded overload risks and all three progressive-disclosure techniques.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0003.title: Make every chart accessible

statement.en: Ensure every chart is accessible.
statement.ja: すべてのchartをaccessibleにする。

conditions: Provide accessibility labels that describe chart values and components.
Provide accessibility elements that let people interact with the chart.
Visible descriptions do not replace accessibility labels or elements.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0003.review_note: Classified the all-chart crucial accessibility outcome as MUST and preserved both required accessibility mechanisms.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0004.title: Size charts for their function and detail

statement.en: Match chart size to its functionality, topic, interactivity, and level of detail.
statement.ja: chart sizeをfunctionality、topic、interactivity、detail levelへ合わせる。

conditions: Provide enough room for readable labels, annotations, and interaction.
A small chart may show glanceable information or preview a larger chart.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0004.review_note: Recorded full-size readability and interactivity plus the glanceable preview exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0005.title: Keep related charts visually consistent

statement.en: Keep charts with similar purposes visually consistent unless a difference needs emphasis.
statement.ja: 同様の目的を持つchartは、differenceの強調が必要な場合を除きvisualに一貫させる。

conditions: Use consistent chart types and styles so learning transfers between charts.
Consider a different type or style only to highlight a meaningful difference.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0005.review_note: Preserved the meaningful-difference exception and learning-transfer rationale.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0006.title: Maintain continuity across views of one dataset

statement.en: Maintain visual continuity among charts that show the same dataset.
statement.ja: 同じdatasetを示すchart間でvisual continuityを保つ。

conditions: Keep chart type, colors, annotations, layout, marks, and descriptive text consistent across overview and detail views.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0006.review_note: Recorded every continuity channel named by the source.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0007.title: Prefer familiar chart types

statement.en: Generally prefer familiar chart types such as bar charts and line charts.
statement.ja: 通常はbar chartやline chartなどfamiliarなchart typeを優先する。

conditions: Familiar types make it more likely that people already know how to read the chart.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0007.review_note: Activated the omitted lead and preserved its In general qualification.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0008.title: Teach people how to read novel charts

statement.en: When a chart presents data in a novel way, help people learn how to interpret it.
statement.ja: chartがnovelな方法でdataを示す場合、解釈方法を学べるよう支援する。

conditions: Introduce novel visual encodings and explain how they map to the represented metrics.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0008.review_note: Activated the conditional novel-chart onboarding rule and generalized the source example without persisting it.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0009.title: Examine data from multiple perspectives

statement.en: Examine data at macro, subset, and individual-point levels to find useful chart details.
statement.ja: dataをmacro、subset、individual pointのlevelで調べ、有用なchart detailを見つける。

conditions: Use high-level summaries, useful subsets, and specific values or items to support different perspectives.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0009.review_note: Activated the omitted lead and preserved all three levels of analysis.

HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0010.title: Add descriptive text to charts

statement.en: Add concise descriptive text that helps people understand a chart’s essential information and takeaways.
statement.ja: chartのessential informationとtakeawayを理解できるconciseなdescriptive textを加える。

conditions: Use titles, subtitles, annotations, headlines, or summaries as appropriate.
A descriptive headline or summary never replaces accessibility labels.
HIG-PATTERNS-CHARTING-DATA-0010.review_note: Activated the omitted descriptive-text rule, recorded every text role, and preserved the accessibility-label boundary.

HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.title: Place the Share button where sharing is easy to start

statement.en: Place the Share button in a convenient location so people can easily start sharing or collaborating.
statement.ja: sharingやcollaborationを簡単に始められる便利な位置にShare buttonを置く。

conditions: A toolbar is one suitable location.
HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.review_note: Concretized the placement outcome and preserved sharing and collaboration as the two supported starts.

HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.title: Summarize sharing permissions succinctly

statement.en: Use succinct phrases to summarize the sharing permissions the collaboration supports.
statement.ja: collaborationが対応するsharing permissionを簡潔なphraseで要約する。

conditions: The summary appears on the button that reveals the sharing options.
Communicate who can access the content and what changes they can make.
HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.review_note: Concretized the permission-summary role and the access and editing concepts it needs to communicate.

HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.title: Keep collaboration setup options simple

statement.en: Provide a simple set of sharing options that streamlines collaboration setup.
statement.ja: collaboration setupを効率化するsimpleなsharing optionの組を提供する。

conditions: Offer only choices that reflect the supported collaboration functionality.
Keep custom choices to a minimum.
Group choices so people can understand them at a glance.
HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.review_note: Recorded the simplicity outcome plus the source's minimum-choice and glanceable-grouping constraints.

HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.title: Limit collaboration popover custom actions to essentials

statement.en: Add custom actions to the collaboration popover only when they are needed.
statement.ja: 必要な場合に限りcollaboration popoverへcustom actionを追加する。

conditions: Offer only essential items people need while collaborating.
Avoid overwhelming people with too much information.

HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.title: Show the Collaboration button when collaboration starts

HIG-PATTERNS-COLLABORATION-AND-SHARING-0.title: Consider customizing the collaboration-management title

HIG-COMPONENTS-STEPPERS-0002.title: Consider a text field for large stepper changes

statement.en: When large value changes are likely, consider pairing a stepper with a text field.

conditions: A standalone stepper suits small changes that require only a few taps or clicks.

HIG-COMPONENTS-STEPPERS-0005.title: Make the value a stepper changes obvious

conditions: A stepper doesn't display a value itself.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0001.title: Ensure snippet custom content remains legible

statement.en: Ensure a snippet's custom content remains legible against the system background.
statement.ja: snippetのcustom contentをsystem backgroundに対して読みやすく保つ。

conditions: Check sufficient contrast in both light and dark appearances.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0002.title: Keep snippet content concise

statement.ja: snippet contentを短く読みやすく保つ。

conditions: Snippets support lightweight, quick interactions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0002.review_note: Recovered both brevity and easy-legibility outcomes from the supporting source context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0003.title: Give a confirmation snippet's primary button a descriptive label

conditions: Use an appropriate system label or provide a custom label.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0004.title: Communicate a snippet's purpose visually

conditions: The spoken app-intent dialogue remains essential when someone isn't looking at the screen.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0005.title: Keep consistent margins within a snippet custom view

conditions: Consistent margins clarify layout and support quick interpretation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0005.review_note: Split the independent margin outcome from the contrast check in the same source sentence.

statement.en: Ensure a snippet custom view doesn't exceed 400 points in height.

conditions: The maximum helps keep all custom-view content visible.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0006.review_note: Classified the explicit no-taller-than 400-point maximum as a platform-contract MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0007.title: Account for preferred text sizes in snippet content

statement.en: When deciding how much text to include in a snippet, account for people's preferred text sizes.
statement.ja: snippetに含めるtext量を決める際は利用者のpreferred text sizeを考慮する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0007.review_note: Recovered the Dynamic Type context without promoting Be mindful language to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0008.title: Deep-link detailed result content to the app

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0008.review_note: Recovered the result-snippet condition and the explicit in-app alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0009.title: Don't rely on dialogue text to convey a snippet's purpose

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0010.title: Prefer omitting dialogue text from a snippet's visual view

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0010.review_note: Preserved the Prefer strength and the distinction between visual omission and spoken accessibility.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0011.title: Avoid snippets on unsupported platforms

HIG-COMPONENTS-SNIPPETS-0011.review_note: Recorded the descriptive platform limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0001.title: Use familiar minimum-to-maximum slider directions

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0002.review_note: Preserved the optional Consider strength and recorded the distinct text-entry and increment purposes.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0010.title: Customize a slider only when it adds value

conditions: Track color, thumb image or tint, and endpoint icons can blend with the app design or communicate intent.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0010.review_note: Recovered the qualified customization directive and its design or communication purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SLIDERS-0011.title: Avoid sliders on tvOS

statement.en: Avoid using sliders on tvOS.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0048.title: Avoid modifying or replicating the purchase confirmation sheet

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0049.title: Mention Family Sharing prominently near offer information

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0050.title: Show context that identifies each recent purchase

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0052.title: Ensure purchase help doesn't obstruct refund requests

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0053.title: Avoid burying the refund-request button

statement.ja: 追加informationの入力要求をsubscription signup後まで延期する。

conditions: Ask only for information necessary to complete initial signup.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0062.title: Ensure free-trial users know automatic billing follows

statement.en: Ensure people know that automatic billing begins when a free trial ends.
statement.ja: free trial終了時にautomatic billingが始まることを利用者へ知らせる。

conditions: The subscription includes a free trial that converts to a paid period.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0062.review_note: Recovered the particularly-important Make sure billing disclosure as MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0063.title: Consider one-time codes for small or restricted distribution

statement.en: Consider one-time offer codes for small distributions or when access must be restricted.
statement.ja: 小規模配布またはaccess制限が必要な場合はone-time offer codeを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0063.review_note: Recovered both source conditions for the one-time-code option.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0064.title: Consider a custom code for a large campaign

statement.en: Consider a custom offer code for a large campaign that needs mass distribution.
statement.ja: mass distributionが必要な大規模campaignではcustom offer codeを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0064.review_note: Recovered the campaign-scale condition for custom codes.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0065.title: Avoid special characters in custom offer codes

statement.en: Avoid special characters, including Chinese and Arabic characters, in custom offer codes.
statement.ja: custom offer codeでChineseやArabicを含むspecial characterを使わない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0065.review_note: Recovered the direct Don't clause separately from the positive ASCII constraint.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0066.title: Explain where custom offer codes can be redeemed

statement.en: Tell people that custom offer codes can be redeemed through a redemption URL or within the app.
statement.ja: custom offer codeをredemption URLまたはapp内でredeemできると伝える。

conditions: Custom codes cannot be redeemed by entering them in App Store account settings.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0066.review_note: Recovered the omitted custom-code redemption-channel guidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0067.title: Consider a promotional image for offer redemption

statement.en: Consider an engaging, informative promotional image that communicates content value during offer redemption.
statement.ja: offer redemptionでcontent valueを伝えるengagingでinformativeなpromotional imageを検討する。

exceptions: If no promotional image is supplied, the system uses the app icon.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0067.review_note: Classified the source's explicitly optional promotional image at MAY.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0068.title: Welcome subscribers who redeem before first launch

statement.en: Be prepared to welcome people who subscribe before opening the app for the first time.
statement.ja: app初回起動前にsubscribeした利用者を迎えられるようにする。

conditions: Align the first app experience with the subscriber's already-unlocked status.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0069.title: Keep required account setup smooth after redemption

statement.en: Keep required account creation or sign-in smooth for new subscribers after redemption.
statement.ja: redemption後のnew subscriberに必要なaccount creationまたはsign-inを円滑にする。

conditions: The app requires an account or sign-in before use.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0069.review_note: Recovered the conditional post-redemption account-flow guidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0070.title: Explain subscription benefits during onboarding

statement.en: During onboarding, explain what people gain by subscribing.
statement.ja: onboarding中にsubscriptionで得られるbenefitを説明する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-IN-APP-PURCHASE-0070.review_note: Recovered the omitted subscription-benefit onboarding outcome.

statement.en: Make iCloud support automatic and easy to use.
statement.ja: iCloud supportを自動的で使いやすいものにする。

conditions: People have enabled iCloud in Settings and expect the app to work with it automatically.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0001.review_note: Replaced the generated meta-statement with the source's automatic, transparent iCloud-use outcome.

statement.en: Avoid asking people to choose individual documents to keep in iCloud.
statement.ja: iCloudに保存する個別documentを利用者に選ばせない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0002.review_note: Preserved the direct Avoid strength and clarified that the discouraged choice is per document.

statement.en: Keep iCloud content current when storage and bandwidth constraints allow.
statement.ja: storageとbandwidthの制約が許す範囲でiCloud contentを最新に保つ。

conditions: Balance freshness against device storage and bandwidth constraints.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0003.review_note: Preserved SHOULD because the lead is qualified by when possible and recorded the resource constraints.

statement.en: Use iCloud storage selectively and respect that it is finite.
statement.ja: 有限なiCloud storageを尊重し選択的に使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0004.review_note: Replaced the generic generated wording with the finite-resource constraint.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0005.title: Ensure the app behaves appropriately when iCloud is unavailable

statement.en: Ensure the app behaves appropriately when iCloud is unavailable.
statement.ja: iCloudが利用できない場合もappが適切に動作するようにする。

conditions: Handle iCloud being disabled or temporarily unavailable.
exceptions: An alert is not required merely because iCloud is unavailable.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0005.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure directive and preserved the no-alert exception.

statement.en: Keep useful cross-device app state information in iCloud.
statement.ja: device間で役立つapp state informationをiCloudに保存する。

exceptions: Store a setting only when people want it applied to all their devices.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0006.review_note: Clarified that the state is intended to support cross-device continuity.

statement.en: Warn people that deleting an iCloud document removes it from every device.
statement.ja: iCloud documentの削除がすべてのdeviceからの削除になることを警告する。

conditions: Apply before deleting a document from an app that supports iCloud.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0007.review_note: Made the deletion consequence explicit without promoting the direct warning guidance to MUST.

statement.en: Make iCloud version-conflict resolution prompt and easy.
statement.ja: iCloudのversion conflictを迅速かつ容易に解決できるようにする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0008.review_note: Replaced the generated meta-statement with the source's conflict-resolution outcome.

statement.en: Include a person's iCloud content in search results.
statement.ja: 利用者のiCloud contentをsearch resultに含める。

statement.en: For a game, consider saving player progress in iCloud.
statement.ja: gameではplayer progressをiCloudに保存することを検討する。

conditions: GameSave can synchronize save data and help handle offline or conflicting saves.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0010.review_note: Retained MAY from the explicit consider qualifier and recorded GameSave as an implementation option.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0011.title: Offer a simple all-data or no-data iCloud choice when needed

statement.en: If people may need to choose iCloud use, offer one simple all-data or no-data option at first launch.
statement.ja: iCloud利用を選べる必要がある場合、初回起動時に全dataか未使用かの単純な選択肢を示す。

conditions: Apply only when people may reasonably want to choose whether the app uses iCloud.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0011.review_note: Recovered the conditional first-launch choice without turning it into a universal prompt requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0012.title: Consider how the app handles and exposes iCloud content

statement.en: Consider how the app handles and exposes iCloud content.
statement.ja: appがiCloud contentを扱い表示する方法を検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0012.review_note: Recovered the explicit consider clause at MAY.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0013.title: Automate iCloud file-management tasks where possible

statement.en: Automate more iCloud file-management tasks where possible.
statement.ja: 可能な範囲でiCloudのfile-management taskを自動化する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0013.review_note: Recovered the try-qualified automation recommendation without raising it to MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0014.title: Balance content freshness against device constraints

statement.en: Balance iCloud content freshness against device storage and bandwidth constraints.
statement.ja: iCloud contentの鮮度とdevice storageおよびbandwidthの制約を両立する。

conditions: Apply when deciding how and when iCloud content updates.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit need-to balance as a bounded MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0015.title: Indicate when a newer iCloud document version is available

statement.en: Indicate when a more recent document version is available in iCloud.
statement.ja: より新しいdocument versionがiCloudにあることを示す。

conditions: Apply when the app lets people control downloads of updated large documents.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0016.title: Provide subtle feedback for longer iCloud downloads

statement.en: Provide subtle feedback when an iCloud document download takes more than a few seconds.
statement.ja: iCloud documentのdownloadに数秒以上かかる場合は控えめなfeedbackを示す。

conditions: A document is updating and the download lasts more than a few seconds.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0017.title: Use iCloud for information people create and understand

statement.en: Use iCloud to store information people create and understand.
statement.ja: 利用者が作成し理解できるinformationをiCloudに保存する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0018.title: Avoid storing regenerable app resources in iCloud

statement.en: Avoid using iCloud for app resources or content the app can regenerate.
statement.ja: app resourceや再生成できるcontentにiCloudを使わない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0018.review_note: Recovered the direct Avoid clause without promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0019.title: Limit content placed in the Documents folder

statement.en: Be selective about content placed in the Documents folder to limit iCloud backup use.
statement.ja: iCloud backup使用量を抑えるためDocuments folderに置くcontentを選別する。

conditions: iCloud backups include every app's Documents folder even when the app does not otherwise support iCloud.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0019.review_note: Recovered the Documents-folder storage recommendation and its backup context.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0020.title: Ensure iCloud settings are appropriate across devices

statement.en: Ensure every setting stored in iCloud is one people want applied across all their devices.
statement.ja: iCloudに保存するsettingを利用者がすべてのdeviceへ適用したいものに限定する。

conditions: Apply when the app uses iCloud to store settings.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0020.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure requirement as MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0021.title: Ask for confirmation before deleting an iCloud document

statement.en: Ask for confirmation before deleting an iCloud document.
statement.ja: iCloud documentを削除する前に確認を求める。

conditions: Deletion removes the document from iCloud and every connected device.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0021.review_note: Recovered confirmation separately from the warning rule and retained SHOULD for the direct imperative.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0022.title: Resolve version conflicts automatically where possible

statement.en: Detect and resolve iCloud version conflicts automatically where possible.
statement.ja: 可能な範囲でiCloudのversion conflictを自動検出して解決する。

conditions: Automatic resolution is feasible without hiding a meaningful user choice.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0023.title: Provide an unobtrusive conflict-choice notification

statement.en: When automatic resolution fails, unobtrusively help people distinguish and choose between conflicting versions.
statement.ja: 自動解決できない場合は控えめな通知でconflicting versionを区別し選べるようにする。

conditions: The app cannot resolve an iCloud version conflict automatically.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0023.review_note: Recovered the conditional notification and version-choice behavior.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0024.title: Consider user-controlled downloads for very large documents

statement.en: For very large documents, consider letting people choose when updated content downloads.
statement.ja: 非常に大きなdocumentでは更新contentをdownloadする時期を利用者が選べるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: The app works with documents large enough to make automatic updates costly.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0024.review_note: Recovered the surrounding may-be-better option at MAY and preserved the very-large-document condition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0025.title: Consider unobtrusive feedback while iCloud is unavailable

statement.en: Consider unobtrusively explaining that changes cannot reach other devices until iCloud access returns.
statement.ja: iCloud accessが戻るまで変更が他deviceへ届かないことを控えめに伝えることを検討する。

conditions: People can continue making changes while iCloud is unavailable.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ICLOUD-0025.review_note: Recovered the surrounding may-still-be-helpful option at MAY.

section_path: Referencing HomeKit and the Home app

statement.en: If desired, use Apple with HomeKit to form Apple HomeKit.
statement.ja: 必要に応じてHomeKitにAppleを付けてApple HomeKitと表記する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0020.review_note: Corrected SHOULD to MAY because the source explicitly qualifies the naming option with if desired.

section_path: Referencing HomeKit and the Home app

statement.en: If desired, use HomeKit in setup, configuration, and instructional text.
statement.ja: 必要に応じてsetup、configuration、instructional textでHomeKitを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0021.review_note: Corrected SHOULD to MAY because the source explicitly qualifies this terminology option with if desired.

statement.en: A HomeKit-integrated app may help people set up, name, and organize accessories.
statement.ja: HomeKit-integrated appはaccessoryのsetup、naming、organizationを支援できる。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0024.review_note: Corrected the example capability from SHOULD to MAY and narrowed it to the iOS, tvOS, and watchOS apps named by the source.

statement.en: A HomeKit-integrated app may provide fine-grained accessory configuration and control.
statement.ja: HomeKit-integrated appはfine-grainedなaccessory configurationとcontrolを提供できる。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0025.review_note: Corrected the example capability from SHOULD to MAY and applied the source's explicit app-platform scope.

statement.en: A HomeKit-integrated app may provide access to custom accessory features.
statement.ja: HomeKit-integrated appはcustom accessory featureへのaccessを提供できる。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0026.review_note: Corrected the example capability from SHOULD to MAY and applied the source's explicit app-platform scope.

statement.en: A HomeKit-integrated app may teach people to create hands-free automations.
statement.ja: HomeKit-integrated appはhands-free automationの作成方法を案内できる。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0027.review_note: Corrected the example capability from SHOULD to MAY and applied the source's explicit app-platform scope.

statement.en: A HomeKit-integrated app may provide accessory support.
statement.ja: HomeKit-integrated appはaccessory supportを提供できる。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0028.review_note: Corrected the example capability from SHOULD to MAY and applied the source's explicit app-platform scope.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0029.title: Ensure service names use only allowed characters

statement.en: Use only alphanumeric characters, spaces, and apostrophes in HomeKit service names.
statement.ja: HomeKit service nameにはalphanumeric character、space、apostropheだけを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0029.review_note: Raised the stable character rule to MUST because it appears under the explicit make sure naming-rules requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0030.title: Never include emojis in HomeKit service names

statement.en: Never include emojis in HomeKit service names.
statement.ja: HomeKit service nameにemojiを含めない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0030.review_note: Raised the named prohibition to MUST_NOT because it is one of the rules covered by the explicit make sure requirement.

statement.en: Reference the HomeKit hierarchy when helping people set up or control accessories.
statement.ja: accessoryのsetupまたはcontrolを支援するときHomeKit hierarchyを参照する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0040.review_note: Recovered the omitted hierarchy-model guidance without persisting voice-command examples.

statement.en: Avoid hiding related HomeKit details in hard-to-discover settings.
statement.ja: 関連するHomeKit detailを見つけにくいsettingsへ隠さない。

exceptions: Prefer making zone, room, and related details available in an accessory detail view.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0041.review_note: Separated the embedded direct don't clause from the broader accessory-detail recommendation.

statement.en: Always defer to the home settings people made in the Home app.
statement.ja: Home appで利用者が行ったhome settingsを常に優先する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0042.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always source-of-truth requirement.

statement.en: Avoid using the word service in app UI.
statement.ja: app UIでserviceという語を使わない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0043.review_note: Recovered the source's UI terminology exclusion and retained direct don't strength.

statement.en: Use a descriptive feature name for each HomeKit service in app UI.
statement.ja: app UIでは各HomeKit serviceにdescriptive feature nameを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0044.review_note: Separated the positive naming alternative from the UI-term exclusion.

statement.en: Avoid using the word characteristic in app UI.
statement.ja: app UIでcharacteristicという語を使わない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0045.review_note: Recovered the source's second UI terminology exclusion and retained direct don't strength.

statement.en: Use a descriptive attribute term for each HomeKit characteristic in app UI.
statement.ja: app UIでは各HomeKit characteristicにdescriptive attribute termを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0046.review_note: Separated the positive attribute-term alternative from the UI-term exclusion.

statement.en: Always use scene instead of action set in app UI.
statement.ja: app UIではaction setではなく常にsceneを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0047.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always UI terminology requirement.

statement.en: Honor a person's choice to use HomeKit for accessory setup.
statement.ja: HomeKitでaccessoryをsetupする利用者の選択を尊重する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0048.review_note: Recovered the setup-choice principle separately from its direct don't clause.

statement.en: Avoid forcing setup of other platforms during the HomeKit setup flow.
statement.ja: HomeKit setup flow中に他platformのsetupを強制しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0049.review_note: Separated the direct don't clause and retained AVOID.

statement.en: Always begin accessory setup with the system-provided flow.
statement.ja: accessory setupは常にsystem-provided flowから始める。

conditions: Offer a custom post-setup experience only after basic accessory functionality is available.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0050.review_note: Split the explicit Always requirement from the optional custom post-setup guidance.

statement.en: Suggest service names that suit the accessory and work well with Siri.
statement.ja: accessoryに適しSiriで使いやすいservice nameを提案する。

conditions: Recommend alternatives when a person enters a suboptimal voice-control name.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0051.review_note: Recovered the positive naming recommendation separately from the Never prohibition.

statement.en: Never suggest company names or model numbers as HomeKit service names.
statement.ja: company nameまたはmodel numberをHomeKit service nameとして提案しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0052.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never naming prohibition.

statement.en: Ensure service names changed in the app follow all HomeKit naming rules.
statement.ja: app内で変更するservice nameがすべてのHomeKit naming ruleに従うようにする。

conditions: Explain invalid input briefly and suggest valid alternatives.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0053.review_note: Recovered the explicit make sure requirement that governs the three naming rules.

statement.en: Ensure every HomeKit service name starts and ends with an alphanumeric character.
statement.ja: すべてのHomeKit service nameの先頭と末尾をalphanumeric characterにする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0054.review_note: Recovered the second mandatory naming-rule outcome from the make sure list.

statement.en: After setup, consider teaching people about more complex Siri commands.
statement.ja: setup後により複雑なSiri commandを案内することを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0055.review_note: Recovered the optional post-setup education guidance at its explicit consider strength.

statement.en: Recommend useful zones and service groups when they fit the accessory.
statement.ja: accessoryに適する場合は有用なzoneとservice groupを提案する。

conditions: Use these structures to support context-specific voice commands.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0056.review_note: Recovered the omitted zone and service-group recommendation.

statement.en: Ensure people can clearly identify what is possible with shortcuts.
statement.ja: shortcutで可能なことを利用者が明確に識別できるようにする。

conditions: Apply when the app supports both HomeKit and shortcuts.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0057.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure clarity requirement.

statement.en: Never encourage a shortcut for a scene or action HomeKit already supports.
statement.ja: HomeKitがすでにsupportするsceneまたはaction向けshortcutを勧めない。

conditions: Apply when the app supports both HomeKit and shortcuts.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0058.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never duplication prohibition separately from shortcut clarity.

statement.en: Never overwrite HomeKit database settings without a person's explicit direction.
statement.ja: 利用者のexplicit directionなしにHomeKit database settingsを上書きしない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0059.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never user-intent safeguard.

statement.en: Avoid creating or imitating a HomeKit or Home app icon design.
statement.ja: HomeKitまたはHome app icon designを独自作成または模倣しない。

conditions: Use only Apple-provided icon artwork.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0060.review_note: Separated the direct don't clause from the positive official-icon guidance.

statement.en: Use a black HomeKit icon on a white or light background when other technology icons are black.
statement.ja: 他のtechnology iconがblackの場合はwhiteまたはlight background上でblack HomeKit iconを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0061.review_note: Recovered the complete black-icon and background condition.

statement.en: Use a white HomeKit icon on a black or dark background when other technology icons are white.
statement.ja: 他のtechnology iconがwhiteの場合はblackまたはdark background上でwhite HomeKit iconを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0062.review_note: Recovered the complete white-icon and background condition.

statement.en: Use a custom HomeKit icon color when other technology icons use the same color.
statement.ja: 他のtechnology iconが同じcolorを使う場合はcustom color HomeKit iconを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0063.review_note: Recovered the source's custom-color matching condition.

statement.en: Avoid using the HomeKit icon or name in custom interactive elements or buttons.
statement.ja: HomeKit iconまたはnameをcustom interactive elementやbuttonで使わない。

exceptions: The Apple Home app icon may open the app's App Store product page.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0064.review_note: Separated the direct don't clause and preserved the Apple Home app icon exception.

statement.en: Pair the HomeKit icon and name consistently with other referenced technologies.
statement.ja: HomeKit iconとnameを他のreferenced technologyと一貫した方法で組み合わせる。

conditions: Use the layout's existing font and place the name below or beside the icon when peers do the same.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0065.review_note: Recovered the omitted icon-and-name pairing guidance.

statement.en: Make HomeKit and Apple Home references less prominent than the app's identity.
statement.ja: HomeKitとApple Homeへのreferenceをapp identityより目立たなくする。

statement.en: Never place an Apple trademark in an app name or image.
statement.ja: Apple trademarkをapp nameまたはimageに含めない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0067.review_note: Recovered the source's explicit can't trademark prohibition.

statement.en: Use Apple product names exactly as shown on the Apple Trademark List.
statement.ja: Apple product nameをApple Trademark Listの表記どおりに使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0068.review_note: Separated the positive exact-name guidance from the trademark prohibition.

statement.en: Include correct credit lines for Apple, HomeKit, and other Apple trademarks wherever legal information appears.
statement.ja: legal informationを表示する場所ではApple、HomeKit、その他Apple trademarkの正しいcredit lineを含める。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0069.review_note: Recovered the omitted trademark-credit requirement without persisting legal text.

section_path: Referencing HomeKit and the Home app

statement.en: Use the complete name Apple Home on the first body-copy reference to the app.
statement.ja: body copyでappへ初めて言及するとき完全名Apple Homeを使う。

exceptions: Subsequent references may use the Home app.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HOMEKIT-0070.review_note: Recovered the first-mention naming rule and preserved the subsequent-mention exception.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0001.title: Ensure a clear privacy-policy URL for App Store submission

statement.en: Provide a URL to a clearly stated privacy policy during app submission.
statement.ja: app submission時に明確なprivacy policyへのURLを提供する。

conditions: Make the policy viewable from the app's App Store page.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0001.review_note: Raised the stable privacy-policy rule to MUST because the source explicitly says the URL must be provided during submission.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0006.title: Always preserve Activity-ring visual appearance

statement.en: Keep the visual appearance of Activity rings the same in every context.
statement.ja: Activity ringのvisual appearanceをすべてのcontextで同一に保つ。

conditions: Preserve the defined ring positions, colors, and background treatment.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0006.review_note: Raised the stable appearance rule to MUST because the source says the appearance must always remain the same.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0007.title: Ensure the required Activity-ring margin

statement.en: Include an outer margin at least as wide as the distance between Activity rings.
statement.ja: Activity ring間の距離以上のouter marginを確保する。

conditions: Apply the minimum to the complete Activity-ring element.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0007.review_note: Raised the stable margin rule to MUST and preserved the source's exact relational minimum.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0016.title: Never use Health app images or screenshots

statement.en: Never use copyrighted Health app images or screenshots in an app or marketing material.
statement.ja: copyrighted Health app imageやscreenshotをappまたはmarketing materialで使わない。

conditions: Use permitted Activity-ring elements for progress instead of Health app imagery.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0016.review_note: Raised the stable image rule to MUST_NOT because the source states copyrighted Health app designs can't appear in apps or marketing.

statement.en: Avoid requesting private health data when the app provides no health or fitness functionality.
statement.ja: appがhealthまたはfitness機能を提供しない場合はprivate health dataを要求しない。

conditions: Tie every requested health-data type to actual health or fitness functionality.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0021.review_note: Recovered the overview's purpose limitation and retained AVOID for the direct don't wording.

statement.en: Clearly show people how the app uses their health data.
statement.ja: appがhealth dataをどう使うかを利用者へ明確に示す。

conditions: Explain use after permission is granted as part of maintaining trust.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0022.review_note: Recovered the essential transparency guidance without promoting essential to explicit MUST wording.

statement.en: Add succinct messages to the standard health permission screen that explain the need and benefit.
statement.ja: standard health permission screenに必要性とbenefitを説明する簡潔なmessageを加える。

conditions: Describe both why the information is needed and how sharing benefits people.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0023.review_note: Recovered the standard-screen disclosure action and both required message topics.

statement.en: Avoid custom screens that replicate the standard health permission screen's behavior or content.
statement.ja: standard health permission screenのbehaviorまたはcontentを再現するcustom screenを避ける。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0024.review_note: Separated the direct Avoid clause from the positive standard-screen message guidance.

statement.en: Use system privacy settings as the sole place for managing health-data sharing.
statement.ja: health-data sharingの管理にはsystem privacy settingsだけを使う。

conditions: Let people manage health-information access globally in system Settings.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0025.review_note: Recovered the system-owned sharing-control boundary without upgrading the imperative lead to MUST.

statement.en: Avoid in-app screens that affect the flow of health data.
statement.ja: health dataのflowに影響するin-app screenを避ける。

conditions: Prevent app UI from appearing to override system health-data sharing controls.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0026.review_note: Separated the direct don't clause and retained AVOID.

statement.en: Avoid replicating or modifying Activity rings for other purposes or data.
statement.ja: Activity ringを他の目的やdata向けに複製または変更しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0027.review_note: Separated the direct don't clause from the source's explicit Never prohibition.

statement.en: Visually distinguish other ring-like elements from Activity rings.
statement.ja: 他のring-like elementをActivity ringから視覚的に区別する。

conditions: Use padding, lines, labels, color, or scale to provide separation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0028.review_note: Recovered the omitted differentiation rule and all listed separation techniques.

statement.en: Avoid repeating system-provided Move, Exercise, or Stand progress in app notifications.
statement.ja: systemが提供するMove、Exercise、Stand progressをapp notificationで繰り返さない。

exceptions: Reference Activity progress only through information unique to the app.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0029.review_note: Recovered the direct don't clause while preserving the app-specific reference exception.

statement.en: Avoid creating or imitating an Apple Health icon design.
statement.ja: Apple Health icon designを独自作成または模倣しない。

conditions: Use only Apple-provided artwork from Apple Design Resources.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0030.review_note: Separated the direct don't clause from the positive official-artwork rule.

statement.en: Avoid compositing the Apple Health icon onto another graphic element.
statement.ja: Apple Health iconを別のgraphic elementへ合成しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0031.review_note: Separated the direct don't clause from the icon clear-space recommendation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0032.title: Ensure permission precedes health-data access

statement.en: Request permission before accessing people's health data.
statement.ja: 利用者のhealth dataへaccessする前にpermissionを要求する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0032.review_note: Recovered the first explicit You must privacy requirement as an atomic permission rule.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0033.title: Ensure accessed health data is protected

statement.en: Take all necessary steps to protect people's health data.
statement.ja: 利用者のhealth dataを保護するために必要なすべての措置を取る。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0033.review_note: Recovered the second explicit You must privacy requirement separately from permission acquisition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0034.title: Request health data only when needed

statement.en: Request access to health data only in the context where it is needed.
statement.ja: health dataが必要なcontextでのみaccessを要求する。

conditions: Relate the request to the person's current task instead of presenting it at launch by default.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0034.review_note: Recovered contextual permission timing and kept the imperative lead at SHOULD.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0035.title: Never represent Activity progress with another ring style

statement.en: Never show Move, Exercise, or Stand progress in another ring-like element.
statement.ja: Move、Exercise、Stand progressを別のring-like elementで表示しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0035.review_note: Recovered the paragraph's explicit Never prohibition separately from the direct don't clause.

statement.en: Never use one Activity-ring element to represent more than one person.
statement.ja: 1つのActivity-ring elementで複数人を表現しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0036.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never multi-person prohibition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0037.title: Make sure the represented person is obvious

statement.en: Make it obvious whose progress an Activity-ring element represents.
statement.ja: Activity-ring elementが誰のprogressを表すかを明確にする。

conditions: Use a label, photo, or avatar when needed to establish identity.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0037.review_note: Recovered the make sure identity outcome separately from the single-person prohibition.

statement.en: Never display Activity rings in labels or background graphics.
statement.ja: Activity ringをlabelまたはbackground graphicに表示しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0038.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never ornamentation prohibition.

statement.en: Never use Activity rings in an app icon or marketing material.
statement.ja: Activity ringをapp iconまたはmarketing materialに使わない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0039.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never branding prohibition.

statement.en: Never alter Activity-ring or background appearance with filters, color changes, or opacity changes.
statement.ja: filter、color変更、opacity変更でActivity ringまたはbackgroundのappearanceを変えない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0040.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never appearance-modification prohibition and all named alteration types.

statement.en: Always scale Activity rings appropriately for their surrounding interface.
statement.ja: 周囲のinterfaceに対してActivity ringを常に適切なscaleにする。

conditions: Prevent the rings from appearing disconnected or out of place.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0041.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always scaling requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0042.title: Never encroach on Activity rings or their margin

statement.en: Never let other elements crop, obstruct, or encroach on Activity rings or their margin.
statement.ja: 他のelementがActivity ringまたはmarginをcrop、obstruct、encroachしないようにする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0042.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never spacing prohibition separately from the minimum-margin requirement.

statement.en: Never show an Activity-ring element in an app notification.
statement.ja: app notificationにActivity-ring elementを表示しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0043.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never notification prohibition separately from repeated progress content.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0044.title: Ensure authorization is requested whenever health-data access is needed
