statement.en: Make an authorization request every time the app needs access to health data.
statement.ja: appがhealth dataへのaccessを必要とするたびにauthorization requestを行う。

conditions: Account for people changing previously granted permissions.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-HEALTHKIT-0044.review_note: Recovered the source's needs-to requirement as an atomic permission-state safeguard.

statement.en: Display the Game Center access point in a game's persistent menu or settings screens.
statement.ja: Game Center access pointをgameのpersistent menuまたはsettings screenに表示する。

conditions: Place the access point where players can intentionally open Game Center outside active play.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0001.review_note: Recorded the recommended persistent-menu contexts; transient and active-play exclusions remain a separate AVOID rule.

statement.en: Avoid placing important controls near the Game Center access point.
statement.ja: important controlをGame Center access pointの近くに配置しない。

conditions: Account for all four supported corners and both collapsed and expanded access-point states.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0002.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the placement choices and expansion state that create overlap risk.

statement.en: Use official Apple-provided Game Center artwork in custom links.
statement.ja: custom linkにはofficial Apple-provided Game Center artworkを使う。

conditions: Use artwork from Apple Design Resources when custom UI refers to Game Center features.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0004.review_note: Recorded the official artwork source while keeping preservation and modification guidance atomic.

statement.en: Use Apple-specified Game Center terminology and system-provided localization in custom links.
statement.ja: custom linkではApple指定のGame Center terminologyとsystem-provided localizationを使う。

conditions: Use the table's names for Game Center, profiles, achievements, leaderboards, challenges, and adding friends.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0005.review_note: Reviewed the complete terminology table without persisting every incorrect-term example in the rule statement.

statement.en: Keep achievement titles and descriptions concise enough to fit their two-line limits.
statement.ja: achievement titleとdescriptionを各2行のlimitに収まる簡潔さにする。

conditions: Use title-style capitalization for titles and sentence-style capitalization for descriptions.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0006.review_note: Recorded the truncation limit and distinct capitalization conventions.

statement.en: Design rich, high-quality achievement images that feel rewarding and encourage return play.
statement.ja: rewardingに感じreturn playを促すrichでhigh-qualityなachievement imageを設計する。

conditions: Achievement artwork appears prominently in Game Center UI.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0008.review_note: Retained the quality recommendation and separated the no-reuse guidance into its own AVOID rule.

statement.en: Create achievement artwork using the source-linked platform size, mask, format, color-space, and resolution specifications.
statement.ja: source-linkedなplatform別size、mask、format、color-space、resolution specificationでachievement artworkを作成する。

conditions: Use the iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS table for those platforms and the separate tvOS table for tvOS.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0009.review_note: Kept table values as source-linked platform context while the explicit centering outcome remains a separate MUST.

statement.en: Create short, skill-based challenges with clear individual accomplishment measures.
statement.ja: 明確なindividual accomplishment measureを持つ短いskill-based challengeを作成する。

conditions: Target activities that take about one to five minutes and that each player can complete individually.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0011.review_note: Recorded the duration and individual-completion constraints without treating the range as a hard platform maximum.

statement.en: Make it easy for players to enter a Game Center challenge and reach playable content.
statement.ja: playerがGame Center challengeへ入りplayable contentへ到達しやすくする。

conditions: Support entry from invitation links, the Game Overlay, and the Games app where available.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0013.review_note: Kept the general entry outcome separate from the exact deep-link MUST and first-time onboarding rule.

statement.en: Create high-quality challenge artwork that encourages players to engage.
statement.ja: playerのengagementを促すhigh-qualityなchallenge artworkを作成する。

conditions: Artwork appears in the Game Overlay, Games app, and invitation-link previews.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0014.review_note: Retained the quality outcome while placement and text localization remain separate atomic rules.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0024.title: Choose achievement display order before upload

statement.en: Choose the intended achievement display order before uploading achievement files.
statement.ja: achievement fileをuploadする前に意図するachievement display orderを決める。

conditions: Game Center displays achievements in upload order.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0024.review_note: Replaced a generic generated statement with the irreversible ordering point from the source.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0025.title: Use leaderboard sets to organize multiple leaderboards

statement.en: Use leaderboard sets to help players find the right board when a game has multiple leaderboards.
statement.ja: 複数のleaderboardがあるgameではplayerが適切なboardを見つけられるようleaderboard setを使う。

conditions: Consider grouping sets by difficulty, activity type, genre, or gameplay theme.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0025.review_note: Corrected the generated fragment and retained the source's organization purpose.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0034.title: Check Game Center sign-in when the game launches

statement.en: When the game launches, determine whether the player is signed in to Game Center.
statement.ja: game launch時にplayerがGame Centerへsign inしているか確認する。

conditions: If the player isn't signed in, initialize them with Game Center at launch.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0034.review_note: Recovered the launch-time authentication sequence and corrected generated capitalization and grammar.

statement.en: Avoid displaying the Game Center access point during active play or transient introductory flows.
statement.ja: active play中またはtransient introductory flowでGame Center access pointを表示しない。

conditions: Transient flows include splash screens, cinematics, and tutorials before the main menu.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0035.review_note: Separated the explicit placement exclusions from the positive menu-screen recommendation.

statement.en: Verify that both collapsed and expanded access-point states don't overlap important UI or controls.
statement.ja: collapsedおよびexpandedの両access-point stateがimportant UIやcontrolと重ならないことを確認する。

conditions: Adjust the surrounding layout when either access-point state overlaps important content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0036.review_note: Recovered the two-state overlap check and its layout response.

statement.en: Preserve the appearance of Apple-provided Game Center artwork in custom links.
statement.ja: custom linkでApple-provided Game Center artworkのappearanceを保つ。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0037.review_note: Recovered the artwork-preservation recommendation separately from the modification AVOID.

statement.en: Avoid adjusting the dimensions or visual effects of Apple-provided Game Center artwork.
statement.ja: Apple-provided Game Center artworkのdimensionまたはvisual effectを調整しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0038.review_note: Retained AVOID for the direct Don't clause rather than promoting it to MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Map game achievements to Game Center's locked, in-progress, hidden, and completed states.
statement.ja: game achievementをGame Centerのlocked、in-progress、hidden、completed stateへ対応づける。

conditions: Use the four states to keep grouping and progress presentation consistent with Game Center.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0039.review_note: Recovered the complete achievement-state mapping without persisting surrounding descriptive prose.

statement.en: Avoid reusing the same image for more than one achievement.
statement.ja: 同じimageを複数のachievementで再利用しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0040.review_note: Recovered the direct Avoid as a distinct artwork-uniqueness rule.

statement.en: Create a unique image for each leaderboard that reflects its ranked gameplay.
statement.ja: 各leaderboardにranked gameplayを反映するunique imageを作成する。

conditions: Use compelling artwork to communicate the experience and attract competition.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0042.review_note: Recovered image uniqueness and gameplay relevance from the source's Aim directive.

statement.en: Use a single leaderboard image in iOS, iPadOS, and macOS games.
statement.ja: iOS、iPadOS、macOS gameではsingle leaderboard imageを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0043.review_note: Recovered and narrowed the static-image branch of the platform-specific artwork guidance.

statement.en: Provide a focusable image set for tvOS leaderboard artwork.
statement.ja: tvOS leaderboard artworkにはfocusable image setを提供する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0044.review_note: Recovered and narrowed the animated-focus branch of the platform-specific artwork guidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0045.review_note: Narrowed the explicit cropping requirement to the four platform contexts named by the source.

statement.en: Track each player's most recent score after every challenge attempt.
statement.ja: 各challenge attempt後にplayerのmost recent scoreを記録する。

conditions: Use recent scores instead of overall progress or personal bests to preserve a level playing field.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0046.review_note: Recovered the source-provided fair-scoring alternative to the existing AVOID rule.

statement.en: Help first-time players complete required onboarding before a challenge begins.
statement.ja: first-time playerがchallenge開始前に必要なonboardingを完了できるようにする。

conditions: If a tutorial is required, launch it first and explain that the challenge follows automatically.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0048.review_note: Recovered the first-time readiness path separately from the exact deep-link MUST.

statement.en: Avoid placing primary challenge artwork where the system's title or description can cover it.
statement.ja: systemのtitleまたはdescriptionが覆う位置にprimary challenge artworkを配置しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0049.review_note: Recovered the title-and-description overlay constraint as a direct AVOID.

statement.en: Provide localized versions of any text included in challenge images.
statement.ja: challenge imageに含めるtextのlocalized versionを提供する。

conditions: Supply localized artwork through App Store Connect or Xcode.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0050.review_note: Recovered the conditional artwork-localization action from the challenge-image paragraph.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0001.title: Offer AR only on devices with the required capabilities

statement.en: Offer AR features only on devices that support their required ARKit capabilities.
statement.ja: 必要なARKit capabilityをsupportするdeviceに限りAR featureを提供する。

conditions: If AR is the app's primary purpose, restrict availability to devices that support ARKit.
exceptions: For an optional unsupported feature, omit it instead of presenting an error.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0001.review_note: Recorded capability-based availability and the no-error fallback for optional AR features.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0010.title: Show when a surface is ready for object placement

statement.en: Show people when a surface is detected and object placement is possible.
statement.ja: surfaceが検出されobject placementが可能になった時点を示す。

conditions: Use the coaching view for surface discovery and a plane-aligned custom indicator for placement readiness.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0010.review_note: Replaced a malformed generated statement and recorded both discovery and placement feedback.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0030.title: Use AR badges only in mixed-viewability collections

statement.en: Use AR badges only when a collection mixes items that are viewable in AR with items that aren't.
statement.ja: ARでviewableなitemとそうでないitemが混在するcollectionに限りAR badgeを使う。

exceptions: Omit badges when every item can be viewed in AR because the badges are redundant.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0030.review_note: Restored the truncated candidate and retained the source's mixed-collection condition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0031.title: Keep AR badge placement consistent and clear

statement.en: Keep AR badge placement consistent and visually clear across object photos.
statement.ja: object photo全体でAR badgeのplacementを一貫させ明確に表示する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0031.review_note: Corrected the generated grammar while the separate Always and Make sure outcomes remain atomic MUST rules.

statement.en: Design AR experiences for varied real-world spaces, surfaces, and movement constraints.
statement.ja: 多様なreal-world space、surface、movement constraintに対応するAR experienceを設計する。

conditions: Communicate physical-environment requirements and expectations before people enter the experience.
exceptions: Consider different feature sets when environments impose meaningfully different constraints.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0036.review_note: Recovered the environment-variability guidance and its upfront-communication response.

statement.en: Introduce physical movement gradually when an AR experience encourages people to move.
statement.ja: AR experienceでmovementを促す場合はphysical movementを徐々に導入する。

conditions: Give people time to adapt before progressively encouraging more movement.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0037.review_note: Recovered the comfort-oriented gradual-motion recommendation without promoting it to MUST.

statement.en: Consider using the system coaching view during AR initialization and relocalization.
statement.ja: AR initializationおよびrelocalization中にsystem coaching viewの利用を検討する。

conditions: Use coaching to show required device movement and provide initialization feedback.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0038.review_note: Retained the optional Consider strength and recorded both documented lifecycle uses.

statement.en: When custom coaching is necessary, use the system coaching view as the interaction reference.
statement.ja: custom coachingが必要な場合はsystem coaching viewをinteraction referenceとして使う。

conditions: Custom coaching may supply additional information or a different visual style.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0039.review_note: Recovered the system-reference requirement within the conditional custom-coaching path.

statement.en: Integrate a placed object immediately using current surface data, then refine its position subtly if needed.
statement.ja: current surface dataでplaced objectを直ちに統合し、必要に応じてpositionを控えめに調整する。

conditions: Don't delay placement while progressive surface detection seeks more accurate data.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0040.review_note: Recovered the immediate-response and later-refinement sequence as one placement transition.

statement.en: Use plane classification to allow virtual-object placement only on appropriate surfaces.
statement.ja: plane classificationを使いvirtual objectを適切なsurfaceに限って配置できるようにする。

conditions: Match the accepted surface class to the object's real-world role.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0041.review_note: Recovered plane classification as a placement constraint rather than persisting the source examples.

statement.en: Keep AR object interactions simple by constraining movement or rotation when appropriate.
statement.ja: 必要に応じてmovementまたはrotationを制約しAR object interactionをsimpleに保つ。

conditions: Account for using two-dimensional touch gestures in a three-dimensional environment.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0042.review_note: Recovered the general simplification rule and retained the two listed constraints as techniques.

statement.en: Avoid using object scale as a proxy for distance.
statement.ja: object scaleをdistanceの代替として使わない。

conditions: Enlarging a distant object makes it larger but doesn't make it appear closer.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0043.review_note: Retained AVOID for the direct Don't and recorded the perception failure it causes.

statement.en: When possible, let new participants join an ongoing multiuser AR experience.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はnew participantが進行中のmultiuser AR experienceへ参加できるようにする。

exceptions: The experience may require every participant to join before it begins.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0044.review_note: Recovered the ongoing-join recommendation and preserved the all-participants-first exception.

statement.en: Consider delaying virtual-object removal briefly after its detected image disappears.
statement.ja: detected imageが消えた直後はvirtual objectの削除を短時間遅らせることを検討する。

conditions: A delay of up to one second can prevent attached virtual objects from flickering.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0045.review_note: Retained the optional Consider strength and treated one second as contextual guidance, not a mandatory timeout.

statement.en: Prefer no more than 100 active reference images at one time.
statement.ja: 同時にactiveにするreference imageは100個以下を優先する。

conditions: Image-detection performance works best at 100 or fewer active images.
exceptions: For larger libraries, change the active set based on context.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0046.review_note: Kept the performance recommendation below MUST because 100 is the best-performing range, not a platform maximum.

statement.en: Minimize reference images that require continuously accurate position tracking.
statement.ja: 継続的にaccurate position trackingを必要とするreference imageを最小限にする。

conditions: Use tracked images when an image may move or when attached content is small relative to it.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0047.review_note: Recovered the resource-cost recommendation and its two tracked-image conditions.

statement.en: Prefer contextual 3D hints in a three-dimensional experience.
statement.ja: three-dimensional experienceではcontextual 3D hintを優先する。

exceptions: Use a textual 2D overlay only when people don't respond to contextual hints.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0048.review_note: Recovered the dimensional-hint preference and its response-based overlay fallback.

statement.en: When more information is necessary, provide a visual indicator that reveals it on tap.
statement.ja: 追加情報が必要な場合はtapで情報を表示するvisual indicatorを提供する。

conditions: Fit the indicator's appearance to the AR experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0049.review_note: Recovered the conditional detail-access path without treating it as universally required.

statement.en: When AR analysis fails or stalls, suggest practical fixes in straightforward, friendly language.
statement.ja: AR analysisが失敗または停滞した場合はstraightforwardでfriendlyな表現でpractical fixを提案する。

conditions: Respond to known causes such as poor light, reflective or low-detail surfaces, and excessive camera motion.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AUGMENTED-REALITY-0050.review_note: Recovered actionable problem-resolution guidance while preserving the table examples as reference context.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0001.title: Use the system volume view for audio adjustments

statement.en: Use the system-provided volume view for user-controlled volume and audio rerouting.
statement.ja: 利用者によるvolume調整とaudio reroutingにはsystem-provided volume viewを使う。

conditions: The volume view provides a slider and an output-rerouting control.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0001.review_note: Retained the system-component recommendation and recorded both provided controls.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0002.title: Choose an audio category that fits sound use

statement.en: Choose the audio category that matches how the app or game uses sound.
statement.ja: appまたはgameのsound用途に合うaudio categoryを選ぶ。

conditions: Choose among five categories based on essentiality, mixing, background, recording, playback, and silence behavior.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0002.review_note: Retained SHOULD and preserved the five-row category table as source-linked decision context.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0003.title: Respond to audio controls only in an audio context

statement.en: Respond to external audio controls only when the app is in a clear audio-related context.
statement.ja: appが明確なaudio-related contextにある場合だけexternal audio controlへ応答する。

conditions: The app is playing audio, showing an audio context, or connected through Bluetooth or AirPlay.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0003.review_note: Retained SHOULD and made the three qualifying contexts explicit.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0004.title: Avoid repurposing audio controls

statement.en: Avoid redefining the meaning of standard audio controls.
statement.ja: standard audio controlの意味を再定義しない。

conditions: Preserve consistent audio-control behavior across apps.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0004.review_note: Retained AVOID despite the essential rationale because the source uses direct Avoid rather than an explicit prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0005.title: Consider custom audio controls only for unsupported commands

statement.en: Consider custom audio player controls only for commands the system doesn't support.
statement.ja: systemが対応しないcommandに限りcustom audio player controlを検討する。

conditions: Examples include custom skip increments or related content such as a sports score.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0005.review_note: Retained MAY and kept the only-if restriction within the optional custom-control decision.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0006.title: Ensure other apps can resume after temporary audio

statement.en: When temporary audio finishes, ensure interrupted apps can determine when to resume.
statement.ja: temporary audio終了時に中断されたappが再開時点を判断できるようにする。

conditions: Flag the audio session to notify other apps on deactivation.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0006.review_note: Raised the rule to MUST after confirming the explicit Be sure session-flag requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0014.title: Determine how to handle audio-session interruptions

statement.en: Determine how the app responds to audio-session interruptions.
statement.ja: appのaudio-session interruptionへの応答方法を決定する。

conditions: Use interruption details, the audio task, and privacy risk to choose the response.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0014.review_note: Retained the interruption decision and separated the explicit Smart Folio requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0030.title: Support audio rerouting when possible

statement.en: Support selecting another audio output unless a compelling reason prevents rerouting.
statement.ja: compelling reasonがない限り別のaudio outputの選択をsupportする。

conditions: People may choose speakers, a car radio, Apple TV, or another output.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0030.review_note: Recovered the rerouting recommendation and preserved its compelling-reason exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0031.title: Decide whether audio resumes after interruption

statement.en: When an interruption ends, decide whether audio should resume automatically.
statement.ja: interruption終了時にaudioを自動再開するか決定する。

conditions: Use both the interruption type and the app type.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0031.review_note: Recovered the post-interruption decision and removed the truncated conditional lead.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0032.title: Ensure audio follows volume and output expectations

statement.en: Ensure audio behaves as people expect when they change volume or output.
statement.ja: volumeまたはoutput変更時にaudioが期待どおり動作するようにする。

conditions: Apply whether sound is central to the experience or an embellishment.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0032.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit need-to-make-sure requirement in the overview.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0033.title: Respect silent mode for nonessential audio

statement.en: In silent mode, silence nonessential sounds and preserve explicitly initiated audio.
statement.ja: silent modeではnonessential soundを消音し、explicitly initiated audioを維持する。

conditions: Nonessential audio includes keyboard clicks, sound effects, game soundtracks, and audible feedback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0033.review_note: Recovered the silent-mode expectation as SHOULD rather than inventing an unconditional application-level MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0034.title: Avoid changing the overall system volume

statement.en: Avoid changing the overall system volume from the app.
statement.ja: appからoverall system volumeを変更しない。

conditions: The system volume governs final audio output.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0034.review_note: Split the direct Don't clause and retained it at AVOID instead of MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0035.title: Keep headphone connection rerouting uninterrupted

statement.en: When headphones connect, reroute audio automatically without interrupting playback.
statement.ja: headphone接続時にplaybackを中断せずaudioを自動rerouteする。

conditions: Audio is actively playing when headphones connect.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0035.review_note: Recovered the connection expectation as a conservative SHOULD rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0036.title: Avoid unnecessarily interrupting other-app audio

statement.en: Avoid making people stop other-app audio when the app doesn't need exclusive playback.
statement.ja: exclusive playbackが不要な場合はother-app audioを止めさせない。

conditions: Choose an audio category that can meet the app's needs without unnecessary interruption.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0036.review_note: Recovered the direct Don't example at AVOID.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0037.title: Avoid responding to unsupported audio controls

statement.en: If the app doesn't support an audio control, avoid responding to it.
statement.ja: appがaudio controlをsupportしない場合は応答しない。

conditions: Don't repurpose the unsupported control for another action.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0037.review_note: Recovered the direct Don't guidance at AVOID and kept it separate from repurposing.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0038.title: Ensure VoIP calls end when Smart Folio closes

statement.en: Ensure a VoIP app ends a call when Smart Folio closes during built-in microphone use.
statement.ja: built-in microphone使用中にSmart Folioが閉じた場合はVoIP callを終了する。

conditions: Closing Smart Folio mutes the iPad microphone and interrupts its audio session.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0038.review_note: Recovered the explicit must-end requirement and narrowed it to the documented iPad Smart Folio context.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0039.title: Avoid silently unmuting after Smart Folio reopens

statement.en: Avoid restarting an iPad VoIP audio session in a way that unmutes the microphone without the person's knowledge.
statement.ja: 利用者に知らせずmicrophoneをunmuteする形でiPad VoIP audio sessionを再開しない。

conditions: Smart Folio closed while the built-in microphone was in use.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0039.review_note: Recovered the privacy risk as AVOID without inventing an explicit MUST_NOT prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0040.title: Adjust relative audio levels when necessary

statement.en: When necessary, adjust independent relative audio levels to create a balanced mix.
statement.ja: 必要に応じてindependentなrelative audio levelを調整しbalanced mixを作る。

conditions: Leave final output governed by the system volume.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0040.review_note: Recovered the positive mixing action separately from the overall-volume AVOID rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0041.title: Pause playback immediately when headphones disconnect

statement.en: When headphones disconnect, pause playback immediately.
statement.ja: headphone切断時にplaybackを直ちにpauseする。

conditions: Audio was routed privately through the headphones.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0041.review_note: Recovered the disconnection expectation as SHOULD because the source doesn't use an explicit mandatory marker.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0042.title: Check resumability before media playback resumes

statement.en: Before a media app resumes playback after an interruption, check that the interruption is resumable.
statement.ja: media appがinterruption後にplaybackを再開する前にinterruptionがresumableか確認する。

conditions: The media app was actively playing when the interruption began.
exceptions: A game can resume without this check because its audio isn't explicitly user-started.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0042.review_note: Recovered the media-app check at SHOULD and retained the game exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0001.title: Consider context-specific tips instead of one onboarding flow

statement.en: Consider using context-specific tips instead of a single onboarding flow.
statement.ja: single onboarding flowの代わりにcontext-specific tipの使用を検討する。

conditions: Use each tip to teach one current action or task while people make progress.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0001.review_note: Retained the explicit consider-level alternative and separated interface placement into its own rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0002.title: Focus onboarding on the product experience

statement.en: Keep onboarding focused on the app or game experience.
statement.ja: onboardingをappまたはgame experienceに集中させる。

conditions: Don't teach people how to use the system or device.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0002.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the source's system-and-device exclusion.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0003.title: Avoid downloads that hinder onboarding

statement.en: Avoid making people wait for large downloads before they can begin interacting.
statement.ja: interaction開始前にlarge downloadを待たせることを避ける。

conditions: Apply whether people participate in or skip onboarding.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0003.review_note: Retained AVOID because the source uses Don't without an explicit mandatory prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0004.title: Avoid licensing details in onboarding

statement.en: Avoid displaying licensing details, agreements, or disclaimers in onboarding.
statement.ja: onboarding内でlicensing detail、agreement、disclaimerを表示しない。

conditions: Prefer letting the App Store present these items before download.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0004.review_note: Retained AVOID and represented the required-content exception separately.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0005.title: Let people experience the product before ratings or purchases

statement.en: Prefer letting people experience the app or game before prompting for ratings or purchases.
statement.ja: ratingやpurchaseを促す前にappまたはgameを体験できるようにする。

conditions: Wait until people have had a chance to become engaged.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0005.review_note: Retained the experience-before-request preference at SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0006.title: Consider making a separate tutorial optional

statement.en: When a separate tutorial makes sense, consider making it optional.
statement.ja: separate tutorialが適切な場合はoptionalにすることを検討する。

conditions: The app or game offers a tutorial outside prerequisite onboarding.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0006.review_note: Repaired the conditional lead and retained its explicit consider-level strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0007.title: Consider essential permission requests during onboarding

statement.en: Consider integrating a permission request into onboarding when the product can't function without access.
statement.ja: accessなしでは機能できない場合はpermission requestをonboardingへ組み込むことを検討する。

conditions: Explain why access is needed and the benefit of granting it.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0007.review_note: Repaired the truncated candidate and retained the source's essential-access condition and MAY strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0008.title: Use interactive onboarding whenever possible

statement.en: Whenever possible, use interactive onboarding instead of only instructional material.
statement.ja: 可能な限りinstructional materialだけでなくinteractive onboardingを使う。

conditions: Let people safely test an action, discover a feature, or try a game mechanic.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0008.review_note: Recovered the interactivity lead and retained its as-much-as-possible qualification.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0009.title: Keep prerequisite onboarding brief and enjoyable

statement.en: When prerequisite onboarding is needed, keep it brief, enjoyable, and easy to remember.
statement.ja: prerequisite onboardingが必要な場合はbrief、enjoyable、覚えやすい内容にする。

conditions: Avoid teaching so much that people feel overwhelmed.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0009.review_note: Recovered the conditional prerequisite-flow guidance and removed the truncated ending.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0010.title: Keep necessary splash screens brief

statement.en: If a splash screen is necessary, keep it brief and succinct.
statement.ja: splash screenが必要な場合はbriefでsuccinctにする。

conditions: Show a clear graphic only long enough for people to absorb it at a glance.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0010.review_note: Recovered the conditional splash-screen guidance without making splash screens a requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0011.title: Defer nonessential setup and customization

statement.en: Defer nonessential setup flows and customization steps until after first use.
statement.ja: nonessentialなsetup flowとcustomization stepをfirst use後まで延期する。

conditions: Let people begin interacting without extra configuration.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0011.review_note: Recovered the direct deferral recommendation and tied it to immediate first use.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0012.title: Keep onboarding fast, engaging, and optional

statement.en: When onboarding is necessary, keep the flow fast, engaging, and optional.
statement.ja: onboardingが必要な場合はflowをfast、engaging、optionalにする。

conditions: Prefer learning through the product experience when onboarding isn't needed.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0012.review_note: Recovered the overview's conditional design outcome at SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0013.title: Keep onboarding separate from launch

statement.en: Present onboarding after launch completes, separate from the launch experience.
statement.ja: launch完了後にonboardingを提示し、launch experienceから分離する。

conditions: The product provides onboarding.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0013.review_note: Recovered the launch-separation architecture at SHOULD because the source doesn't use an explicit mandatory marker.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0014.title: Place interface-specific instructions near their target

statement.en: Display instructions near the interface area they describe.
statement.ja: instructionを説明対象のinterface areaの近くに表示する。

conditions: The instructional content refers to a specific interface area.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0014.review_note: Recovered the contextual placement recommendation as a separate check.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0015.title: Avoid repeating a skipped tutorial on later launches

statement.en: If a person skips a tutorial at first launch, avoid presenting it again on later launches.
statement.ja: first launchでtutorialをskipした場合はlater launchで再提示しない。

conditions: The tutorial remains available through a discoverable location.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0015.review_note: Recovered the direct Don't guidance at AVOID instead of promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0016.title: Ensure skipped tutorials remain easy to find

statement.en: Ensure a skipped tutorial remains easy to find for later viewing.
statement.ja: skipしたtutorialを後から簡単に見つけられるようにする。

conditions: Provide access from a help, account, or settings area.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0016.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Make sure discoverability requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0017.title: Consider bundling content to prevent blocking downloads

statement.en: Consider bundling enough initial media and content to avoid blocking first interaction on downloads.
statement.ja: downloadでfirst interactionを妨げないよう十分なinitial mediaとcontentの同梱を検討する。

conditions: People otherwise need to wait for downloads before interacting.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0017.review_note: Recovered the mitigation and lowered the generated SHOULD to the source's explicit consider-level strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0018.title: Keep required onboarding licensing nondisruptive

statement.en: If licensing details must appear in onboarding, integrate them in a balanced, nondisruptive way.
statement.ja: licensing detailをonboardingに含める必要がある場合はbalancedでnondisruptiveに統合する。

conditions: Use this exception only when the items can't remain in the App Store flow.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0018.review_note: Recovered the conditional exception without weakening the general licensing AVOID rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0019.title: Provide reasonable defaults for immediate first use

statement.en: Provide reasonable defaults so most people can begin without additional configuration.
statement.ja: 多くの利用者がadditional configurationなしで開始できるreasonable defaultを提供する。

conditions: Defer nonessential setup and customization.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0019.review_note: Recovered the default-settings recommendation as a separate first-use check.

HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0020.title: Use just-in-time requests for nonessential permissions

statement.en: For nonessential access, present the permission request when people first use the related feature.
statement.ja: nonessential accessではrelated featureを初めて使うときにpermission requestを提示する。

conditions: The product can function before the permission is granted.
HIG-PATTERNS-ONBOARDING-0020.review_note: Recovered the source's otherwise branch as a just-in-time SHOULD rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0001.title: Match help format to task complexity

statement.en: Match the help format to the task's complexity and scope.
statement.ja: help formatをtaskのcomplexityとscopeに合わせる。

conditions: Use an inline view for simple one- or two-step tasks.
Use a tutorial for complex or multistep goals.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0001.review_note: Reframed the broad lead as a help-format decision and retained its simple-versus-complex examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0002.title: Use relevant and consistent help content

statement.en: Use relevant and consistent language and imagery in help content.
statement.ja: help contentではrelevantでconsistentなlanguageとimageryを使う。

conditions: Keep language and imagery aligned with the task and surrounding interface.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0002.review_note: Retained the general SHOULD while separating the explicit context and platform-consistency requirements.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0003.title: Ensure all help content is inclusive

statement.en: Ensure all help content is inclusive.
statement.ja: すべてのhelp contentをinclusiveにする。

conditions: Apply the HIG Inclusion guidance when reviewing help content.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0003.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the unqualified Make sure directive.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0004.title: Avoid explaining standard components or patterns

statement.en: Avoid bloating help content with explanations of standard components or patterns.
statement.ja: standard componentやpatternの説明でhelp contentを肥大化させない。

conditions: Describe the app-specific action or task the standard element performs.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0004.review_note: Retained AVOID because the source uses direct Avoid guidance rather than an explicit prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0005.title: Choose a tip type that fits the interface

statement.en: Choose the tip type that fits the feature and surrounding interface.
statement.ja: featureとsurrounding interfaceに適したtip typeを選ぶ。

conditions: Use a popover to preserve content flow.
Use an inline tip to keep surrounding information visible.
Use annotation style for a specific interface element.
Use hint style when no specific interface element is involved.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0005.review_note: Made the tip-type decision concrete and retained all four source mappings.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0006.title: Use tips for simple features

statement.en: Use tips for features that are easy to describe and complete in a few steps.
statement.ja: 説明しやすく少ないstepで完了できるfeatureにtipを使う。

conditions: Treat more than three actions as a complexity signal, not a hard limit.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0006.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the three-action example as a review signal instead of a universal threshold.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0007.title: Keep tips short, actionable, and engaging

statement.en: Keep tips short, actionable, and engaging.
statement.ja: tipをshort、actionable、engagingにする。

conditions: Encourage people to try the feature rather than merely describing it.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0007.review_note: Retained the three related tip-quality attributes and separated length, language, and content exclusions.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0008.title: Use tip buttons for information or options

statement.en: Use buttons in tips to direct people to relevant information or options.
statement.ja: tip内のbuttonでrelevantなinformationやoptionへ案内する。

conditions: Link directly to settings, setup flows, or useful additional resources.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0008.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the source's settings and information destinations.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0014.title: Define eligibility rules for tip audiences

statement.en: Define eligibility rules so each tip reaches people who might benefit from it.
statement.ja: 各tipがbenefitを得られる利用者に届くようeligibility ruleを定義する。

conditions: Use parameter-based or event-based eligibility rules.
Display a tip only when the person might benefit from it.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0014.review_note: Retained SHOULD and did not promote the conditional only-if phrasing to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0015.title: Consider a familiar image or symbol in a tip

statement.en: Consider including an image or symbol people associate with the feature in its tip.
statement.ja: featureと関連づけられるimageまたはsymbolをtipに含めることを検討する。

conditions: The image or symbol has an established association with the feature.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0015.review_note: Repaired the truncated candidate and retained the explicit consider-level strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0025.title: Keep help related to the current task

statement.en: Keep help directly related to the precise action or task a person is performing.
statement.ja: helpを利用者が実行中のactionまたはtaskに直接関連づける。

conditions: Provide help in the context where the person needs it.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0025.review_note: Recovered the current-task relevance recommendation separately from help-format selection.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0026.title: Keep contextual help easy to dismiss or avoid

statement.en: Keep contextual help easy to dismiss or avoid when a person doesn't need it.
statement.ja: 不要なcontextual helpを簡単にdismissまたはavoidできるようにする。

conditions: Don't force people to complete help before continuing their task.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0026.review_note: Recovered the user-control recommendation without inventing a mandatory dismissal mechanism.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0027.title: Ensure help guidance fits the current context

statement.en: Ensure help guidance is appropriate for the person's current context.
statement.ja: help guidanceを利用者のcurrent contextに適合させる。

conditions: Don't show input-device imagery that conflicts with the person's current input.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0027.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Always make sure directive and retained its input-device example.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0028.title: Ensure help terminology matches the platform

statement.en: Ensure help terms and descriptions are consistent with the current platform.
statement.ja: helpのtermとdescriptionをcurrent platformに合わせる。

conditions: Don't describe iPhone interaction as clicking.
Don't describe Mac interaction as tapping.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0028.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Be sure directive and retained its platform-terminology examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0029.title: Orient people quickly to unusual controls or input

statement.en: Quickly orient people when the experience introduces a unique control or nonstandard input method.
statement.ja: unique controlまたはnonstandard input methodを導入する場合は利用者を素早く案内する。

conditions: The control is unique or an input device is used nonstandardly.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0029.review_note: Recovered the conditional orientation recommendation and kept its unusual-input scope.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0030.title: Prefer visual orientation for unusual controls

statement.en: Prefer animation or graphics over lengthy text when explaining unusual controls or input.
statement.ja: unusual controlやinputの説明ではlengthy textよりanimationまたはgraphicsを優先する。

conditions: Apply when quick orientation is needed for unique or nonstandard interaction.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0030.review_note: Recovered the source's preferred teaching medium at SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0031.title: Use direct action-oriented language in tips

statement.en: Use direct, action-oriented language to explain what a feature does and how to use it.
statement.ja: featureの動作と使用方法をdirectでaction-orientedなlanguageで説明する。

conditions: The tip encourages people to try the feature.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0031.review_note: Recovered the action-language recommendation as a separate writing check.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0032.title: Keep tips to one or two sentences

statement.en: Keep each tip to one or two sentences.
statement.ja: 各tipを1文または2文に収める。

conditions: Preserve enough information to explain the feature and its use.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0032.review_note: Recovered the explicit length target at SHOULD rather than treating it as a platform-enforced limit.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0033.title: Avoid promotional or unrelated tip content

statement.en: Avoid promotional content or material from a different feature or user flow in a tip.
statement.ja: tipにpromotional contentや別のfeatureまたはuser flowの内容を含めない。

conditions: Treat advertising, selling, and context-misaligned content as promotional.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0033.review_note: Recovered the direct avoid guidance at AVOID rather than promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0034.title: Use a reasonable cadence for multiple tips

statement.en: When an app has multiple tips, set a reasonable display cadence.
statement.ja: appに複数のtipがある場合はreasonableなdisplay cadenceを設定する。

conditions: Treat once every 24 hours as an example, not a universal minimum.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0034.review_note: Recovered the cadence recommendation without converting its 24-hour example into a threshold.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0035.title: Prefer filled variants of familiar tip symbols

statement.en: When a tip uses a familiar symbol, prefer its filled variant.
statement.ja: tipでfamiliarなsymbolを使う場合はfilled variantを優先する。

conditions: The symbol has a filled variant suitable for the feature.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0035.review_note: Split the preference from the optional image-inclusion decision so their strengths remain distinct.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0036.title: Avoid repeating a connected feature image in its tip

statement.en: When a tip connects directly to a feature image, avoid repeating that image inside the tip.
statement.ja: tipがfeature imageへ直接つながる場合は同じimageをtip内で繰り返さない。

conditions: The same image is already visible in the interface.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0036.review_note: Recovered the conditional image-repetition guidance at AVOID.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0001.title: Always identify the authentication method you offer

statement.en: Always identify the authentication method available to a person.
statement.ja: 利用者が使えるauthentication methodを常に明示する。

conditions: Use labels that name the current method, such as Sign in with Face ID.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0001.review_note: Retained MUST after confirming the unqualified Always directive and its current-method labeling example.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0002.title: Avoid passcode for account authentication

statement.en: Avoid using passcode to describe account authentication.
statement.ja: account authenticationを表すためにpasscodeという用語を使わない。

conditions: Reserve passcode for unlocking a device or authenticating an Apple service.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0002.review_note: Retained AVOID because the source uses direct Avoid guidance, not an explicit prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0003.title: Provide in-app account deletion initiation

statement.en: Provide a clear way to initiate account deletion within the app or game.
statement.ja: appまたはgame内にaccount deletionを開始する明確な方法を設ける。

conditions: Keep the deletion control discoverable in the account-management context.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0003.review_note: Retained SHOULD for the preferred in-app path; the mandatory web fallback is represented separately.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0004.title: Keep app and web deletion flows consistent

statement.en: Provide a consistent account-deletion experience in the app and on the website.
statement.ja: app内とwebsite上で一貫したaccount-deletion experienceを提供する。

conditions: Avoid making either channel substantially longer or more complex.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0004.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the source's cross-channel complexity comparison.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0005.title: Consider scheduled account deletion

statement.en: Consider letting people schedule account deletion for a future time.
statement.ja: account deletionを将来の時点にscheduleできるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: If scheduling is available, also offer immediate deletion.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0005.review_note: Retained MAY for the optional scheduling capability and separated the accompanying immediate option.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0006.title: Avoid app sign-out for system-level TV provider accounts

statement.en: Avoid displaying an app sign-out option when a person uses system-level TV provider authentication.
statement.ja: system-level TV provider authenticationの利用中はapp内sign-out optionの表示を避ける。

conditions: Apply where a system-level TV Provider account is available.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0006.review_note: Retained AVOID and narrowed the rule to the system-authenticated TV provider context.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0007.title: Never use privacy controls for TV provider sign-out

statement.en: Never instruct people to sign out of a TV provider account through privacy controls.
statement.ja: privacy controlを使ったTV provider accountのsign-outを案内しない。

conditions: Privacy controls don't provide the TV provider sign-out mechanism.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0007.review_note: Retained MUST_NOT after confirming the explicit Never instruction in its TV provider context.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0010.title: Avoid app-specific biometric opt-in settings

statement.en: Avoid offering an app-specific setting for biometric-authentication opt-in.
statement.ja: biometric authenticationへのopt-in用app-specific settingを設けない。

conditions: Rely on system-level biometric enrollment and authentication controls.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0010.review_note: Retained AVOID because the source describes the setting as redundant and potentially confusing.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0016.title: Explain account benefits and signup steps

statement.en: Explain the benefits of an account and how to sign up.
statement.ja: accountの利点とsignup方法を説明する。

conditions: When an account is required, keep the sign-in-view explanation brief and friendly.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0016.review_note: Recovered the account-value explanation as SHOULD without turning the conditional account requirement into a universal one.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0017.title: Defer sign-in as long as possible

statement.en: Delay sign-in until people need account-dependent features.
statement.ja: account-dependent featureが必要になるまでsign-inを遅らせる。

conditions: Let people explore usable content before requiring authentication.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0017.review_note: Recovered the delay recommendation and tied it to the first account-dependent task.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0018.title: Prefer passkeys when Sign in with Apple isn't used

statement.en: On supported platforms, prefer passkeys when the app doesn't use Sign in with Apple.
statement.ja: supported platformでSign in with Appleを使わない場合はpasskeyを優先する。

conditions: The app requires account authentication and doesn't offer Sign in with Apple.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0018.review_note: Recovered the conditional preference and narrowed it to the four platforms enumerated by the source.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0019.title: Name only currently available authentication methods

statement.en: Refer only to authentication methods available in the current context.
statement.ja: current contextで利用できるauthentication methodだけを示す。

conditions: Check device capabilities and use the system's current terminology.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0019.review_note: Recovered the availability rule and recorded both capability and terminology checks.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0020.title: Ensure people know when account deletion will complete

statement.en: Ensure people understand how long account deletion takes.
statement.ja: account deletionの完了までにかかる時間を利用者が理解できるようにする。

conditions: Communicate the expected completion timing before deletion finishes.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0020.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit make-sure timing requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0021.title: Explain deletion-related billing and cancellation

statement.en: Explain billing and cancellation outcomes for in-app purchases during account deletion.
statement.ja: account deletion時のin-app purchaseに関するbillingとcancellationの結果を説明する。

conditions: Cover the purchase types and billing arrangements the account supports.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0021.review_note: Recovered the billing guidance as SHOULD and kept the purchase-management action separate.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0022.title: Require an account only for core functionality

statement.en: Require an account only when the app's core functionality depends on it.
statement.ja: appのcore functionalityに必要な場合だけaccountを必須にする。

conditions: Otherwise, let people use the app or game without an account.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0022.review_note: Recovered the account-necessity constraint at SHOULD without promoting the source's conditional only-if phrasing to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0023.title: Consider Sign in with Apple for required accounts

statement.en: When an account is required, consider offering Sign in with Apple.
statement.ja: accountが必要な場合はSign in with Appleの提供を検討する。

conditions: The app requires an account for core functionality.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0023.review_note: Recovered the explicit consider clause as MAY and preserved the source's platform scope.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0024.title: Use two-factor authentication with passwords

statement.en: When passwords remain necessary, require two-factor authentication to strengthen account security.
statement.ja: passwordが必要な場合はaccount securityを強化するためtwo-factor authenticationを必須にする。

conditions: Apply when the account flow still relies on passwords.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0024.review_note: Recovered the conditional security recommendation at SHOULD and preserved the four-platform context.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0025.title: Ensure in-app accounts can be deleted

statement.en: Ensure people can delete accounts they create within the app or game.
statement.ja: appまたはgame内で作成したaccountを利用者が削除できるようにする。

conditions: Deletion must remove the account, not merely deactivate it.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0025.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit you-must deletion obligation.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0026.title: Ensure compliance with regional account-deletion requirements

statement.en: Ensure account deletion complies with applicable regional and right-to-be-forgotten requirements.
statement.ja: account deletionを該当地域およびright-to-be-forgottenの要件に適合させる。

conditions: Review the legal requirements applicable to each supported region.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0026.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit be-sure compliance directive while keeping jurisdictional details conditional.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0027.title: Describe legally required retention or deletion processes

statement.en: Clearly describe legally required account retention or deletion processes.
statement.ja: 法的に必要なaccount retentionまたはdeletion processを明確に説明する。

conditions: Apply when law compels retained information, retained accounts, or a particular deletion process.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0027.review_note: Recovered the conditional transparency guidance without inventing a retention requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0028.title: Ensure a direct deletion link when in-app deletion is unavailable

statement.en: When in-app deletion is unavailable, ensure the app provides a direct link to the deletion webpage.
statement.ja: in-app deletionを提供できない場合はdeletion webpageへのdirect linkをapp内に設ける。

conditions: Keep the link easy to discover in the account-management context.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0028.review_note: Recovered the conditional MUST from the source's you-must direct-link requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0029.title: Avoid burying account-deletion links

statement.en: Avoid burying an account-deletion link in a privacy policy or terms page.
statement.ja: account-deletion linkをprivacy policyやterms page内に埋もれさせない。

conditions: Present the link where people manage their account.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0029.review_note: Recovered the direct don't-bury guidance at AVOID rather than promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0030.title: Offer immediate deletion with scheduled deletion

statement.en: If scheduled deletion is available, also offer immediate account deletion.
statement.ja: scheduled deletionを提供する場合はimmediate account deletionも提供する。

conditions: Apply only when the service offers future scheduling.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0030.review_note: Recovered the accompanying immediate option as SHOULD, separate from the optional scheduling decision.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0031.title: Ensure people are notified when account deletion finishes

statement.en: Ensure people receive a notification when account deletion finishes.
statement.ja: account deletionの完了時に利用者へnotificationを届ける。

conditions: Use the completion notice to keep people informed throughout the process.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0031.review_note: Recovered MUST from the source's explicit make-sure notification outcome and supporting essential rationale.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0032.title: Explain subscription cancellation and purchase management

statement.en: Explain how to cancel subscriptions and manage purchases during account deletion.
statement.ja: account deletion時のsubscription cancellationとpurchase managementの方法を説明する。

conditions: Provide information for the purchase types the account uses.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0032.review_note: Recovered the action-oriented purchase-management guidance at SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0033.title: Ensure deletion for externally purchased subscriptions

statement.en: Ensure account deletion remains available when a subscription was purchased outside the app.
statement.ja: subscriptionをapp外で購入した場合もaccount deletionを利用できるようにする。

conditions: External subscription purchase doesn't remove the account-deletion obligation.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0033.review_note: Recovered MUST from the source's still-need-to-support account deletion requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0034.title: Use TV Provider Authentication for provider sign-in

statement.en: Use TV Provider Authentication when a TV provider app requires sign-in.
statement.ja: TV provider appでsign-inが必要な場合はTV Provider Authenticationを使う。

conditions: Apply where system-level TV Provider Authentication is available.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0034.review_note: Recovered the conditional system-authentication recommendation without inferring an unsupported platform list.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0035.title: Ensure TV provider sign-out routes to Settings

statement.en: If the app exposes TV provider sign-out, ensure it routes people to Settings > TV Provider.
statement.ja: appがTV provider sign-outを提供する場合はSettings > TV Providerへ案内する。

conditions: Apply only when the app must expose sign-out despite system-level authentication.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0035.review_note: Recovered the conditional MUST from the source's needs-to-prompt platform requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0036.title: Use iCloud synchronization for watchOS Keychain access

statement.en: Use iCloud synchronization so watchOS can access Keychain credentials and settings.
statement.ja: watchOSからKeychain credentialとsettingへアクセスするためiCloud synchronizationを使う。

conditions: The watchOS app needs synced credentials or account settings.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0036.review_note: Recovered the watchOS-only synchronization recommendation and its Keychain-access purpose.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0037.title: Revoke Sign in with Apple tokens during deletion

statement.en: Revoke associated Sign in with Apple tokens when deleting the linked account.
statement.ja: linked accountを削除するときは関連するSign in with Apple tokenをrevokeする。

conditions: The account was created or authenticated using Sign in with Apple.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0037.review_note: Recovered the token-revocation instruction at SHOULD because the source doesn't use an explicit mandatory marker.

statement.en: Keep notifications concise, informative, and valuable.
statement.ja: notificationを簡潔で有益かつ価値のある内容にする。

conditions: Give people quick updates and communicate the useful information succinctly.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0001.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded both concision and information value.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0002.title: Avoid duplicate notifications for the same event

statement.en: Avoid sending multiple notifications for the same event when a person hasn't responded.
statement.ja: 利用者が応答していない場合でも同じeventのnotificationを複数送らない。

conditions: Let people attend at their convenience instead of filling Notification Center with repeats.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0002.review_note: Retained AVOID and preserved the unanswered-notification condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0003.title: Avoid notifications that assign in-app tasks

statement.en: Avoid using a notification merely to tell people to perform tasks inside the app.
statement.ja: app内でtaskを行うよう伝えるだけのnotificationを避ける。

conditions: Dismissed instructions are difficult to remember.
exceptions: Offer simple, useful notification actions when people can complete the task without opening the app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0003.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the actionable-notification exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0004.title: Use an alert instead of a notification for errors

statement.en: Use an alert, not a notification, to display an error message.
statement.ja: error messageの表示にはnotificationではなくalertを使う。

conditions: Preserve the familiar distinction between alerts and notifications.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0004.review_note: Retained SHOULD component guidance and made the error-message choice explicit.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0005.title: Never expose private information in notifications

statement.en: Never include sensitive, personal, or confidential information in a notification.
statement.ja: sensitive、personal、confidentialな情報をnotificationに含めない。

conditions: Assume a notification can be visible to other people in an unpredictable context.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0005.review_note: Raised the privacy rule to MUST_NOT because the source calls avoiding visible private information essential.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0006.title: Use a short notification title when it adds context

statement.en: Use a short notification title when it provides useful context.
statement.ja: 有用なcontextを加える場合は短いnotification titleを使う。

conditions: Prefer glanceable titles, especially on Apple Watch.
Use title-style capitalization with no ending punctuation.
exceptions: For a generic noncommunication title, letting the system show the app name can be better.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0006.review_note: Retained the conditional SHOULD and recorded title style plus the generic-title exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0007.title: Write succinct notification content

statement.en: Write succinct, easy-to-read notification content.
statement.ja: 簡潔で読みやすいnotification contentを書く。

conditions: Use complete sentences, sentence case, and proper punctuation.
Don't manually truncate the message; let the system truncate when necessary.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0007.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded every writing and truncation condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0008.title: Provide a privacy-preserving hidden-preview description

statement.en: Provide a generic description for notifications whose previews aren't available.
statement.ja: previewを表示できないnotificationにはgeneric descriptionを提供する。

conditions: Give enough context to decide whether to view the notification without revealing too much detail.
Use sentence-style capitalization.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0008.review_note: Retained SHOULD and prioritized the user-controlled preview privacy context.

statement.en: Avoid repeating the app name or app icon in notification content.
statement.ja: notification content内でapp nameやapp iconを重複表示しない。

conditions: The system already supplies the appropriate app or sender imagery and app identity.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0009.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the system-provided identity context.

statement.en: Consider using sound to supplement a notification.
statement.ja: notificationを補助するsoundの使用を検討する。

conditions: Choose a system-provided alert sound or a custom sound that fits the app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0010.review_note: Retained MAY and separated sound quality and nonaudio access into mandatory rules.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0011.title: Offer useful actions in notification context

statement.en: Offer beneficial notification actions that fit the current context.
statement.ja: 現在のcontextに合う有益なnotification actionを提供する。

conditions: Prefer common, time-saving tasks people can complete without opening the app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0011.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the usefulness and no-launch preference.

statement.en: Avoid a notification action that merely opens the app.
statement.ja: appを開くだけのnotification actionを避ける。

conditions: Opening related content is already the expected result of tapping the notification or its preview.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0012.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the duplicate-navigation rationale.

statement.en: Prefer nondestructive notification actions.
statement.ja: nondestructiveなnotification actionを優先する。

exceptions: A destructive action may be provided when the separate context requirement is satisfied.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0013.review_note: Retained preference strength and split the conditional destructive-action requirement.

statement.en: Provide a simple, recognizable interface icon for each notification action.
statement.ja: 各notification actionにsimpleでrecognizableなinterface iconを提供する。

conditions: Choose or adapt an SF Symbol that reinforces the action's meaning.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0014.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the icon-meaning purpose and SF Symbols option.

statement.en: Use a badge only to show the number of unread notifications.
statement.ja: badgeは未読notification数の表示だけに使う。

conditions: Keep unrelated numeric information out of badges under the separate avoidance rule.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0015.review_note: Retained SHOULD and split the explicit unrelated-data avoidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0016.title: Ensure badging isn't the only essential-information channel

statement.en: Ensure badging isn't the only way the app communicates essential information.
statement.ja: badgingをappがessential informationを伝える唯一の方法にしない。

conditions: People can disable badges in notification settings.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0016.review_note: Retained the explicit MUST and prioritized the user's badge-setting choice.

statement.en: Keep notification badges up to date.
statement.ja: notification badgeを最新状態に保つ。

conditions: Update the badge as soon as people open the corresponding notifications.
exceptions: Reducing the badge count to zero removes all related notifications from Notification Center.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0017.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded update timing plus the zero-count side effect.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0018.title: Avoid custom elements that mimic badges

statement.en: Avoid custom images or components that mimic a notification badge.
statement.ja: notification badgeを模倣するcustom imageやcomponentを避ける。

conditions: Respect the user's choice to disable notification badges.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0018.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the explicit user-setting rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0026.title: Obtain consent before sending notifications

statement.en: Obtain a person's consent before sending them any notifications.
statement.ja: notificationを送信する前に本人の同意を得る。

conditions: Request notification permission before the app begins sending notifications.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit have-to consent requirement and assigned privacy and explicit-intent priority.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0027.title: Handle foreground notification information unobtrusively

statement.en: When the app is in the foreground, present notification information in a discoverable, unobtrusive way.
statement.ja: appがforegroundの場合はnotification informationを見つけやすく控えめに提示する。

conditions: The app still receives the information even though its notification doesn't appear.
Use a subtle badge update or insert new data into the current view when appropriate.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0027.review_note: Recovered the inactive foreground-handling lead and its discoverability and distraction constraints.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0028.title: Ensure custom notification sounds meet quality requirements

statement.en: Ensure every custom notification sound is short, distinctive, and professionally produced.
statement.ja: custom notification soundを短くdistinctiveでprofessionally producedなものにする。

conditions: Apply when the app supplies a custom sound instead of a system alert sound.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0028.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure sound-quality MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0029.title: Ensure important notification information doesn't depend on sound

statement.en: Ensure important notification information remains available without hearing its sound.
statement.ja: soundを聞けなくてもimportant notification informationを得られるようにする。

conditions: People may not hear notification sounds, so provide an equivalent visual or otherwise perceivable channel.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0029.review_note: Recovered the accessibility requirement from the explicit don't-rely-on-sound instruction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0030.title: Limit a notification detail view to four actions

statement.en: Limit a notification detail view to no more than four action buttons.
statement.ja: notification detail viewのaction buttonを最大4個に制限する。

conditions: Treat four as the system-supported maximum, not as a required number of actions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0030.review_note: Recovered the explicit platform-contract maximum without requiring apps to provide actions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0031.title: Use short title-case notification action labels

statement.en: Use a short title-case term or phrase for each notification action label.
statement.ja: 各notification action labelに短いtitle-caseの語句を使う。

conditions: Keep labels brief enough to avoid truncation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0031.review_note: Recovered action-label length and capitalization as one formatting rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0032.title: Describe each notification action result clearly

statement.en: Make each notification action label clearly describe its result.
statement.ja: 各notification action labelでactionの結果を明確に表す。

conditions: Help people predict the outcome before they activate the button.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0032.review_note: Recovered the independent action-result clarity requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0033.title: Avoid extraneous notification action-label content

statement.en: Avoid app names and extraneous information in notification action labels.
statement.ja: notification action labelにapp nameや余分な情報を含めない。

conditions: Keep the label focused on the result of the action.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0033.review_note: Recovered the explicit don't-include clause as AVOID.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0034.title: Account for localization in notification action labels

statement.en: Write notification action labels to remain clear and concise after localization.
statement.ja: localization後もnotification action labelが明確で簡潔になるように書く。

conditions: Review translated labels for meaning and truncation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0035.title: Ensure destructive notification actions have enough context

statement.en: When providing a destructive notification action, ensure people have enough context to avoid unintended consequences.
statement.ja: destructiveなnotification actionを提供する場合は意図しない結果を避けるため十分なcontextを示す。

conditions: Identify the action as destructive so the system gives it a distinct appearance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0035.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure MUST separately from the nondestructive preference.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0036.title: Avoid unrelated numeric data in notification badges

statement.en: Avoid using notification badges for numeric information unrelated to unread notifications.
statement.ja: 未読notificationと無関係な数値情報にnotification badgeを使わない。

conditions: Examples include weather data, dates, times, stock prices, and game scores.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0036.review_note: Recovered the explicit don't-use clause as AVOID without raising it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0037.title: Ensure important notification information is easy to find in the app

statement.en: Ensure important notification information is easy to find as soon as the app opens.
statement.ja: appを開いた直後にimportant notification informationを見つけられるようにする。

conditions: Provide in-app access even when the person disables or misses badging.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0037.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always make sure requirement and tied it to the badge-setting context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0038.title: Provide a static watchOS long-look interface

statement.en: Provide at least a static interface for every custom watchOS long-look notification.
statement.ja: すべてのcustom watchOS long-look notificationに少なくともstatic interfaceを提供する。

conditions: The system uses the static interface whenever the dynamic interface is unavailable.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0038.review_note: Recovered the explicit at-the-minimum platform requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0039.title: Prefer a dynamic watchOS long-look interface too

statement.en: In addition to the required static interface, prefer providing a dynamic watchOS long-look interface.
statement.ja: 必須のstatic interfaceに加えてdynamic watchOS long-look interfaceも提供することを優先する。

conditions: Use the dynamic interface for full notification content and greater appearance control.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0039.review_note: Split the preference from the static-interface minimum so it remains SHOULD.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0040.title: Package static watchOS long-look resources in advance

statement.en: Ensure static watchOS long-look resources are created in advance and packaged with the app.
statement.ja: static watchOS long-look resourceを事前に作成してappへ同梱する。

conditions: Resources must remain available when there is no network or the iPhone companion is unreachable.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0040.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure packaging requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0041.title: Avoid changing the system-defined watchOS long-look structure

statement.en: Avoid attempting to change the system-defined watchOS long-look structure.
statement.ja: system-defined watchOS long-look structureの変更を試みない。

conditions: Customize the content area while retaining the sash at the top and Dismiss button below custom buttons.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0041.review_note: Recovered the platform capability limit as AVOID rather than inventing a stronger prohibition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0042.title: Avoid sensitive information in watchOS short-look titles

statement.en: Avoid potentially sensitive information in a watchOS short-look title.
statement.ja: watchOS short-look titleにpotentially sensitiveな情報を含めない。

conditions: Keep short looks discreet and limited to basic information.
HIG-COMPONENTS-NOTIFICATIONS-0042.review_note: Recovered the explicit title-specific privacy avoidance separately from the general discreet-content rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0001.title: Prefer the system-provided edit menu

statement.en: Prefer the system-provided edit menu for standard editing commands.
statement.ja: 標準editing commandにはsystem-provided edit menuを優先する。

conditions: Avoid recreating the same standard commands in a custom menu because duplication can confuse people.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0001.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the familiarity, redundancy, and confusion rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0002.title: Use familiar system interactions to reveal edit menus

statement.en: Let people reveal edit menus using the familiar system-defined interactions for each platform.
statement.ja: 各platformで慣れたsystem-defined interactionを使ってedit menuを表示できるようにする。

conditions: Support the applicable touch-and-hold, pinch-and-hold, and secondary-click conventions instead of introducing a custom interaction for a standard task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0002.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the platform interaction examples without converting them into universal gestures.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0003.title: Keep edit-menu commands relevant to the current state

statement.en: Show edit-menu commands relevant to the current state, removing or dimming commands that don't apply.
statement.ja: 現在のstateに関連するedit-menu commandを表示し、適用できないcommandは削除またはdim表示する。

conditions: When nothing is selected, omit or disable commands such as Copy or Cut that require a selection.
When there is nothing to paste, omit or disable Paste.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0003.review_note: Replaced the generated wording with a state-aware command-availability rule and preserved both source examples.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0004.title: Support undo and redo when possible

statement.en: Support undo and redo for edit-menu actions when possible.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はedit-menu actionのundoとredoをsupportする。

conditions: Because edit-menu actions don't require confirmation, provide recovery for changes where the app can restore prior state.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0004.review_note: Retained the when-possible SHOULD and recorded why recovery matters for immediately executed commands.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0005.title: Keep custom-command labels short

statement.en: Use short labels for custom edit-menu commands.
statement.ja: custom edit-menu commandには短いlabelを使う。
