conditions: Keep the label concise while the separate action-wording rule preserves clarity.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0005.review_note: Retained SHOULD and separated label length from the source's independent wording requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0006.title: Ensure edit menus work in both iOS and iPadOS styles

statement.en: Ensure edit menus work in both the compact horizontal and vertical menu styles on iOS and iPadOS.
statement.ja: iOSとiPadOSでedit menuがcompact horizontal styleとvertical menu styleの両方で機能するようにする。

conditions: The system uses the compact horizontal style for Multi-Touch and the vertical style for keyboard or pointing-device interaction.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0006.review_note: Retained the explicit platform-scoped MUST and recorded the input-dependent style mapping.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0007.title: Avoid controls that duplicate edit-menu commands

statement.en: Avoid adding other controls that duplicate familiar edit-menu commands.
statement.ja: 慣れたedit-menu commandを重複する別のcontrolの追加を避ける。

conditions: Preserve interface space for actions people may not already know how to access.
exceptions: A product requirement may justify a redundant control when the risk and space tradeoff are documented.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0007.review_note: Retained AVOID rather than raising the qualified in-general guidance to a prohibition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0008.title: Place custom commands near related system commands

statement.en: Place custom edit-menu commands near the related system-provided commands.
statement.ja: custom edit-menu commandを関連するsystem-provided commandの近くに配置する。

conditions: For example, place custom formatting commands after the system commands in the formatting section to preserve expected ordering.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0008.review_note: Recovered the omitted command-grouping rule and recorded its ordering example.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0009.title: Avoid too many custom commands

statement.en: Avoid overwhelming people with too many custom edit-menu commands.
statement.ja: custom edit-menu commandを増やしすぎて利用者を圧倒しない。

conditions: Keep the menu focused on commands relevant to the current context.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0009.review_note: Recovered the separate AVOID clause from the custom-command paragraph without treating it as MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0010.title: Allow copying noneditable content when useful

statement.en: When useful, let people select and copy noneditable content text.
statement.ja: 有用な場合はnoneditable content textを選択してcopyできるようにする。

conditions: Examples include image captions and social-media status text that people may paste into a message, note, or search.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0010.review_note: Recovered the conditional content-copying rule and kept its usefulness qualifier.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0011.title: Avoid making control labels copyable

statement.en: Avoid making control labels selectable and copyable as content.
statement.ja: control labelをcontentとして選択・copy可能にすることを避ける。

conditions: Distinguish control labels from content text that people may reasonably reuse.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0011.review_note: Recovered the qualified not-control-labels clause as AVOID rather than an unconditional prohibition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0012.title: Differentiate deletion-command behavior

statement.en: Differentiate edit-menu commands that delete content in meaningfully different ways.
statement.ja: contentを異なる方法で削除するedit-menu commandを区別する。

conditions: For example, Delete removes content directly, whereas Cut first copies it to the system pasteboard.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0012.review_note: Recovered the when-necessary deletion-semantics rule and preserved the Delete versus Cut distinction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0013.title: Describe custom commands with action words

statement.en: Label custom edit-menu commands with verbs or short verb phrases that describe their action.
statement.ja: custom edit-menu commandをactionを表すverbまたは短いverb phraseでlabel付けする。

conditions: Use wording that remains succinct while making the performed action clear.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0013.review_note: Recovered the independent command-wording rule from the same source paragraph as label length.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0014.title: Avoid relying on edit menus in tvOS or watchOS

statement.en: Avoid relying on edit menus in tvOS or watchOS, where the system doesn't provide them.
statement.ja: systemがedit menuを提供しないtvOSとwatchOSではedit menuに依存しない。

conditions: Choose another platform-supported component or interaction for editing tasks.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit unsupported-platform constraint as AVOID and scoped it only to tvOS and watchOS.

HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0015.title: Reposition edit menus only when necessary

statement.en: Reposition an iOS or iPadOS edit menu when necessary to keep important content visible.
statement.ja: 重要なcontentを見える状態に保つ必要がある場合はiOSまたはiPadOSのedit menuを再配置する。

conditions: Keep the default placement above or below the insertion point or selection when it works.
Move the menu when it would otherwise cover important content or interface areas.
exceptions: You can change the menu position, but not the shape of the menu or its pointer.
HIG-COMPONENTS-EDIT-MENUS-0015.review_note: Recovered the conditional placement rule and recorded both the default behavior and customization limit.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0001.title: Choose marks for the information being communicated

statement.en: Choose a chart mark type based on the information you need to communicate.
statement.ja: 伝える必要があるinformationに基づいてchart mark typeを選ぶ。

conditions: Use bars for category comparisons or proportions, lines for changes and trends, and points for relationships, outliers, or clusters.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0001.review_note: Replaced the generated wording and recorded each documented mark-type purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0002.title: Consider combining mark types for clarity

statement.en: Consider combining mark types when doing so adds clarity to a chart.
statement.ja: chartの明確さが増す場合はmark typeの組み合わせを検討する。

conditions: For example, points can expose individual values while a line communicates the overall trend.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0002.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the distinct-detail versus trend relationship.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0003.title: Match fixed or dynamic axis range to meaning

statement.en: Use a fixed or dynamic axis range according to the meaning and variability of the data.
statement.ja: dataのmeaningとvariabilityに応じてfixedまたはdynamic axis rangeを使う。

conditions: Use a fixed range when meaningful bounds apply to all values; consider a dynamic range when values vary widely and should fill the plot area.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0003.review_note: Recorded the semantic-bound and wide-variability conditions for both range choices.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0004.title: Prefer familiar axis-label sequences

statement.en: Prefer familiar value sequences for axis tick and grid-line labels.
statement.ja: axis tickとgrid-line labelには見慣れたvalue sequenceを優先する。

conditions: Use sequences whose interval people can recognize at a glance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0004.review_note: Replaced the generated wording and recorded interval predictability.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0005.title: Explain a chart before people inspect it

statement.en: Write descriptions that explain a chart's purpose and function before people inspect it.
statement.ja: chartを詳しく見る前にpurposeとfunctionを説明するdescriptionを書く。

conditions: Use information-rich titles and labels, especially for VoiceOver users and people with cognitive disabilities.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0005.review_note: Recorded the before-detail timing and accessibility rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0006.title: Ensure every chart is accessible

statement.en: Ensure every chart is fully accessible regardless of how people perceive content.
statement.ja: contentの知覚方法にかかわらずすべてのchartを完全にaccessibleにする。

conditions: Treat accessibility as required for every chart, not as an optional enhancement.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0006.review_note: Raised the general chart-accessibility rule to MUST from the explicit fully-accessible requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0007.title: Allow useful chart-data interaction

statement.en: Let people interact with chart data when interaction adds useful detail.
statement.ja: 有用なdetailが得られる場合はchart dataを操作できるようにする。

conditions: Keep the chart's main message visible before interaction.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0007.review_note: Separated optional detail exploration from the critical-information interaction prohibition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0008.title: Make chart interactions easy for everyone

statement.en: Make chart interactions easy for people with every level of motor control.
statement.ja: motor controlの程度にかかわらずchartを簡単に操作できるようにする。

conditions: Don't require precise targeting of marks that are too small for a finger or pointer.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0008.review_note: Recorded the motor-control and target-size context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0009.title: Make chart navigation logical for keyboard and Switch Control

statement.en: Make interactive chart navigation logical and predictable for keyboard and Switch Control users.
statement.ja: keyboardとSwitch Control利用者向けのinteractive chart navigationをlogicalかつpredictableにする。

conditions: Use accessibility APIs for a predictable path or focus subsets of values in very large datasets.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0009.review_note: Repaired truncation and recorded both documented custom-navigation strategies.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0010.title: Help people notice chart changes

statement.en: Help people notice important changes to chart marks or axes.
statement.ja: chart markやaxisの重要なchangeに気づけるようにする。

conditions: Animation can supplement but not replace a nonanimated accessibility cue.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0010.review_note: Recorded the misreading risk and split the mandatory nonanimation path.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0011.title: Avoid color-only chart distinctions

statement.en: Avoid relying only on color to distinguish chart data or communicate essential information.
statement.ja: chart dataの区別や必須informationの伝達をcolorだけに依存しない。

conditions: Pair color with a perceivable encoding such as shape or pattern.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0011.review_note: Repaired truncation and separated the required alternative encoding.

section_path: Enhancing the accessibility of a chart

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0012.title: Consider Audio Graphs for VoiceOver

statement.en: Consider using Audio Graphs to give VoiceOver users more chart information.
statement.ja: VoiceOver利用者へ追加のchart informationを提供するAudio Graphを検討する。

conditions: Supply a chart title and descriptive summary when customizing the Swift Charts implementation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0012.review_note: Retained MAY and corrected the modality from generic voice to screen reader.

section_path: Enhancing the accessibility of a chart

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0013.title: Write chart-purpose-aware accessibility labels

statement.en: Write accessibility labels whose detail and grouping support the chart's purpose.
statement.ja: chartのpurposeを支えるdetailとgroupingでaccessibility labelを書く。

conditions: Label individual marks or meaningful groups according to what people need to learn from the chart.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0013.review_note: Recorded the chart-purpose test and individual-versus-group label choice.

section_path: Enhancing the accessibility of a chart

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0014.title: Prioritize clear comprehensive chart labels

statement.en: Make chart accessibility labels clear, comprehensive, and concise.
statement.ja: chart accessibility labelを明確・包括的・簡潔にする。

conditions: Provide context for a value without repeating information available from the overview or Audio Graphs.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0014.review_note: Recorded context-before-detail order and the redundancy boundary.

section_path: Enhancing the accessibility of a chart

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0015.title: Avoid subjective terms in chart descriptions

statement.en: Avoid subjective terms in chart accessibility descriptions.
statement.ja: chart accessibility descriptionでsubjective termを避ける。

conditions: Use actual values so people can form their own interpretation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0015.review_note: Recorded the interpretation risk and objective-value alternative.

section_path: Enhancing the accessibility of a chart

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0016.title: Describe chart meaning instead of appearance

statement.en: Describe what chart details represent rather than what they look like.
statement.ja: chart detailの見た目ではなく何を表すかを説明する。

conditions: Identify each data series instead of describing its visual color.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0016.review_note: Corrected the generated gaze modality to screen reader and recorded semantic identification.

section_path: Enhancing the accessibility of a chart

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0017.title: Refer to chart axes consistently

statement.en: Refer to each chart axis consistently throughout the app.
statement.ja: app全体で各chart axisを一貫して参照する。

conditions: Use a stable axis order so people can identify the relevant axis quickly.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0019.title: Choose lower bounds by mark type and usage

statement.en: Set an axis lower bound according to the mark type and the chart's purpose.
statement.ja: mark typeとchart purposeに応じてaxis lower boundを設定する。

conditions: Zero can support bar-height comparison, but avoid it when it obscures meaningful differences far from zero.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0019.review_note: Recorded both the zero-baseline benefit and the meaningful-difference risk.

section_path: Enhancing the accessibility of a chart

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0020.title: Hide redundant axis labels from assistive technologies

statement.en: Hide visible axis and tick labels from assistive technologies when accessible alternatives provide the same information.
statement.ja: accessible alternativeが同じinformationを提供する場合はvisible axis・tick labelをassistive technologyから隠す。

conditions: Accessibility labels and Audio Graphs already expose mark values and trend information.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0020.review_note: Added the redundancy condition so visible labels aren't hidden without equivalent accessible information.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0021.title: Adapt grid lines and labels to chart use

statement.en: Adapt grid-line and label density and weight to the chart's context and tasks.
statement.ja: chartのcontextとtaskに合わせてgrid-line・labelのdensityとweightを調整する。

conditions: Avoid both visual overload from too many lines and poor value estimation from too few.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0021.review_note: Recovered the omitted axes lead and both density failure modes.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0022.title: Ensure chart descriptions summarize key information

statement.en: Ensure chart descriptions summarize the main message and essential key information.
statement.ja: chart descriptionでmain messageと必須key informationを要約する。

conditions: Help people grasp the chart's most important information without examining every detail.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0022.review_note: Recovered the explicit essential summary requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0023.title: Use consistent chart visual hierarchy

statement.en: Use a consistent visual hierarchy that reflects the importance of chart elements.
statement.ja: chart elementの重要度を反映する一貫したvisual hierarchyを使う。

conditions: Keep data most prominent and let descriptions and axes provide secondary context.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0023.review_note: Recovered the omitted hierarchy lead and source-defined prominence order.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0024.title: Maximize compact-chart plot width

statement.en: In compact environments, maximize the plot width available for examining a chart.
statement.ja: compact environmentではchart確認に使えるplot widthを最大化する。

conditions: Move units or longer labels elsewhere only when doing so doesn't obscure important data.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0024.review_note: Recovered the compact-width lead and bounded the alternative label placements.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0025.title: Ensure compact-chart axis labels stay concise

statement.en: In a compact chart, ensure vertical-axis labels are as short as possible without losing clarity.
statement.ja: compact chartでは明確さを失わない範囲でvertical-axis labelを可能な限り短くする。

conditions: Apply when chart width is constrained and vertical-axis labels consume plot space.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0025.review_note: Recovered the conditional explicit Ensure requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0026.title: Avoid interaction-only critical chart information

statement.en: Avoid requiring interaction to reveal critical chart information.
statement.ja: critical chart informationの表示に操作を必須とすることを避ける。

conditions: Make the chart's main message available before any interaction.
exceptions: Interaction can reveal optional details after the main message is already available.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit Don't clause separately from optional interaction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0027.title: Consider a plot-wide chart hit target

statement.en: Consider expanding a chart's hit target to the entire plot area when individual marks are too small.
statement.ja: 個々のmarkが小さすぎる場合はchart hit targetをplot area全体へ広げることを検討する。

conditions: Let people scrub across the enlarged target to reveal values.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0027.review_note: Recovered the conditional hit-target option and motor-accessibility purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0028.title: Ensure chart changes are noticeable without animation

statement.en: Ensure important chart changes remain noticeable without relying on animation.
statement.ja: animationに依存せず重要なchart changeに気づけるようにする。

conditions: Provide a nonanimated cue for VoiceOver users and people who disable animations.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0028.review_note: Recovered the explicit accessibility requirement for an additional change cue.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0029.title: Align charts with surrounding interface elements

statement.en: Align a chart with surrounding interface elements.
statement.ja: chartを周囲のinterface elementと整列させる。

conditions: Preserve a clean leading edge by placing vertical-grid labels carefully or moving the Y axis when appropriate.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0029.review_note: Recovered the omitted alignment lead and its leading-edge techniques.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0030.title: Separate contiguous chart colors visually

statement.en: Use visual separation between contiguous areas of color in a chart.
statement.ja: chart内で隣接するcolor areaの間にvisual separationを設ける。

conditions: Use separators to distinguish adjacent marks in stacked rows or columns.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0030.review_note: Recovered the omitted color-separation lead and stacked-mark application.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0031.title: Ensure noncolor alternatives convey chart information

statement.en: Ensure noncolor alternatives communicate essential chart information and data distinctions.
statement.ja: 非colorの代替手段で必須chart informationとdataの違いを伝える。

conditions: Supplement color with shapes, patterns, labels, or another perceivable encoding.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0031.review_note: Recovered the source's crucial accessibility requirement separately from color-only avoidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0032.title: Ensure every chart supports VoiceOver

statement.en: Ensure every chart supports VoiceOver navigation and information access.
statement.ja: すべてのchartでVoiceOverによるnavigationとinformation accessを可能にする。

conditions: Provide accessible descriptions and navigation without requiring visual perception.

automated: Inspect the accessibility tree for meaningful chart summaries, elements, labels, values, and navigation order.
manual: Can a VoiceOver user understand the chart's main message and navigate its meaningful details?

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0032.review_note: Recovered the explicit essential VoiceOver requirement with testable accessibility-tree coverage.

section_path: Enhancing the accessibility of a chart

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0033.title: Provide a chart overview without Audio Graphs

statement.en: When Audio Graphs aren't used, provide an overview of the chart's structure and purpose.
statement.ja: Audio Graphを使わない場合はchartのstructureとpurposeのoverviewを提供する。

conditions: Identify the chart type, explain each axis, and describe upper and lower axis bounds.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0033.review_note: Recovered the explicit need-to-provide fallback and its required overview content.

section_path: Enhancing the accessibility of a chart

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0034.title: Label important and interactive chart elements

statement.en: Provide purpose-appropriate accessibility labels for important or interactive chart elements.
statement.ja: 重要またはinteractiveなchart elementにpurposeに合うaccessibility labelを提供する。

conditions: Choose per-mark or grouped labels according to chart purpose, mark scope, and density.
exceptions: A small chart inside a control can use one succinct high-level label when it opens a detailed version.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0034.review_note: Recovered label coverage and granularity from the Important note without making per-mark labeling universal.

section_path: Enhancing the accessibility of a chart

HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0035.title: Avoid ambiguous chart-description formats

statement.en: Avoid ambiguous formats and abbreviations in chart accessibility descriptions.
statement.ja: chart accessibility descriptionで曖昧なformatやabbreviationを避ける。

conditions: Spell out dates and units when compact forms could have multiple meanings.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CHARTS-0035.review_note: Recovered the omitted clarity lead and its date and unit examples.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0001.title: Make buttons easy to recognize and use

statement.en: Make buttons easy for people to recognize, select, and activate.
statement.ja: buttonを認識・選択・操作しやすくする。

conditions: Support every input method available on the target platform.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0001.review_note: Replaced the generic generated statement and separated concrete spacing and hit-region requirements.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0002.title: Always provide a custom-button press state

statement.en: Always provide a visible press state for every custom button.
statement.ja: すべてのcustom buttonにvisible press stateを常に提供する。

conditions: The press state confirms that the button accepted input.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0002.review_note: Retained the unqualified Always-based MUST and recorded its responsiveness purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0003.title: Distinguish preferred choices by style, not size

statement.en: Use visual style rather than size to distinguish a preferred button among multiple options.
statement.ja: 複数option内のpreferred buttonはsizeではなくvisual styleで区別する。

conditions: Keep buttons in a coherent choice set the same size; make the preferred option more prominent.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0003.review_note: Restored the same-size set relationship and prominent-versus-less-prominent styling technique.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0004.title: Avoid matching button-label and content colors

statement.en: Avoid using similar colors for button labels and content-layer backgrounds.
statement.ja: button labelとcontent layer backgroundに似たcolorを使うことを避ける。

conditions: Keep button labels visually distinct from the content behind them.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0004.review_note: Repaired the generated wording and recorded the content-layer contrast boundary.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0005.title: Ensure every button communicates its purpose

statement.en: Ensure every button clearly communicates its purpose.
statement.ja: 各buttonが目的を明確に伝えることを確実にする。

conditions: Use a symbol, text label, or both as supported by the target platform.
exceptions: macOS and visionOS can also reveal a brief explanatory tooltip after hover or gaze.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0005.review_note: Retained the explicit Ensure-based MUST and recorded platform-supported content forms.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0006.title: Consider text when it is clearer than an icon

statement.en: Consider a short text label when it communicates a button's action more clearly than an icon.
statement.ja: iconよりbutton actionを明確に伝える場合は短いtext labelを検討する。

conditions: An icon doesn't communicate the button's action as clearly as a few words can.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0006.review_note: Retained MAY from Consider and narrowed the choice to relative communication clarity.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0007.title: Avoid primary roles for destructive buttons

statement.en: Avoid assigning the primary role to a destructive button, even when it is the most likely choice.
statement.ja: 最も選ばれやすい場合でもdestructive buttonにprimary roleを割り当てることを避ける。

conditions: Primary visual prominence can cause people to choose without reading first.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0007.review_note: Repaired the truncated rule and retained AVOID from the direct Don't directive.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0030.title: Associate familiar actions with familiar icons

statement.en: Try to associate familiar actions with familiar icons.
statement.ja: 見慣れたactionには見慣れたiconを対応させるよう努める。

conditions: Use an existing or customized symbol when an icon suits the action.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0030.review_note: Retained SHOULD from Try and recorded the standard-symbol path.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0031.title: Emphasize the most likely action with prominent style

statement.en: Use a prominent visual style for the most likely action in a view.
statement.ja: view内で最も選ばれやすいactionにprominent visual styleを使う。

conditions: A prominent style can apply an accent-colored background and attract attention.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0031.review_note: Replaced the long title and separated the one-or-two prominent-button limit.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0032.title: Ensure sufficient space around every button

statement.en: Ensure every button has enough surrounding space for people to distinguish and activate it.
statement.ja: 各buttonの周囲に識別と操作に十分なspaceを確保する。

conditions: Provide sufficient separation and activation space for every supported input method.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0032.review_note: Recovered the explicit essential and critical input-accessibility requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0033.title: Ensure a 44-point minimum button hit region

statement.en: Ensure buttons outside visionOS have a hit region of at least 44 by 44 points.
statement.ja: visionOS以外のbuttonには少なくとも44×44 pointのhit regionを確保する。

conditions: Treat 44 points as the component-level general hit-region floor.
Apply stricter platform accessibility values where documented; tvOS uses at least 56 by 56 points and prefers 66 by 66 points.

automated: Measure each scoped button hit region and compare it with the stricter applicable component or platform minimum.
manual: Can people reliably select each button with every supported input method?

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0033.review_note: Recovered the explicit 44-point minimum, separated visionOS, and documented the higher-priority tvOS accessibility floor.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0034.title: Ensure a 60-point visionOS button hit region

statement.en: Ensure visionOS buttons have a hit region of at least 60 by 60 points.
statement.ja: visionOS buttonには少なくとも60×60 pointのhit regionを確保する。

conditions: Apply the visionOS minimum for comfortable eye-based selection.

automated: Measure each visionOS button hit region and verify a minimum width and height of 60 points.
manual: Can people comfortably look at and select each visionOS button?

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0034.review_note: Recovered and scoped the explicit 60-point visionOS minimum.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0035.title: Limit prominent buttons per view

statement.en: Keep the number of prominent buttons to one or two per view.
statement.ja: viewごとのprominent buttonを1個または2個に抑える。

conditions: Too many prominent choices increase cognitive load and decision time.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0035.review_note: Recovered the explicit one-or-two limit and its cognitive-load rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0036.title: Prefer monochromatic labels over colorful content

statement.en: Prefer the default monochromatic button-label appearance over bright or colorful content.
statement.ja: 明るくcolorfulなcontent上ではdefault monochromatic button labelを優先する。

conditions: The content layer already contains bright or colorful content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0036.review_note: Recovered the conditional monochromatic-label preference from supporting prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0037.title: Keep text button labels succinct

statement.en: Use a few words that succinctly describe the button's action.
statement.ja: button actionを簡潔に説明する数語のlabelを使う。

conditions: A text label communicates the action more clearly than an icon.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0037.review_note: Recovered the label-length and action-description guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0038.title: Consider verb-led text button labels

statement.en: For a title-style text label, consider starting with a verb that conveys the button's action.
statement.ja: title styleのtext labelではbutton actionを伝えるverbから始めることを検討する。

conditions: Use title-style capitalization and a verb that succinctly describes the action.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0038.review_note: Recovered the conditional verb-led label guidance and retained MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0039.title: Assign the primary role to the most likely choice

statement.en: Assign the primary role to the button people are most likely to choose.
statement.ja: 最も選ばれやすいbuttonにprimary roleを割り当てる。

conditions: Return-key activation can confirm the choice and dismiss a temporary view automatically.
exceptions: Exclude destructive buttons even when they are the most likely choice.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BUTTONS-0039.review_note: Recovered the omitted positive primary-role guidance and preserved the destructive-button exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0001.title: Avoid duplicating common activity-view actions

statement.en: Avoid duplicating common actions already available in the activity view.
statement.ja: activity viewですでに利用できる一般的なactionの重複を避ける。

conditions: System-provided actions such as Print already have familiar meaning and placement.
exceptions: Give similar app-specific functionality a distinguishing custom title.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0001.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the confusion risk plus the distinct-title exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0002.title: Consider a symbol for a custom activity

statement.en: Consider using a symbol to represent a custom activity.
statement.ja: custom activityを表すsymbolの使用を検討する。

conditions: Use a symbol that communicates the activity's item or concept.
exceptions: A custom interface icon can be used when the symbol set doesn't fit.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0002.review_note: Retained MAY from Consider and recorded the custom-icon alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0003.title: Write succinct descriptive custom-action titles

statement.en: Use a succinct, descriptive title for each custom action.
statement.ja: 各custom actionに簡潔で説明的なtitleを使う。

conditions: Long titles can wrap and may be truncated by the system.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0003.review_note: Replaced the generated wording and recorded the wrapping and truncation risk.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0004.title: Ensure activities fit the current context

statement.en: Ensure every displayed activity is appropriate for the current context.
statement.ja: 表示する各activityが現在のcontextに適切であることを確実にする。

conditions: Exclude inapplicable system tasks and choose custom tasks for the current situation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0004.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure directive and recorded both system and custom activity controls.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0005.title: Use the Share button to reveal an activity view

statement.en: Use the Share button to reveal an activity view.
statement.ja: activity viewの表示にはShare buttonを使う。

conditions: People expect system-provided sharing activities behind the Share button.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0005.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the familiar system-access rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0006.title: Avoid extra modal views above extensions

statement.en: Avoid displaying an additional modal view above an extension.
statement.ja: extensionの上に追加のmodal viewを表示することを避ける。

conditions: The system already presents an extension within a modal view.
exceptions: An alert above the extension can be necessary.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0006.review_note: Retained AVOID and restored the system-modal context and alert exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0007.title: Show lengthy extension-task status in the main app

statement.en: Use the main app to show the status of a lengthy extension task.
statement.ja: 時間のかかるextension taskのstatusはmain appで示す。

conditions: An activity view dismisses immediately after people finish the extension interaction.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0007.review_note: Replaced the vague progress wording and recorded the immediate-dismissal context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0008.title: Distinguish app-specific activities with custom titles

statement.en: Give an app-specific activity a custom title when it resembles an existing action.
statement.ja: 既存actionに似たapp固有activityにはcustom titleを付ける。

conditions: The title explains the app-specific behavior that differs from the common action.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0008.review_note: Recovered the conditional custom-title guidance from supporting prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0009.title: Center custom activity icons in a 70-pixel area

statement.en: Center a custom activity icon in an area about 70 by 70 pixels.
statement.ja: custom activity iconを約70×70 pixelのarea中央に配置する。

conditions: Apply when creating a custom interface icon instead of using a symbol.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0009.review_note: Recovered the approximate custom-icon canvas size without turning it into an exact threshold.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0010.title: Prefer verb-based custom-action titles

statement.en: Prefer a single verb or brief verb phrase that clearly describes a custom action.
statement.ja: custom actionを明確に表す単一verbまたは短いverb phraseを優先する。

conditions: Keep the title short enough to reduce wrapping or truncation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0010.review_note: Recovered the preferred grammatical form and action-clarity condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0011.title: Avoid brand names in custom-action titles

statement.en: Avoid including a company or product name in a custom-action title.
statement.ja: custom action titleにcompany名やproduct名を含めることを避ける。

conditions: The title names a custom action rather than a share activity.
exceptions: A share activity typically displays a company name below its icon.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0011.review_note: Recovered the action-title restriction and preserved the distinct share-activity convention.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0012.title: Consider excluding inapplicable activities

statement.en: Consider excluding system activities that aren't applicable to the current app context.
statement.ja: 現在のapp contextに該当しないsystem activityの除外を検討する。

conditions: System-provided activities can't be reordered, but inapplicable ones can be excluded.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0012.review_note: Recovered the documented exclusion option and retained MAY rather than making it mandatory.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0013.title: Avoid alternate activity-view entry points

statement.en: Avoid providing another way to reveal the same activity view.
statement.ja: 同じactivity viewを表示する別の方法を提供することを避ける。

conditions: Use the familiar Share button entry point instead.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0013.review_note: Recovered the explicit confusion-avoidance guidance separately from positive Share-button use.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0014.title: Keep necessary custom extension interfaces familiar

statement.en: When a custom extension interface is necessary, make it feel familiar.
statement.ja: custom extension interfaceが必要な場合は見慣れた体験にする。

conditions: A share or action extension needs custom UI instead of a system-provided view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0014.review_note: Recovered the conditional interface-familiarity lead and retained SHOULD.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0015.title: Prefer the system composition view for share extensions

statement.en: Prefer the system-provided composition view for a share extension.
statement.ja: share extensionではsystem提供のcomposition viewを優先する。

conditions: The system view provides a consistent sharing experience people already know.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0015.review_note: Recovered the explicit preference and familiar-sharing rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0016.title: Include the app name in action extension interfaces

statement.en: Include the app name in an action extension interface.
statement.ja: action extension interfaceにapp名を含める。

conditions: An action extension presents an interface.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0016.review_note: Recovered the direct action-extension naming guidance and kept conservative SHOULD strength.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0017.title: Relate custom extension interfaces to the main app

statement.en: Include recognizable app-interface elements when an extension presents a custom interface.
statement.ja: extensionがcustom interfaceを表示する場合はappを認識できるinterface elementを含める。

conditions: Help people understand that the extension and main app are related.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0017.review_note: Recovered the conditional visual-relationship guidance from supporting prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0018.title: Streamline extension interactions

statement.en: Streamline extension interactions and limit the steps needed to complete the task.
statement.ja: extension操作を簡潔にしtask完了までのstepを制限する。

conditions: Minimize the number of taps or clicks needed for the extension task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0018.review_note: Recovered the omitted interaction-efficiency lead and retained SHOULD.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0019.title: Provide a purpose image when an extension needs one

statement.en: When necessary, provide an image that communicates the extension's purpose.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はextensionの目的を伝えるimageを提供する。

conditions: A share extension automatically uses the main app's icon.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0019.review_note: Recovered the conditional image guidance and the automatic share-extension icon behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0020.title: Prefer task-identifying action extension icons

statement.en: For an action extension, prefer a symbol or interface icon that clearly identifies the task.
statement.ja: action extensionではtaskを明確に識別するsymbolまたはinterface iconを優先する。

conditions: An action extension needs an image that communicates its task.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0021.title: Continue time-consuming extension work in the background

statement.en: Continue a time-consuming extension task in the background.
statement.ja: 時間のかかるextension taskはbackgroundで継続する。

conditions: The activity view dismisses immediately after the extension interaction finishes.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0021.review_note: Recovered background continuation separately from main-app status visibility.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0022.title: Avoid extension completion-only notifications

statement.en: Avoid notifying people solely because an extension task completes.
statement.ja: extension taskが完了したという理由だけで通知することを避ける。

conditions: The extension task completes without a problem that requires attention.
exceptions: A notification can report a problem with the operation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0022.review_note: Recovered the completion-notification prohibition and preserved the problem-reporting exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0023.title: Avoid activity views on unsupported platforms

statement.en: Avoid offering an activity view on macOS, tvOS, or watchOS.
statement.ja: macOS、tvOS、watchOSでactivity viewを提供することを避ける。

conditions: Activity views are unsupported on these platforms.
exceptions: macOS supports share and action app extensions even though it has no activity view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-VIEWS-0023.review_note: Recovered the platform limitation, corrected scope to unsupported platforms, and preserved the macOS extension exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0001.title: Display Activity rings only when relevant

statement.en: Display Activity rings when they're relevant to the app's purpose.
statement.ja: appの目的に関連する場合にActivity ringsを表示する。

conditions: Health, fitness, and HealthKit-related apps are contexts where people commonly expect Activity rings.
exceptions: Workout metrics and summary screens are examples, not required placements.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0001.review_note: Recorded relevance and product-context conditions without making example placements universal.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0002.title: Use Activity rings only for their three activity metrics

statement.en: Use Activity rings only for Move, Exercise, and Stand progress.
statement.ja: Activity ringsはMove、Exercise、Standのprogressだけに使う。

conditions: Preserve the component's consistent meaning across apps.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0002.review_note: Kept the positive scope rule at SHOULD and represented the source's explicit Never prohibitions separately.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0003.title: Use Activity rings for one person's progress

statement.en: Use Activity rings to show progress for a single person.
statement.ja: Activity ringsで1人分のprogressを示す。

conditions: Keep the represented person's identity clear.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0003.review_note: Retained the positive single-person recommendation and split the explicit multi-person prohibition and identity requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0004.title: Always preserve Activity ring appearance

statement.en: Always preserve the visual appearance of Activity rings wherever they appear.
statement.ja: Activity ringsは表示場所にかかわらずvisual appearanceを常に維持する。

conditions: Keep styling consistent across the app.
exceptions: On iOS, the system automatically shows three rings with a paired Apple Watch and Move-only without one; history can contain both states.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0004.review_note: Retained Always-based MUST and distinguished system-controlled ring count from app-controlled visual styling.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0005.title: Maintain required Activity ring margins

statement.en: Maintain the required outer margin around Activity rings.
statement.ja: Activity ringsの必須outer marginを維持する。

conditions: The outer margin is at least the distance between adjacent rings.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0005.review_note: Raised the generated SHOULD to MUST based on the explicit source must and restored its relative minimum.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0006.title: Avoid redundant Activity notifications

statement.en: Avoid notifications that repeat Activity app progress information.
statement.ja: Activity appのprogress情報を繰り返すnotificationを避ける。

conditions: The system already delivers Move, Exercise, and Stand progress updates.
exceptions: A notification can reference progress in an app-specific way without replicating system information.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0006.review_note: Recorded the redundancy boundary and preserved the documented unique-reference exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0007.title: Avoid decorative Activity rings

statement.en: Avoid using Activity rings as decoration.
statement.ja: Activity ringsを装飾として使わない。

conditions: Activity rings must communicate activity information rather than merely embellish the design.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0007.review_note: Retained the general decoration avoidance and split the explicit label and background prohibition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0008.title: Avoid Activity rings as branding

statement.en: Avoid using Activity rings for branding.
statement.ja: Activity ringsをbrandingに使わない。

conditions: Use the component strictly to display Activity progress in the app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0008.review_note: Retained the general branding avoidance and split its explicit icon and marketing prohibition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0009.title: Never alter Activity ring colors or opacity

statement.en: Never alter Activity ring colors, filters, or opacity.
statement.ja: Activity ringのcolor、filter、opacityを変更しない。

conditions: Preserve the system-defined visual identity of all three rings.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0009.review_note: Retained the explicit Never prohibition and restored filters as a covered alteration.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0010.title: Always use a black Activity ring background

statement.en: Always display Activity rings on a black background.
statement.ja: Activity ringsは常にblack background上に表示する。

conditions: Keep the black background visually connected to the rings.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0011.title: Prefer a circular Activity ring background enclosure

statement.en: Prefer enclosing Activity rings and their black background within a circle.
statement.ja: Activity ringsとblack backgroundをcircle内に収めることを優先する。

conditions: Create the enclosure by adjusting the view's corner radius.
exceptions: Don't apply a circular mask to the rings.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0011.review_note: Repaired truncation and preserved Prefer strength plus the corner-radius technique.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0012.title: Ensure black remains visible outside the outer ring

statement.en: Ensure the black background remains visible around the outermost Activity ring.
statement.ja: outermost Activity ringの周囲にblack backgroundが見える状態を確保する。

conditions: Add a thin black outer stroke if needed.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0012.review_note: Retained Ensure-based MUST and separated optional stroke from visual-effect avoidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0013.title: Always scale Activity rings appropriately

statement.en: Always scale Activity rings so they remain visually connected and appropriately placed.
statement.ja: Activity ringsが視覚的につながり適切に配置されるよう常にscaleする。

conditions: Prevent the rings from appearing disconnected or out of place.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0013.review_note: Retained Always-based MUST and the two visual outcomes.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0014.title: Never use Activity rings for other data

statement.en: Never use Activity rings to display data other than Move, Exercise, or Stand progress.
statement.ja: Move、Exercise、Stand以外のdata表示にActivity ringsを使わない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never prohibition separately from the positive three-metric rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0015.title: Never restyle Activity progress as other rings

statement.en: Never show Move, Exercise, or Stand progress in another ring-like element.
statement.ja: Move、Exercise、Stand progressを別のring-like elementで表示しない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0015.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never prohibition that protects Activity ring identity.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0016.title: Never combine multiple people's data in Activity rings

statement.en: Never use Activity rings to represent data for more than one person.
statement.ja: Activity ringsで複数人のdataを表さない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0016.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never prohibition separately from positive single-person guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0017.title: Ensure the represented person's identity is clear

statement.en: Ensure it's obvious whose progress Activity rings show.
statement.ja: Activity ringsが誰のprogressを示すか明確にする。

conditions: Use a label, photo, or avatar to identify the person.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0017.review_note: Recovered the make-sure identity requirement as an atomic MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0018.title: Blend surrounding UI with Activity rings when needed

statement.en: When necessary, design the surrounding interface to blend with Activity rings.
statement.ja: 必要な場合は周囲のinterfaceをActivity ringsになじむよう設計する。

conditions: Adapt surrounding UI rather than changing the rings.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0018.review_note: Recovered the conditional positive action separately from the Never prohibition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0019.title: Never change Activity rings to match surrounding UI

statement.en: Never change Activity rings to blend with the surrounding interface.
statement.ja: 周囲のinterfaceになじませるためActivity ringsを変更しない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0019.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never prohibition from the mixed-strength sentence.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0020.title: Match associated content to Activity ring colors

statement.en: Use the matching Activity ring color for directly associated labels and values.
statement.ja: 直接関連するlabelやvalueには対応するActivity ring colorを使う。

conditions: Use RGB 250,17,79 for Move; 166,255,0 for Exercise; and 0,255,246 for Stand.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0020.review_note: Recovered the inactive color-association lead and recorded official RGB values from image alt text without storing images.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0021.title: Never encroach on Activity ring margins

statement.en: Never let other elements crop, obstruct, or encroach on Activity rings or their margin.
statement.ja: 他のelementでActivity ringsやmarginをcrop、obstruct、encroachしない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0021.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never prohibition separately from the positive minimum-margin requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0022.title: Differentiate other ring-like elements

statement.en: Differentiate other ring-like elements from Activity rings.
statement.ja: 他のring-like elementをActivity ringsと区別する。

conditions: Use padding, lines, labels, color, or scale to create visual separation when other rings are necessary.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0022.review_note: Recovered the inactive lead and its separation techniques.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0023.title: Avoid Activity ring elements in notifications

statement.en: Avoid showing an Activity ring element in app notifications.
statement.ja: app notification内にActivity ring elementを表示しない。

exceptions: Reference Activity progress in an app-specific, nonredundant way instead.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0023.review_note: Recovered the separate notification-element prohibition and its permitted progress-reference alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0024.title: Avoid Activity rings on unsupported platforms

statement.en: Avoid offering Activity rings on macOS, tvOS, or visionOS.
statement.ja: macOS、tvOS、visionOSではActivity ringsを提供しない。

conditions: Activity rings are unsupported on these platforms.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0024.review_note: Recovered the explicit platform limitation and corrected scope to unsupported platforms.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0025.title: Avoid outer-ring visual effects

statement.en: Avoid gradients, shadows, or other visual effects around the outer Activity ring.
statement.ja: outer Activity ring周囲のgradient、shadow、その他visual effectを避ける。

exceptions: A thin black stroke is acceptable when needed to preserve visible black background.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0025.review_note: Separated visual-effect avoidance from the conditional black-stroke technique.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0026.title: Never place Activity rings in labels or backgrounds

statement.en: Never display Activity rings in labels or background graphics.
statement.ja: labelやbackground graphic内にActivity ringsを表示しない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never prohibition under decoration guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0027.title: Never use Activity rings in icons or marketing

statement.en: Never use Activity rings in app icons or marketing materials.
statement.ja: app iconやmarketing materialにActivity ringsを使わない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTIVITY-RINGS-0027.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never prohibition under branding guidance.

HIG-INPUTS-GYRO-AND-ACCELEROMETER-0001.title: Use motion data only for tangible user benefit

statement.en: Use motion data only when it provides a tangible benefit to people.
statement.ja: 利用者へ具体的なbenefitを提供する場合だけmotion dataを使う。

conditions: Tie motion-data use to a clear product or gameplay outcome.
exceptions: Fitness feedback and enhanced gameplay are examples, not required use cases.
HIG-INPUTS-GYRO-AND-ACCELEROMETER-0001.review_note: Recorded the only-when boundary and separated unsupported collection from positive use.

HIG-INPUTS-GYRO-AND-ACCELEROMETER-0002.title: Avoid motion-data collection without user benefit

statement.en: Avoid collecting motion data without a tangible user benefit.
statement.ja: 具体的なuser benefitがないmotion data収集を避ける。

conditions: Don't gather motion data merely because it is available.
HIG-INPUTS-GYRO-AND-ACCELEROMETER-0002.review_note: Recovered the explicit data-minimization prohibition as a separate privacy-aware rule.

HIG-INPUTS-GYRO-AND-ACCELEROMETER-0003.title: Avoid direct motion-based UI manipulation outside gameplay

statement.en: Outside active gameplay, avoid direct interface manipulation with accelerometers or gyroscopes.
statement.ja: active gameplay外ではaccelerometerやgyroscopeによる直接interface操作を避ける。

conditions: Motion gestures can be imprecise, physically challenging, and costly to battery life.
HIG-INPUTS-GYRO-AND-ACCELEROMETER-0003.review_note: Recovered the inactive source lead, preserved the gameplay exception, and recorded accessibility, precision, and battery risks.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0001.title: Place virtual game buttons within easy reach

statement.en: Place virtual game buttons where they're easy to access.
statement.ja: virtual game buttonを操作しやすい位置に置く。

conditions: Account for device boundaries, safe areas, and comfortable control locations.
Place frequent buttons near the player's thumb and outside expected movement and camera regions.
Place secondary controls toward the top of the screen.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0001.review_note: Corrected scope to iOS and iPadOS touch controls and recorded reach, safe-area, frequency, and control-region constraints.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0002.title: Make sure virtual game controls meet minimum sizes

statement.en: Make sure virtual game controls meet their minimum sizes.
statement.ja: virtual game controlがminimum sizeを満たすようにする。

conditions: Frequently used controls are at least 44 by 44 points.
Less-important controls are at least 28 by 28 points.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0002.review_note: Retained the explicit Make sure MUST and restored both source-defined size classes and thresholds.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0003.title: Always include visible and tactile virtual-control press states

statement.en: Always include visible and tactile press states for virtual game controls.
statement.ja: virtual game controlにはvisibleおよびtactileなpress stateを常に含める。

conditions: Keep the visual state perceivable while a finger covers the control.
Use sound and haptics to strengthen physical feedback when appropriate.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0003.review_note: Retained Always-based MUST, corrected touch scope, and recorded covered-control visibility plus tactile feedback.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0004.title: Use action-representative virtual-control symbols

statement.en: Use virtual-control symbols that communicate the actions they perform.
statement.ja: 実行するactionを伝えるvirtual-control symbolを使う。

conditions: Choose artwork that visually represents the associated game action.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0004.review_note: Corrected touch scope and separated positive symbol guidance from the abstract-artwork avoidance.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0005.title: Adapt virtual controls to gameplay context

statement.en: Show and hide virtual controls to reflect gameplay context.
statement.ja: gameplay contextに合わせてvirtual controlを表示または非表示にする。

conditions: Hide unavailable or irrelevant actions to reduce clutter and focus attention.
exceptions: Hiding movement controls until touch begins is an example, not a universal trigger.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0005.review_note: Recorded context, availability, and clutter reduction while keeping the example optional.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0006.title: Provide a default-interaction fallback for controllers

statement.en: When supporting game controllers, provide a fallback using the platform's default interaction method.
statement.ja: game controller対応時はplatform既定interaction methodのfallbackを提供する。

conditions: Controllers are optional purchases and may be unavailable.
exceptions: tvOS and visionOS games can require a controller when they disclose and handle that requirement.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0006.review_note: Recovered the controller prerequisite and fallback purpose while preserving the documented platform exception.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0007.title: Support multiple connected game controllers

statement.en: Support multiple connected game controllers.
statement.ja: 複数の接続済みgame controllerをsupportする。

conditions: Use labels and glyphs matching the controller a player is actively using.
In multiplayer, use the correct labels and symbols for each player's controller.
exceptions: Consider listing multiple controller-button references together when necessary.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0007.review_note: Recorded active-controller and player-specific labeling plus the optional grouped-reference technique.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0008.title: Prefer symbols for controller elements

statement.en: Prefer symbols instead of text when referring to game-controller elements.
statement.ja: game-controller elementの参照にはtextよりsymbolを優先する。

conditions: Symbols can reduce the need to search for a written button label during gameplay.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0008.review_note: Preserved Prefer and the accessibility value for players unfamiliar with controllers.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0009.title: Prioritize single-key game commands

statement.en: Prioritize single-key commands for keyboard game controls.
statement.ja: keyboard game controlではsingle-key commandを優先する。

conditions: Single-key commands are easier and faster while also using a mouse or trackpad.
exceptions: Letter and Space bindings are examples, not required commands.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0009.review_note: Corrected keyboard modality and preserved the simultaneous-pointer-use rationale.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0010.title: Test game-binding comfort on an Apple keyboard

statement.en: Test the comfort of game key bindings using an Apple keyboard.
statement.ja: Apple keyboardでgame key bindingの快適さをtestする。

conditions: Account for Apple-keyboard key placement and simultaneous movement-key use.
exceptions: Remapping Control to Command is a context-dependent example, not a universal binding.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0010.review_note: Repaired the generated wording and corrected the modality to keyboard.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0011.title: Let players customize game key bindings

statement.en: Let players customize game key bindings.
statement.ja: playerがgame key bindingをcustomizeできるようにする。

conditions: Provide reasonable defaults while supporting personal comfort and play style.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0011.review_note: Corrected keyboard modality and recorded both default and customization expectations.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0013.title: Evaluate virtual controls over game content

statement.en: Determine whether virtual controls should appear over game content.
statement.ja: game content上にvirtual controlを表示するか判断する。

conditions: Virtual controls can suit many actions or movement control; direct object interaction can improve immersion.
Look for gestures that reduce controls overlapping game content.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0013.review_note: Corrected touch scope and recorded both virtual-control and direct-interaction tradeoffs.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0016.title: Combine related touch actions into one control

statement.en: Combine related game actions into a single touch control when practical.
statement.ja: 実用的な場合は関連game actionを1つのtouch controlへまとめる。

conditions: Consider redesigning mechanics that require simultaneous or sequential multi-button input.
Use gestures to expose variations of the same action when appropriate.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0016.review_note: Recovered the inactive lead and its multi-button and gesture conditions without requiring the examples.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0017.title: Use predictable touch movement and camera controls

statement.en: Use predictable behavior for touch movement and camera controls.
statement.ja: touch movementとcamera controlに予測可能なbehaviorを使う。

conditions: Place movement input on the left and camera input on the right.
Use large input areas for both controls.
Prefer a movement thumbstick that appears at the player's touch location.
Prefer direct touch for camera panning over a virtual thumbstick.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0017.review_note: Recovered the inactive lead and all four expected touch-control behaviors.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0018.title: Explain required physical game controllers

statement.en: Tell people when a physical game controller is required.
statement.ja: physical game controllerが必要な場合は利用者へ伝える。

conditions: People can open the game without a connected controller.
Check for a required controller and gracefully prompt people to connect one when missing.
Use the App Store requirement metadata so the system can display its badge.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0018.review_note: Recovered the inactive lead, limited controller requirements to tvOS and visionOS, and recorded the missing-controller state.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0019.title: Detect paired game controllers automatically

statement.en: Automatically detect a paired game controller and its profile.
statement.ja: paired game controllerとprofileを自動検出する。

conditions: Avoid requiring players to perform manual controller setup.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0019.review_note: Recovered the inactive automatic-detection lead and both pairing and profile results.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0020.title: Match onscreen content to the connected controller

statement.en: Match onscreen controller content to the connected game controller.
statement.ja: onscreen controller contentを接続中のgame controllerへ合わせる。

conditions: Actual controller colors and symbols may differ from framework-standard element names.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0020.review_note: Recovered the inactive lead and the framework-versus-hardware mismatch condition.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0021.title: Map controller buttons to expected UI behavior

statement.en: Map physical-controller buttons to expected UI behavior outside gameplay.
statement.ja: gameplay外ではphysical-controller buttonを期待されるUI behaviorへmapする。

conditions: A activates a control; B cancels or returns.
Left and right shoulder buttons navigate between screens or sections.
Thumbsticks and the directional pad move selection.
Reserve Home or logo buttons for system controls.
Menu opens game settings or pauses gameplay.
exceptions: The source specifies no expected UI behavior for X, Y, or trigger buttons.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0021.review_note: Recovered the inactive lead and compactly recorded the structured platform mapping without reproducing unrelated table content.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0022.title: Account for key proximity in game bindings

statement.en: Account for physical key proximity when defining game bindings.
statement.ja: game binding定義時にphysical key proximityを考慮する。

conditions: Place other high-value commands near movement keys.
Consider physically grouping bindings for closely related actions.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0022.review_note: Recovered the inactive lead, corrected modality, and preserved both movement and related-action contexts.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0023.title: Ensure virtual buttons don't overlap system features

statement.en: Ensure virtual game buttons don't overlap system interface features.
statement.ja: virtual game buttonがsystem interface featureと重ならないようにする。

conditions: Respect system features such as the Home indicator and Dynamic Island where present.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0023.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure requirement and scoped the examples to devices where those features exist.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0024.title: Ensure interface labels match the connected controller

statement.en: Ensure controller references and related interface content use the connected controller's labels.
statement.ja: controller参照と関連interface contentに接続中controllerのlabelを使う。

conditions: The interface refers to controls or displays controller-related content.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0024.review_note: Recovered the Be sure requirement separately from general onscreen-content adaptation.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0025.title: Avoid abstract or controller-named virtual-control artwork

statement.en: Avoid abstract shapes or controller-based names as virtual-control artwork.
statement.ja: virtual-control artworkにabstract shapeやcontroller由来の名前を使わない。

conditions: Use action-representative symbols that are easier to understand and remember.
exceptions: Specific controller labels are examples of the discouraged naming pattern.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0025.review_note: Recovered the explicit Avoid separately from positive symbol guidance.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0026.title: Avoid game-control features on watchOS

statement.en: Avoid offering game-control features on watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSではgame-control featureを提供しない。

conditions: Game controls are unsupported on watchOS.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit platform limitation and corrected scope to watchOS itself.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0001.title: Consider physical-world inspiration for a nearby interaction

statement.en: Consider a task's physical-world perspective when designing a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: nearby interactionを設計するときtaskのphysical-world perspectiveを検討する。

conditions: Look for physical actions that can make the task feel easy, natural, and engaging.
exceptions: Device-to-device media transfer is an example, not a required interaction model.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0001.review_note: Preserved Consider and the inspiration purpose without generalizing the example.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0002.title: Use available proximity and context information

statement.en: Use available distance, direction, and context to inform a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: 利用可能なdistance、direction、contextをnearby interactionに反映する。

conditions: Prioritize nearby, contextually relevant information.
iPhone provides peer-device distance and direction; Apple Watch provides peer-device distance.
exceptions: Contact suggestion is an example, not a required nearby-interaction feature.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0002.review_note: Recorded platform capability differences so direction isn't incorrectly required on Apple Watch.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0003.title: Consider proximity-responsive nearby feedback

statement.en: Consider changing nearby-interaction feedback as physical distance changes.
statement.ja: physical distanceの変化に合わせてnearby-interaction feedbackを変えることを検討する。

conditions: Mirror the way perception typically becomes more precise at closer distances.
exceptions: The documented locator transition is an example, not a required visual treatment.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0003.review_note: Preserved Consider and the physical-distance relationship while keeping the example optional.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0004.title: Provide continuous nearby-interaction feedback

statement.en: Provide continuous feedback during a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: nearby interaction中はcontinuous feedbackを提供する。

conditions: Keep feedback uninterrupted and responsive to people's movement.
Use continuous updates to strengthen the connection between the physical task and the interaction.
exceptions: Direction-and-proximity updates are an example, not a requirement on platforms without direction data.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0004.review_note: Recovered responsiveness and continuity without requiring unavailable direction information.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0005.title: Consider multiple nearby-interaction feedback types

statement.en: Consider combining feedback types for a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: nearby interactionで複数のfeedback typeを組み合わせることを検討する。

conditions: Coordinate visual, audible, or haptic feedback with the task and current context.
exceptions: Use only feedback types that are available and appropriate for the device and situation.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0005.review_note: Preserved Consider and contextual modality choice rather than requiring every feedback type.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0006.title: Avoid making nearby interaction the only task path

statement.en: Avoid using a nearby interaction as the only way to perform a task.
statement.ja: nearby interactionをtask実行の唯一の方法にしない。

conditions: Not everyone can experience a nearby interaction.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0006.review_note: Retained the direct accessibility prohibition and split its required positive alternative into a separate MUST.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0007.title: Encourage portrait orientation for nearby interaction

statement.en: Encourage portrait orientation during a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: nearby interaction中はportrait orientationを促す。

conditions: Landscape orientation can reduce the accuracy or availability of distance and relative-direction information.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0007.review_note: Removed watchOS from the orientation scope and recorded the accuracy and availability rationale.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0008.title: Design for the directional field of view

statement.en: Design a nearby interaction for the device's directional field of view.
statement.ja: deviceのdirectional field of viewを考慮してnearby interactionを設計する。

conditions: A participating device outside the field of view may provide distance without relative direction.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0008.review_note: Removed watchOS because its platform capability is distance-only and recorded the partial-data state.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0009.title: Explain nearby-interaction obstruction effects

statement.en: Help people understand how intervening objects affect a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: intervening objectがnearby interactionへ与える影響を理解できるようにする。

conditions: People, animals, or sufficiently large objects can reduce the accuracy or availability of distance and direction information.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0009.review_note: Recorded both affected signal properties and separated optional onboarding advice.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0010.title: Ensure alternative ways to complete nearby-interaction tasks

statement.en: Ensure people can complete a task without using a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: nearby interactionを使わなくてもtaskを完了できるようにする。

conditions: Provide an alternative because not everyone can experience a nearby interaction.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0010.review_note: Recovered the explicit essential accessibility requirement as a positive atomic MUST.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0011.title: Prefer implicit visual portrait guidance

statement.en: When nearby interaction requires portrait orientation, prefer implicit visual holding guidance.
statement.ja: nearby interactionでportrait orientationが必要な場合はimplicit visual holding guidanceを優先する。

conditions: The nearby-interaction feature supports only portrait orientation while it runs.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0011.review_note: Recovered the conditional Prefer rule and limited it to handheld portrait-capable devices.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0012.title: Avoid explicit portrait instructions when possible

statement.en: When possible, avoid explicitly telling people to hold the device in portrait.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はdeviceをportraitで持つよう明示的に指示しない。

conditions: Prefer implicit visual feedback when portrait-only nearby interaction is active.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0012.review_note: Preserved the when-possible qualifier and separated explicit-instruction avoidance from the positive implicit-feedback preference.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0013.title: Consider obstruction advice in onboarding

statement.en: Consider obstacle-avoidance advice in nearby-interaction onboarding or tutorials.
statement.ja: nearby-interaction onboardingまたはtutorialでobstacle回避のadviceを検討する。

conditions: Intervening objects can degrade distance or direction accuracy and availability.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0013.review_note: Preserved Consider and both documented content locations.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0014.title: Avoid nearby-interaction features on unsupported platforms

statement.en: Avoid offering nearby-interaction features on macOS, tvOS, or visionOS.
statement.ja: macOS、tvOS、visionOSではnearby-interaction featureを提供しない。

conditions: Nearby interactions are unsupported on these platforms.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit platform limitation and corrected scope to the unsupported platforms themselves.

HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0015.title: Ensure participating watchOS apps stay foregrounded

statement.en: Ensure a watchOS app remains in the foreground while participating in a nearby interaction.
statement.ja: watchOS appがnearby interactionへ参加中はforegroundを維持する。

conditions: The watchOS app participates in a nearby-interaction experience.
HIG-INPUTS-NEARBY-INTERACTIONS-0015.review_note: Recovered the explicit all-apps must-be-foreground platform contract as a conditional MUST.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0001.title: Support Full Keyboard Access when possible

statement.en: Support Full Keyboard Access when possible.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はFull Keyboard Accessをsupportする。

conditions: Let people navigate and activate windows, menus, controls, and system features using only the keyboard.
Test with Full Keyboard Access enabled in the system accessibility settings.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0001.review_note: Reviewed accessibility first, preserved when-possible strength, and removed tvOS from the scope because the source lists four supported platforms.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0002.title: Respect standard keyboard shortcuts

statement.en: Respect standard keyboard shortcuts and their expected actions.
statement.ja: standard keyboard shortcutと期待されるactionを尊重する。

conditions: People expect common shortcuts to behave consistently across apps and the system.
Use the official standard-shortcut table as the source of current action mappings.
exceptions: Game key bindings can remain customizable to fit personal play styles; review Game controls for game-specific guidance.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0002.review_note: Recorded systemwide expectations and table provenance without copying the 116-row mapping table into the rule store.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0003.title: Use shortcut modifiers in expected ways

statement.en: Use keyboard modifier keys in ways people expect.
statement.ja: keyboard modifier keyを利用者が期待する方法で使う。

conditions: Preserve familiar modifier meanings across selection, movement, and resizing interactions.
exceptions: The source interaction examples illustrate conventions; they aren't universal commands for every app.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0003.review_note: Kept the general convention rule and represented the structured modifier recommendations as separate atomic rules.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0004.title: Avoid redundant Shift in upper-character shortcuts

statement.en: Avoid listing Shift when a shortcut uses the upper character of a two-character key.
statement.ja: two-character keyのupper characterを使うshortcutではShiftを重複表示しない。

conditions: People already use Shift to type the upper character; list the upper character directly.
exceptions: Slash and question-mark shortcuts are examples, not required command bindings.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0004.review_note: Preserved Avoid and the clarity rationale while keeping the illustrated commands nonbinding.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0005.title: Let the system localize keyboard shortcuts

statement.en: Let the system localize shortcut keys for the connected keyboard.
statement.ja: 接続中のkeyboardに合わせたshortcut keyのlocalizationをsystemへ任せる。

conditions: Allow the system to localize both primary and modifier keys.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0005.review_note: Split localization from RTL mirroring so each system-provided behavior is independently reviewable.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0006.title: Avoid unrelated modifier extensions of existing shortcuts

statement.en: Avoid adding a modifier to an existing shortcut for an unrelated command.
statement.ja: 既存shortcutへmodifierを追加して無関係なcommandへ割り当てない。

conditions: Preserve the semantic relationship people infer between a base shortcut and its modifier variants.
exceptions: Undo and redo illustrate the expected relationship; they aren't the only commands covered.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0006.review_note: Preserved Avoid and generalized the semantic-conflict rationale beyond the example.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0008.title: Limit custom shortcuts to frequent app-specific commands

statement.en: Define custom keyboard shortcuts only for frequently used app-specific commands.
statement.ja: custom keyboard shortcutは頻繁に使うapp固有commandだけに定義する。

conditions: Avoid making the app harder to learn by defining too many shortcuts.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0008.review_note: Recorded both the frequency and app-specific constraints plus the learnability rationale.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0009.title: Avoid repurposing standard keyboard shortcuts

statement.en: In general, avoid repurposing standard keyboard shortcuts for custom actions.
statement.ja: 原則としてstandard keyboard shortcutをcustom actionへ転用しない。

conditions: Repurposing a familiar shortcut can make its behavior confusing or inconsistent.
exceptions: Consider redefining a standard shortcut only when its standard action doesn't make sense in the experience.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0009.review_note: Preserved the in-general qualifier and the documented narrow exception without converting the example into a reusable binding.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0011.title: Prefer Command as the main custom-shortcut modifier

statement.en: Prefer Command as the main modifier in a custom keyboard shortcut.
statement.ja: custom keyboard shortcutのmain modifierにはCommandを優先する。

conditions: Apply when choosing the primary modifier for a custom shortcut.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0011.review_note: Recovered the Command row from the structured modifier table and preserved Prefer strength.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0012.title: Prefer Shift as a related secondary modifier

statement.en: Prefer Shift as a secondary modifier that complements a related shortcut.
statement.ja: 関連shortcutを補完するsecondary modifierにはShiftを優先する。

conditions: The modified shortcut remains semantically related to the base shortcut.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0012.review_note: Recovered the Shift row and retained both secondary-use and semantic-relationship constraints.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0013.title: Use Option sparingly for less-common commands

statement.en: Use Option sparingly for less-common commands or power features.
statement.ja: less-common commandまたはpower featureにはOptionを控えめに使う。

conditions: Reserve Option-modified shortcuts for less-common or expert-oriented functionality.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0013.review_note: Recovered the Option row and its sparse-use boundary.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0014.title: Avoid Control as a custom-shortcut modifier

statement.en: Avoid using Control as a custom keyboard-shortcut modifier.
statement.ja: custom keyboard shortcutのmodifierにControlを使わない。

conditions: Control already participates in many systemwide features and shortcuts.
