exceptions: Focus movement and screenshot capture are examples of system uses.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0014.review_note: Recovered the Control row and its system-conflict rationale.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0015.title: Always order multiple shortcut modifiers consistently

statement.en: Always list multiple shortcut modifiers in Control, Option, Shift, Command order.
statement.ja: 複数のshortcut modifierは常にControl、Option、Shift、Commandの順で並べる。

conditions: A custom keyboard shortcut uses more than one modifier key.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0015.review_note: Recovered the explicit conditional Always rule and its complete fixed order.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0016.title: Let the system mirror shortcuts for right-to-left layouts

statement.en: Let the system mirror keyboard shortcuts in right-to-left layouts.
statement.ja: right-to-left layoutでのkeyboard shortcut mirrorをsystemへ任せる。

conditions: The app or game switches to a right-to-left layout.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0016.review_note: Split RTL mirroring from connected-keyboard localization so both system behaviors remain atomic.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0017.title: Avoid keyboard-shortcut features on watchOS

statement.en: Avoid offering keyboard-shortcut features on watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSではkeyboard-shortcut featureを提供しない。

conditions: The Keyboards guidance is unsupported on watchOS.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0017.review_note: Recovered the explicit platform limitation and corrected scope to watchOS itself.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0002.title: Make sure macOS print option interdependencies are clear

statement.en: Make interdependencies among macOS print options clear.
statement.ja: macOS print option間のinterdependencyを明確にする。

conditions: Make an option's availability changes clear when they depend on another selection.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0002.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure lead and recorded the dependent-availability context without turning the example into a universal pairing.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0003.title: Consider previewing a macOS print setting

statement.en: Consider letting people preview the effect of a macOS print setting.
statement.ja: macOS print settingの効果をpreviewできるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: A preview can make a setting's output effect easier to understand.
exceptions: Updating a thumbnail for a tone control is an example, not a required preview implementation.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0003.review_note: Preserved Consider and kept the thumbnail technique as an example.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0004.title: Consider storing modified print settings with a document

statement.en: Consider storing modified print settings with the document.
statement.ja: 変更したprint settingをdocumentとともに保存することを検討する。

conditions: Stored settings can support printing the document again.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0004.review_note: Preserved Consider and separated optional document storage from the minimum session-retention recommendation.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0007.title: Consider a custom category for app-specific macOS print options

statement.en: When macOS print options are app-specific and absent from the system, consider a custom print-panel category.
statement.ja: macOS print optionがapp固有でsystemにない場合は、custom print-panel categoryを検討する。

conditions: The app offers useful print options that the system print panel doesn't provide.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0007.review_note: Recovered the complete custom-category object and preserved both prerequisites and Consider strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0008.title: Consider a page setup dialog for document-specific settings

statement.en: When an app supports document-specific page settings, consider a page setup dialog.
statement.ja: appがdocument固有のpage settingを扱う場合はpage setup dialogを検討する。

conditions: Use the dialog for rarely changed settings that apply to printing a particular document.
exceptions: Page size, orientation, and scaling are examples of such settings.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0008.review_note: Preserved the document-specific prerequisite and Consider strength while keeping listed settings as examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0009.title: Avoid offering printing on tvOS or watchOS

statement.en: Avoid offering printing on tvOS or watchOS.
statement.ja: tvOSまたはwatchOSではprintingを提供しない。

conditions: Printing is unsupported on these platforms.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0009.review_note: Recovered the explicit platform limitation and corrected the generated scope to the unsupported platforms themselves.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0010.title: Give a custom macOS print category a unique name

statement.en: Give a custom macOS print-panel category a unique name.
statement.ja: custom macOS print-panel categoryに固有の名前を付ける。

conditions: The app provides a custom category for app-specific print options.
exceptions: Using the app name is an example, not a required naming formula.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0010.review_note: Separated category naming from category contents and kept the app-name wording as an example.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0011.title: Include helpful app-specific options in a custom print category

statement.en: Include app-specific options that improve the print experience in a custom category.
statement.ja: custom categoryにはprint experienceを改善するapp固有optionを含める。

conditions: The app provides a custom category in the macOS print panel.
exceptions: Presentation-specific options are examples, not a required option set.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0011.review_note: Separated category contents from naming and retained the user-value purpose without adopting the example option set.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0012.title: Avoid duplicating system-provided print features

statement.en: Avoid implementing print features the system already provides.
statement.ja: systemが提供するprint featureを重複実装しない。

conditions: Apply when omitting the duplicate makes sense for the app's page-setup experience.
exceptions: Orientation changes and reverse-order printing are examples of system-provided features.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0012.review_note: Preserved the conditional Avoid and kept the listed system features as examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0013.title: Separate advanced macOS print features

statement.en: Separate advanced macOS print features from frequently used features.
statement.ja: advanced macOS print featureを頻繁に使うfeatureから分離する。

conditions: Preserve easy access to frequently used print features.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0013.review_note: Recovered the direct separation guidance as its own atomic recommendation.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0014.title: Consider disclosing advanced print options on demand

statement.en: Consider a disclosure control that hides advanced print options until needed.
statement.ja: 必要になるまでadvanced print optionを隠すdisclosure controlを検討する。

conditions: Advanced options are separated from frequently used print features.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0014.review_note: Preserved Consider and the on-demand disclosure behavior.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0015.title: Retain modified print settings until document close

statement.en: Keep modified print settings until the document closes, at minimum.
statement.ja: 変更したprint settingを少なくともdocumentを閉じるまで保持する。

conditions: Retaining settings supports printing the same document again during the session.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0015.review_note: Recovered the source's minimum retention recommendation separately from optional document-level persistence.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0016.title: Label advanced print options explicitly

statement.en: Label advanced print settings “Advanced Options.”
statement.ja: advanced print settingには「Advanced Options」とlabel付けする。

conditions: The macOS print interface exposes a group of advanced options.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0016.review_note: Recovered the exact label guidance as a separate recommendation rather than combining it with optional disclosure.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0001.title: Match the launch screen to the first screen

statement.en: Design the launch screen to closely match the app or game's first screen.
statement.ja: launch screenをappまたはgameのfirst screenに近づけてdesignする。

conditions: Prevent an unpleasant flash when the launch screen transitions to the first screen.
If the app initially shows only a solid color, use only that color on the launch screen.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0001.review_note: Replaced the generic statement, captured the solid-color branch, and narrowed launch-screen scope to iOS, iPadOS, and tvOS.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0002.title: Avoid text on launch screens

statement.en: Avoid text on a launch screen, even when the first screen contains text.
statement.ja: first screenにtextがあってもlaunch screenにはtextを含めない。

conditions: Launch-screen content is static, so displayed text is not localized.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0002.review_note: Retained direct Avoid at AVOID, restored the localization rationale, and narrowed the platform scope.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0003.title: Avoid advertising on launch screens

statement.en: Avoid using a launch screen for advertising or branding.
statement.ja: launch screenをadvertisingやbrandingに使うことを避ける。

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0003.review_note: Replaced the malformed generated statement, retained direct Don't at AVOID, and split the concrete visual anti-patterns.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0005.title: Consider a splash screen at onboarding

statement.en: When a splash screen is needed, consider placing it at the start of onboarding.
statement.ja: splash screenが必要な場合はonboardingの開始時に置くことを検討する。

exceptions: Without onboarding, a splash screen may appear after launching completes.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0005.review_note: Retained the conditional Consider option and recorded the no-onboarding fallback.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0006.title: Minimize launch time

statement.en: Minimize launch time so people can begin interacting immediately.
statement.ja: 人がすぐにinteractできるようlaunch timeを最小限にする。

conditions: People may be unwilling to wait more than a couple of seconds.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0006.review_note: Activated the instant-launch recommendation and retained the source's user-wait tolerance as context, not a hard threshold.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0007.title: Ensure required platforms have a launch screen

statement.en: Provide a launch screen on iOS, iPadOS, and tvOS.
statement.ja: iOS、iPadOS、tvOSではlaunch screenを用意する。

conditions: The system presents the launch screen immediately and replaces it with the first screen.
exceptions: macOS, visionOS, and watchOS do not require launch screens.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0007.review_note: Recovered the explicit platform-required contract as a conditional MUST and recorded unsupported-platform exceptions.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0008.title: Restore state after an app restart

statement.en: Restore the previous state after an app restarts.
statement.ja: appのrestart後にprevious stateを復元する。

conditions: Restore granular details wherever practicable, including scroll position and window state and location.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0008.review_note: Activated state restoration and recorded the granular scroll and window examples without making them universal invariants.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0009.title: Downplay the launch-screen experience

statement.en: Downplay the launch-screen experience.
statement.ja: launch-screen experienceを控えめにする。

conditions: Use a launch screen only to make launch feel quick and immediately ready.
Do not treat it as onboarding, a splash screen, or artistic expression.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0009.review_note: Activated the purpose constraint and narrowed it to platforms that use launch screens.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0010.title: Launch in the appropriate orientation

statement.en: Launch in the orientation appropriate to the iOS or iPadOS interface.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOS interfaceに適したorientationでlaunchする。

conditions: For portrait-and-landscape interfaces, use the device's current orientation.
For a single-orientation interface, use its supported orientation and let people rotate the device if needed.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0010.review_note: Activated the iOS and iPadOS orientation mappings and separated the explicit landscape-response requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0011.title: Consider automatic playback in live-viewing apps

statement.en: In a tvOS live-viewing app, consider starting playback automatically after brief inactivity.
statement.ja: tvOS live-viewing appでは短いinactivity後のautomatic playback開始を検討する。

conditions: Use new or recently viewed live content after a few seconds of inactivity.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0011.review_note: Activated the tvOS-only optional playback behavior without turning the few-seconds example into a mandatory threshold.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0012.title: Avoid making people retrace steps after restart

statement.en: Avoid making people retrace steps after an app restart.
statement.ja: appのrestart後に以前の場所まで手順をやり直させない。

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0012.review_note: Split the direct Avoid anti-pattern from the positive state-restoration recommendation.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0013.title: Make sure launch screens match orientation and appearance

statement.en: Make sure each launch screen matches the current orientation and appearance mode.
statement.ja: 各launch screenを現在のorientationとappearance modeに一致させる。

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0013.review_note: Recovered the supporting Make sure outcome as a separate MUST within launch-screen platform scope.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0014.title: Avoid splash-screen or About-window styling

statement.en: Avoid making a launch screen resemble a splash screen or About window.
statement.ja: launch screenをsplash screenやAbout windowのように見せない。

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0014.review_note: Recovered the concrete direct Avoid visual anti-pattern separately from general advertising guidance.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0015.title: Avoid nonpersistent branding on launch screens

statement.en: Avoid branding elements unless they are fixed parts of the first screen.
statement.ja: first screenの固定部分でないbranding elementをlaunch screenに含めない。

conditions: Logos are an example of branding elements.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0015.review_note: Recovered the direct Don't clause and its fixed-first-screen exception at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0016.title: Ensure landscape interfaces support both rotation directions

statement.en: Ensure landscape-only iOS and iPadOS interfaces support both device rotation directions.
statement.ja: landscape-onlyのiOSおよびiPadOS interfaceで左右両方のdevice rotation方向に対応する。

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0016.review_note: Recovered the explicit Ensure requirement as a separate iOS and iPadOS MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0004.title: Consider launching an immersive visionOS app in the Shared Space

statement.en: Consider launching a fully immersive visionOS app in the Shared Space first.
statement.ja: fully immersiveなvisionOS appでも最初にShared Spaceでlaunchすることを検討する。

conditions: A Shared Space window can provide context while the app or game loads.
The window can provide a control for entering the fully immersive experience.
Preserve people's choice of when to transition to a Full Space, especially while other apps are running.
HIG-PATTERNS-LAUNCHING-0004.review_note: Preserved the source's Consider strength and recorded the contextual-loading and user-controlled-transition rationale without promoting it to a requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0001.title: Clearly identify the data people need to enter

statement.en: Clearly identify the data people need to provide.
statement.ja: 入力が必要なdataを明確に示す。

conditions: Use a field prompt or introductory label to describe the expected information.
Prefill only reasonable default values that reduce decisions and speed entry.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0001.review_note: Concretized the clarity outcome and recorded the prompt, label, and reasonable-default techniques.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0002.title: Use secure entry for sensitive data

statement.en: When collecting sensitive data, use a secure text-entry field that obscures the input.
statement.ja: sensitive dataを収集する場合、inputを隠すsecure text-entry fieldを使う。

conditions: Apply when the app or game needs people to enter sensitive data.
A tvOS digit-entry view can obscure entered numerals.
A system-provided visionOS secure field hides entered data from people other than the wearer.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0002.review_note: Raised the privacy-sensitive conditional outcome to MUST and retained its tvOS and visionOS behavior.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0003.title: Never prepopulate a password field

statement.en: Never prepopulate a password field.
statement.ja: password fieldを事前入力しない。

conditions: A password field is present.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0003.review_note: Retained MUST_NOT after confirming the explicit Never prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0005.title: Accept pasted and dragged data where practicable

statement.en: Wherever practicable, let people provide data by pasting it or dragging and dropping it.
statement.ja: 可能な限りpasteまたはdrag and dropでdataを入力できるようにする。

conditions: These methods can reduce entry effort and integrate the experience with the system.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0005.review_note: Preserved the As much as possible qualification and both supported transfer methods.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0006.title: Pregather information to minimize manual entry

statement.en: Pregather as much information as possible to minimize the data people must supply.
statement.ja: 手動入力を減らすため、可能な限り情報を事前取得する。

conditions: Obtain permission before accessing protected information.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0006.review_note: Activated the overview guidance and preserved both minimization and permission boundaries.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0007.title: Support all available input methods

statement.en: Support all available input methods so people can choose the one that works for them.
statement.ja: 利用可能なすべてのinput methodに対応し、適した方法を選べるようにする。

conditions: Review touch, keyboard, pointer, voice, and assistive-technology input as applicable to the platform.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0007.review_note: Activated the accessibility-oriented overview outcome and made the input-method review concrete.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0008.title: Get available information from the system

statement.en: Get needed information from the system whenever possible instead of asking people to reenter it.
statement.ja: 可能な場合は再入力を求めず、必要な情報をsystemから取得する。

conditions: Use existing settings when available.
Request explicit permission before accessing protected data such as location or calendar information.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0008.review_note: Activated the system-data rule and preserved the explicit-permission gate.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0009.title: Avoid asking for information the system can obtain

statement.en: Avoid asking people to enter information the app can obtain automatically or with their permission.
statement.ja: automaticまたはpermissionにより取得できる情報の入力を求めない。

conditions: Do not bypass permission when the information is protected.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0009.review_note: Recovered the direct Don't guidance at AVOID and retained the permission boundary.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0010.title: Require password entry or secure authentication

statement.en: Require people to enter their password or use biometric or keychain authentication.
statement.ja: password入力またはbiometric・keychain authenticationを要求する。

conditions: The experience authenticates with a password or an approved biometric or keychain alternative.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0010.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Always authentication requirement and separated it from password-field prepopulation.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0011.title: Offer choices instead of text entry when possible

statement.en: When possible, offer choices instead of requiring people to enter text.
statement.ja: 可能な場合、text入力を求めずchoiceを提供する。

conditions: Consider a picker, menu, or other selection component when it fits the information.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0011.review_note: Activated the practicability-qualified choice guidance and retained component selection as a contextual option.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0012.title: Validate field values as people enter them

statement.en: Validate field values dynamically and provide feedback as soon as a problem is detected.
statement.ja: field valueを動的にvalidateし、問題検出時にすぐfeedbackを提供する。

conditions: For numeric data, consider a formatter that restricts input and formats the displayed value.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0012.review_note: Activated the validation rule and recorded immediate feedback plus the optional numeric formatter.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0013.title: Communicate and enforce required data before proceeding

statement.en: When data entry is necessary, ensure people understand and provide all required data before proceeding.
statement.ja: data entryが必要な場合、続行前にrequired dataを理解して入力できるようにする。

conditions: Keep a Next or Continue action unavailable until the required data is present.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0013.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure and must outcome and recorded the source's progression gate.

HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0004.title: Consider an expansion tooltip for clipped macOS field text

statement.en: Consider an expansion tooltip that shows the complete text when a macOS field clips or truncates it.
statement.ja: macOS fieldでtextがclippedまたはtruncatedになる場合は、全文を示すexpansion tooltipを検討する。

conditions: The field is too small to display the complete entered data.
This applies to macOS apps, including iOS and iPadOS apps running on a Mac.
The expansion tooltip appears when the pointer rests over the field.
HIG-PATTERNS-ENTERING-DATA-0004.review_note: Preserved the source's Consider strength and recorded its clipping, hover, and platform scope without inventing editing-specific behavior.

statement.en: Consider additional shortcuts for converting text into tokens.
statement.ja: textをtokenへ変換する追加shortcutを検討する。

conditions: Comma entry already performs the default conversion.
Return is an example additional shortcut, not a required key binding.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOKEN-FIELDS-0001.review_note: Preserved Consider and separated the default behavior from optional shortcuts.

statement.en: Consider a comfortable delay before showing suggested tokens.
statement.ja: suggested token表示前のcomfortableなdelayを検討する。

conditions: The app suggests tokens while people type.
Adjust the default immediate presentation if it distracts from typing.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOKEN-FIELDS-0002.review_note: Recorded the typing-distraction condition and preserved optional delay customization.

statement.en: Use a context menu to add useful token options or information.
statement.ja: context menuでtokenに有用なoptionまたはinformationを追加する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-TOKEN-FIELDS-0003.review_note: Recovered the missing Add-value lead and both documented menu-content types.

statement.en: Avoid using token fields outside macOS.
statement.ja: macOS以外でtoken fieldを使わない。

conditions: Token fields are a macOS-only component.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TOKEN-FIELDS-0004.review_note: Recorded the descriptive iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, visionOS, and watchOS limitations at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-STEPPERS-0003.title: Consider Shift-click for large macOS stepper ranges

statement.en: Consider Shift-click for quick changes in a large macOS stepper range.
statement.ja: largeなmacOS stepper rangeのquick changeにはShift-clickを検討する。

conditions: The app benefits from changing the value by more than the default increment.
exceptions: Ten times the default increment is an example, not a required multiplier.
HIG-COMPONENTS-STEPPERS-0003.review_note: Preserved Consider, the large-change condition, and the nonnormative example multiplier.

statement.en: Avoid using steppers on watchOS or tvOS.
statement.ja: watchOSまたはtvOSでstepperを使わない。

conditions: Steppers have no additional considerations for iOS, iPadOS, or visionOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-STEPPERS-0004.review_note: Recorded the descriptive watchOS and tvOS limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SIDEBARS-0007.title: Consider a sidebar within a visionOS tab for deep hierarchy

statement.en: Consider a sidebar within a visionOS tab for deep hierarchy.
statement.ja: deep hierarchyにはvisionOS tab内のsidebarを検討する。

conditions: Use the sidebar for secondary navigation within the tab.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SIDEBARS-0007.review_note: Preserved the deep-hierarchy condition and the sidebar's secondary-navigation role.

statement.en: Avoid using sidebars on watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSでsidebarを使わない。

conditions: Sidebars have no additional considerations for tvOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SIDEBARS-0009.review_note: Recorded the descriptive watchOS limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SIDEBARS-0010.title: Keep visionOS sidebar selections within the current tab

statement.en: Ensure sidebar selections don't change the currently open visionOS tab.
statement.ja: sidebar selectionで現在開いているvisionOS tabを変更しない。

conditions: A sidebar provides secondary navigation within a tab.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SIDEBARS-0010.review_note: Recovered the conditional MUST from the explicit be-sure-to-prevent directive.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0001.title: Use pull-down buttons for directly related commands or items

statement.en: Use a pull-down button to present commands or items directly related to the button's action.
statement.ja: buttonのactionに直接関連するcommandまたはitemを示すためにpull-down buttonを使う。

conditions: Use the menu to clarify the action's target or customize its behavior without adding more buttons.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0001.review_note: Retained SHOULD and recorded the target-clarification and behavior-customization purposes.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0002.title: Avoid hiding all view actions in one pull-down button

statement.en: Avoid putting all of a view's actions in one pull-down button.
statement.ja: viewのすべてのactionを1つのpull-down buttonに入れない。

conditions: Keep primary actions directly discoverable instead of requiring people to open the menu first.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0002.review_note: Retained AVOID and recorded the primary-action discoverability requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0003.title: Display a succinct pull-down menu title only when meaningful

statement.en: Display a succinct pull-down menu title only when it adds meaning.
statement.ja: 意味を加える場合に限り、簡潔なpull-down menu titleを表示する。

conditions: The button content and descriptive menu items usually provide enough context without a title.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0003.review_note: Retained the conditional SHOULD and recorded why a title is normally unnecessary.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0004.title: Identify destructive pull-down menu items

statement.en: Identify pull-down menu items that perform potentially destructive actions.
statement.ja: 破壊的なactionを実行する可能性があるpull-down menu itemを明示する。

conditions: The menu uses red text for items identified as potentially destructive.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0004.review_note: Kept destructive identification in the stable rule and separated confirmation into rule 0010.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0005.title: Include a menu-item icon only when it adds value

statement.en: Include an interface icon with a pull-down menu item only when it adds value or clarifies meaning.
statement.ja: 価値を加えるか意味を明確にする場合に限り、pull-down menu itemにinterface iconを含める。

conditions: Display the icon or image after the item's label.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0005.review_note: Retained the conditional SHOULD and recorded the meaning and placement constraints.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0006.title: Consider a More pull-down button for nonprominent items

statement.en: Consider a More pull-down button for items that don't need prominence.
statement.ja: prominenceが不要なitemにはMore pull-down buttonを検討する。

conditions: Main-interface space is constrained.
Balance the More button's compact size against reduced content predictability and discoverability.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0006.review_note: Restored the truncated recommendation and recorded both sides of the documented tradeoff.

statement.en: Avoid using pull-down buttons on tvOS or watchOS.
statement.ja: tvOSまたはwatchOSでpull-down buttonを使わない。

conditions: Pull-down buttons have no additional considerations for macOS or visionOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0007.review_note: Recorded the descriptive tvOS and watchOS limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0008.title: Use a pop-up button for mutually exclusive noncommand choices

statement.en: Use a pop-up button instead of a pull-down button for mutually exclusive choices that aren't commands.
statement.ja: commandではない排他的な選択肢にはpull-down buttonではなくpop-up buttonを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0008.review_note: Recovered the component-selection alternative for mutually exclusive noncommand choices.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0009.title: Balance pull-down menu length with ease of use

statement.en: Balance the length of a pull-down menu with ease of use.
statement.ja: pull-down menuの長さと使いやすさのバランスを取る。

conditions: A minimum of three items can make opening the menu feel worthwhile.
For only one or two items, consider buttons for actions or toggles and switches for selections.
Avoid so many items that finding a specific one becomes slow.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0009.review_note: Recovered the menu-length rule and preserved the minimum-three heuristic, small-menu alternatives, and long-menu cost.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0010.title: Ask people to confirm destructive pull-down menu actions

statement.en: Ask people to confirm their intent after choosing a destructive pull-down menu action.
statement.ja: 破壊的なpull-down menu actionを選んだ後に、利用者へ意図の確認を求める。

conditions: The system presents an action sheet in iOS or a popover in iPadOS so people can confirm or cancel.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0010.review_note: Recovered confirmation as an atomic rule separate from destructive-item identification.

HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0011.title: Consider SF Symbols for pull-down menu item icons

statement.en: Consider using SF Symbols for pull-down menu item icons.
statement.ja: pull-down menu itemのiconにSF Symbolsを使うことを検討する。

conditions: SF Symbols can provide familiar imagery that remains aligned with text at every scale.
HIG-COMPONENTS-PULL-DOWN-BUTTONS-0011.review_note: Recovered the optional SF Symbols path and its familiarity and alignment benefits.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0008.title: Consider a pop-up button for compact iPadOS list-item options

statement.en: Consider a pop-up button for compact iPadOS list-item options.
statement.ja: compactなiPadOS list-item optionにはpop-up buttonを検討する。

conditions: The list item appears within a popover or modal view.
The option set is fairly small, well defined, and works well in a menu.
Use the pop-up button instead of navigating through a disclosure indicator to a detail view.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0008.review_note: Restored the complete truncated recommendation and all documented applicability conditions.

statement.en: Avoid using pop-up buttons on tvOS or watchOS.
statement.ja: tvOSまたはwatchOSでpop-up buttonを使わない。

conditions: Pop-up buttons have no additional considerations for iOS, macOS, or visionOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0009.review_note: Recorded the descriptive tvOS and watchOS limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Consider the continuous capacity style for a large range.
statement.ja: large rangeにはcontinuous capacity styleを検討する。

conditions: A discrete capacity indicator would make individual segments too small to be useful.
HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0003.review_note: Preserved Consider and recorded the large-range legibility condition.

statement.en: Consider changing fill color to communicate significant range levels.
statement.ja: significantなrange levelを伝えるためfill colorの変更を検討する。

conditions: Use a whole-indicator color change or a tiered sequence when it fits the app's meaning.
HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0004.review_note: Preserved optional color changes and both documented presentation approaches.

statement.en: Avoid using gauges on tvOS.
statement.ja: tvOSでgaugeを使わない。

conditions: Gauges have no additional considerations for iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, or watchOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0005.review_note: Recorded the descriptive tvOS limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Never partially fill a discrete capacity-indicator segment.
statement.ja: discrete capacity-indicator segmentを部分的にfillしない。

conditions: Each segment represents a discrete unit and fills completely to indicate the current value.
HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0006.review_note: Recovered the platform-specific MUST_NOT from the explicit never-partially invariant.

statement.en: Choose the spatial Persona template that suits the shared activity.
statement.ja: shared activityに適したspatial Persona templateを選ぶ。

conditions: Compare side-by-side, surround, and conversational layouts against content visibility and social interaction needs.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0006.review_note: Recorded the three system templates and the content-versus-interaction choice.

statement.en: Prepare the visionOS app to launch directly into its shared activity.
statement.ja: visionOS appがshared activityへ直接launchできるように準備する。

conditions: The system automatically launches the app when someone shares the activity in FaceTime.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0007.review_note: Recorded the direct-launch expectation separately from window restrictions and prerequisite tasks.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0008.title: Help people enter a visionOS shared activity together

statement.en: Help people enter a visionOS shared activity together.
statement.ja: peopleがvisionOS shared activityへ一緒に入れるよう支援する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0008.review_note: Kept synchronized entry at SHOULD and split the adjacent non-coercion guidance into its own AVOID rule.

statement.en: Ensure all participants view the same app state.
statement.ja: すべてのparticipantが同じapp stateを表示するようにする。

exceptions: A participant may temporarily leave the shared activity when needed.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0009.review_note: Retained the explicit Make sure shared-state MUST and its temporary-exit exception.

statement.en: Use Spatial Audio to enrich the shared activity.
statement.ja: Spatial Audioでshared activityを豊かにする。

conditions: Use spatial sound when it strengthens the realism of the shared experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0010.review_note: Recorded the intended realism benefit without making Spatial Audio universal.

statement.en: Help people keep private and shared content separate.
statement.ja: private contentとshared contentを区別できるようにする。

conditions: Review both system differentiation and app-provided multiwindow sharing cues.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0011.review_note: Recorded the privacy-sensitive separation outcome and split its multiwindow actions.

statement.en: Let people personalize their experience without changing it for others.
statement.ja: 他のparticipantのexperienceを変えずにpersonalizeできるようにする。

conditions: Support adjustments for accessibility or comfort, such as volume or subtitles.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0012.review_note: Recorded independent personalization and its accessibility and comfort purposes.

statement.en: Consider a unique content view for each participant when perspective matters.
statement.ja: perspectiveが重要な場合はparticipantごとのunique content viewを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0013.review_note: Preserved optional per-person viewing and its perspective-dependent condition.

statement.en: Make exiting and rejoining a shared activity easy.
statement.ja: shared activityからのexitとrejoinを容易にする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0014.review_note: Kept the general ease guidance at SHOULD and split the explicit rejoin-control requirement.

statement.en: Avoid using SharePlay on watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSでSharePlayを使わない。

conditions: SharePlay has no additional considerations for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, or tvOS.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0016.review_note: Recorded the descriptive watchOS limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Avoid displaying unrelated windows during automatic shared-activity launch.
statement.ja: shared activityのautomatic launch中に無関係なwindowを表示しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0017.review_note: Recovered the launch-specific window restriction without raising want-to-avoid wording to MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Present prerequisite input in an autodismissible window.
statement.ja: prerequisite inputをautodismissible windowで提示する。

conditions: People must complete input, such as sign-in, before joining the shared activity.
Dismiss the window as soon as the required input is complete.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0018.review_note: Recovered the conditional MUST from the explicit be-sure directive and its automatic-dismissal outcome.

statement.en: Check whether synchronized immersion would disrupt a participant's current task.
statement.ja: immersionの同期がparticipantのcurrent taskを妨げないか確認する。

conditions: Check before changing the participant's level of immersion.

statement.en: Avoid forcing an immersion change that disrupts a participant's task.
statement.ja: participantのtaskを妨げるimmersion changeを強制しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0020.review_note: Split the lead's don't-force clause at AVOID because it does not use Never or must not.

statement.en: Offer a choice when synchronized immersion would disrupt a participant's task.
statement.ja: immersionの同期がtaskを妨げる場合は参加するか選べるようにする。

conditions: Let the participant choose whether to enter the updated experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0030.review_note: Recovered participant choice as the non-coercive synchronization path.

statement.en: Integrate new participants without disrupting the shared experience.
statement.ja: shared experienceを妨げずにnew participantを統合する。

conditions: Update shared immersive content to keep participants synchronized.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0021.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit need-to-integrate requirement and preserved its non-disruption outcome.

statement.en: Consider accommodating up to five participants in the spatial arrangement.
statement.ja: spatial arrangementで最大5人のparticipantへの対応を検討する。

conditions: Update participant positions as necessary.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0022.review_note: Preserved the source's consider framing for the five-participant arrangement.

statement.en: Prefer natural social solutions to shared-experience confusion or conflict when possible.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はshared experienceのconfusionやconflictにnatural social solutionを優先する。

conditions: Let participants coordinate verbally or with gestures when social interaction can resolve tool use.

statement.en: Consider a simple conflict-resolution rule when simultaneous changes can conflict.
statement.ja: 同時変更がconflictする場合はsimpleなconflict-resolution ruleを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0024.review_note: Preserved the conditional consider guidance for app-level conflict resolution.

statement.en: Help people choose which app window to share.
statement.ja: shareするapp windowを選べるようにする。

conditions: The app can open multiple windows.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0025.review_note: Recovered the multiwindow sharing-selection task separately from state distinction.

statement.en: Make shared and unshared app windows easy to distinguish.
statement.ja: shared app windowとunshared app windowを区別しやすくする。

conditions: The app can open multiple windows.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0026.review_note: Recovered the privacy-sensitive multiwindow state distinction.

statement.en: Consider letting people move content from a private window to a shared one.
statement.ja: private windowからshared windowへcontentを移動できるようにすることを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0027.review_note: Preserved the if-possible content-transfer capability as MAY.

statement.en: Keep participant positions and app context synchronized for per-person shared content.
statement.ja: per-person shared contentでもparticipant positionとapp contextを同期し続ける。

conditions: The app provides per-person versions of shared content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0031.review_note: Recovered the conditional MUST from the explicit be-sure-to-continue directive.

statement.en: Present a control that lets people quickly rejoin after exiting.
statement.ja: exit後にすばやくrejoinできるcontrolを提示する。

conditions: A participant leaves to perform another task or engage with physical surroundings.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0028.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit need-to-present requirement and preserved the quick-rejoin outcome.

statement.en: Consider continuing shared content while a participant hides their spatial Persona.
statement.ja: participantがspatial Personaを隠している間もshared contentの継続表示を検討する。

conditions: Ongoing content helps the participant stay informed about the shared experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0029.review_note: Preserved the source's might-want optional framing.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0001.title: Indicate SharePlay support

statement.en: Indicate which content or experiences support SharePlay.
statement.ja: どのcontentやexperienceがSharePlayに対応するか示す。

conditions: Use the SharePlay SF Symbol as an indicator when appropriate.
For media apps, align the indicator with people's content-sharing expectations.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0001.review_note: Concretized the support-disclosure outcome and retained the symbol as an optional implementation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0002.title: Support Picture in Picture for shared video

statement.en: Support Picture in Picture for shared video when possible.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はshared videoでPicture in Pictureをサポートする。

conditions: Use Picture in Picture on iPhone and iPad.
On Mac, keep shared video in a movable foreground window when the app is in the background.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0002.review_note: Preserved when-possible strength and scoped the documented behavior to iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0003.title: Use SharePlay as a noun or direct-action verb

statement.en: Use SharePlay as a noun or as a verb for a direct interface action.
statement.ja: SharePlayを名詞、またはinterface上の直接actionを表す動詞として使う。

conditions: Apply the separate terminology rules for adjectives and altered forms.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0003.review_note: Concretized correct noun and direct-action verb usage without merging the two avoidance rules.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0004.title: Make starting a SharePlay activity easy

statement.en: Make starting a SharePlay activity easy.
statement.ja: SharePlay activityを簡単に開始できるようにする。

conditions: When no SharePlay session is active, let the interface start a group activity.
Let the system offer sharing or solo continuation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0004.review_note: Recorded the easy-start outcome and the inactive-session path without overriding the system choice.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0005.title: Complete prerequisites before showing shared-activity UI

statement.en: Before showing shared-activity UI, help people complete prerequisites.
statement.ja: shared-activity UIを表示する前に必要な準備を完了できるよう支援する。

conditions: Prerequisites can include sign-in, downloads, or payment.
Keep prerequisite completion simple and effortless.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0005.review_note: Concretized prerequisite timing and examples while retaining the source's recommendation strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0015.title: Consider quick access for nonsubscribers

statement.en: If part of the app requires a subscription, consider helping nonsubscribers join quickly.
statement.ja: appの一部にsubscriptionが必要な場合、nonsubscriberがすばやく参加できる支援を検討する。

conditions: Consider temporary or provisional access, a one-time pass, or Family Sharing.
Apply the separate streamlined-signup rule when subscription can start during SharePlay.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0015.review_note: Preserved the conditional consider framing and separated joining accommodations from in-session signup.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0032.title: Briefly describe each SharePlay activity

statement.en: Give each SharePlay activity a brief, meaningful description.
statement.ja: 各SharePlay activityに短く意味のあるdescriptionを付ける。

conditions: Help people understand the activity before joining.
Keep the description short enough to avoid truncation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0032.review_note: Activated the omitted activity-description lead and recorded meaning and truncation constraints.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0033.title: Defer tasks that delay a shared activity

statement.en: When possible, defer app tasks that could delay a shared activity.
statement.ja: 可能な場合、shared activityを遅らせるapp taskを後回しにする。

conditions: For example, request a participant profile when the activity pauses or finishes.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0033.review_note: Activated the omitted lead and preserved its when-possible condition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0034.title: Smoothly update a shared activity for new participants

statement.en: When new participants join, update the shared activity smoothly.
statement.ja: new participantが参加したらshared activityを滑らかに更新する。

conditions: Apply the separate MUST rule for integrating participants without disrupting the shared experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0034.review_note: Activated the omitted visionOS umbrella lead while retaining the stronger atomic integration requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0035.title: Streamline subscription signup during SharePlay

statement.en: If people can subscribe during SharePlay, present a streamlined signup flow.
statement.ja: SharePlay中にsubscriptionを開始できる場合、簡潔なsignup flowを提示する。

conditions: Help the person join without making other participants wait.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0035.review_note: Recovered the conditional in-session signup guidance without raising it to MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0036.title: Avoid adjectives with SharePlay

statement.en: Avoid adding adjectives such as virtual or spatial to SharePlay.
statement.ja: SharePlayにvirtualやspatialなどの形容詞を付けることを避ける。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0036.review_note: Recovered the direct terminology avoidance without overstating it as MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0037.title: Avoid altering the term SharePlay

statement.en: Avoid altering SharePlay into variants such as SharePlayed, SharePlays, or SharePlaying.
statement.ja: SharePlayをSharePlayed、SharePlays、SharePlayingなどの形に変えることを避ける。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAREPLAY-0037.review_note: Recovered the direct terminology avoidance without overstating it as MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-COLOR-WELLS-0001.title: Consider the system-provided color picker

statement.en: Consider the system-provided color picker for a familiar, consistent experience.
statement.ja: familiarでconsistentなexperienceのためにsystem-provided color pickerを検討する。

conditions: The built-in picker lets people save colors for access from any app.
It can provide familiarity across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-COLOR-WELLS-0001.review_note: Preserved the source's Consider strength and recorded consistency, saved-color, and cross-platform benefits.

HIG-COMPONENTS-COLOR-WELLS-0002.title: Avoid color wells in tvOS and watchOS

statement.en: Avoid using color wells in tvOS or watchOS.
statement.ja: tvOSまたはwatchOSでcolor wellを使うことを避ける。

conditions: Apple HIG records color wells as unsupported on these platforms.
HIG-COMPONENTS-COLOR-WELLS-0002.review_note: Recovered the explicit platform limitation at AVOID rather than overstating descriptive support text as MUST_NOT.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Make the product meaningful

statement.en: Make the product meaningful to the people it serves.
statement.ja: productをそれが支える人々にとってmeaningfulにする。

conditions: Identify what matters most to people and focus the product on it.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized the principle while retaining the page's decision-tool strength.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Let people accomplish goals their own way

statement.en: Let people accomplish goals in ways that fit them.
statement.ja: 人々が自分に合う方法でgoalを達成できるようにする。

conditions: Preserve informed choice, freedom to explore, and recovery from mistakes.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized agency without treating the general principle as mandatory.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Keep the interface clear and direct

statement.en: Keep the interface clear, direct, and logically organized.
statement.ja: interfaceを明確で直接的かつ論理的に整理する。

conditions: Remove unnecessary complexity and keep navigation straightforward.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized the simplicity outcome at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Design for human emotion

statement.en: Design for emotions that make the experience feel human.
statement.ja: experienceをhumanに感じさせるemotionを意識して設計する。

conditions: Choose emotions appropriate to the product's purpose and audience.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized delight without turning subjective expression into a requirement.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Create value through purpose

statement.en: Create genuine value by serving the product's purpose.
statement.ja: productのpurposeを果たすことでgenuine valueを生み出す。

conditions: At each development stage, evaluate whether the design serves its purpose.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Recovered the purpose test and retained SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Focus on the most important features

statement.en: Focus on the features most important to how people use the product.
statement.ja: 人々のproduct利用に最も重要なfeatureへ集中する。

conditions: Align feature priority with people's primary goals.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Replaced the malformed generated statement with the reviewed focus outcome.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Give people freedom to explore

statement.en: Let people explore without locking them into unnecessary flows or modes.
statement.ja: 不要なflowやmodeへ固定せず、人々が自由に探索できるようにする。

conditions: When guidance is necessary, let people skip or exit it.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized exploration and escape behavior at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Make mistakes reversible

statement.en: Make mistakes reversible without costing people's time or work.
statement.ja: 人々の時間や作業を失わせずにmistakeを元に戻せるようにする。

conditions: Provide a forgiving path back to the previous state.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized recovery and its time-and-work preservation outcome.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Be transparent about product behavior

statement.en: Be transparent about what the product does and why.
statement.ja: productが何をなぜ行うかについてtransparentにする。

conditions: Apply the separate atomic requirements for intent, permissions, and data disclosure.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Retained the umbrella principle at SHOULD and separated stronger explicit outcomes.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Keep people's information safe

statement.en: Protect the integrity and safety of people's information.
statement.ja: 人々のinformationのintegrityとsafetyを保護する。

conditions: Apply the separate data-minimization and misuse-protection requirements.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Repaired the malformed statement and kept the umbrella principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Use familiar concepts

statement.en: Use familiar real-world and software concepts.
statement.ja: familiarなreal-worldおよびsoftware conceptを使う。

conditions: Use people's existing knowledge to reduce learning effort.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized familiarity at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Keep patterns consistent

statement.en: Apply established visual and interaction patterns consistently.
statement.ja: 確立されたvisualとinteraction patternを一貫して適用する。

conditions: Preserve recognizable behavior across the product.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Repaired the malformed statement and retained SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Provide clear feedback

statement.en: Provide clear, consistent feedback that keeps people informed and in control.
statement.ja: 人々が状況を理解しcontrolできる明確で一貫したfeedbackを提供する。

conditions: Communicate availability, state changes, alerts, and choices when relevant.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Recovered the feedback purpose and relevant state contexts.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Design inclusively

statement.en: Design inclusively for diverse experiences, perspectives, and needs.
statement.ja: 多様なexperience、perspective、needを含めて設計する。

conditions: Apply the separate accessibility-from-the-start requirement.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized inclusion while separating the explicit accessibility priority.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Preserve context across adaptations

statement.en: Preserve context as the design adapts across platforms and configurations.
statement.ja: platformやconfigurationにdesignを適応するときもcontextを保持する。

conditions: Keep important elements predictable and animate transitions naturally.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Recovered predictable placement and transition context.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Consider varied input methods

statement.en: Consider voice, touch, keyboard, and other input methods.
statement.ja: voice、touch、keyboardなど複数のinput methodを検討する。

conditions: Choose methods that fit the platform, device, task, and person.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Preserved the source's Consider strength at MAY.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Include only what's necessary

statement.en: Include only what is necessary for a focused, useful experience.
statement.ja: focusedでusefulなexperienceに必要なものだけを含める。

conditions: Remove elements that don't support the primary purpose.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized the necessary-content outcome at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Use concise language

statement.en: Use only the words needed to convey a concept or label a control.
statement.ja: conceptの説明やcontrolのlabelに必要なwordだけを使う。

conditions: Prefer concise wording that remains clear.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Recovered the writing and control-label scope.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Maintain the product's craft

statement.en: Keep the interface current with platform capabilities and design patterns.
statement.ja: interfaceをplatform capabilityとdesign patternの進化に合わせて更新する。

conditions: Revisit the design as platforms and expectations evolve.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized ongoing craft and platform evolution.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Create defining moments

statement.en: Create moments that express the product's character.
statement.ja: productのcharacterを表すdefining momentを作る。

conditions: Use interaction, motion, sound, or visuals when they support the purpose.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized the expressive outcome without mandating decoration.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Avoid decorative delight that interferes

statement.en: Avoid letting decorative delight interfere with the product's core purpose.
statement.ja: decorativeなdelightがproductのcore purposeを妨げることを避ける。

conditions: Delight should support the experience rather than compete with it.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Repaired the malformed negative statement and retained AVOID.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Consider the whole experience

statement.en: Consider the whole experience when shaping delight.
statement.ja: delightを設計するときはexperience全体を検討する。

conditions: Evaluate how individual moments combine across the complete journey.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Preserved the source's Consider strength and restored its experience scope.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Identify the intended emotion

statement.en: Identify the emotion the experience should evoke and let it shape the design.
statement.ja: experienceが喚起するemotionを特定し、designへ反映する。

conditions: Choose an emotional direction appropriate to the product.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Recovered the emotion-to-design relationship.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Act in people's best interests

statement.en: Act in people's best interests.
statement.ja: 人々のbest interestを優先して行動する。

conditions: Prioritize safety, privacy, and transparency when priorities compete.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted responsibility principle at conservative SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Build on familiar patterns

statement.en: Build on familiar physical and digital patterns.
statement.ja: familiarなphysicalおよびdigital patternを基礎にする。

conditions: Use existing knowledge to help people understand the product.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted familiarity principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Adapt to diverse contexts and needs

statement.en: Adapt to diverse contexts, devices, interactions, and perspectives.
statement.ja: 多様なcontext、device、interaction、perspectiveへ適応する。

conditions: Preserve the primary task as the experience changes.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted flexibility principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Care about every detail

statement.en: Care about every design detail and take time to do the work well.
statement.ja: すべてのdesign detailを大切にし、十分な時間をかけて仕上げる。

conditions: Apply the quality bar across the complete experience.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted craft principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Find new ways to solve the problem

statement.en: Investigate existing solutions before defining a distinct approach.
statement.ja: distinctなapproachを定める前にexisting solutionを調査する。

conditions: Avoid re-creating existing work without a meaningful difference.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted purpose principle without overstating experimentation.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Stay out of the way

statement.en: Keep the design unobtrusive and get people directly to their task or content.
statement.ja: designを控えめにし、人々をtaskやcontentへ直接導く。

conditions: Minimize barriers between people and their goals.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted agency principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Approach every platform with intention

statement.en: Give every supported platform the same level of intentional care.
statement.ja: すべてのsupported platformへ同じ水準のintentional careを注ぐ。

conditions: Respect each platform's capabilities, conventions, and input methods.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted platform-intent principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Establish a clear hierarchy

statement.en: Establish a clear hierarchy with recognizable controls and consistent structure.
statement.ja: recognizableなcontrolと一貫したstructureで明確なhierarchyを確立する。

conditions: Make relationships and priorities easy to understand.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted hierarchy principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Set a high quality bar

statement.en: Set a high quality bar across visuals, motion, writing, and audio.
statement.ja: visual、motion、writing、audio全体で高いquality barを設定する。

conditions: Quality choices establish expectations for the complete experience.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted quality principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Experiment and iterate

statement.en: Prototype, test, refine, and iterate in real-world settings.
statement.ja: real-world settingでprototype、test、refine、iterateを行う。

conditions: Use findings to improve both details and overall direction.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted iterative-craft principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Make app intentions clear from the start

statement.en: Make the app's intentions clear from the first interaction.
statement.ja: 最初のinteractionからappのintentionを明確にする。

conditions: People need this context before deciding whether to continue.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the explicit from-the-start transparency outcome as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Explain permission requests

statement.en: When asking for permission, provide a clear rationale.
statement.ja: permissionを求めるとき、明確なrationaleを提供する。

conditions: Explain why the app needs the requested access.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified permission rationale as a privacy and informed-intent MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Disclose data collection and use

statement.en: When collecting data, disclose what you collect and how you use it.
statement.ja: dataを収集するとき、収集内容と利用方法を開示する。

conditions: Make the disclosure understandable before people provide the data.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Split the privacy disclosure outcome from the same supporting source sentence.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Minimize data collection

statement.en: Collect only the data the product needs to function.
statement.ja: productのfunctionに必要なdataだけを収集する。

conditions: Do not expand collection beyond functional need.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the source's only-needed data-minimization boundary as MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Protect data from misuse and harm

statement.en: Protect data against foreseeable misuse, harm, abuse, and unintended consequences.
statement.ja: foreseeableなmisuse、harm、abuse、unintended consequenceからdataを保護する。

conditions: Evaluate both intentional abuse and unintended downstream effects.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the explicit information-safety outcome as a security MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Prioritize accessibility from the start

statement.en: Treat accessibility as a priority from the start.
statement.ja: 最初からaccessibilityをpriorityとして扱う。

conditions: Integrate accessibility into initial product and interaction decisions.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the explicit from-the-start accessibility priority as MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0001.title: Obtain approval before storing recognized songs

statement.en: Before storing recognized songs in iCloud, obtain the person's approval.
statement.ja: recognized songをiCloudへ保存する前に本人のapprovalを得る。

conditions: The app can store songs recognized with ShazamKit in the person's iCloud library.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0001.review_note: Raised the opt-in control to an explicit-user-intent MUST and preserved its before-storage timing.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0002.title: Stop recording as soon as possible

statement.en: Stop ShazamKit audio recording as soon as recognition sampling allows.
statement.ja: recognition sampleを取得でき次第ShazamKitのaudio recordingを停止する。

conditions: People granted microphone access for audio recognition.
Apply the separate privacy MUST that limits recording to the required sample duration.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0002.review_note: Activated the omitted umbrella lead at SHOULD and kept the stricter privacy boundary separate.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0003.title: Request microphone access for recognition

statement.en: Before using the device microphone for ShazamKit recognition, request access.
statement.ja: ShazamKit recognitionにdevice microphoneを使う前にaccessをrequestする。

conditions: The app needs the device microphone to obtain an audio sample.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0003.review_note: Recovered the source's explicit must-request permission requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0004.title: Explain the microphone access request

statement.en: Explain why the app requests microphone access.
statement.ja: appがmicrophone accessをrequestする理由を説明する。

conditions: The app requests microphone access for ShazamKit recognition.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0004.review_note: Recovered the permission-explanation guidance and retained its important-but-not-mandatory strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0005.title: Limit recognition recording to the required sample

statement.en: Record recognition audio only as long as needed to obtain the sample.
statement.ja: recognition audioは必要なsampleを取得する時間だけrecordする。

conditions: The person granted microphone access for audio recognition.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-SHAZAMKIT-0005.review_note: Classified the source's privacy-specific only-duration boundary as MUST.

statement.en: Determine study eligibility as soon as possible.
statement.ja: study eligibilityを可能な限り早く判定する。

conditions: Complete eligibility before presenting consent when possible.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0013.review_note: Recorded the early eligibility check and its relationship to avoiding unnecessary consent steps.

statement.en: Clearly describe the study's subject and purpose.
statement.ja: studyのsubjectとpurposeを明確に説明する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0014.review_note: Recovered both study-description dimensions from the introduction guidance.

statement.en: Let existing participants quickly sign in and resume an in-progress study.
statement.ja: 既存participantがすばやくsign inして進行中のstudyを再開できるようにする。

conditions: The introduction also serves returning participants.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0015.review_note: Recovered the returning-participant path separately from first-time introduction content.

statement.en: Present only eligibility requirements necessary for the study.
statement.ja: studyに必要なeligibility requirementだけを提示する。

conditions: Minimize the eligibility information requested from prospective participants.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0016.review_note: Recovered the explicit only restriction as a privacy-sensitive data-minimization MUST.

statement.en: Describe eligibility requirements in simple, straightforward language.
statement.ja: eligibility requirementをsimpleでstraightforwardなlanguageで説明する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0017.review_note: Recovered the eligibility-language quality separately from information-entry ease.

statement.en: Make eligibility information easy to enter.
statement.ja: eligibility informationを入力しやすくする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0018.review_note: Recovered the input-effort guidance as a separate eligibility rule.

statement.en: Ensure the app follows applicable App Store consent requirements.
statement.ja: appが該当するApp Store consent requirementに従うようにする。

conditions: Also review applicable legal and ethics-board requirements outside this design-rule set.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0019.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure compliance directive without treating this informational page as legal advice.

statement.en: Divide a long consent form into digestible sections.
statement.ja: 長いconsent formを理解しやすいsectionに分割する。

conditions: Let each section focus on one aspect of the study.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0020.review_note: Recovered the missing Break lead and preserved the one-aspect section context.

statement.en: Use simple language for each high-level consent overview.
statement.ja: 各consent sectionのhigh-level overviewにsimpleなlanguageを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0021.review_note: Recovered the overview-language rule within long-form consent guidance.

statement.en: Provide a detailed consent explanation when necessary.
statement.ja: 必要な場合は詳細なconsent explanationを提供する。

conditions: Let participants open the detail from the corresponding overview section.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0022.review_note: Preserved the source's if-necessary condition instead of making detailed text universal.

statement.en: Ensure participants can view the entire consent form before agreeing.
statement.ja: participantが同意前にconsent form全体を閲覧できるようにする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0023.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit need-to-be-able requirement before agreement.

statement.en: Consider a comprehension quiz when it fits the consent process.
statement.ja: consent processに適する場合はcomprehension quizを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0024.review_note: Preserved the source's if-it-makes-sense condition as optional guidance.

statement.en: Obtain the participant's consent before they join the study.
statement.ja: participantがstudyへ参加する前にconsentを得る。

conditions: Complete the informed-consent flow before study participation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0025.review_note: Classified the unqualified consent directive as a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

statement.en: Consider collecting participant contact information when appropriate.
statement.ja: 適切な場合はparticipant contact informationの収集を検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0026.review_note: Split optional contact information from the mandatory consent decision.

statement.en: Obtain permission before accessing a participant's device or data.
statement.ja: participantのdeviceまたはdataへaccessする前にpermissionを得る。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0027.review_note: Classified the direct access-permission requirement as a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

statement.en: Clearly explain why the study needs each requested data type.
statement.ja: studyが各requested data typeを必要とする理由を明確に説明する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0028.review_note: Recovered the purpose explanation separately from permission and minimization.

statement.en: Avoid requesting access to data that isn't critical to the study.
statement.ja: studyに不可欠でないdataへのaccess requestを避ける。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0029.review_note: Retained AVOID for the direct don't guidance; the source does not use Never or must not.

statement.en: Obtain notification permission when the study requires notifications.
statement.ja: studyでnotificationが必要な場合はnotification permissionを得る。

conditions: The study needs to send notifications to the participant's device.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0030.review_note: Retained the conditional permission requirement as an explicit-user-intent MUST.

statement.en: Tell participants the survey question count and estimated duration.
statement.ja: participantにsurveyのquestion countとestimated durationを伝える。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0031.review_note: Recovered both expectation-setting values from the survey list.

statement.en: Use standard question text and slightly smaller explanatory text.
statement.ja: questionにはstandard text、explanationには少し小さいtextを使う。

conditions: The survey question needs additional explanation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0032.review_note: Recovered the conditional text hierarchy without treating the relative size as an absolute measurement.

statement.en: Tell participants when a survey is complete.
statement.ja: surveyが完了したことをparticipantに伝える。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0033.review_note: Recovered the survey completion state separately from task completion.

statement.en: Explain task timing and circumstance requirements.
statement.ja: taskのtimingとcircumstance requirementを説明する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0034.review_note: Recovered requirements that affect when or under what circumstances a task is performed.

section_path: Managing personal information and providing encouragement

statement.en: Keep profile and progress screens accessible throughout the app.
statement.ja: profileとprogress screenをapp内で常にaccess可能にする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0035.review_note: Preserved the source's ideal framing at SHOULD rather than MUST.

section_path: Managing personal information and providing encouragement

statement.en: Consider providing an easy way to leave a study from the profile.
statement.ja: profileからstudyを離脱できるeasyな方法の提供を検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0036.review_note: Kept the profile exit capability optional because the source presents it as something a profile can provide.

section_path: Managing personal information and providing encouragement

statement.en: Consider profile access to the consent document and privacy policy.
statement.ja: profileからconsent documentとprivacy policyへaccessできるようにすることを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0037.review_note: Kept document access optional because the source presents it as a profile capability.

statement.en: Avoid using ResearchKit on macOS, tvOS, visionOS, or watchOS.
statement.ja: macOS、tvOS、visionOS、watchOSでResearchKitを使わない。

conditions: ResearchKit is supported on iOS and iPadOS.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-RESEARCHKIT-0038.review_note: Recorded the descriptive platform limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Show the smallest watchOS map region that encompasses the points of interest.
statement.ja: point of interestを包含する最小のwatchOS map regionを表示する。

conditions: The watchOS map is a noninteractive static snapshot.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0016.review_note: Recorded the static-map context and kept the positive region-selection guidance at SHOULD.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0021.title: Ensure the entire watchOS map fits without scrolling

statement.en: Ensure the entire watchOS map interface element is visible without scrolling.
statement.ja: watchOS map interface element全体をscrollなしで表示する。

conditions: Fit the map interface element to the Apple Watch display.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0021.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit needs-to-be-visible requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0022.title: Ensure all key watchOS map content remains visible

statement.en: Ensure all key watchOS map content is visible within the displayed region.
statement.ja: watchOS mapの全key contentをdisplayed region内に表示する。

conditions: The map interface element does not scroll.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAPS-0022.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit all-key-content must-be-visible clause.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0001.title: Make sure Mac-idiom views and images look good

statement.en: Make sure views and images look good when the app uses the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomを使うappでviewとimageを良好に表示する。

conditions: Review unscaled iPadOS views and image assets at 100% rendering size.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0001.review_note: Retained the explicit Make sure MUST and narrowed it to the Mac-idiom rendering context.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0002.title: Make sure important tab items remain quickly accessible

statement.en: Make sure important iPad tab-bar items remain quickly accessible in the Mac app.
statement.ja: importantなiPad tab-bar itemをMac appでもすぐaccessできるようにする。

conditions: List top-level items in the macOS View menu when replacing the tab bar.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0002.review_note: Retained the Make sure MUST and the explicit View-menu technique.

statement.en: Offer multiple ways to move between pages in the Mac app.
statement.ja: Mac appでpage間を移動する複数の方法を提供する。

conditions: Provide Next and Previous buttons for pointer and keyboard users in addition to swipe gestures.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0003.review_note: Recorded the documented controls, modalities, and gesture alternative.

statement.en: Create a macOS version of the app icon for the Mac Catalyst app.
statement.ja: Mac Catalyst app用にmacOS版app iconを作成する。

conditions: Use the lifelike macOS rendering style while maintaining harmony across platforms.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0004.review_note: Recorded both platform-specific rendering and cross-platform continuity.

statement.en: Consider moving controls from the iPad app's main interface to the Mac app toolbar.
statement.ja: iPad appのmain interfaceにあるcontrolをMac app toolbarへ移すことを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0005.review_note: Preserved Consider and separated the mandatory menu-command follow-up.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0006.title: Use regular size classes in the Mac app

statement.en: Use the regular-width and regular-height size classes in the Mac app.
statement.ja: Mac appでregular-widthとregular-heightのsize classを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0006.review_note: Separated the direct size-class guidance from optional side-by-side reflow.

statement.en: Present Mac inspector UI beside the main content instead of in a popover.
statement.ja: Mac inspector UIをpopoverではなくmain contentの横に表示する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0007.review_note: Recorded both the placement and the popover alternative.

statement.en: Wherever practicable, adopt a top-down flow in the Mac app.
statement.ja: 可能な限りMac appでtop-down flowを採用する。

conditions: Place the most important actions and content near the top of the window.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0008.review_note: Preserved the practicability qualifier and top-of-window hierarchy.

statement.en: Support both keyboard navigation and keyboard shortcuts in the Mac app.
statement.ja: Mac appでkeyboard navigationとkeyboard shortcutの両方をsupportする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0009.review_note: Recovered both keyboard expectations from the suitability context.

statement.en: Avoid Mac Catalyst when the essential experience depends on capabilities unavailable on Mac.
statement.ja: essential experienceがMacで利用できないcapabilityに依存する場合はMac Catalystを避ける。

conditions: Examples include device sensors, a rear camera, HealthKit, ARKit, or touch-centric marking, handwriting, and navigation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0010.review_note: Recorded the suitability boundary and all documented example capability groups.

statement.en: When the iPad idiom already feels at home on Mac, consider switching to the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: iPad idiomがMacになじんだ後はMac idiomへの切替を検討する。

conditions: The Mac idiom can improve detail, Mac-like appearance, performance, and power use.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0011.review_note: Preserved the prerequisite and optional strength plus the documented benefits.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0012.title: Audit layout when adopting the Mac idiom

statement.en: Thoroughly audit the app layout and plan necessary changes when adopting the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomを採用するときapp layoutを十分に監査し必要な変更を計画する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0012.review_note: Recovered both the audit and change-planning actions.

statement.en: Consider a separate asset catalog for Mac app assets instead of reusing the iPad catalog.
statement.ja: iPad catalogの再利用ではなくMac app asset用の別asset catalogを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0013.review_note: Preserved Consider and the non-reuse alternative.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0014.title: Adjust Mac-idiom font sizes as needed

statement.en: Adjust font sizes as needed when the app uses the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomを使う場合は必要に応じてfont sizeを調整する。

conditions: Mac-idiom text renders at 100% and can otherwise appear too large.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-MAC-CATALYST-0014.review_note: Recorded the 100% rendering context and conditional adjustment.

statement.en: Use text styles wherever possible in the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomでは可能な限りtext styleを使う。

statement.en: Avoid fixed font sizes in the Mac idiom.
statement.ja: Mac idiomでfixed font sizeを避ける。
