statement.en: Order live-viewing tvOS tabs consistently.
statement.ja: live-viewing tvOS tabを一貫した順序にする。

conditions: Order live content first, cloud DVR or other recorded content second, and other content last.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0026.review_note: Activated the omitted live-viewing rule and recorded the exact three-part order.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0027.title: Provide a symbol and label for every visionOS tab

statement.en: Provide a symbol and text label for every visionOS tab.
statement.ja: すべてのvisionOS tabにsymbolとtext labelを提供する。

conditions: The symbol stays visible when collapsed, and the system reveals labels when people look at the tab bar.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0027.review_note: Activated the omitted symbol-and-label directive and recorded gaze-driven label reveal.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0028.title: Keep visionOS tab labels short

statement.en: Keep visionOS tab labels short enough to read at a glance.
statement.ja: visionOS tab labelを一目で読める短さに保つ。

conditions: The tab bar expands and reveals labels when people look at it.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0028.review_note: Recovered the explicit You need to directive and its at-a-glance purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0029.title: Keep sidebar selections within the open visionOS tab

statement.en: Be sure visionOS sidebar selections don't change which tab is open.
statement.ja: visionOS sidebarのselectionでopen tabが変わらないようにする。

conditions: The app uses a sidebar for secondary navigation within a tab.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TAB-BARS-0029.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure directive and retained its within-tab sidebar condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0001.title: Use text fields for small pieces of information

statement.en: Use a text field to request a small, specific piece of information.
statement.ja: smallでspecificな情報を求めるためtext fieldを使う。

conditions: Examples include a name or email address; use the separately reviewed text-view alternative for larger input.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0001.review_note: Recorded the small-input boundary and separated the larger-input alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0002.title: Show a hint that communicates text-field purpose

statement.en: Show a text-field hint when it helps communicate the field's purpose.
statement.ja: fieldのpurposeを伝える場合はtext-field hintを表示する。

conditions: Placeholder examples include Email or Password while the field contains no other text.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0002.review_note: Recorded the hint purpose and separated the persistent-label option.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0003.title: Use secure text fields for private data

statement.en: Use a secure text field to hide private data.
statement.ja: private dataを隠すためsecure text fieldを使う。

conditions: Apply the separately reviewed Always requirement when the requested data is sensitive.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0003.review_note: Retained the general secure-field guidance and separated the stronger sensitive-data rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0004.title: Keep text-field tab order logical

statement.en: Ensure tabbing between multiple text fields moves focus in a logical, expected sequence.
statement.ja: 複数text field間のtab移動でfocusが論理的かつ期待される順序になるようにする。

conditions: The interface contains multiple fields; customize order only when the system's automatic sequence is insufficient.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0004.review_note: Retained the explicit Ensure directive, fixed duplicated generated wording, and recorded keyboard modality.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0005.title: Use a number formatter for numeric data

statement.en: Use a number formatter to help people enter and read numeric data.
statement.ja: numeric dataの入力と読み取りを支援するためnumber formatterを使う。

conditions: Configure numeric acceptance and a suitable decimal, percentage, or currency display.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0005.review_note: Recorded input restriction and display-format purposes and separated locale caution.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0006.title: Consider an expansion tooltip for clipped text

statement.en: Consider an expansion tooltip for the full version of clipped or truncated text.
statement.ja: clippedまたはtruncated textの全文表示にexpansion tooltipを検討する。

conditions: The tooltip appears when someone places a pointer over the field.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0006.review_note: Preserved MAY and recorded the pointer-triggered behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0007.title: Minimize tvOS and watchOS text entry

statement.en: Minimize text entry in tvOS and watchOS apps.
statement.ja: tvOSとwatchOS appではtext entryを最小化する。

conditions: Long passages and numerous fields are time-consuming on Apple TV and Apple Watch.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0007.review_note: Corrected page-wide scope to the two named platforms and separated the button alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0008.title: Provide a trailing Clear button

statement.en: Display a Clear button at the trailing end of an iOS or iPadOS text field.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOS text fieldのtrailing endにClear buttonを表示する。

conditions: Let people erase all input without repeatedly tapping Delete.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0008.review_note: Made placement and erase behavior concrete.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0009.title: Use text-field images and buttons for clarity and function

statement.en: Use images and buttons to add clarity or functionality to iOS and iPadOS text fields.
statement.ja: iOSとiPadOS text fieldのclarityまたはfunctionality向上にimageとbuttonを使う。

conditions: Use custom images at either end or a suitable system-provided button.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0009.review_note: Recorded supported accessory types and separated leading and trailing purposes.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0010.title: Consider a macOS combo box for text and choices

statement.en: Consider a macOS combo box when pairing text input with a list of choices.
statement.ja: text inputとchoice listを組み合わせる場合はmacOS combo boxを検討する。

conditions: The input needs both free text and selectable choices.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0010.review_note: Preserved MAY and the paired-input condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0011.title: Use watchOS text fields only when necessary

statement.en: Present a watchOS text field only when necessary.
statement.ja: 必要な場合にだけwatchOS text fieldを表示する。

conditions: Apply the separately reviewed list-of-options preference whenever possible.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0011.review_note: Made the watchOS scope explicit and separated its preferred alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0012.title: Use a text view for larger input

statement.en: Use a text view when people need to enter a larger amount of text.
statement.ja: 多量のtextを入力する場合はtext viewを使う。

conditions: The requested input exceeds a small, specific piece of information.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0012.review_note: Separated the larger-input alternative from text-field use.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0013.title: Consider a separate persistent field label

statement.en: Consider a separate text-field label when a disappearing placeholder may obscure the field's purpose.
statement.ja: placeholder消失でfieldのpurposeが不明になる場合は別のtext-field labelを検討する。

conditions: Placeholder text disappears after people begin typing.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0014.title: Always use secure fields for sensitive data

statement.en: Always use a secure text field when the app requests sensitive data.
statement.ja: appがsensitive dataを求める場合は常にsecure text fieldを使う。

conditions: Sensitive data includes passwords.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always directive and its sensitive-data condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0015.title: Match field size to expected text quantity

statement.en: When possible, match a text field's size to the anticipated amount of text.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はtext field sizeを予想されるtext量に合わせる。

conditions: Field size helps people gauge how much information to provide.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0015.review_note: Activated the qualified sizing rule without raising it to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0016.title: Space multiple text fields evenly

statement.en: Space multiple text fields evenly.
statement.ja: 複数text fieldを均等に配置する。

conditions: Leave enough space for people to associate each input field with its introductory label.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0016.review_note: Activated the omitted spacing rule and recorded label association.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0017.title: Prefer vertically stacked text fields

statement.en: Stack multiple text fields vertically when possible.
statement.ja: 可能な場合は複数text fieldをverticalにstackする。

conditions: The layout contains multiple related fields.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0017.review_note: Separated the qualified stacking preference from spacing and width.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0018.title: Use consistent widths for related text fields

statement.en: Use consistent widths for related groups of text fields.
statement.ja: 関連するtext field groupでは一貫したwidthを使う。

conditions: Different related groups can use different widths when their expected input differs.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0018.review_note: Separated width consistency and retained the source's grouped-width example.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0019.title: Validate text fields when context warrants

statement.en: Validate text fields when it makes sense for their content and task.
statement.ja: contentとtaskに適する場合はtext fieldをvalidateする。

conditions: Choose validation behavior and timing from the input's legitimate values and task context.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0019.review_note: Activated the general validation rule and separated three source-specific outcomes.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0020.title: Alert people to invalid digits-only input

statement.en: Alert people when a digits-only text field contains other characters.
statement.ja: digits-only text fieldに他のcharacterが含まれる場合は利用者へalertする。

conditions: The only legitimate value is a string of digits.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0020.review_note: Recovered the explicit needs to alert directive and its digits-only condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0021.title: Validate email after leaving its field

statement.en: Validate an email address when people switch to another field.
statement.ja: 利用者が別fieldへ移るときemail addressをvalidateする。

conditions: The field accepts an email address.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0021.review_note: Recovered the source's best-time recommendation for email validation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0022.title: Validate user names and passwords before leaving

statement.en: Ensure user-name or password validation happens before people switch to another field.
statement.ja: 別fieldへ移る前にuser nameまたはpasswordのvalidationを行う。

conditions: The field creates a user name or password.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0022.review_note: Recovered the explicit validation needs to happen timing and retained its credential-creation condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0023.title: Avoid assuming numeric presentation across locales

statement.en: Avoid assuming how formatted numeric data appears across people's locales.
statement.ja: locale間でformatted numeric dataの表示方法を決めつけない。

conditions: Decimal, percentage, and currency formatting can vary significantly by locale.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0023.review_note: Separated the source's Don't caution from number-formatter use.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0024.title: Choose line breaks for the field's needs

statement.en: Choose text-field clipping, wrapping, or truncation behavior according to the field's needs.
statement.ja: fieldのneedsに応じてtext-field clipping、wrapping、truncation behaviorを選ぶ。

conditions: Wrapping can occur at characters or words; truncation can occur at the beginning, middle, or end.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0024.review_note: Activated the omitted line-break rule and recorded all documented behaviors.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0025.title: Show the appropriate virtual keyboard

statement.en: Show the keyboard type appropriate for the entered content in iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS.
statement.ja: iOS、iPadOS、tvOS、visionOSでは入力contentに適したkeyboard typeを表示する。

conditions: Choose a keyboard designed for the input type, such as numbers or URLs, to streamline entry.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0025.review_note: Activated the omitted rule and corrected page-wide scope to the four named platforms.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0026.title: Consider buttons instead of tvOS or watchOS text entry

statement.en: Consider buttons or another efficient alternative to gather tvOS or watchOS information.
statement.ja: tvOSまたはwatchOSの情報収集にはbuttonなど効率的な代替手段を検討する。

conditions: The alternative reduces long passages or numerous text fields.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0026.review_note: Separated the optional efficient-input alternative and retained its two-platform scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0027.title: Use leading field accessories to indicate purpose

statement.en: Generally, use the leading end of an iOS or iPadOS text field to indicate its purpose.
statement.ja: 通常はiOSまたはiPadOS text fieldのleading endでpurposeを示す。

conditions: A suitable image can clarify the field.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0027.review_note: Separated the general leading-end purpose from other accessory behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0028.title: Use trailing field accessories for additional features

statement.en: Generally, use the trailing end of an iOS or iPadOS text field for additional features.
statement.ja: 通常はiOSまたはiPadOS text fieldのtrailing endで追加featureを提供する。

conditions: Examples include bookmarking or clearing input.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0028.review_note: Separated the general trailing-end purpose from leading-end clarity.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0029.title: Prefer watchOS option lists over text entry

statement.en: Whenever possible, prefer a list of options over watchOS text entry.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はwatchOS text entryよりoption listを優先する。

conditions: A predefined list can replace manual text entry for the task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-FIELDS-0029.review_note: Separated the preferred watchOS alternative from the text-field necessity rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0001.title: Use text views for long, editable, or specially formatted text

statement.en: Use a text view for long, editable, or specially formatted text.
statement.ja: long、editable、またはspecially formattedなtextにはtext viewを使う。

conditions: A text view offers more specialized display and input options than a label or text field.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0001.review_note: Made the component-selection criteria concrete and separated both small-text alternatives.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0002.title: Keep text-view content legible

statement.en: Keep text-view content legible when varying fonts, colors, or alignments.
statement.ja: font、color、alignmentを変える場合もtext-view contentをlegibleに保つ。

conditions: Creative styling must preserve content readability.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0002.review_note: Fixed ungrammatical generated wording and recorded the styling context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0003.title: Make useful text-view content selectable

statement.en: Make useful text-view content selectable.
statement.ja: usefulなtext-view contentをselectableにする。

conditions: For information such as an error message, serial number, or IP address, let people select and copy it for reuse.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0003.review_note: Recorded the useful-information condition and copy-and-paste purpose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0004.title: Show a content-appropriate text-view keyboard

statement.en: Ensure an editable iOS or iPadOS text view shows a keyboard appropriate for its content.
statement.ja: editableなiOSまたはiPadOS text viewでcontentに適したkeyboardを表示する。

conditions: People are editing the text view; select a keyboard type designed for the input to streamline entry.

manual: Does each editable text view present a keyboard layout appropriate for its expected content?

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0004.review_note: Changed SHOULD to MUST after confirming the surrounding needs to be appropriate requirement, and replaced the irrelevant hardware-keyboard traversal check.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0005.title: Use a label for small read-only text

statement.en: Use a label for a small amount of read-only text.
statement.ja: 少量のread-only textにはlabelを使う。

conditions: The content does not need text-view formatting or input capabilities.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0005.review_note: Separated the small read-only component alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0006.title: Use a text field for small editable text

statement.en: Use a text field for a small amount of editable text.
statement.ja: 少量のeditable textにはtext fieldを使う。

conditions: The content does not need text-view formatting or multiline capabilities.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0006.review_note: Separated the small editable component alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0007.title: Adopt Dynamic Type for text views

statement.en: Adopt Dynamic Type so text-view content remains legible after text-size changes.
statement.ja: text size変更後もtext-view contentをlegibleに保つためDynamic Typeを採用する。

conditions: People can change text size on their device.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0007.review_note: Recovered the source's good-idea recommendation without promoting it to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0008.title: Test text views with accessibility options

statement.en: Be sure to test text-view content with accessibility options such as bold text enabled.
statement.ja: bold textなどのaccessibility optionを有効にしてtext-view contentをtestする。

conditions: Verify that the content remains readable under supported accessibility settings.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0008.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure directive and its bold-text example.

HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0009.title: Use text fields for editable tvOS text

statement.en: Use a text field instead of a text view for editable tvOS text.
statement.ja: editableなtvOS textにはtext viewではなくtext fieldを使う。

conditions: Text input is minimal by design in tvOS; text views remain available for displaying text.
HIG-COMPONENTS-TEXT-VIEWS-0009.review_note: Recovered the tvOS editing component choice while retaining display behavior as context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0001.title: Choose a content-appropriate virtual keyboard

statement.en: Choose a virtual keyboard that matches the content people are editing.
statement.ja: 編集中のcontentに合うvirtual keyboardを選ぶ。

conditions: Use keys optimized for the expected input, such as numbers and punctuation for numeric data.
exceptions: On watchOS, set the text field content type because the keyboard type can't be changed.

manual: Does each text-entry context present a virtual keyboard suited to its expected content?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0001.review_note: Made the content-to-keyboard selection criterion concrete and removed an irrelevant hardware-keyboard traversal check.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0002.title: Customize the Return key only when it clarifies text entry

statement.en: Consider customizing the Return key type when it clarifies the next text-entry action.
statement.ja: 次のtext-entry actionが明確になる場合はReturn key typeのcustomizeを検討する。

conditions: A nondefault label such as Search communicates the action more clearly than the standard Return key.

manual: If the Return key is customized, does its label clarify the action people perform next?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0002.review_note: Retained the source's conditional MAY and recorded the action-clarity criterion.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0003.title: Keep custom input views appropriate to the app context

statement.en: Ensure a custom input view makes sense in the context of the app.
statement.ja: custom input viewがappのcontextに適合するようにする。

conditions: The app replaces the system keyboard with a custom input view.

manual: Is replacing the system keyboard with this custom input view understandable and appropriate in the app context?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0003.review_note: Retained the explicit Make sure directive as MUST and separated simplicity and benefit communication into atomic rules.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0004.title: Provide an obvious way to switch custom keyboards

statement.en: Provide an obvious and easy way to switch between custom keyboards.
statement.ja: custom keyboard間を明確かつ容易に切り替えられるようにする。

conditions: Use an interaction that is as intuitive as the standard Globe-key behavior.

manual: Can people discover and use the custom keyboard's switching control without instruction?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0004.review_note: Narrowed the custom-keyboard-extension rule to the three explicitly supported platforms and recorded the Globe-key expectation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0005.title: Avoid duplicating system-provided keyboard features

statement.en: Avoid duplicating system-provided features in a custom keyboard.
statement.ja: custom keyboard内でsystem-provided featureを重複させない。

conditions: The system may already display features such as Emoji or Globe and Dictation controls outside the custom keyboard.

manual: Does the custom keyboard omit system controls that the app can't affect and that would confuse people if repeated?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0005.review_note: Retained AVOID, narrowed platform scope, and recorded why system-provided controls must not be duplicated.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0006.title: Consider an in-app custom-keyboard tutorial

statement.en: Consider providing a custom-keyboard tutorial in the app.
statement.ja: app内でcustom keyboardのtutorial提供を検討する。

conditions: People need help choosing, activating, using, or leaving a nonstandard keyboard.

manual: When the custom keyboard has a learning curve, does the app explain setup, use, and switching clearly?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0006.review_note: Retained MAY, narrowed platform scope, and separated the tutorial location restriction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0007.title: Use the keyboard layout guide for integrated iOS and iPadOS layouts

statement.en: Use the keyboard layout guide to integrate the keyboard with an iOS or iPadOS interface.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOS interfaceとkeyboardを統合するためkeyboard layout guideを使う。

conditions: Keep important interface content visible and usable while the virtual keyboard is onscreen.

manual: With the virtual keyboard onscreen, do important content and controls remain visible and usable?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0007.review_note: Recorded visibility and usability as the layout-guide outcomes and removed an irrelevant hardware-keyboard traversal check.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0008.title: Place keyboard accessory controls thoughtfully

statement.en: Place custom controls above the iOS or iPadOS keyboard thoughtfully.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOS keyboard上部のcustom controlを慎重に配置する。

conditions: An input accessory view provides app-specific functionality related to the data people are editing.

manual: Do controls above the keyboard support the edited data without crowding or distracting from entry?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0008.review_note: Made the input-accessory context concrete and split relevance, material, and positioning requirements.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0009.title: Consider a custom input view for app-specific entry

statement.en: Consider a custom input view when it enhances an app-specific data-entry task.
statement.ja: app固有のdata-entry taskを改善する場合はcustom input viewを検討する。

conditions: The custom view replaces the system keyboard only while people are in the app.

manual: Does the custom input view add task-specific value that the system keyboard doesn't provide?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0009.review_note: Recovered the conditional custom-input capability as MAY without making replacement a default.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0010.title: Consider specifying semantic meaning for text input

statement.en: Consider specifying the semantic meaning of a text input area.
statement.ja: text input areaのsemantic meaning指定を検討する。

conditions: The system can use the meaning to select an appropriate keyboard and refine corrections.

manual: Where supported, does the text input's semantic type help the system optimize keyboard choice or corrections?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0010.review_note: Recovered the semantic-input capability as MAY because the source describes a conditional system benefit.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0011.title: Keep custom input-view entry simple and intuitive

statement.en: Make data entry with a custom input view simple and intuitive.
statement.ja: custom input viewによるdata entryをsimpleかつintuitiveにする。

conditions: The app replaces the familiar system keyboard during the task.

manual: Can people understand and complete entry in the custom input view without avoidable friction?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0011.review_note: Separated the source's usability expectation from the contextual MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0012.title: Explain the benefit of a custom input view

statement.en: Help people understand the benefit of using a custom input view.
statement.ja: custom input viewを使うbenefitが理解できるようにする。

conditions: People may otherwise wonder why the system keyboard is unavailable in the app.

manual: Is the reason for replacing the system keyboard apparent from the task and custom controls?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0012.review_note: Separated benefit communication from simplicity and the contextual MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0013.title: Play the standard keyboard sound in custom input views

statement.en: Play the standard keyboard sound while people type in a custom input view.
statement.ja: custom input viewで入力中はstandard keyboard soundを再生する。

conditions: Use the system input-click behavior so the person's keyboard-sound setting remains effective.

manual: Do custom keys provide the familiar input sound while respecting the system keyboard-sound setting?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0013.review_note: Recovered the omitted sound-feedback rule and recorded the user-controlled Settings behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0014.title: Consider an app extension for an installable custom keyboard

statement.en: On iOS, iPadOS, or tvOS, consider an app extension for an installable custom keyboard.
statement.ja: iOS、iPadOS、tvOSでinstall可能なcustom keyboardにはapp extensionを検討する。

conditions: People need to use the keyboard in place of the standard keyboard across apps.

manual: Is an installable app extension appropriate for the keyboard's intended cross-app use?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0014.review_note: Recovered the extension capability as MAY and retained the explicit three-platform scope.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0015.title: Use custom keyboards for unique systemwide functionality

statement.en: Use a custom keyboard for unique keyboard functionality people need systemwide.
statement.ja: systemwideに必要なunique keyboard functionalityにはcustom keyboardを使う。

conditions: Examples include a novel input method or a language the system keyboard doesn't support.

manual: Does the custom keyboard provide distinctive functionality that remains useful across apps?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0015.review_note: Recovered the systemwide-use criterion and its unique-functionality examples.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0016.title: Consider a custom input view for app-only keyboard functionality

statement.en: Consider a custom input view for keyboard functionality used only within the app.
statement.ja: app内だけで使うkeyboard functionalityにはcustom input viewを検討する。

conditions: People don't need the custom functionality in other apps.

manual: If functionality is app-specific, was a custom input view considered before an installable keyboard extension?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0016.review_note: Separated the conditional in-app alternative without promoting it above MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0017.title: Avoid help content inside a custom keyboard

statement.en: Avoid displaying help content within the custom keyboard itself.
statement.ja: custom keyboard自体の中にhelp contentを表示しない。

conditions: Put any needed tutorial or usage instructions in the app instead.

manual: Is instructional content kept in the app rather than consuming space inside the custom keyboard?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0017.review_note: Recovered the omitted final Avoid directive as a separate atomic rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0018.title: Keep keyboard accessory controls relevant to the current task

statement.en: Ensure custom controls that augment the iOS or iPadOS keyboard are relevant to the current task.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOS keyboardを補うcustom controlがcurrent taskに関連するようにする。

conditions: The app provides an input accessory view above the keyboard.

manual: Does every control above the keyboard directly support the current data-entry task?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0018.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit conditional Make sure directive as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0019.title: Apply Liquid Glass to keyboard accessory controls when needed

statement.en: Apply Liquid Glass to the keyboard accessory view when needed for consistency.
statement.ja: consistencyのため必要な場合はkeyboard accessory viewにLiquid Glassを適用する。

conditions: Other app views use Liquid Glass, or the accessory view otherwise looks out of place above the keyboard.
exceptions: A standard toolbar adopts Liquid Glass automatically.

manual: Does the accessory view visually fit the surrounding app and keyboard context?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0019.review_note: Recovered the conditional material treatment as SHOULD without raising it to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0020.title: Use the layout guide and standard padding for accessory controls

statement.en: Use the keyboard layout guide and standard padding to position keyboard accessory controls.
statement.ja: keyboard accessory controlの配置にkeyboard layout guideとstandard paddingを使う。

conditions: Let the system position the controls as expected within the accessory view.

manual: Are accessory controls positioned with the keyboard layout guide and standard padding?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0020.review_note: Recovered the concrete positioning technique as a separate SHOULD rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0021.title: Consider setting the watchOS text content type

statement.en: Consider setting a watchOS text field's content type to improve text entry.
statement.ja: text entryを改善するためwatchOS text fieldのcontent type設定を検討する。

conditions: The keyboard type itself can't be changed in watchOS; the system may use content type to offer suggestions.

manual: Does the text field provide an accurate content type where it can improve watchOS entry suggestions?

HIG-COMPONENTS-VIRTUAL-KEYBOARDS-0021.review_note: Recovered the watchOS content-type capability as MAY and retained the fixed keyboard-type constraint as context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0001.title: Share watch faces that feature your app's complications

statement.en: Share watch faces that feature your complications to help people discover the app.
statement.ja: appのcomplicationを含むwatch faceを共有し、appの発見を助ける。

conditions: A configured watch face can introduce people to the app and its complications.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0001.review_note: Made the discovery goal and featured-complication mechanism concrete.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0002.title: Preview every shared watch face

statement.en: Display a preview of every watch face you share.
statement.ja: 共有するすべてのwatch faceにpreviewを表示する。

conditions: Use a preview suitable for its display context, including websites and watchOS or iOS apps.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0002.review_note: Removed generic generated wording and recorded where the preview can be displayed.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0003.title: Aim for shareable watch faces across Apple Watch devices

statement.en: Aim to offer shareable watch faces for all Apple Watch devices.
statement.ja: すべてのApple Watch device向けにshareable watch faceを提供することを目指す。

conditions: Watch-face availability varies by Apple Watch model and generation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0003.review_note: Preserved the aspirational SHOULD and recorded the compatibility reason.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0004.title: Handle incompatible shared watch faces gracefully

statement.en: Respond gracefully when people choose an incompatible shared watch face.
statement.ja: 非互換のshared watch faceが選ばれた場合はgracefulに対応する。

conditions: The system reports that the selected face isn't available on the person's Apple Watch.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0004.review_note: Made the incompatibility trigger explicit and split the alternative and disclosure actions.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0005.title: Support multiple complications in shareable watch faces

statement.en: When possible, support multiple complications in a shareable watch face.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はshareable watch faceで複数のcomplicationをsupportする。

conditions: Use multiple app complications to showcase capabilities and create a curated experience.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0005.review_note: Recovered the source's ideal recommendation without elevating it to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0006.title: Consider customizing supported watch-face attributes

statement.en: Consider specifying a system accent color, images, or styles for a shareable watch face.
statement.ja: shareable watch faceのsystem accent color、image、style指定を検討する。

conditions: The selected watch face supports the attribute.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0006.review_note: Recovered the face-dependent customization capability as MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0007.title: Highlight watch-face advantages in its preview

statement.en: Highlight the advantages of a shared watch face in its preview.
statement.ja: shared watch faceのadvantageをpreviewで強調する。

conditions: Help people visualize the watch face's benefits before adding it.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0007.review_note: Separated preview content quality from the requirement to provide a preview.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0008.title: Consider an Apple-provided bezel for watch-face previews

statement.en: Consider an illustrated or high-fidelity hardware bezel for a watch-face preview.
statement.ja: watch-face previewにillustratedまたはhigh-fidelity hardware bezelを使うことを検討する。

conditions: Use the illustrated bezel included with the preview or an Apple Design Resources hardware bezel.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0008.review_note: Recovered both Apple-provided bezel options as a MAY choice.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0009.title: Consider a similar face for earlier Apple Watch devices

statement.en: Consider a similar watch-face configuration for devices that don't support the selected face.
statement.ja: 選択したfaceをsupportしないdevice向けに類似watch-face configurationを検討する。

conditions: The preferred watch face is unavailable on an earlier Apple Watch model.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0009.review_note: Recovered the compatibility fallback as conditional MAY guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0010.title: Consider labeling supported Apple Watch devices

statement.en: Consider labeling each shareable watch face with the devices it supports.
statement.ja: 各shareable watch faceにsupport対象deviceをlabel表示することを検討する。

conditions: Device compatibility information helps people choose an appropriate face.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0010.review_note: Recovered the optional compatibility label without converting can to a requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0011.title: Consider immediately offering a compatible alternative

statement.en: Consider immediately offering a compatible watch-face configuration instead of displaying an error.
statement.ja: error表示の代わりに互換watch-face configurationを即時提供することを検討する。

conditions: The person selects a watch face that isn't compatible with their Apple Watch.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0011.review_note: Recovered the immediate compatible alternative as conditional MAY guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0012.title: Explain possible alternatives for incompatible watch faces

statement.en: Help people understand that an incompatible choice may produce an alternative watch face.
statement.ja: 非互換の選択ではalternative watch faceが提供される可能性を理解できるようにする。

conditions: Communicate the possibility alongside the watch-face previews.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WATCH-FACES-0012.review_note: Separated the disclosure from the optional alternative-handling action.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0029.title: Support Always-On display for iPhone Lock Screen widgets

statement.en: Support the Always-On display in iPhone Lock Screen widgets.
statement.ja: iPhone Lock Screen widgetでAlways-On displayをsupportする。

conditions: Use gray levels with enough contrast when the system renders the widget at reduced luminance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0029.review_note: Narrowed the rule from the shared section to iPhone and recorded reduced-luminance contrast.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0030.title: Offer Live Activities for frequent real-time updates

statement.en: Offer Live Activities instead of widgets for frequent real-time updates.
statement.ja: 頻繁なreal-time updateにはwidgetではなくLive Activityを提供する。

conditions: People track a limited-duration task or event whose progress changes frequently.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0030.review_note: Recorded that widgets aren't real-time surfaces and preserved the limited-duration tracking condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0031.title: Test visionOS widgets across palettes and lighting

statement.en: Test visionOS widgets across every system color palette and varied lighting conditions.
statement.ja: visionOS widgetをすべてのsystem color paletteとさまざまなlighting conditionでtestする。

conditions: Include every provided tint palette when any UI elements are excluded from tinting.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0031.review_note: Made the test matrix explicit and split both Make sure outcomes into MUST rules.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0032.title: Adapt visionOS widget detail to both distance thresholds

statement.en: Design a responsive visionOS widget layout for both distance thresholds.
statement.ja: 2つのdistance thresholdに対応するresponsiveなvisionOS widget layoutを設計する。

conditions: At a distance, show fewer details, larger type, and no buttons or toggles.
Nearby, show more detail with smaller type.
Maintain shared elements across both thresholds for continuity.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0032.review_note: Recorded the distant, nearby, and continuity behaviors without splitting one responsive state transition.

statement.en: Offer visionOS widget family sizes that fit people's surroundings.
statement.ja: 人のsurroundingsに合うvisionOS widget family sizeを提供する。

conditions: Match real-world size to likely placement and content, such as a desk, wall, or sideboard.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0033.review_note: Recorded real-world placement and content as the size-selection criteria.

statement.en: Keep visionOS widget content legible across viewing distances and supported scales.
statement.ja: viewing distanceとsupport対象scaleの範囲でvisionOS widget contentをlegibleに保つ。

conditions: Account for scaling from 75 to 125 percent.
Use clear hierarchy, strong typography, and high-resolution assets that work at every size.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0034.review_note: Recorded the system scale range and the print-design and asset techniques.

statement.en: Choose the visionOS widget mounting style that fits the content and intended experience.
statement.ja: contentと意図するexperienceに合うvisionOS widget mounting styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Elevated works on horizontal and vertical surfaces; recessed works only on vertical surfaces and suits ambient or immersive content.
exceptions: A widget can opt out of a style that doesn't suit it; recessed-only widgets can't be placed horizontally.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0035.review_note: Recorded placement constraints, content fit, and the supported opt-out.

statement.en: Test elevated visionOS widget designs with every system-provided frame width.
statement.ja: elevated visionOS widget designをすべてのsystem-provided frame widthでtestする。

conditions: The layout can't change in response to the frame width a person chooses.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0036.review_note: Recorded the fixed-layout constraint and split the explicit visual-balance MUST.

statement.en: Choose the visionOS paper style for a grounded, print-like widget.
statement.ja: groundedでprint-likeなvisionOS widgetにはpaper styleを選ぶ。

conditions: The whole widget should respond to ambient lighting and blend into its surroundings.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0037.review_note: Recorded ambient-light response and physical-object character as the paper-style criteria.

statement.en: Choose the visionOS glass style for information-rich widgets.
statement.ja: information-richなvisionOS widgetにはglass styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Use full-color foreground elements for important content that must remain sharp and legible as ambient light changes.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0038.review_note: Recorded foreground-background separation and stable legibility as the glass-style criteria.

statement.en: Provide a meaningful colorful background for a watchOS Smart Stack widget.
statement.ja: watchOS Smart Stack widgetに意味を伝えるcolorful backgroundを提供する。

conditions: The default background is black; use custom color only when it adds meaning.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0039.review_note: Recorded meaningful color as the condition rather than treating custom color as decoration.

statement.en: Provide relevancy information that helps the system surface a watchOS Smart Stack widget.
statement.ja: systemがwatchOS Smart Stack widgetを適切に表示できるrelevancy informationを提供する。

conditions: Relevance may be location-based or tied to an ongoing system action such as a workout.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0040.review_note: Made the RelevanceKit input concrete instead of implying direct control over widget position.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0042.title: Apply Complications principles to Lock Screen widgets

statement.en: Apply Complications design principles to Lock Screen widgets.
statement.ja: Lock Screen widgetにComplicationsのdesign principleを適用する。

conditions: Lock Screen widgets are functionally similar to watch complications.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0043.title: Provide useful information in Lock Screen widgets

statement.en: Provide useful information in a Lock Screen widget.
statement.ja: Lock Screen widgetにuseful informationを提供する。

conditions: The widget should deliver glanceable value before anyone opens the app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0043.review_note: Separated the information value from the launcher anti-pattern.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0044.title: Avoid treating Lock Screen widgets only as app launchers

statement.en: Avoid using a Lock Screen widget only as a way to launch the app.
statement.ja: Lock Screen widgetをapp起動だけの手段として使わない。

conditions: Provide useful information directly in the widget.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0044.review_note: Recovered the explicit launcher-only anti-pattern as AVOID.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0045.title: Keep Always-On widget content legible

statement.en: Ensure iPhone Always-On widget content remains legible at reduced luminance.
statement.ja: reduced luminanceでもiPhone Always-On widget contentをlegibleに保つ。

conditions: The Lock Screen renders in the Always-On reduced-luminance state.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0045.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure legibility requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0046.title: Use glanceable information and large text in CarPlay widgets

statement.en: Use glanceable information and large text to keep CarPlay widgets easy to read.
statement.ja: CarPlay widgetを読みやすくするためglanceable informationとlarge textを使う。

conditions: People read the widget on a car display.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0046.review_note: Separated the CarPlay readability requirement from shared StandBy system behavior.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0047.title: Limit rich imagery and color reliance in StandBy widgets

statement.en: Limit reliance on rich images or color to convey meaning in StandBy widgets.
statement.ja: StandBy widgetで意味を伝える際のrich imageやcolorへの依存を抑える。

conditions: Use the additional space to enlarge and rearrange text for viewing at a distance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0047.review_note: Activated the previously nonactionable lead and recorded the distance-reading alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0048.title: Avoid background colors in StandBy widgets

statement.en: Avoid background colors when a widget appears in StandBy.
statement.ja: widgetがStandByに表示される場合はbackground colorを使わない。

conditions: Blend the widget seamlessly with StandBy's black background.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0048.review_note: Recovered the explicit StandBy background anti-pattern.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0049.title: Design visionOS widgets for their spatial surroundings

statement.en: Adapt visionOS widget design and content to the surrounding spatial experience.
statement.ja: visionOS widgetのdesignとcontentを周囲のspatial experienceに適応させる。

conditions: Consider likely rooms, surfaces, viewing distances, and real-world scale early in design.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0049.review_note: Activated the previously nonactionable lead and recorded spatial context as a design input.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0050.title: Keep visionOS widget presentation consistent across palettes and lighting

statement.en: Ensure a visionOS widget's tone, contrast, and legibility remain consistent and intentional.
statement.ja: visionOS widgetのtone、contrast、legibilityを一貫し意図的に保つ。

conditions: Test across every system color palette and varied lighting conditions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0050.review_note: Recovered and retained the first explicit Make sure outcome.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0051.title: Keep untinted visionOS widget elements legible

statement.en: Ensure untinted visionOS widget elements remain legible in every system tint palette.
statement.ja: untintedなvisionOS widget elementをすべてのsystem tint paletteでlegibleに保つ。

conditions: The widget excludes UI elements from tinting and a person applies a tint color.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0051.review_note: Recovered and retained the conditional second Make sure outcome.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0052.title: Keep elevated visionOS widget layouts balanced at every frame width

statement.en: Ensure an elevated visionOS widget layout remains balanced at every system frame width.
statement.ja: elevated visionOS widget layoutをすべてのsystem frame widthでbalancedに保つ。

conditions: People can choose the frame width, but the widget can't change its layout in response.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0052.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure visual-balance requirement.

statement.en: Choose a simple widget concept that supports the app's main purpose.
statement.ja: appの主目的を支えるsimpleなwidget conceptを選ぶ。

conditions: Center the concept on timely content and relevant functionality.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0001.review_note: Concretized the purpose test and kept the direct Choose guidance at SHOULD.

statement.en: Give people quick access to the widget content they want.
statement.ja: 求めるwidget contentへすばやくaccessできるようにする。

conditions: Use meaningful content, useful actions, and deep links to key app areas.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0002.review_note: Recorded quick access as the outcome and split its content and app-icon details.

statement.en: Prefer widget information that changes meaningfully throughout the day.
statement.ja: 一日の中で意味のある変化をするwidget informationを優先する。

conditions: Widgets don't update continuously or minute by minute.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0003.review_note: Preserved Prefer at SHOULD and recorded the non-real-time constraint.

statement.en: Offer multiple widget sizes when each size adds value.
statement.ja: 各sizeが価値を加える場合に複数のwidget sizeを提供する。

exceptions: One size that best represents the content is better than supporting every size without added value.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0004.review_note: Preserved the conditional scope and separated the expansion anti-pattern and one-size fallback.

statement.en: Display only information directly related to the widget's main purpose.
statement.ja: widgetの主目的に直接関係するinformationだけを表示する。

conditions: Larger sizes may add data or detail while staying centered on the same purpose.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0005.review_note: Recorded the larger-size allowance without weakening the purpose boundary.

statement.en: Use brand elements thoughtfully in widgets.
statement.ja: widgetではbrand elementを慎重に使う。

conditions: Brand colors, type, and glyphs may aid recognition; a logo is seldom necessary.
When a small logo helps distinguish multiple content sources, the top-right corner is sufficient.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0006.review_note: Recorded the recognition purpose and split the information-competition anti-pattern.

statement.en: Choose automatic or configurable widget content according to what is most useful.
statement.ja: 最も有用なinformationに応じてautomaticまたはconfigurableなwidget contentを選ぶ。

conditions: Offer configuration when people need to select the information; automate when recent content is useful without setup.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0007.review_note: Recorded the decision criteria without requiring configuration for every widget.

statement.en: Avoid mirroring a widget's appearance in an app when the in-app element behaves differently.
statement.ja: app内elementの動作が異なる場合にwidgetのappearanceを模倣しない。

conditions: A widget-like in-app element can create incorrect interaction expectations.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0008.review_note: Preserved direct Avoid guidance and made the behavior-mismatch condition explicit.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0009.title: Ensure people know when signing in adds widget value

statement.en: When signing in adds widget functionality, ensure people know it is available.
statement.ja: sign inでwidget functionalityが増える場合、そのことを確実に伝える。

conditions: The signed-out widget can use a concise sign-in message to explain the added value.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0009.review_note: Raised the conditional outcome to MUST from the paragraph's explicit Make sure directive.

statement.en: Keep widget information current enough to remain relevant and useful.
statement.ja: widget informationをrelevantかつusefulに保てる程度に最新化する。

conditions: Base update timing on how often data changes and when people need new data.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0010.review_note: Concretized currentness and split frequency selection and last-updated disclosure.

statement.en: Use system functionality to refresh widget dates and times.
statement.ja: widgetのdateとtimeのrefreshにはsystem functionalityを使う。

conditions: Automatic date and time refresh preserves limited widget update opportunities.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0011.review_note: Recorded the limited-update rationale and separated stale-placeholder handling.

statement.en: Use animated transitions to call attention to widget data updates.
statement.ja: widget dataのupdateに注意を向けるためanimated transitionを使う。

conditions: Use animation when new information arrives or content displays differently.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0012.review_note: Kept animation as SHOULD and split the two-second duration constraint.

statement.en: Offer simple, relevant widget functionality and reserve complex tasks for the app.
statement.ja: widgetではsimpleでrelevantなfunctionalityを提供し、complexなtaskはappに任せる。

conditions: Widget actions should relate directly to displayed content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0013.review_note: Preserved the widget-to-app complexity boundary as SHOULD.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0014.title: Ensure widget interactions open the app at the relevant location

statement.en: Ensure each widget interaction opens the app at the location relevant to its content.
statement.ja: 各widget interactionからcontentに関連するapp locationを開く。

conditions: Deep link to directly related details or actions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0014.review_note: Retained MUST from Ensure and split the navigation anti-pattern.

statement.en: Offer widget interactivity while keeping the layout glanceable and uncluttered.
statement.ja: layoutをglanceableかつunclutteredに保ちながらwidget interactivityを提供する。

conditions: Inline accessory widgets support only one tap target.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0015.review_note: Separated the app-like-layout AVOID and target-reliability MUST from the general recommendation.

statement.en: Prefer the system font, text styles, and SF Symbols in widgets.
statement.ja: widgetではsystem font、text style、SF Symbolsを優先する。

exceptions: Use a custom font sparingly, such as for large text, while retaining readable smaller text.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0016.review_note: Preserved Prefer at SHOULD and split symbol alignment and custom-font legibility.

statement.en: Avoid very small widget text.
statement.ja: widgetで非常に小さいtextを避ける。

conditions: In general, use font sizes of 11 points or larger.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0017.review_note: Preserved direct Avoid at AVOID and recorded the general 11-point threshold.

statement.en: Avoid rasterizing widget text.
statement.ja: widget textのrasterizeを避ける。

conditions: Rasterized text doesn't scale like text elements and isn't directly available to VoiceOver.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0018.review_note: Kept the anti-pattern at AVOID and split the explicit Always accessibility requirement.

statement.en: Use color to enhance a widget without competing with its content.
statement.ja: contentと競合しない範囲でcolorによりwidgetを引き立てる。

conditions: Color should not prevent people from absorbing information at a glance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0019.review_note: Recorded glanceability as the limit on decorative color.

statement.en: Convey widget meaning without relying on specific colors.
statement.ja: 特定のcolorに依存せずwidgetの意味を伝える。

conditions: Widgets may become monochromatic, tinted, or color-inverted in supported contexts.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0020.review_note: Preserved the accessibility guidance at SHOULD and split the text-and-icon technique.

statement.en: Use full-color widget images judiciously.
statement.ja: widgetのfull-color imageを慎重に使う。

conditions: Full-color images can draw disproportionate attention in tinted or clear appearances.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0021.review_note: Recorded the appearance mismatch risk and split the optional media-content use.

statement.en: Support light and dark appearances for full-color widgets.
statement.ja: full-color widgetでlightとdark appearanceをsupportする。

conditions: Prefer appearance-appropriate backgrounds and semantic colors or asset variants.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0022.review_note: Kept Support at SHOULD and recorded the documented adaptation techniques.

statement.en: Provide enough contrast for legible vibrant-mode widget content.
statement.ja: vibrant modeのwidget contentに十分なcontrastを設ける。

conditions: Brighter grayscale values create more contrast; darker values create less.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0023.review_note: Preserved Offer at SHOULD rather than elevating the embedded purpose clause.

statement.en: Create assets optimized for the vibrant rendering effect.
statement.ja: vibrant rendering effect向けに最適化したassetを作る。

conditions: Render primary content at full opacity and use grayscale value to establish hierarchy.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0024.review_note: Separated grayscale contrast confirmation and opaque-value technique.

statement.en: Design a realistic widget-gallery preview for each offered experience.
statement.ja: 提供する各experience向けにrealisticなwidget gallery previewを設計する。

conditions: Clearly represent the capability of each widget type or size.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0025.review_note: Recorded informed selection as the preview purpose and split the simulated-data fallback.

statement.en: Design placeholder content that keeps an installed widget recognizable while data loads.
statement.ja: data load中もinstalled widgetを認識できるplaceholder contentを設計する。

conditions: Combine static interface elements with semitransparent stand-ins for dynamic text, glyphs, and images.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0026.review_note: Recorded the loading-state purpose and the documented placeholder composition.

statement.en: Write a succinct description that explains what the widget does.
statement.ja: widgetの機能を説明する簡潔なdescriptionを書く。

conditions: The widget gallery uses the description to help people understand the offering.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0027.review_note: Split action-verb, self-reference, language, and capitalization details into atomic rules.

statement.en: Consider using a brand color for the widget gallery's Add button.
statement.ja: widget galleryのAdd buttonにbrand colorを使うことを検討する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0028.review_note: Preserved Consider as MAY and did not require a custom button color.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0041.title: Use standard widget margins by default

statement.en: Use standard widget margins by default to preserve legibility.
statement.ja: legibilityを保つため標準widget marginをdefaultで使う。

conditions: Use 16 points for most widgets; 11 points can work for tighter graphic, button, or background groupings.
exceptions: Widgets use smaller margins on the Mac desktop and on the Lock Screen, including StandBy.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0041.review_note: Preserved In general at SHOULD and recorded both documented widths and platform exceptions.

statement.en: Include timely content and relevant functionality in a widget.
statement.ja: widgetにtimelyなcontentとrelevantなfunctionalityを含める。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0053.review_note: Recovered the two content-quality criteria as one cohesive rule.

statement.en: Display meaningful content and offer useful actions and deep links in a widget.
statement.ja: widgetでmeaningfulなcontent、usefulなaction、deep linkを提供する。

conditions: Deep links should lead to key areas of the app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0054.review_note: Recovered the concrete content and action techniques behind quick access.

statement.en: Avoid using a widget only to replicate an app icon.
statement.ja: app iconの複製だけを目的とするwidgetを避ける。

conditions: An icon-only replica provides little additional value and may be removed.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0055.review_note: Recovered the low-value app-icon anti-pattern as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Keep widget content fresh enough to invite frequent viewing.
statement.ja: 頻繁な閲覧を促せる程度にwidget contentをfreshに保つ。

conditions: A widget whose content never appears to change may lose prominence.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0056.review_note: Separated perceived freshness from the preference for dynamic information.

statement.en: Avoid expanding a smaller widget's content merely to fill a larger area.
statement.ja: larger areaを埋めるだけのためにsmall widgetのcontentを拡張しない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0057.review_note: Recovered the explicit size-expansion anti-pattern as AVOID.

statement.en: Prefer one widget size that fits the content over supporting every size without added value.
statement.ja: 価値を増やさず全sizeをsupportするよりcontentに合う一つのwidget sizeを優先する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0058.review_note: Recovered the one-size preference without requiring multiple variants.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0059.title: Balance widget information density

statement.en: Balance widget information density to keep the layout useful and glanceable.
statement.ja: layoutをusefulかつglanceableに保てるようwidget information densityを調整する。

conditions: Show essential information at a glance and allow a longer look for details.
If the layout is too dense, consider a larger size or graphics in place of text.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0059.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized Balance lead and recorded both sparse and dense risks.

statement.en: Avoid letting brand elements overpower useful widget information or feel out of place.
statement.ja: brand elementがusefulなwidget informationを圧倒したり場違いに見えたりしないようにする。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0060.review_note: Recovered the direct brand-balance anti-pattern as AVOID.

statement.en: Choose widget update frequency from data-change timing and when people need new data.
statement.ja: dataの変化時期と新しいdataが必要な時期からwidget update frequencyを選ぶ。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0061.review_note: Recovered both documented inputs to the update-frequency decision.

statement.en: Consider showing when widget data was last updated.
statement.ja: widget dataの最終更新時刻を示すことを検討する。

conditions: People are likely to check the widget more frequently than it can update.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0062.review_note: Recovered the conditional disclosure and preserved Consider as MAY.

statement.en: Show widget content quickly without hiding stale data behind placeholders.
statement.ja: stale dataをplaceholderで隠さずwidget contentをすばやく表示する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0063.review_note: Recovered the loading and stale-content behavior as SHOULD.

statement.en: Avoid making people navigate after a widget opens its related app content.
statement.ja: widgetから関連app contentを開いた後にnavigationを要求しない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0064.review_note: Recovered the direct don't clause as AVOID while the opening-location outcome remains MUST.

statement.en: Avoid app-like layouts in widgets.
statement.ja: widgetでapp-likeなlayoutを避ける。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0065.review_note: Recovered direct Avoid guidance without prohibiting multiple appropriate targets.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0066.title: Ensure widget interaction targets support accurate input

statement.en: Ensure widget targets support confident taps and clicks without unintended actions.
statement.ja: widget targetで意図しないactionを起こさず確実にtapまたはclickできるようにする。

conditions: Size each target for the supported touch or pointer input.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0066.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Make sure interaction-reliability requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0067.title: Coordinate content and widget corner radii

statement.en: Coordinate content corner radii with the widget's corner radius.
statement.ja: contentのcorner radiusをwidgetのcorner radiusと調和させる。

conditions: Use a SwiftUI container to apply the correct relative corner shape.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0067.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized Coordinate lead as SHOULD.

statement.en: Use SF Symbols to align and scale symbols with system-font text.
statement.ja: system-font textとsymbolをalignおよびscaleするためSF Symbolsを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0069.title: Ensure custom widget fonts remain glanceably legible

statement.en: When using a custom widget font, ensure it is easy to read at a glance.
statement.ja: custom widget fontを使う場合は一目で読みやすくする。

conditions: Use custom fonts sparingly; they often fit large text better than small text.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0069.review_note: Recovered the conditional Be sure legibility requirement as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0070.title: Use scalable, VoiceOver-readable text elements

statement.en: Always use text elements and styles so widget text scales and VoiceOver can speak it.
statement.ja: widget textがscaleしVoiceOverで読み上げられるよう常にtext elementとstyleを使う。

conditions: In iOS, iPadOS, and visionOS, supported APIs provide Dynamic Type from Large through AX5.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0070.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Always accessibility requirement as MUST.

statement.en: Use text and iconography in addition to color to express widget meaning.
statement.ja: widgetの意味を表すためcolorに加えてtextとiconographyを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0071.review_note: Recovered the concrete non-color cues as an accessibility technique.

statement.en: Consider reserving smaller full-color widget images for media content.
statement.ja: 小さめのfull-color widget imageをmedia content向けに限定することを検討する。

conditions: The widget intentionally preserves image color in a tinted or clear appearance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0072.review_note: Recovered the optional media-content exception and preserved Consider as MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0073.title: Group widget components for accented rendering

statement.en: Group widget components into accented and primary rendering groups.
statement.ja: widget componentをaccentedとprimaryのrendering groupに分ける。

conditions: The system applies platform-specific tints to the two groups.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0073.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized Group lead as SHOULD.

statement.en: Confirm that vibrant-mode image content has sufficient contrast in grayscale.
statement.ja: vibrant modeのimage contentがgrayscaleで十分なcontrastを持つことを確認する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0074.review_note: Recovered the explicit grayscale verification step as SHOULD.

statement.en: Use opaque grayscale values instead of white opacity for the vibrant material effect.
statement.ja: vibrant material effectにはwhite opacityではなくopaque grayscale valueを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0075.review_note: Recovered the implementation technique without turning it into an unsupported MUST.

statement.en: Use realistic simulated data when live widget-preview data loads too slowly.
statement.ja: live widget preview dataのloadが遅すぎる場合はrealisticなsimulated dataを使う。

conditions: Use real data when it can be generated or loaded promptly.

statement.en: Begin a widget description with an action verb.
statement.ja: widget descriptionをaction verbで始める。

statement.en: Use approachable language and sentence-style capitalization in widget descriptions.
statement.ja: widget descriptionでapproachableなlanguageとsentence-style capitalizationを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0078.review_note: Recovered the tone and capitalization convention as one writing rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0079.title: Group widget sizes under one description

statement.en: Group all sizes of a widget together and provide one shared description.
statement.ja: widgetの全sizeをまとめて一つのshared descriptionを提供する。

conditions: Help people understand that sizes are perspectives on the same content and functionality.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0079.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized Group lead and retained both grouping and single-description outcomes.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0080.title: Keep widget data-update animations within two seconds

statement.en: Use widget data-update animations with durations of no more than two seconds.
statement.ja: widget data-update animationのdurationを2秒以内にする。

conditions: The duration applies to standard and custom animations that announce new or changed content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0080.review_note: Recovered the explicit numeric animation limit as SHOULD rather than an unsupported MUST.

statement.en: Avoid phrases in a widget description that refer to the widget itself.
statement.ja: widget descriptionでwidget自体に言及するphraseを避ける。

conditions: Omit framing such as “This widget shows,” “Use this widget to,” or “Add this widget.”
HIG-COMPONENTS-WIDGETS-0081.review_note: Recovered direct Avoid guidance as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0001.title: Avoid app-specific appearance settings

statement.en: Avoid offering an app-specific appearance setting.
statement.ja: app独自のappearance settingを提供しない。

conditions: Respect the systemwide appearance choice so people don't need to adjust multiple settings or mistake the app for being unresponsive.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0001.review_note: Retained direct Avoid guidance as AVOID, not MUST_NOT, and recorded the system-preference rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0002.title: Ensure the app works visually in both appearance modes

statement.en: Ensure the app looks good in both light and dark appearance modes.
statement.ja: appがlightとdarkの両appearance modeで適切に見えるようにする。

conditions: Account for the Auto appearance setting changing modes while the app is running.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0002.review_note: Retained the explicit Ensure-based MUST and recorded the runtime Auto-transition context.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0003.title: Test both appearances with relevant accessibility settings

statement.en: Test content in both appearance modes with relevant accessibility settings.
statement.ja: 関連するaccessibility settingを使ってcontentを両appearance modeでtestする。

conditions: Test Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency separately and together.
The separate split rule preserves the mandatory legibility outcome.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0003.review_note: Narrowed the base rule to the testing action and split the explicit make-sure legibility outcome into a separate MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0004.title: Aim for sufficient contrast in every appearance

statement.en: Aim for sufficient color contrast in every appearance.
statement.ja: すべてのappearanceで十分なcolor contrastを目指す。

conditions: System-defined colors can help maintain foreground-background contrast.
Apply the separate 4.5:1 minimum and 7:1 custom-color target.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0004.review_note: Retained the general Aim guidance as SHOULD and separated both numeric thresholds.

statement.en: Use SF Symbols wherever possible in both appearance modes.
statement.ja: 両appearance modeで可能な限りSF Symbolsを使う。

conditions: Use dynamic tint colors or vibrancy so symbols adapt across appearances.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0005.review_note: Retained the qualified wherever-possible recommendation and recorded its adaptive treatments.

statement.en: Design separate interface icons for light and dark appearances when needed.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はlightとdark appearance向けに別々のinterface iconを設計する。

conditions: Use appearance-specific outlines or borders when an icon edge otherwise loses contrast.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0006.review_note: Retained the conditional recommendation and recorded the contrast-driven threshold for separate assets.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0007.title: Ensure full-color images and icons work in both appearances

statement.en: Ensure full-color images and icons look good in both light and dark appearances.
statement.ja: full-color imageとiconがlightとdarkの両appearanceで適切に見えるようにする。

conditions: Reuse one asset only when it works in both appearances.
Otherwise modify it or provide separate light and dark assets in an asset catalog.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0007.review_note: Retained the explicit Make sure requirement and recorded the single-asset and variant branches.

statement.en: Use system-provided label colors for labels.
statement.ja: labelにはsystem提供のlabel colorを使う。

conditions: Primary, secondary, tertiary, and quaternary label colors adapt automatically across appearances.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0008.review_note: Recorded the adaptive label-color hierarchy and retained SHOULD strength.

statement.en: Use system views to draw text fields and text views.
statement.ja: text fieldとtext viewの描画にはsystem viewを使う。

conditions: System views adapt text for backgrounds and vibrancy.
When possible, prefer a system-provided text view over custom text drawing.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0009.review_note: Recorded the vibrancy behavior and qualified system-view preference.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0013.title: Consider a dark-only interface only in rare cases

statement.en: In rare cases, consider using only a dark appearance in the interface.
statement.ja: まれな場合に限りinterfaceをdark appearanceだけにすることを検討する。

conditions: A permanently dark interface can fit immersive media viewing when it helps the UI recede and keeps focus on media.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0013.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized rare Consider lead without generalizing its immersive-media example.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0014.title: Use colors that adapt to the current appearance

statement.en: Use colors that adapt to the current appearance.
statement.ja: 現在のappearanceへ適応するcolorを使う。

conditions: Prefer semantic system colors that automatically adapt.
Use the separate custom-color rule when a semantic color doesn't fit.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0014.review_note: Activated the Embrace lead as SHOULD and recorded the semantic-color preference.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0015.title: Define appearance variants for custom colors

statement.en: When a custom color is needed, define it in a Color Set and supply bright and dim variants.
statement.ja: custom colorが必要な場合はColor Setで定義しbrightとdim variantを用意する。

conditions: Use an asset-catalog Color Set in Xcode for colors that semantic system colors can't provide.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0015.review_note: Recovered the conditional custom-color implementation guidance without raising it to MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0016.title: Avoid hard-coded and nonadaptive colors

statement.en: Avoid hard-coded color values and colors that don't adapt to the current appearance.
statement.ja: hard-codeされたcolor valueと現在のappearanceへ適応しないcolorを避ける。

conditions: Use semantic colors or appearance-specific Color Set variants instead.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0016.review_note: Recovered the direct Avoid clause and retained AVOID rather than promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0017.title: Maintain at least a 4.5:1 color contrast ratio

statement.en: Ensure the contrast ratio between colors is at least 4.5:1 in every appearance.
statement.ja: すべてのappearanceでcolor間のcontrast ratioを4.5:1以上にする。

conditions: Treat 4.5:1 as the documented minimum; the separate custom-color rule recommends a higher ratio.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0017.review_note: Recovered the at-a-minimum Make sure requirement as MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0018.title: Aim for 7:1 contrast with custom foreground and background colors

statement.en: Aim for a 7:1 contrast ratio between custom foreground and background colors.
statement.ja: custom foreground colorとbackground colorのcontrast ratio 7:1を目指す。

conditions: Apply the higher target especially to small text while preserving the separate 4.5:1 minimum.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0018.review_note: Recovered the higher custom-color target as SHOULD rather than treating it as the minimum.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0019.title: Soften white image backgrounds in Dark Mode

statement.en: Use a slightly darkened treatment for white content-image backgrounds when needed in Dark Mode.
statement.ja: Dark Modeで必要な場合はcontent imageのwhite backgroundを少し暗く処理する。

conditions: Prevent a white image background from appearing to glow against the surrounding dark interface.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0019.review_note: Activated the Soften lead and preserved the image and Dark Mode conditions.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0020.title: Ensure content remains legible in both appearance modes

statement.en: Ensure content remains comfortably legible in both appearance modes under relevant accessibility settings.
statement.ja: 関連するaccessibility settingの下でもcontentを両appearance modeで快適に読める状態にする。

conditions: Test Dark Mode with Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency both separately and together.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0020.review_note: Recorded the split explicit make-sure legibility outcome as an accessibility MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0010.title: Prefer system background colors in iOS and iPadOS Dark Mode

statement.en: Prefer system background colors in iOS and iPadOS Dark Mode.
statement.ja: iOSとiPadOSのDark Modeではsystem background colorを優先する。

conditions: Let the system switch between dimmer base and brighter elevated colors to communicate layered depth, multitasking separation, and window separation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0010.review_note: Recorded the dynamic base-to-elevated behavior and the visual distinctions custom colors can obscure.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0011.title: Use transparency in neutral custom macOS component backgrounds

statement.en: Include transparency in a custom macOS component background when appropriate for desktop tinting.
statement.ja: desktop tintingに適する場合はcustom macOS component backgroundにtransparencyを含める。

conditions: The component has a visible background or bezel and is in a neutral state that doesn't use color.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0011.review_note: Made the visible-background and neutral-state limits explicit and separated the colored-state anti-pattern.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0012.title: Avoid transparency in colored custom macOS component states

statement.en: Avoid transparency in a custom macOS component background when the state uses color.
statement.ja: stateがcolorを使う場合はcustom macOS component backgroundのtransparencyを避ける。

conditions: Desktop tinting could otherwise make the component color fluctuate as the desktop context changes.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-DARK-MODE-0012.review_note: Recovered the colored-state transparency warning as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0004.title: Use standard tvOS interface elements for layered images

statement.en: Use standard tvOS views and system focus APIs to display layered images.
statement.ja: layered imageの表示にはstandard tvOS viewとsystem focus APIを使う。

conditions: Standard views and focus APIs such as FocusState automatically apply parallax when the image receives focus.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0004.review_note: Recorded the standard-view and system-focus mechanism that supplies automatic parallax.

conditions: Higher layers may use varying opacity, but the background layer must remain opaque.
A nonopaque background produces an error and can compromise parallax, drop shadows, and system backgrounds.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0005.review_note: Recorded the higher-layer allowance and the explicit opaque-background requirement and failure mode.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0006.title: Keep tvOS image layering simple and subtle

statement.en: Keep tvOS layered-image depth simple and subtle.
statement.ja: tvOS layered imageのdepthをsimpleかつsubtleに保つ。

conditions: Parallax should be nearly unnoticeable; excessive 3D effects can feel unrealistic or jarring.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0006.review_note: Recorded the intended subtlety and the excessive-depth anti-pattern.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0007.title: Always preview tvOS layered images

statement.en: Always preview tvOS layered images throughout the design process.
statement.ja: tvOS layered imageをdesign process全体で必ずpreviewする。

conditions: Inspect scaling and clipping and readjust essential content as needed.
After finalizing the image, preview it on an actual TV for the most accurate result.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0007.review_note: Preserved the unqualified Always directive and recorded both iterative and final-device previews.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0008.title: Create a layered visionOS app icon

statement.en: Create a visionOS app icon with two or three depth layers.
statement.ja: visionOS app iconを2層または3層のdepth layerで作成する。

conditions: The layers move at subtly different rates when the icon receives focus.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0008.review_note: Recorded the two-to-three-layer structure and subtle focus motion.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0009.title: Prefer vector art for visionOS 2D images

statement.en: Prefer vector-based art for 2D images in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSの2D imageにはvector-based artを優先する。

conditions: People can view visionOS images across a wide range of dynamically scaled sizes and angles.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0009.review_note: Recorded the dynamic scale range and separated the bitmap anti-pattern.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0010.title: Make sure spatial photos render correctly in visionOS

statement.en: Make sure spatial photos render correctly in a visionOS app.
statement.ja: visionOS appでspatial photoが正しくrenderされるようにする。

conditions: Use stereo HEIC and include spatial metadata so visionOS recognizes the photo and applies comfort treatments.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0010.review_note: Preserved the explicit Make sure directive and recorded the stereo-HEIC and spatial-metadata requirements.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0011.title: Prefer feathered glass behind text over spatial photos

statement.en: Prefer a feathered glass background when placing text over a spatial photo.
statement.ja: spatial photo上にtextを置く場合はfeathered glass backgroundを優先する。

conditions: Use the effect to improve text contrast and blur detail that could cause viewing discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0011.review_note: Recorded both the readability and visual-comfort purposes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0012.title: Show spatial photos and scenes in standalone views
