statement.en: Display visionOS spatial photos and spatial scenes in standalone views.
statement.ja: visionOSのspatial photoとspatial sceneをstandalone viewで表示する。

conditions: Use a separate sheet, window, or comparable standalone presentation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0012.review_note: Recorded the standalone presentation and separated inline avoidance and fallback spacing.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0013.title: Use visionOS spatial scenes for specific moments

statement.en: Use spatial scenes in a visionOS app for specific moments.
statement.ja: visionOS appではspatial sceneを特定のmomentに使う。

conditions: A scene can take several seconds to generate; design an explicit or otherwise intentional creation moment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0013.review_note: Recorded the generation delay and intentional-use constraint.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0014.title: Prefer large centered visionOS spatial scenes

statement.en: Prefer larger spatial scenes centered in the viewer’s field of view.
statement.ja: より大きなspatial sceneをviewerのfield of view中央に配置することを優先する。

conditions: Lateral head movement reveals parallax; smaller scenes provide a weaker effect.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0014.review_note: Recorded the centered scale preference and its parallax rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0015.title: Use autoscaling PDFs for watchOS image sizes

statement.en: Use autoscaling PDFs to supply one watchOS image asset for all screen sizes.
statement.ja: すべてのwatchOS screen sizeに1つのimage assetを提供するためautoscaling PDFを使う。

conditions: WatchKit automatically applies the documented per-screen scaling values when it loads the PDF.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0015.review_note: Recorded the single-asset outcome and separated base-asset sizing into its own rule.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0016.title: Organize tvOS layered images by visual depth

statement.en: Identify logical foreground, middle, and background elements in each tvOS layered image.
statement.ja: 各tvOS layered imageでlogicalなforeground、middle、background elementを特定する。

conditions: A layered image uses two to five distinct layers.
Put prominent elements in front, secondary content and shadows in the middle, and an opaque backdrop behind them.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0016.review_note: Recorded the two-to-five-layer definition and each depth role without promoting descriptive prose to MUST.

conditions: Apply when a tvOS image needs to support the system parallax effect.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0018.review_note: Recovered the explicit required-to-support relationship as a platform-scoped MUST.

conditions: Apply to the tvOS app icon, not every other focusable image.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0019.review_note: Recovered the app-icon MUST and kept the optional focusable-image recommendation separate.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0020.title: Use layered images for other focusable tvOS content when practical

statement.en: Use layered images for other focusable tvOS content when practical.
statement.ja: 他のfocusable tvOS contentにも実用的な範囲でlayered imageを使う。

conditions: The recommendation includes Top Shelf images.
exceptions: Layering is optional for focusable images other than the tvOS app icon.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0020.review_note: Preserved the strongly-encouraged recommendation and its explicit optionality.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0021.title: Choose embedded or runtime tvOS layered images

statement.en: Choose either embedded tvOS layered images or images retrieved from a content server at runtime.
statement.ja: tvOS layered imageはembeddedまたはruntimeのcontent server取得から選ぶ。

conditions: Both delivery approaches are supported; runtime retrieval has separate file-format constraints.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0021.review_note: Recorded the two supported delivery options as MAY rather than a recommendation to use both.

conditions: The app retrieves layered images from a content server at runtime.
Generate .lcr files from LSR or Photoshop files with Xcode’s layerutil tool when needed.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0022.review_note: Recovered the conditional runtime-format MUST and recorded the documented generation path.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0023.title: Avoid embedding runtime tvOS layered images

statement.en: Avoid embedding runtime layered images in a tvOS app.
statement.ja: runtime layered imageをtvOS appへembedしない。

conditions: Runtime layered images are intended for download.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0023.review_note: Kept the direct don’t directive at AVOID under the normative policy; it is not an explicit must-not or never prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0024.title: Keep tvOS layered-image text in front

statement.en: Generally keep text in the foreground of a tvOS layered image.
statement.ja: tvOS layered imageのtextは原則としてforegroundに置く。

conditions: Foreground placement preserves clarity.
exceptions: Place text elsewhere only when intentionally obscuring it is appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0024.review_note: Recovered the foreground-text recommendation with its intentional-obscuring exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0025.title: Keep essential tvOS image content inside a safe zone

statement.en: Keep essential content within a safe zone around the foreground layers of a tvOS image.
statement.ja: tvOS imageのessential contentをforeground layer周囲のsafe zone内に保つ。

conditions: Focus scaling and movement can crop content on some layers.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0025.review_note: Recovered the safe-zone rule and recorded focus-driven scaling and cropping.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0026.title: Avoid bitmap art for visionOS 2D images

statement.en: Avoid bitmap art for 2D images in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSの2D imageではbitmap artを避ける。

conditions: Bitmap content may degrade when the system scales it up.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0026.review_note: Separated the bitmap anti-pattern from the positive vector-art preference.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0027.title: Balance visionOS raster quality with performance

statement.en: Balance rasterized visionOS image quality with performance when choosing a resolution.
statement.ja: visionOS raster imageのresolution選択ではqualityとperformanceを両立する。

conditions: A fixed @2x image can look acceptable at common distances but soft at close range.
Higher resolutions increase file size and runtime cost, especially above @6x.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0027.review_note: Recovered the conditional raster fallback and recorded both distance and performance tradeoffs.

conditions: The rasterized visionOS image has a resolution higher than @2x.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0028.review_note: Recovered the conditional Be sure filtering requirement and its exact threshold.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0029.title: Design spatial-photo metadata for visual comfort

statement.en: Account for visual comfort when creating spatial photos from existing 2D content.
statement.ja: 既存2D contentからspatial photoを作る際はvisual comfortを考慮する。

conditions: Disparity and other spatial metadata can change scene perception and cause discomfort from some viewing positions.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0029.review_note: Recovered the visual-comfort rule and recorded the viewing-position and disparity risks.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0030.title: Avoid inline visionOS spatial photos

statement.en: Avoid displaying visionOS spatial photos inline with other content.
statement.ja: visionOS spatial photoを他のcontentとinline表示しない。

conditions: Inline depth changes can cause visual discomfort.
exceptions: Use a standalone sheet or window by default; unavoidable inline stereoscopic images have a separate spacing rule.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0030.review_note: Separated the inline anti-pattern from the standalone recommendation and conditional spacing fallback.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0031.title: Space unavoidable inline stereoscopic images generously

statement.en: Provide generous spacing around a stereoscopic image when it must appear inline.
statement.ja: stereoscopic imageをinline表示せざるを得ない場合は周囲に十分なspacingを設ける。

conditions: Inline stereoscopic presentation is unavoidable; spacing helps people’s eyes adjust to depth changes.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0031.review_note: Preserved the conditional fallback as SHOULD; the source’s if-you-must wording does not make inline display a MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0032.title: Avoid showing too many spatial scenes at once

statement.en: Avoid displaying too many visionOS spatial scenes at once.
statement.ja: visionOS spatial sceneを一度に過剰表示しない。

conditions: Keep the visual information hierarchy simple and account for scene-generation time.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0032.review_note: Recovered the simultaneous-scene anti-pattern and its hierarchy constraint.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0033.title: Move between spatial scenes with explicit navigation

statement.en: Use scroll views, pagination, or explicit actions to move between visionOS spatial scenes.
statement.ja: visionOS spatial scene間の移動にはscroll view、pagination、またはexplicit actionを使う。

conditions: Use an alternative that keeps the visual information hierarchy simple.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0033.review_note: Recovered the three documented navigation alternatives as one choice-set rule.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0034.title: Prefer minimal UI for immersive spatial-image viewing

statement.en: Prefer minimal UI when displaying spatial images immersively in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSでspatial imageをimmersive表示する場合はminimal UIを優先する。

conditions: Keep controls and captions limited to what the immersive viewing task needs.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0034.review_note: Recovered the immersive minimal-UI preference without turning the example layout into a fixed requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0035.title: Design watchOS autoscaling PDF assets at 2x

statement.en: Design watchOS autoscaling PDF images for 40 mm and 42 mm screens at 2x.
statement.ja: watchOS autoscaling PDF imageを40mmおよび42mm screen向けに2xでdesignする。

conditions: WatchKit scales the base asset to 90% at 38 mm, 100% at 40 mm and 42 mm, 106% at 41 mm, 110% at 44 mm, and 119% at 45 mm and 49 mm.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMAGES-0035.review_note: Recovered the base-asset sizing action and preserved every value in the watchOS scaling table.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0001.title: Avoid Liquid Glass in the content layer

statement.en: Avoid using Liquid Glass in the content layer.
statement.ja: content layerでLiquid Glassを使わない。

conditions: Use standard materials for content-layer elements such as app backgrounds.
Reserve Liquid Glass for the distinct controls-and-navigation layer.
exceptions: Transient content-layer controls can adopt Liquid Glass while activated, including sliders and toggles.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0001.review_note: Retained direct Don't guidance as AVOID, not MUST_NOT, and recorded the transient-control exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0002.title: Use custom Liquid Glass effects sparingly

statement.en: Use Liquid Glass effects sparingly, especially on custom controls.
statement.ja: 特にcustom controlではLiquid Glass effectを控えめに使う。

conditions: Standard framework components adopt Liquid Glass automatically.
Limit custom effects to the app's most important functional elements.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0002.review_note: Recorded automatic system-component behavior and the source's functional-importance limit.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0003.title: Choose materials by semantic meaning and intended use

statement.en: Choose materials and effects by semantic meaning and recommended use.
statement.ja: semantic meaningとrecommended useに基づいてmaterialとeffectを選ぶ。

conditions: Match each material or vibrancy style to its specific use case.
Apply the separate apparent-color avoidance rule.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0003.review_note: Recorded semantic selection and split the source's direct Avoid outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0004.title: Use vibrant colors over materials for legibility

statement.en: Use vibrant colors over materials to help preserve legibility.
statement.ja: legibilityを保つためmaterial上でvibrant colorを使う。

conditions: Apply vibrant colors regardless of material thickness.
System-defined vibrant colors adapt across appearance and contrast contexts.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0004.review_note: Retained SHOULD because Help ensure expresses a design recommendation, not an explicit mandatory outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0005.title: Consider contrast and context when choosing material thickness

statement.en: Consider contrast and visual separation when choosing material thickness with blur and vibrancy.
statement.ja: blurとvibrancyを組み合わせるmaterial thicknessではcontrastとvisual separationを検討する。

conditions: Thicker materials can improve contrast for text and fine features.
Thinner materials can preserve context by revealing background content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0005.review_note: Retained the Consider lead as MAY and recorded both documented thickness tradeoffs.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0006.title: Choose vibrancy intentionally in custom macOS controls

statement.en: Choose intentionally when to allow vibrancy in custom macOS views and controls.
statement.ja: custom macOS viewとcontrolでvibrancyを許可する場面を意図的に選ぶ。

conditions: Test varied configurations, backgrounds, and system settings to confirm vibrancy improves appearance and communication.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0006.review_note: Recorded the context-testing requirement and system-setting dependence.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0007.title: Choose a complementary macOS background blending mode

statement.en: Choose a macOS background blending mode that complements the interface design.
statement.ja: interface designを補完するmacOS background blending modeを選ぶ。

conditions: Choose between behind-window and within-window blending according to the intended background relationship.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0007.review_note: Recorded both system blending modes and their selection context.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0008.title: Prefer translucent visionOS windows

statement.en: Prefer translucency to opaque colors in visionOS windows.
statement.ja: visionOS windowではopaque colorよりtranslucencyを優先する。

conditions: Preserve awareness of physical and virtual surroundings and avoid making people feel constricted.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0008.review_note: Recorded the surroundings-awareness and comfort rationale for translucency.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0009.title: Use materials to orient people in watchOS modal views

statement.en: Use materials to provide context and orientation in full-screen watchOS modal views.
statement.ja: full-screen watchOS modal viewでcontextとorientationを示すためmaterialを使う。

conditions: Use layer contrast to distinguish controls and system elements from other content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0009.review_note: Recorded the orientation and element-separation purposes and separated default-background avoidance.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0010.title: Use label vibrancy for standard visionOS text

statement.en: Use UIVibrancyEffectStyle.label for standard text in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSのstandard textにはUIVibrancyEffectStyle.labelを使う。

conditions: Use this highest text-vibrancy level to communicate the primary hierarchy.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0010.review_note: Recorded the standard-text mapping and its hierarchy role.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0011.title: Use secondaryLabel vibrancy for descriptive visionOS text

statement.en: Use UIVibrancyEffectStyle.secondaryLabel for descriptive visionOS text.
statement.ja: visionOSのdescriptive textにはUIVibrancyEffectStyle.secondaryLabelを使う。

conditions: The mapping includes footnotes, subtitles, and comparable secondary text.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0011.review_note: Recorded the descriptive-text mapping and examples.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0012.title: Reserve tertiaryLabel vibrancy for inactive visionOS elements

statement.en: Use UIVibrancyEffectStyle.tertiaryLabel only for inactive visionOS elements that do not need high text legibility.
statement.ja: 高いtext legibilityが不要なinactive visionOS elementに限りUIVibrancyEffectStyle.tertiaryLabelを使う。

conditions: The element is inactive and its text does not require high legibility.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0012.review_note: Preserved both the inactivity and lower-legibility limits.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0013.title: Consider 35% dimming behind clear Liquid Glass over bright content

statement.en: When underlying content is bright, consider a dark dimming layer with 35% opacity.
statement.ja: underlying contentが明るい場合は35% opacityのdark dimming layerを検討する。

conditions: Apply behind components that use clear Liquid Glass.
exceptions: No added layer is needed over sufficiently dark content.
No added layer is needed when AVKit controls provide their own dimming.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0013.review_note: Repaired the truncated candidate and retained the bright-content option plus both no-dimming exceptions.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0014.title: Consider standard iOS and iPadOS content-layer materials

statement.en: Consider a standard iOS or iPadOS material to create distinction in the content layer.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSのcontent layerでvisual distinctionを作るためstandard materialを検討する。

conditions: Choose from ultraThin, thin, regular, or thick; regular is the default standard material.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0014.review_note: Recorded the four supported standard materials as an optional content-layer choice.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0015.title: Use nonquaternary label vibrancy on any iOS or iPadOS material

statement.en: Use label, secondaryLabel, or tertiaryLabel vibrancy on any iOS or iPadOS material when appropriate.
statement.ja: 適切な場合は任意のiOSまたはiPadOS materialでlabel、secondaryLabel、tertiaryLabel vibrancyを使える。

conditions: The default label level provides the highest contrast; lower levels communicate progressively less emphasis.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0015.review_note: Recorded the nonquaternary label styles as supported on every material, not as a requirement to use them.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0016.title: Avoid quaternaryLabel on thin iOS and iPadOS materials

statement.en: Avoid quaternaryLabel vibrancy on thin and ultraThin iOS or iPadOS materials.
statement.ja: thinまたはultraThinのiOS/iPadOS materialではquaternaryLabel vibrancyを避ける。

conditions: The combination provides contrast that is too low.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0016.review_note: Recovered the qualified low-contrast AVOID and its exact material scope.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0017.title: Use fill vibrancy styles on any iOS or iPadOS material

statement.en: Use fill, secondaryFill, or tertiaryFill vibrancy on any iOS or iPadOS material when appropriate.
statement.ja: 適切な場合は任意のiOSまたはiPadOS materialでfill、secondaryFill、tertiaryFill vibrancyを使える。

conditions: All three documented fill vibrancy levels work on every standard material.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0017.review_note: Recorded the fill styles as supported capabilities rather than mandatory choices.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0018.title: Use default separator vibrancy on any iOS or iPadOS material

statement.en: Use the default separator vibrancy on any iOS or iPadOS material when appropriate.
statement.ja: 適切な場合は任意のiOSまたはiPadOS materialでdefault separator vibrancyを使える。

conditions: The system provides one separator vibrancy value that works on every standard material.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0018.review_note: Recorded the single supported separator value without inventing a requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0019.title: Consider tvOS material thickness for view and color context

statement.en: Consider a tvOS standard material whose thickness matches the view and color-scheme context.
statement.ja: viewとcolor-schemeのcontextに合う厚さのtvOS standard materialを検討する。

conditions: Use ultraThin for full-screen light views, thin for partially obscuring light overlays, regular for other partially obscuring overlays, and thick for partially obscuring dark overlays.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0019.review_note: Preserved all four table mappings as examples under the source's consider wording.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0020.title: Choose system materials for custom visionOS components

statement.en: Choose a system material for a custom visionOS component when visual separation or interactivity needs emphasis.
statement.ja: visual separationまたはinteractivityの強調が必要なcustom visionOS componentにはsystem materialを選ぶ。

conditions: Use thin to emphasize interactive elements, regular to separate sections, and thick for a dark element over a regular background.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0020.review_note: Recovered the conditional custom-component choice and all three example material mappings.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0021.title: Avoid replacing default watchOS modal-sheet materials

statement.en: Avoid removing or replacing a watchOS modal sheet’s default material background.
statement.ja: watchOS modal sheetのdefault material backgroundを削除または置換しない。

conditions: The modal sheet receives its material background by default.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0021.review_note: Recovered the default-background AVOID and kept it separate from the positive orientation rule.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0022.title: Use clear Liquid Glass only over visually rich backgrounds

statement.en: Use clear Liquid Glass only for components over visually rich backgrounds.
statement.ja: visually richなbackground上のcomponentに限りclear Liquid Glassを使う。

conditions: Use it for components floating above media such as photos or videos.
Account for Reduce Transparency, Increase Contrast, and preferred Liquid Glass appearance settings.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0022.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized Only lead and retained SHOULD rather than inventing a MUST prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0023.title: Use regular Liquid Glass when legibility needs protection

statement.en: Use regular Liquid Glass when backgrounds threaten legibility or components contain significant text.
statement.ja: backgroundがlegibilityを損なう場合やcomponentに多くのtextがある場合はregular Liquid Glassを使う。

conditions: Regular blurs and adjusts background luminosity.
Examples include alerts, sidebars, and popovers.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0023.review_note: Recovered the regular-variant selection rule and both documented triggers.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0024.title: Determine whether clear Liquid Glass needs a dimming layer

statement.en: Determine whether clear Liquid Glass needs a dimming layer for contrast and legibility.
statement.ja: contrastとlegibilityのためclear Liquid Glassにdimming layerが必要か判断する。

conditions: Use the separate bright-content recommendation and dark-content or AVKit exceptions.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0024.review_note: Recovered the general evaluation step separately from its optional numeric treatment.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0025.title: Use standard materials to structure the content layer

statement.en: Use standard materials and effects to convey structure in the content layer.
statement.ja: content layerのstructureを伝えるためstandard materialとeffectを使う。

conditions: Standard effects include blur, vibrancy, and blending modes beneath Liquid Glass.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0025.review_note: Recovered the unbolded standard-material purpose statement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0026.title: Avoid choosing materials by apparent color

statement.en: Avoid choosing a material or effect by its apparent color.
statement.ja: 見かけのcolorだけでmaterialやeffectを選ばない。

conditions: System settings can change a material's appearance and behavior.
Choose by semantic meaning and intended use instead.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MATERIALS-0026.review_note: Recovered direct Avoid guidance as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0001.title: Keep list-item alignment consistent in RTL contexts

statement.en: Use consistent alignment for every text item in an RTL list.
statement.ja: RTL list内のすべてのtext itemで一貫したalignmentを使う。

conditions: Reverse every list item's alignment, including items displayed in another script.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0001.review_note: Recorded the all-items scope and different-script inclusion.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0002.title: Avoid reversing digits within a specific number

statement.en: Avoid reversing digit order within a specific number.
statement.ja: 特定のnumber内でdigit orderを反転しない。

conditions: Keep phone, credit-card, and other specific numbers in the same digit order across contexts.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0002.review_note: Retained direct Don't guidance as AVOID, not MUST_NOT, and recorded the invariant examples.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0003.title: Preserve controls that express an actual direction

statement.en: Preserve the direction of controls that express an actual direction or onscreen area.
statement.ja: actual directionまたはonscreen areaを表すcontrolの方向を保つ。

conditions: A control meaning “to the right” must point right in every language context.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0003.review_note: Raised the rule to MUST from the supporting must-always directional invariant.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0004.title: Avoid flipping photographs, illustrations, and artwork

statement.en: Avoid flipping photographs, illustrations, and general artwork for RTL contexts.
statement.ja: RTL context向けにphotograph、illustration、general artworkを反転しない。

conditions: Flipping can change meaning or violate image copyright.
Apply the separate alternative-image recommendation when reading direction matters.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0004.review_note: Retained direct Avoid guidance and recorded semantic and legal risks.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0005.title: Consider localized interface icons that display text

statement.en: Consider a localized version of an interface icon that displays actual text.
statement.ja: actual textを表示するinterface iconのlocalized versionを検討する。

conditions: Examples include signature, rich-text, font-size, and I-beam pointer symbols.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0005.review_note: Retained the optional localization branch and its script-related examples.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0006.title: Always display logos in their original form

statement.en: Display every logo in its original form, even when it includes text.
statement.ja: textを含む場合でもlogoを常にoriginal formで表示する。

conditions: A flipped logo can confuse people and create legal repercussions.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0006.review_note: Narrowed the mixed lead to the explicit Always logo requirement and split universal marks separately.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0007.title: Avoid flipping icons that depict real-world objects

statement.en: Generally avoid flipping interface icons that depict familiar real-world objects.
statement.ja: familiarなreal-world objectを表すinterface iconは通常反転しない。

conditions: Keep clocks and right-handed tools unchanged when they do not indicate direction.
exceptions: Flip the object when it communicates directionality.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0007.review_note: Retained the general AVOID and its directionality exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0008.title: Match text alignment to interface direction

statement.en: Match text alignment to interface direction when the system does not do so automatically.
statement.ja: systemが自動調整しない場合はtext alignmentをinterface directionに合わせる。

conditions: Mirror left-aligned LTR content as right-aligned RTL content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0008.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized alignment lead and preserved its system-handled condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0009.title: Align paragraphs by language

statement.en: Align paragraphs by their language rather than the surrounding interface direction.
statement.ja: paragraphをsurrounding interface directionではなくlanguageに合わせて配置する。

conditions: Treat three or more lines as a paragraph.
Align one- or two-line blocks with the current interface direction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0009.review_note: Recovered the language-based paragraph rule and both documented line-count branches.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0010.title: Identify locale-appropriate number representations

statement.en: Identify the appropriate number representation for each supported locale in number-centric content.
statement.ja: number-centric contentでは各supported localeに適切なnumber representationを特定する。

conditions: Apply to mathematical concepts and other number-focused topics.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0010.review_note: Recovered the unbolded locale-specific number guidance.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0011.title: Consider system number representations for non-number-centric content

statement.en: For content that is not number-centric, consider relying on system-provided number representations.
statement.ja: number-centricでないcontentではsystem提供のnumber representation利用を検討する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0011.review_note: Split the system-provided fallback from the number-centric locale requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0012.title: Reverse progress and counting numeral sequences

statement.en: Reverse numeral sequences that show progress, counting direction, or a specific order in RTL contexts.
statement.ja: RTL contextではprogress、counting direction、specific orderを示すnumeral sequenceを反転する。

conditions: Match the sequence to its flipped control or RTL ordering direction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0012.review_note: Split the mixed lead and retained MUST from the supporting Be sure directive.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0013.title: Never mirror numeral glyphs

statement.en: Never mirror numeral glyphs themselves in RTL contexts.
statement.ja: RTL contextでもnumeral glyph自体を決してmirrorしない。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0013.review_note: Split and retained the source's explicit Never prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0014.title: Match progress-control direction to reading direction

statement.en: Match progress-control direction to the reading direction in RTL contexts.
statement.ja: RTL contextではprogress-control directionをreading directionに合わせる。

conditions: Flip sliders and progress indicators so forward progress follows RTL reading direction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0014.review_note: Recovered the control-flipping recommendation separately from its mandatory accompanying-glyph outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0015.title: Reverse progress-control endpoint glyph positions

statement.en: When flipping a progress control, reverse accompanying glyphs or images that represent its endpoint values.
statement.ja: progress controlを反転するときはendpoint valueを表すglyphやimageの位置も反転する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0015.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure requirement as a separate MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0016.title: Flip fixed-order navigation controls in RTL contexts

statement.en: Ensure fixed-order navigation controls flip to match RTL reading order.
statement.ja: fixed-order navigation controlをRTL reading orderに合わせて反転する。

conditions: Point Back rightward and flip Next or Previous controls for ordered lists.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0016.review_note: Recovered MUST from the supporting must and need-to requirements.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0017.title: Visually balance adjacent Latin and RTL scripts

statement.en: Match the visual size of adjacent Latin and RTL scripts when necessary.
statement.ja: 必要な場合は隣接するLatinとRTL scriptのvisual sizeを合わせる。

conditions: For Arabic or Hebrew beside uppercase Latin, consider increasing the RTL font by about 2 points.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0017.review_note: Recovered the visual-balance rule and retained the numeric adjustment as an example.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0018.title: Consider a new image when reading direction affects meaning

statement.en: When image content is strongly connected to reading direction, consider creating a new version instead of flipping it.
statement.ja: image contentがreading directionに強く結び付く場合は反転ではなくnew versionを検討する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0018.review_note: Split the optional replacement branch from the general image-flipping AVOID.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0019.title: Reverse image positions when order is meaningful

statement.en: Preserve meaningful image order by reversing positions in RTL contexts.
statement.ja: RTL contextではimage positionを反転してmeaningful orderを保つ。

conditions: Apply to chronological, alphabetical, favorite, and other meaningful sequences.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0019.review_note: Recovered the positional reversal rule and its ordering examples.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0020.title: Consider specifying custom-symbol directionality

statement.en: Consider specifying directionality for custom symbols used in RTL contexts.
statement.ja: RTL contextで使うcustom symbolのdirectionality指定を検討する。

conditions: SF Symbols supplies RTL variants and localized Arabic and Hebrew symbols.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0020.review_note: Recovered the custom-symbol capability as an optional design branch.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0021.title: Adapt text-direction icons to RTL

statement.en: Adapt interface icons that represent text or reading direction to the RTL context.
statement.ja: textまたはreading directionを表すinterface iconをRTL contextに合わせる。

conditions: Right-align bars that represent text in RTL versions.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0021.review_note: Recovered the text-direction icon adaptation rule.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0022.title: Consider text-free alternatives for nonreading icon concepts

statement.en: For custom icon text unrelated to reading or writing, consider a text-free alternative.
statement.ja: readingやwritingと無関係なcustom icon textにはtext-free alternativeを検討する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0023.title: Flip forward and backward motion icons in RTL contexts

statement.en: Ensure icons that show forward or backward motion flip in RTL contexts.
statement.ja: forwardまたはbackward motionを示すiconをRTL contextで反転する。

conditions: Preserve motion meaning, including the direction of speaker sound waves.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0023.review_note: Recovered MUST from the supporting needs-to-flip requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0024.title: Avoid flipping universal signs and marks

statement.en: Avoid flipping universal signs and marks in RTL contexts.
statement.ja: RTL contextでもuniversal signやmarkを反転しない。

conditions: People expect symbols such as checkmarks to keep a consistent appearance.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0024.review_note: Split universal marks from the logo MUST and retained direct Avoid strength.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0025.title: Consider components and balance before flipping a complex icon

statement.en: Consider individual components and overall visual balance before flipping a complex custom interface icon.
statement.ja: complex custom interface iconを反転する前にindividual componentとoverall visual balanceを検討する。

conditions: Evaluate badges, slashes, magnifying glasses, and other independently meaningful components.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0025.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized contextual Consider guidance.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0026.title: Preserve localization-independent icon-component language

statement.en: Ensure localization-independent icon components preserve their visual design language.
statement.ja: localization-independentなicon componentのvisual design languageを保つ。

conditions: Preserve components such as a negation backslash when the design language requires consistency.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0026.review_note: Recovered the conditional needs-to-adhere requirement as MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0027.title: Flip UI-representing icon badges with the interface

statement.en: Ensure an icon badge that represents actual UI flips when the represented interface flips.
statement.ja: actual UIを表すicon badgeをrepresented interfaceとともに反転する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0027.review_note: Recovered the conditional needs-to-flip UI representation requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0028.title: Consider meaning and balance before flipping a modifying badge

statement.en: Consider whether flipping a meaning-modifying badge preserves both meaning and icon balance.
statement.ja: meaning-modifying badgeの反転がmeaningとicon balanceの両方を保つか検討する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0028.review_note: Split the optional meaning-modifying badge decision from the mandatory UI-representation case.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-RIGHT-TO-LEFT-0029.title: Consider preserving handed-tool orientation inside a flipped icon

statement.en: Consider preserving a handed tool's orientation while flipping its icon base when necessary.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はicon baseを反転しつつhanded toolのorientation維持を検討する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0001.title: Verify rendering-mode legibility in every context

statement.en: Confirm that each symbol's rendering mode remains legible in every context.
statement.ja: 各symbolのrendering modeがすべてのcontextでlegibleか確認する。

conditions: Check symbol size and contrast against the current background.
Review automatic preferred-mode results and choose a different mode when it improves legibility.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0001.review_note: Replaced the generic generated statement with the documented legibility test and automatic-mode fallback.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0002.title: Use variable color to communicate change

statement.en: Use variable color to communicate a characteristic that changes over time.
statement.ja: 時間とともに変化するcharacteristicを伝えるためにvariable colorを使う。

conditions: Map symbol layers to thresholds between zero and 100 percent for values such as capacity or strength.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0002.review_note: Narrowed the original mixed lead to its positive change-communication recommendation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0003.title: Apply symbol animations judiciously

statement.en: Use symbol animations judiciously.
statement.ja: symbol animationを慎重に使う。

conditions: Avoid adding so many animations that the interface becomes overwhelming or distracting.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0003.review_note: Replaced the duplicated generated wording and recorded the documented overload risk.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0004.title: Ensure symbol animations communicate a clear purpose

statement.en: Ensure every symbol animation serves a clear purpose in communicating the symbol's intent.
statement.ja: 各symbol animationがsymbolのintentを伝える明確なpurposeを果たすようにする。

conditions: Evaluate how people may interpret each movement and whether one or more combined animations could be confusing.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0004.review_note: Retained the explicit Make sure directive as MUST and fixed the duplicated generated statement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0005.title: Use symbol animations to communicate efficiently

statement.en: Use symbol animations to communicate information efficiently.
statement.ja: 情報を効率よく伝えるためにsymbol animationを使う。

conditions: Use animation for visual feedback or to present complex information in limited space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0005.review_note: Recorded the feedback and compact-information purposes from the supporting prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0006.title: Consider app tone when adding symbol animations

statement.en: Consider how a symbol animation aligns with the app's brand, style, and tone.
statement.ja: symbol animationがappのbrand、style、toneに合うか検討する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0006.review_note: Retained the optional tone evaluation and its branding context.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0007.title: Use an SF Symbols template as a design guide

statement.en: Use an SF Symbols template to guide a custom symbol's design.
statement.ja: custom symbolのdesign guideとしてSF Symbols templateを使う。

conditions: Match system symbols in detail, optical weight, alignment, position, and perspective.
Keep the symbol simple, recognizable, inclusive, and directly related to its action or content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0007.review_note: Expanded the generic template lead with the complete documented consistency and design-quality criteria.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0008.title: Optimize custom-symbol layers for animation

statement.en: Optimize custom-symbol layers for the animations the symbol supports.
statement.ja: custom symbolのlayerを対応するanimation向けに最適化する。

conditions: Use Z-order to control front-to-back or back-to-front variable-color animation.
Group related layers when they need to move together.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0008.review_note: Recorded the Z-order and layer-group choices while separating the mandatory annotation prerequisite.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0009.title: Test all animation presets with custom symbols

statement.en: Test each custom symbol with all animation presets.
statement.ja: 各custom symbolをすべてのanimation presetでtestする。

conditions: Verify that shapes, paths, and layers appear as intended while moving.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0009.review_note: Restored the all-presets scope and the documented motion-rendering risk.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0010.title: Avoid building common variants into custom symbols

statement.en: Avoid building common enclosures or badges directly into custom symbols.
statement.ja: common enclosureやbadgeをcustom symbolへ直接組み込まない。

conditions: Use the SF Symbols component library to create common variants consistently.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0010.review_note: Retained direct Avoid strength and recorded the component-library alternative.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0011.title: Provide alternative text labels for custom symbols

statement.en: Provide alternative text labels for custom symbols.
statement.ja: custom symbolにalternative text labelを用意する。

conditions: Supply an accessibility description that lets VoiceOver describe the visible symbol.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0011.review_note: Retained the unqualified accessibility recommendation at SHOULD without inventing stronger source language.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0012.title: Do not reproduce Apple products as custom symbols

statement.en: Do not reproduce Apple products in custom symbols.
statement.ja: Apple productをcustom symbolとして複製しない。

conditions: Apple products are copyrighted.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0012.review_note: Raised the direct Don't lead to MUST_NOT because the supporting legal statement explicitly says the copyrighted products can't be reproduced.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0013.title: Use the outline variant alongside text

statement.en: Use the outline variant when displaying a symbol alongside text.
statement.ja: symbolをtextと並べて表示するときはoutline variantを使う。

conditions: Typical contexts include toolbars and lists.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0014.title: Consider an enclosing variant at small sizes

statement.en: At small sizes, consider an enclosing shape to improve symbol legibility.
statement.ja: 小さいsizeではsymbolのlegibility向上にenclosing shapeを検討する。

conditions: Use an enclosure such as a square or circle when it improves recognition.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0014.review_note: Activated the small-size legibility option without overstating it as a requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0015.title: Use a fill variant for emphasis or selection

statement.en: Use a fill variant when a symbol needs visual emphasis or communicates selection.
statement.ja: symbolにvisual emphasisが必要な場合やselectionを伝える場合はfill variantを使う。

conditions: Typical contexts include iOS tab bars, swipe actions, and accent-color selection.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0015.review_note: Recovered the complete fill-variant recommendation from the previously truncated candidate.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0016.title: Consider negative side margins for optical alignment

statement.en: Consider negative side margins when a custom symbol needs optical horizontal alignment.
statement.ja: custom symbolにoptical horizontal alignmentが必要な場合はnegative side marginを検討する。

conditions: Apply when a badge or another element increases the symbol's width.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0016.review_note: Activated the conditional margin option and its badge-width context.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0017.title: Confirm SF Symbols availability for target systems

statement.en: Confirm that each symbol and symbol feature is available on every targeted system version.
statement.ja: 各symbolとsymbol featureがすべてのtarget system versionで利用可能か確認する。

conditions: A symbol or feature introduced in a later year isn't available on earlier operating systems.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0017.review_note: Recovered the overview's target-version availability constraint.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0018.title: Understand the SF Symbols terms and conditions

statement.en: Understand the SF Symbols terms and conditions before using the symbols.
statement.ja: symbolを使う前にSF Symbolsのterms and conditionsを理解する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0018.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure directive from the overview.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0019.title: Do not use SF Symbols for trademarked purposes

statement.en: Do not use SF Symbols or confusingly similar images in app icons, logos, or other trademarked uses.
statement.ja: SF Symbolsまたは紛らわしく類似したimageをapp icon、logo、その他のtrademarked useに使わない。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0019.review_note: Split and retained the overview's explicit usage prohibition as MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0020.title: Use system colors for adaptive symbol appearances

statement.en: Use system-provided colors when symbols need adaptive appearances.
statement.ja: symbolにadaptive appearanceが必要な場合はsystem提供colorを使う。

conditions: System colors adapt to accessibility accommodations, vibrancy, and Dark Mode.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0020.review_note: Recovered the adaptive-color recommendation and its accessibility and appearance benefits.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0021.title: Prefer gradients at larger symbol sizes

statement.en: Prefer gradient rendering at larger symbol sizes.
statement.ja: 大きなsymbol sizeではgradient renderingを優先する。

conditions: Gradient rendering works at any size and across rendering modes, system and custom colors, and custom symbols.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0021.review_note: Recovered the size-quality recommendation while preserving the any-size support exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0022.title: Avoid variable color for depth

statement.en: Avoid using variable color to communicate depth.
statement.ja: depthを伝えるためにvariable colorを使わない。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0022.review_note: Split the direct Don't branch and kept it at AVOID rather than promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0023.title: Use Hierarchical rendering mode for depth

statement.en: Use Hierarchical rendering mode to communicate depth and visual hierarchy.
statement.ja: depthとvisual hierarchyを伝えるためにHierarchical rendering modeを使う。

conditions: Use opacity differences to elevate layers and distinguish foreground from background.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0023.review_note: Split the documented positive alternative from the variable-color AVOID.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0024.title: Match symbol weight to adjacent San Francisco text

statement.en: Match a symbol's weight to adjacent San Francisco text.
statement.ja: symbolのweightを隣接するSan Francisco textに合わせる。

conditions: Choose among the nine symbol weights that correspond to system-font weights.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0024.review_note: Recovered the weight-matching relationship from the unbolded section prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0025.title: Consider symbol scale when adjusting emphasis

statement.en: Consider changing symbol scale to adjust emphasis beside text.
statement.ja: text横のemphasisを調整するためにsymbol scaleの変更を検討する。

conditions: Preserve weight matching with text at the same point size.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0025.review_note: Recovered the optional scale-based emphasis adjustment.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0026.title: Use design variants to communicate states and actions

statement.en: Use symbol design variants to communicate precise states and actions.
statement.ja: preciseなstateやactionを伝えるためにsymbol design variantを使う。

conditions: A slash can show unavailability, and a fill can show selection.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0026.review_note: Recovered the section-level variant-selection recommendation and examples.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0027.title: Consider letting the containing view choose a variant

statement.en: Consider letting the containing view choose between outline and fill variants.
statement.ja: outlineとfill variantの選択をcontaining viewに任せることを検討する。

conditions: An iOS tab bar prefers fill, whereas a toolbar uses outline.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0027.review_note: Recovered the optional view-determined default behavior.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0028.title: Create custom symbols from a similar exported template

statement.en: Create a custom symbol by modifying an exported template for a similar SF Symbol.
statement.ja: 類似するSF Symbolのexported templateを編集してcustom symbolを作成する。

conditions: Use a vector-editing tool to modify the exported template.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0028.review_note: Recovered the documented custom-symbol starting workflow.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0029.title: Do not customize SF Symbols that depict Apple products

statement.en: Do not customize an SF Symbol that depicts an Apple product or feature.
statement.ja: Apple productまたはfeatureを表すSF Symbolをcustomizeしない。

conditions: The SF Symbols app identifies noncustomizable symbols with an Info badge and describes restrictions in the inspector.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0029.review_note: Recovered the explicit can't-customize restriction from the copyright callout.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0030.title: Use the naming pattern for custom-symbol margins

statement.en: When adding negative side margins to a custom symbol, use the documented configuration naming pattern.
statement.ja: custom symbolへnegative side marginを追加するときはdocumented configuration naming patternを使う。

conditions: Include the relevant configuration in names such as left-margin-Regular-M.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0030.review_note: Recovered the conditional be-sure requirement from the supporting margin prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0031.title: Annotate custom-symbol layers before by-layer animation

statement.en: Before animating a custom symbol by layer, annotate its layers in the SF Symbols app.
statement.ja: custom symbolをlayer単位でanimateする前にSF Symbols appでlayerをannotateする。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0031.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure requirement from the supporting animation prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0032.title: Consider whole shapes for animated custom symbols

statement.en: Consider drawing animated custom symbols with whole shapes.
statement.ja: animated custom symbolをwhole shapeで描くことを検討する。

conditions: Use an erase layer for overlaps when preserving full shape and layer information improves animation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SF-SYMBOLS-0032.review_note: Split the optional whole-shape technique from the custom-symbol animation test.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0001.title: Use readable platform font sizes

statement.en: Use readable font sizes at or above the documented platform defaults and minimums.
statement.ja: documented platformのdefaultおよびminimum以上の読みやすいfont sizeを使う。

conditions: Use default/minimum sizes of 17/11 pt on iOS and iPadOS, 13/10 pt on macOS, and 29/23 pt on tvOS.
Use default/minimum sizes of 17/12 pt on visionOS and 16/12 pt on watchOS.
When a custom font has a thin weight, aim above the recommended sizes.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0001.review_note: Replaced the generic statement with the cross-platform defaults and minimums from the reviewed numeric table.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0002.title: Test text legibility in context

statement.en: Test text legibility on every target platform and in each viewing context.
statement.ja: 各target platformとviewing contextでtextのlegibilityをtestする。

conditions: If text is difficult to read, use a larger size, stronger contrast, a more legible typeface, or the system font.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0002.review_note: Recorded the platform-and-context test plus the documented size, contrast, and typeface remedies.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0003.title: Minimize the number of typefaces

statement.en: Minimize the number of typefaces, including in highly customized interfaces.
statement.ja: 高度にcustomizeしたinterfaceでもtypeface数を最小限にする。

conditions: Too many typefaces can obscure hierarchy, reduce readability, and weaken consistency.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0003.review_note: Retained the unqualified recommendation and its hierarchy, readability, and consistency rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0004.title: Prioritize important content as text size changes

statement.en: Prioritize important content when text size changes.
statement.ja: text sizeが変わるときは重要なcontentを優先する。

conditions: Avoid enlarging every item equally when doing so lets secondary content overpower primary content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0004.review_note: Preserved the content-priority recommendation without requiring equal scaling of secondary elements.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0005.title: Consider built-in text styles

statement.en: Consider built-in text styles for hierarchy and accessibility behavior.
statement.ja: hierarchyとaccessibility behaviorのためにbuilt-in text styleを検討する。

conditions: Built-in styles support visual hierarchy and platform Dynamic Type behavior where available.
Use the reviewed platform specification tables when selecting a style.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0005.review_note: Retained Consider at MAY and linked the option to the reviewed platform style tables.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0006.title: Ensure custom-font legibility

statement.en: Make sure custom fonts remain legible at their intended styles, weights, and sizes.
statement.ja: custom fontが意図したstyle、weight、sizeでlegibleに保たれるようにする。

conditions: Use the documented platform minimum sizes as a baseline for each custom style and weight.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0006.review_note: Confirmed the explicit Make sure outcome as MUST and tied it to the reviewed minimum-size table.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0007.title: Ensure layouts adapt to every Dynamic Type size

statement.en: Make sure the layout adapts to every supported Dynamic Type size.
statement.ja: layoutがすべてのsupported Dynamic Type sizeへ適応するようにする。

conditions: Verify text and glyph legibility at every size.
On iPhone and iPad, test with Larger Accessibility Text enabled.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0007.review_note: Confirmed the explicit Make sure outcome as MUST and removed macOS, which does not support Dynamic Type.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0008.title: Minimize truncation as font size increases

statement.en: Keep text truncation to a minimum as font size increases.
statement.ja: font sizeが大きくなるときもtext truncationを最小限にする。

conditions: Aim to show as much useful text at the largest accessibility size as at the largest standard size.
Allow labels to use as many lines as needed for useful content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0008.review_note: Retained the recommendation and separated the scrollable-region AVOID into its own atomic rule.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0009.title: Consider layout changes at large font sizes

statement.en: At large font sizes, consider stacking content or reducing columns.
statement.ja: 大きなfont sizeではcontentのstack化やcolumn削減を検討する。

conditions: Adjust when side-by-side content or multiple columns would overlap, truncate, or become difficult to scan.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0009.review_note: Retained the optional large-size layout adaptation and its overlap and truncation triggers.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0010.title: Maintain hierarchy at every font size

statement.en: Maintain a consistent information hierarchy at every font size.
statement.ja: すべてのfont sizeで一貫したinformation hierarchyを保つ。

conditions: Keep primary content near the top and preserve distinctions among multiple information levels.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0010.review_note: Recorded the top-position and multilevel hierarchy requirements within the Dynamic Type platform scope.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0013.title: Adjust tracking in interface mockups when necessary

statement.en: Adjust tracking in variable-system-font interface mockups when necessary.
statement.ja: variable system fontを使うinterface mockupでは必要に応じてtrackingを調整する。

conditions: Running apps adjust system-font tracking dynamically at every point size.
Use the reviewed tracking tables for the target platform, typeface, and point size.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0013.review_note: Rebound stable ID 0013 from the false-positive Tracking values heading to the actual mockup-tracking guidance.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0014.title: Avoid light font weights

statement.en: Avoid light font weights, especially at small text sizes.
statement.ja: 特に小さなtext sizeではlight font weightを避ける。

conditions: Prefer Regular, Medium, Semibold, or Bold over Ultralight, Thin, or Light.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0014.review_note: Retained direct Avoid at AVOID and recorded the recommended weight alternatives.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0023.title: Use type attributes to convey hierarchy

statement.en: Use font weight, size, and color to convey information hierarchy.
statement.ja: information hierarchyを伝えるためにfont weight、size、colorを使う。

conditions: Emphasize important information and help people distinguish levels.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0023.review_note: Activated the hierarchy technique as SHOULD and separated the explicit size-change outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0024.title: Modify built-in text styles when necessary

statement.en: Modify built-in text styles with symbolic traits when necessary.
statement.ja: 必要に応じてsymbolic traitでbuilt-in text styleを変更する。

conditions: Use weight traits for hierarchy and leading traits for readability or space.
Loose leading can help wide columns or long passages; tight leading can help height-constrained multiline areas.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0024.review_note: Activated the conditional style-modification recommendation and separated the three-line tight-leading AVOID.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0025.title: Support accessibility with custom fonts

statement.en: Support accessibility features when using custom fonts.
statement.ja: custom fontを使う場合はaccessibility featureをsupportする。

conditions: The exact Dynamic Type and Bold Text outcome is a separate mandatory rule.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0025.review_note: Activated the broad accessibility recommendation while preserving the supporting Make sure outcome separately.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0026.title: Scale meaningful icons with font size

statement.en: Increase meaningful interface-icon sizes as the font size increases.
statement.ja: font sizeが大きくなるにつれてmeaningful interface iconも大きくする。

conditions: SF Symbols scale automatically with Dynamic Type.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0026.review_note: Activated the scaling recommendation and separated the explicit larger-size visibility outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0027.title: Ensure hierarchy is preserved when text sizes change

statement.en: Maintain relative hierarchy and visual distinction when people adjust text sizes.
statement.ja: 人がtext sizeを調整してもrelative hierarchyとvisual distinctionを維持する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0027.review_note: Recovered and retained the explicit Be sure outcome as MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0028.title: Avoid tight leading for three or more lines

statement.en: Avoid tight leading when displaying three or more lines of text.
statement.ja: 3行以上のtextを表示するときはtight leadingを避ける。

conditions: Apply even when vertical space is limited.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0028.review_note: Recovered the conditional direct Avoid without elevating it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0029.title: Avoid embedding system fonts

statement.en: Avoid embedding system fonts in an app or game.
statement.ja: appやgameへsystem fontをembedすることを避ける。

conditions: Access system fonts through Font.Design constants.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0029.review_note: Recovered the direct Don't guidance at AVOID because the source provides no stronger prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0030.title: Ensure custom fonts match accessibility behavior

statement.en: On supported platforms, make custom fonts match Dynamic Type and Bold Text behavior.
statement.ja: supported platformではcustom fontをDynamic TypeとBold Textのbehaviorに合わせる。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0030.review_note: Recovered the supporting Make sure sentence as an explicit platform-scoped MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0031.title: Ensure a Unity text-size fallback

statement.en: When the Unity plug-in is inappropriate, provide another text-size control.
statement.ja: Unity plug-inが適切でない場合は別のtext-size controlを用意する。

conditions: The Unity-based game cannot appropriately use Apple's Dynamic Type plug-in.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0031.review_note: Recovered the conditional Be sure fallback as a separate MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0032.title: Ensure meaningful icons remain visible at larger sizes

statement.en: Make sure meaningful interface icons remain easy to view at larger font sizes.
statement.ja: meaningful interface iconが大きなfont sizeでも見やすく保たれるようにする。

conditions: The icon communicates important information.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0032.review_note: Recovered the supporting Make sure visibility outcome as a separate MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0033.title: Avoid incomplete truncation in scrollable regions

statement.en: Avoid truncating scrollable text unless people can open a complete view.
statement.ja: complete viewを開けない場合はscrollable textのtruncationを避ける。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0033.review_note: Split the conditional direct Avoid from the general truncation-minimization recommendation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0011.title: Make sure scalable visionOS text remains legible

statement.en: Make sure visionOS text looks good and remains legible at every supported scale.
statement.ja: visionOS textがすべての対応scaleで適切に見え、legibleに保たれるようにする。

conditions: Choose a text style that looks good at full scale, then test legibility at different scales.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0011.review_note: Preserved the Make sure requirement, recorded the full-scale baseline and multi-scale test, and removed a false gaze modality inferred from ordinary wording.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0012.title: Keep spatial visionOS text facing people

statement.en: Keep spatial visionOS text facing people as much as possible.
statement.ja: spatialなvisionOS textを可能な限り人の方向へ向け続ける。

conditions: For text associated with a point in space, use billboarding so it faces the wearer as either they or the object moves.
Rotate around the y-axis so the text baseline remains perpendicular to the person’s line of sight.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0012.review_note: Recorded the billboarding behavior, rotation axis, and line-of-sight geometry.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0015.title: Consider bold for backgroundless visionOS text

statement.en: Consider bold weight to improve the legibility of visionOS text that has no background.
statement.ja: backgroundのないvisionOS textのlegibility向上にはbold weightを検討する。

conditions: The text appears without a background surface.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0015.review_note: Preserved the conditional consider wording and separated the shadow anti-pattern.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0016.title: Design macOS text without Dynamic Type reliance

statement.en: Design macOS text and layout without relying on Dynamic Type support.
statement.ja: Dynamic Type supportに依存せずmacOSのtextとlayoutを設計する。

conditions: macOS does not support Dynamic Type.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0016.review_note: Recorded the platform limitation as a design constraint at SHOULD, not as an unsupported prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0017.title: Match macOS standard-control text with dynamic font variants

statement.en: Use a dynamic macOS system font variant when text needs to match a standard control.
statement.ja: textをstandard macOS controlに合わせる必要がある場合はdynamic system font variantを使う。

conditions: Map control content, labels, menus, menu bars, messages, palettes, titles, and tool tips to their matching system font APIs.
Use userFont for document text, userFixedPitchFont for monospaced document text, and the bold or standard system font APIs as appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0017.review_note: Recovered the conditional dynamic-variant rule and preserved the complete mapping table as structured conditions.

conditions: The visionOS app uses NY instead of relying only on SF Pro styles.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0018.review_note: Recovered the conditional You need to specify requirement for NY type styles.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0019.title: Prefer 2D text in visionOS

statement.en: Prefer visionOS text with little or no visual depth when people need to read and understand it.
statement.ja: 人が読んで理解するvisionOS textにはvisual depthがほぼない2D表現を優先する。

conditions: Greater character depth can make text harder to read.
exceptions: A small amount of 3D text can be an attention-drawing decorative element.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0019.review_note: Recovered the 2D preference and preserved the limited decorative 3D exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0020.title: Maximize visionOS text contrast against its container

statement.en: Maximize contrast between visionOS text and its container background.
statement.ja: visionOS textとcontainer backgroundのcontrastを最大化する。

conditions: The system defaults to white text because it contrasts strongly with the default background material.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0020.review_note: Recovered the contrast directive and recorded the system-white rationale without making white mandatory.

conditions: The design replaces the default white visionOS text color.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0021.review_note: Recovered the conditional Be sure to test requirement without making white text itself mandatory.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0022.title: Avoid shadows on backgroundless visionOS text

statement.en: Avoid adding shadows to backgroundless visionOS text solely to increase contrast.
statement.ja: contrast向上だけを目的にbackgroundのないvisionOS textへshadowを加えない。

conditions: The current space may lack a surface for an accurate shadow, and its Environment makes reliable size and density unpredictable.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-TYPOGRAPHY-0022.review_note: Recovered the qualified shadow AVOID and its spatial-environment rationale.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IOS-00.title: Focus iOS interfaces on primary tasks and content

statement.en: Help people focus on primary iOS tasks and content by limiting onscreen controls.
statement.ja: onscreen controlを絞り、iOSのprimary taskとcontentへ集中できるようにする。

conditions: Keep secondary details and actions discoverable with minimal interaction.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IOS-00.review_note: Repaired the truncated extraction and preserved both control restraint and secondary-action discoverability.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IOS-00.title: Adapt iOS interfaces to appearance changes

statement.en: Adapt iOS interfaces seamlessly to orientation, Dark Mode, and Dynamic Type changes.
statement.ja: iOS interfaceをorientation、Dark Mode、Dynamic Typeの変化へseamlessに適応させる。

conditions: Let people choose the configurations that work best for them.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IOS-00.review_note: Recovered the complete appearance-adaptation rule and all three documented change types.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IOS-00.title: Support comfortable iPhone holding patterns

statement.en: Support iOS interactions that accommodate how people usually hold iPhone.
statement.ja: iPhoneの一般的な持ち方に合うiOS interactionをsupportする。

conditions: Place frequently reached controls near the middle or bottom of the display when appropriate.
Provide comfortable swipe access for back navigation and list-row actions.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IOS-00.review_note: Recovered the ergonomic rule and recorded both reachability and swipe examples without making their positions universal.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IOS-00.title: Integrate permissioned iOS platform information

statement.en: With people’s permission, integrate iOS platform information to enhance the experience without requiring manual data entry.
statement.ja: 人のpermissionを得てiOS platform情報を統合し、manual data entryなしで体験を向上させる。

conditions: Request and use information only with explicit permission.
Examples include payments, biometric authentication, and location-based features.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IOS-00.review_note: Recovered the permission-gated integration rule and raised its conflict priority to privacy and explicit intent.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IPADOS.title: Size iPadOS content for viewing distance and input mode

statement.en: Use viewing distance and input mode to determine iPadOS content size and density.
statement.ja: viewing distanceとinput modeに基づいてiPadOS contentのsizeとdensityを決める。

conditions: Evaluate both the expected viewing distance and the active input mode.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IPADOS.review_note: Repaired the truncated extraction and preserved both documented sizing inputs.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IPADOS.title: Support standard iPad input methods

statement.en: Let people use Multi-Touch gestures, a physical keyboard or trackpad, or Apple Pencil.
statement.ja: Multi-Touch gesture、physical keyboard、trackpad、Apple Pencilを利用できるようにする。

conditions: Support the input methods that apply to the experience instead of assuming touch alone.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IPADOS.review_note: Repaired the truncated extraction and separated standard input support from optional combined interactions.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IPADOS.title: Use the large iPad display for important content

statement.en: Use iPad’s large display to elevate important content and reduce modal interfaces and full-screen transitions.
statement.ja: iPadのlarge displayでimportant contentを高め、modal interfaceとfull-screen transitionを減らす。

conditions: Position onscreen controls where they are easy to reach without obstructing content.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IPADOS.review_note: Repaired the truncated extraction and preserved content prominence, transition restraint, reachability, and nonobstruction.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IPADOS.title: Adapt iPadOS interfaces across configurations

statement.en: Adapt iPadOS interfaces across orientation, multitasking modes, Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, and macOS transitions.
statement.ja: iPadOS interfaceをorientation、multitasking mode、Dark Mode、Dynamic Type、macOS transitionへ適応させる。

conditions: Let people choose the configurations that work best for them.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IPADOS.review_note: Recovered the omitted adaptation rule and preserved every documented configuration and transition context.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IPADOS.title: Consider combining iPad input modes

statement.en: Consider unique iPad interactions that combine multiple input modes.
statement.ja: 複数のinput modeを組み合わせる独自のiPad interactionを検討する。

conditions: Treat combined input as an opportunity, not a requirement for simultaneous input.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-IPADOS.review_note: Split the source's conditional consider clause from its stronger standard-input guidance.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.title: Support flexible macOS window management

statement.en: Let people resize, hide, show, and move macOS windows for their work style and device configuration.
statement.ja: work styleとdevice configurationに合わせてmacOS windowをresize、hide、show、moveできるようにする。

conditions: Apply window flexibility across the work styles and device configurations the app supports.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.review_note: Repaired the truncated extraction and separated window-management flexibility from full-screen support.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.title: Expose app commands in the macOS menu bar

statement.en: Use the macOS menu bar to give people easy access to every app command they need.
statement.ja: 必要なすべてのapp commandへ容易にアクセスできるようmacOS menu barを使う。

conditions: Include commands people need to perform app tasks.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.review_note: Repaired the truncated extraction and preserved the complete app-command access scope.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.title: Support high-precision macOS input

statement.en: Help people use high-precision macOS input for pixel-perfect selections and edits.
statement.ja: pixel-perfectなselectionとeditにhigh-precision macOS inputを使えるよう支援する。

conditions: Support selections and edits that benefit from pixel-level control.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.review_note: Replaced the generic paraphrase and recorded the high-precision pointer-input modality.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.title: Support macOS personalization

statement.en: Support personalization of macOS toolbars, window views, interface colors, and fonts.
statement.ja: macOS toolbar、window view、interface color、fontのpersonalizationをsupportする。

conditions: Let people configure the views they use most and choose the colors and fonts they want.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.review_note: Repaired the truncated extraction and preserved every documented personalization area.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.title: Use large macOS displays without excessive density

statement.en: Use large macOS displays to present more content with fewer nested levels and less modality.
statement.ja: large macOS displayでより多くのcontentを少ないnesting levelとmodalityで提示する。

conditions: Maintain a comfortable information density that does not make people strain to view content.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.review_note: Recovered the omitted large-display rule and preserved its density and viewing-comfort constraint.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.title: Support distraction-free macOS full-screen mode

statement.en: Support full-screen mode to provide a distraction-free macOS context.
statement.ja: distraction-freeなmacOS contextを提供するためfull-screen modeをsupportする。

conditions: Offer full-screen mode as a distraction-free context.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.review_note: Split full-screen support from the source sentence's separate window-management guidance.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.title: Support macOS keyboard shortcuts

statement.en: Support macOS keyboard shortcuts for faster actions and keyboard-only work styles.
statement.ja: actionの高速化とkeyboard-only work styleのためmacOS keyboard shortcutをsupportする。

conditions: Preserve both action efficiency and keyboard-only work styles.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-MACOS-.review_note: Recovered the omitted keyboard-shortcut rule and preserved both efficiency and keyboard-only use.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-TVOS-0.title: Support familiar Siri Remote gestures

statement.en: Support fluid, familiar Siri Remote gestures for powerful and delightful tvOS interactions.
statement.ja: powerfulでdelightfulなtvOS interactionのためfluidでfamiliarなSiri Remote gestureをsupportする。

conditions: Use gesture behavior people already know from the Siri Remote.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-TVOS-0.review_note: Repaired the generated paraphrase and removed voice modality inferred only from the Siri Remote product name.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-TVOS-0.title: Use the tvOS focus system

statement.en: Use the tvOS focus system to highlight and expand items as people move among them.
statement.ja: 項目間を移動するときhighlightとexpandを行うtvOS focus systemを使う。

conditions: Help people know what to do and where they are at all times.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-TVOS-0.review_note: Recovered the omitted focus-system rule and preserved its action and location awareness goals.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-TVOS-0.title: Create a clear tvOS cinematic experience

statement.en: Create a clear, legible, and captivating tvOS cinematic experience that works from across the room.
statement.ja: 部屋の反対側からもclear、legible、captivatingなtvOS cinematic experienceを作る。

conditions: Use edge-to-edge artwork, subtle fluid animation, and engaging audio as supporting techniques.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-TVOS-0.review_note: Recovered the omitted cinematic outcome and recorded the three supporting techniques without making them separate universal requirements.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-TVOS-0.title: Make tvOS multiuser sign-in easy and infrequent

statement.en: Make tvOS multiuser sign-in easy and infrequent, including shared sign-in.
statement.ja: shared sign-inを含むtvOS multiuser sign-inをeasyかつinfrequentにする。

conditions: Handle shared sign-in as part of the multiuser experience.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-TVOS-0.title: Switch tvOS profiles with the current viewer

conditions: Apply automatic switching within a multiuser experience.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-TVOS-0.review_note: Split the automatic profile-switching action from the source sentence's separate sign-in guidance.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.title: Keep watchOS interactions quick and glanceable

statement.en: Support quick, glanceable, single-screen watchOS interactions for critical information and targeted actions.
