conditions: Help people complete targeted actions with one or two gestures.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.review_note: Repaired the truncated extraction and preserved information density, screen scope, and gesture count.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.title: Minimize watchOS navigation hierarchy depth

statement.en: Minimize hierarchy depth in watchOS app navigation.
statement.ja: watchOS app navigationのhierarchy depthを最小化する。

conditions: Keep navigation shallow for streamlined interactions.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.review_note: Separated hierarchy depth from the source sentence's Digital Crown guidance and removed its modality from this rule.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.title: Show relevant data in watchOS complications

statement.en: Use complications for relevant, potentially dynamic watch-face data and graphics.
statement.ja: relevantでpotentially dynamicなwatch-face dataとgraphicsにcomplicationを使う。

conditions: Make the content viewable on every wrist raise.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.review_note: Repaired the truncated extraction and separated display value from direct app opening.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.title: Use watchOS notifications for timely information and actions

statement.en: Use watchOS notifications for timely, high-value information and important actions without opening the app.
statement.ja: appを開かずtimelyでhigh-valueな情報とimportant actionを提供するためwatchOS notificationを使う。

conditions: Keep notification information timely and high value.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.review_note: Replaced the generic paraphrase and preserved both information delivery and in-notification action.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.title: Use watchOS backgrounds for supporting information

statement.en: Use watchOS background content such as color to convey useful supporting information.
statement.ja: usefulなsupporting informationを伝えるためcolorなどのwatchOS background contentを使う。

conditions: Keep background information supportive rather than primary.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.review_note: Repaired the truncated extraction and separated background information from material hierarchy.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.title: Make the watchOS app function independently

statement.en: Design the watchOS app to function independently and complement its notifications and complications.
statement.ja: watchOS appをindependentに機能させ、notificationとcomplicationを補完するよう設計する。

conditions: Provide additional details and functionality beyond notifications and complications.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.review_note: Replaced the generic paraphrase and preserved the app's independent and complementary roles.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.title: Personalize watchOS with relevant on-device data

statement.en: Personalize watchOS with on-device data that anticipates needs and provides actionable near-term content.
statement.ja: needを予測しactionableなnear-term contentを提供するon-device dataでwatchOSをpersonalizeする。

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.title: Use the Digital Crown for vertical navigation

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.title: Open the app from its watchOS complication

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGNING-FOR-WATCHO.title: Use watchOS materials for hierarchy and place

statement.ja: essentialなapp functionの集合をAction buttonから利用できるようにする。

conditions: A separate App Shortcut solely for opening the app is unnecessary because the system already provides one.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0001.review_note: Replaced the generated paraphrase and preserved the system-provided open-app exception.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0002.title: Prefer system Action button instructions

statement.en: Prefer the system's instructions for showing people how to use the Action button with the app.
statement.ja: appでのAction buttonの使い方はsystemのinstructionで示すことを優先する。

conditions: The system automatically helps people configure an app function for the Action button.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0002.review_note: Replaced the generic preference paraphrase and separated repeated-content avoidance.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0003.title: Keep iOS Action button actions in context

statement.en: Let people use iOS Action button actions without leaving their current context.
statement.ja: current contextを離れずiOS Action button actionを使えるようにする。

conditions: When possible, use lightweight capabilities such as Live Activities or custom snippets instead of opening the app.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0003.review_note: Specified iOS scope and recorded both documented lightweight alternatives.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0004.title: Consider a secondary watchOS Action button function

statement.en: Consider a secondary watchOS Action button function that supports or advances the selected primary action.
statement.ja: 選択したprimary actionをsupportまたはadvanceするsecondary watchOS Action button functionを検討する。

conditions: For workouts or dives, keep a secondary function simple, intuitive, and easy to learn and remember.
exceptions: Consider carefully before offering more than one secondary function because it increases cognitive load.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0004.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the workout, dive, learnability, memorability, and cognitive-load limits.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0005.title: Use later Action button presses for additional functionality

statement.en: Prefer later watchOS Action button presses for additional functionality instead of stopping or concluding a function.
statement.ja: watchOS Action buttonのlater pressはfunctionのstopやconclusionではなくadditional functionalityに使うことを優先する。

conditions: Offer stopping the main task within the interface instead.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0005.review_note: Repaired the preference paraphrase and recorded the in-interface stopping alternative.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0006.title: Describe each Action button action succinctly

statement.en: Give each supported Action button action a short, descriptive label.
statement.ja: supportする各Action button actionに短く簡潔なdescriptive labelを付ける。

conditions: People see the label while configuring Action button behavior in Settings.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0006.review_note: Recovered the omitted per-action labeling rule and its Settings context.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0007.title: Use title-style capitalization in Action button labels

statement.en: Use title-style capitalization in Action button labels.
statement.ja: Action button labelにtitle-style capitalizationを使う。

conditions: Apply this capitalization to labels shown in Settings.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0007.review_note: Recovered the capitalization constraint from the label-format list.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0008.title: Begin Action button labels with a verb

statement.en: Begin each Action button label with a verb.
statement.ja: 各Action button labelをverbで始める。

conditions: Apply this structure to labels shown in Settings.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0008.review_note: Recovered the leading-verb constraint from the label-format list.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0009.title: Use present tense in Action button labels

statement.en: Use present tense in Action button labels.
statement.ja: Action button labelにpresent tenseを使う。

conditions: Apply present tense to labels shown in Settings.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0009.review_note: Recovered the present-tense constraint from the label-format list.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0010.title: Avoid articles and prepositions in Action button labels

statement.en: Avoid articles and prepositions in Action button labels.
statement.ja: Action button labelでarticleとprepositionを避ける。

conditions: Apply this concise style to labels shown in Settings.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0010.review_note: Recovered the article-and-preposition exclusion as an AVOID rule.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0011.title: Limit Action button labels to three words

statement.en: Keep each Action button label as short as possible, with a maximum of three words.
statement.ja: 各Action button labelを可能な限り短くし、最大3語にする。

conditions: Treat three words as the maximum, not a target length.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0011.review_note: Recovered the explicit three-word maximum and short-as-possible preference.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0012.title: Avoid repeating system Action button guidance

statement.en: Avoid repeating Action button guidance or usage tips the system already provides.
statement.ja: systemが既に提供するAction button guidanceやusage tipを繰り返さない。

conditions: The system already supplies the guidance or usage tip.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0012.review_note: Split repeated-content avoidance from the source sentence's separate system-instruction preference.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0013.title: Ensure subsequent Action button presses fit the action

statement.en: Ensure each subsequent Action button press follows logically from the first and fits the current context.
statement.ja: Action buttonの各subsequent pressをfirst pressから論理的につながりcurrent contextに合うようにする。

conditions: People may use the Action button without looking at the screen.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0013.review_note: Recovered the explicit needs-to requirement and separated it from optional secondary-function guidance.

HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0014.title: Support expected Action-button pausing

statement.en: Support pausing with the Action and side buttons unless pausing creates a negative experience.
statement.ja: negative experienceを生む場合を除きAction buttonとside buttonによるpauseをsupportする。

conditions: People press the Action button and side button together.
exceptions: Do not pause a dive when pausing could endanger the diver or hide critical dive state.
HIG-INPUTS-ACTION-BUTTON-0014.review_note: Recovered the conditional Be sure requirement and preserved the diver-safety exception.

HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0001.title: Use SF Symbols for Camera Control functions

statement.en: Use SF Symbols that clearly represent each Camera Control function.
statement.ja: 各Camera Control functionを明確に表すSF Symbolを使う。

conditions: Custom symbols are unsupported.
Treat a control symbol as its behavior, not its current state.
HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0001.review_note: Repaired SF capitalization and recorded custom-symbol and current-state platform constraints without promoting them to MUST.

HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0002.title: Keep Camera Control names short

statement.en: Keep Camera Control names short.
statement.ja: Camera Control nameを短く保つ。

conditions: Labels scale with Dynamic Type, and longer names can obscure the viewfinder.
HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0002.review_note: Repaired the generated grammar and recorded Dynamic Type and viewfinder-obscuration context.

HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0003.title: Give Camera Control slider values context

statement.en: Include units or symbols with Camera Control slider values to provide context.
statement.ja: contextを示すためCamera Control slider valueにunitまたはsymbolを含める。

conditions: Examples include units, percentages, or a localized custom string.
HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0003.review_note: Replaced the generic paraphrase and recorded the documented contextual value formats.

HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0004.title: Reserve viewfinder space for the Camera Control overlay

statement.en: Make space for the Camera Control overlay in the viewfinder.
statement.ja: viewfinder内にCamera Control overlay用のspaceを確保する。

conditions: Keep app UI outside overlay areas in portrait and landscape.
Maximize viewfinder dimensions and let the overlay appear and disappear over it.
HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0004.review_note: Replaced the generic paraphrase and recorded both orientations, nonoverlap, viewfinder size, and overlay transition behavior.

HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0005.title: Minimize Camera Control viewfinder distractions

statement.en: Minimize visual distractions in the Camera Control viewfinder.
statement.ja: Camera Control viewfinder内のvisual distractionを最小化する。

conditions: Preserve a large preview image while capturing photos or video.
HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0005.review_note: Replaced the generic paraphrase and separated duplicate-control avoidance.

HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0006.title: Match Camera Control availability to camera mode

statement.en: Enable or disable Camera Control options according to the current camera mode.
statement.ja: current camera modeに応じてCamera Control optionをenableまたはdisableにする。

conditions: Disable video-specific controls while taking photos.
Controls can't be added or removed from the overlay at runtime.
HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0006.review_note: Replaced the generic paraphrase and recorded the mode example and fixed runtime control set.

HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0007.title: Consider Camera Control ordering by usage

statement.en: Consider ordering Camera Control options by usage frequency.
statement.ja: usage frequencyに基づくCamera Control optionの並びを検討する。

conditions: Place commonly used controls near the middle and lesser-used controls on either side.
exceptions: The system returns to the last control used when reopening the overlay.
HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0007.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded common-use placement and system-restored selection.

HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0008.title: Launch the camera experience from anywhere

statement.en: Let people launch the app's camera experience from anywhere with Camera Control.
statement.ja: Camera Controlでappのcamera experienceをどこからでも起動できるようにする。

conditions: Use a locked camera capture extension that people explicitly configure.
Support launch from a locked device, Home Screen, or another app.
HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0008.review_note: Replaced the generic paraphrase and raised explicitly configured locked-device launch to privacy and explicit-intent priority.

HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0009.title: Define prominent Camera Control slider values

statement.en: Define prominent values for each Camera Control slider.
statement.ja: 各Camera Control sliderのprominent valueを定義する。

conditions: Use frequently selected values or evenly spaced major increments.
The system lands more easily on defined prominent values.
HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0009.review_note: Specified Camera Control scope and recorded selection frequency, spacing, and system snapping behavior.

HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0010.title: Avoid duplicate viewfinder and overlay controls

statement.en: Avoid duplicating controls between the viewfinder and Camera Control overlay.
statement.ja: viewfinderとCamera Control overlay間でcontrolを重複させない。

conditions: The system is displaying the Camera Control overlay.
HIG-INPUTS-CAMERA-CONTROL-0010.review_note: Split the direct duplicate-control avoidance from the broader distraction-minimization rule.

HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0001.title: Consider Digital Crown data inspection

statement.en: Consider using the Digital Crown to inspect data when navigation isn't needed.
statement.ja: navigationが不要なときDigital Crownでdataをinspectすることを検討する。

conditions: The Digital Crown doesn't need to navigate lists or pages.
HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0001.review_note: Retained MAY, repaired the generated wording, and narrowed the Apple Watch section to watchOS.

HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0002.title: Provide Digital Crown visual feedback

statement.en: Provide visual feedback for every Digital Crown interaction.
statement.ja: すべてのDigital Crown interactionにvisual feedbackを提供する。

conditions: Update the interface from directly tracked crown turns when needed.
HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0002.review_note: Repaired the generated wording, preserved the no-effect perception risk, and narrowed scope to watchOS.

HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0003.title: Use default Digital Crown haptics when appropriate

statement.en: Use default Digital Crown haptic feedback when it fits the watchOS experience.
statement.ja: watchOS experienceに合う場合はdefault Digital Crown haptic feedbackを使う。

conditions: Turn off detents when they don't fit the app or its animation.
exceptions: Tables may use linear instead of row-based detents for differently sized rows.
HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0003.review_note: Repaired the generated wording, recorded detent alternatives, and narrowed scope to watchOS.

HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0004.title: Anchor watchOS navigation to the Digital Crown

statement.en: Use the Digital Crown as the primary anchor for watchOS app navigation.
statement.ja: watchOS app navigationのprimary anchorとしてDigital Crownを使う。

conditions: Use vertically oriented lists, tabs, and scroll views for important interface elements.
exceptions: Digital Crown presses remain reserved for system functionality.
HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0004.review_note: Recovered the omitted navigation-anchor rule and preserved vertical layout and reserved-press constraints.

HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0005.title: Back Digital Crown navigation with touch

statement.en: Back every Digital Crown navigation interaction with a corresponding touch interaction.
statement.ja: すべてのDigital Crown navigation interactionを対応するtouch interactionで補完する。

conditions: The watchOS app anchors navigation or another interaction to the Digital Crown.
HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0005.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure requirement and recorded both touch and Digital Crown modalities.

HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0006.title: Match interface updates to Digital Crown speed

statement.en: Match watchOS interface update speed to Digital Crown turning speed.
statement.ja: watchOS interfaceのupdate speedをDigital Crownのturning speedに合わせる。

conditions: Preserve the precise control people expect from crown rotation.
HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0006.review_note: Recovered the omitted speed-matching rule and recorded the precision rationale.

HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0007.title: Avoid selection-blocking Digital Crown update rates

statement.en: Avoid interface update rates that make Digital Crown values difficult to select.
statement.ja: Digital Crown valueを選びにくくするinterface update rateを避ける。

conditions: People use crown rotation to select a value.
HIG-INPUTS-DIGITAL-CROWN-0007.review_note: Split the direct update-rate avoidance from the source sentence's speed-matching guidance.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0012.title: Match spatial controller interactions to hand input

statement.en: Make visionOS spatial controller interactions behave like equivalent hand interactions.
statement.ja: visionOSのspatial controller interactionを対応するhand interactionと同様に動作させる。

conditions: A visionOS game supports a spatial game controller.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0012.review_note: Repaired the generated wording and recorded the gaze, hand-gesture, and game-controller modalities.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0014.title: Support indirect gaze-and-trigger interaction

statement.en: Support looking at an object and pressing a spatial controller trigger to interact indirectly.
statement.ja: objectを見てspatial controllerのtriggerを押す間接interactionをサポートする。

conditions: Use either the left or right spatial controller trigger.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0014.review_note: Split the source's indirect interaction mapping and recorded its gaze and trigger inputs.

HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0015.title: Support direct reach-and-trigger interaction

statement.en: Support reaching toward an object and pressing a spatial controller trigger to interact directly.
statement.ja: objectへ手を伸ばしてspatial controllerのtriggerを押す直接interactionをサポートする。

conditions: Use either the left or right spatial controller trigger.
HIG-INPUTS-GAME-CONTROLS-0015.review_note: Split the source's direct interaction mapping and recorded its reach gesture and trigger inputs.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0007.title: Make visionOS shortcut titles self-contained

statement.en: Make every visionOS shortcut title descriptive enough to convey its action without submenu context.
statement.ja: 各visionOS shortcut titleをsubmenu contextなしでactionを伝えられる十分にdescriptiveな内容にする。

conditions: The shortcut appears in the visionOS shortcut interface's flat category list.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0007.review_note: Recorded the missing submenu-title context and the explicit requirement that each title convey its action independently.

HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0010.title: Account for the visionOS virtual keyboard overlay

statement.en: Account for the virtual keyboard overlay when a physical keyboard connects to a visionOS app or game.
statement.ja: physical keyboardがvisionOS appまたはgameへ接続されたときvirtual keyboard overlayを考慮する。

conditions: The system overlay provides typing completion and other controls while the physical keyboard is connected.
HIG-INPUTS-KEYBOARDS-0010.review_note: Repaired the generated wording and recorded the system-provided overlay behavior without raising it to MUST.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0001.title: Prefer standard gestures for standard remote actions

statement.en: Prefer standard remote gestures for standard tvOS actions.
statement.ja: tvOSのstandard actionにはstandard remote gestureを優先する。

conditions: Preserve familiar remote behavior in ordinary app use.
exceptions: Custom gestures can be appropriate during active gameplay.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0001.review_note: Recorded the standard-behavior expectation and gameplay exception.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0002.title: Keep remote gestures consistent with tvOS focus

statement.en: Combine remote gestures with tvOS focus behavior in familiar ways.
statement.ja: remote gestureをtvOS focus behaviorと馴染みのある方法で組み合わせる。

conditions: Move focus in the same direction as the gesture.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0002.review_note: Recorded the direction-preserving focus example as the primary consistency check.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0003.title: Provide clear remote-gesture feedback

statement.en: Provide clear feedback that shows the result of remote gestures.
statement.ja: remote gestureの結果を示す明確なfeedbackを提供する。

conditions: Make the available gesture and its result understandable before or as it occurs.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0003.review_note: Repaired generated wording and retained both gesture discoverability and outcome feedback.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0004.title: Consider positional remote taps

statement.en: Consider using remote tap position to aid navigation or gameplay.
statement.ja: navigationまたはgameplayを助けるためremote tap位置の利用を検討する。

conditions: Use positional taps only when the behavior is contextual, intuitive, and discoverable.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0004.review_note: Retained MAY and removed the misleading touchscreen modality from physical-remote taps.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0005.title: Map Play/Pause to media playback controls

statement.en: During media playback, make Play/Pause play, pause, or resume the content.
statement.ja: media playback中はPlay/Pauseでcontentをplay、pause、resumeする。

conditions: A tvOS app is playing music or video.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0005.review_note: Combined the best-practice wording with the explicit Buttons-table contract.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0006.title: Limit custom remote gestures to fitting contexts

statement.en: Define a custom remote gesture only when it fits the tvOS experience.
statement.ja: tvOS experienceに合う場合だけcustom remote gestureを定義する。

conditions: Gameplay can justify a discoverable custom gesture.
exceptions: Prefer standard gestures in most nongame contexts.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0006.review_note: Repaired generated wording and preserved the gameplay-qualified custom-gesture case.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0007.title: Distinguish remote presses from taps

statement.en: Distinguish intentional remote presses from taps.
statement.ja: 意図的なremote pressとtapを区別する。

conditions: Use presses for selection, confirmation, and intentional gameplay actions; reserve taps for navigation or additional information.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0007.review_note: Recovered the omitted press-versus-tap distinction as one atomic rule.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0008.title: Avoid responding to inadvertent remote taps

statement.en: Avoid responding to inadvertent remote taps.
statement.ja: 意図しないremote tapへの応答を避ける。

conditions: A tap can occur while a person rests a thumb, moves the remote, or hands it to someone.
exceptions: In particular, avoid tap responses during live video playback.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0008.review_note: Split inadvertent-tap avoidance from the press-versus-tap distinction.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0009.title: Open the parent screen for Back by default

statement.en: In almost all cases, open the current screen's parent when a person presses Back.
statement.ja: ほぼすべての場合、Backが押されたらcurrent screenのparentを開く。

conditions: Use the app hierarchy, not necessarily navigation history, to identify the parent.
exceptions: At the top level, the parent is the Apple TV Home Screen; active gameplay uses the pause-menu flow.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0009.review_note: Recovered the qualified Back-navigation default and both hierarchy exceptions.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0010.title: Open a pause menu for Back during gameplay

statement.en: During active gameplay, open an in-game pause menu when a person presses Back.
statement.ja: active gameplay中にBackが押されたらin-game pause menuを開く。

conditions: Repeated accidental Back presses could otherwise disrupt gameplay.
exceptions: Provide another interaction in the pause menu for navigating to the main game menu.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0010.review_note: Split the active-gameplay Back exception from ordinary parent navigation.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0011.title: Close the pause menu and resume for Back

statement.en: When an in-game pause menu is open, make Back close it and resume gameplay.
statement.ja: in-game pause menuが開いているときBackで閉じてgameplayを再開する。

conditions: The tvOS game is paused in its in-game pause menu.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0011.review_note: Separated the second-stage Back behavior from pause-menu opening.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0012.title: Map app swipes to navigation and focus

statement.en: Make a remote touch-surface swipe navigate or change focus in a tvOS app.
statement.ja: tvOS appではremote touch-surface swipeでnavigateまたはfocus変更する。

conditions: The remote touch surface receives a swipe in a tvOS app.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0012.review_note: Recovered the app-side swipe mapping from the required behavior table.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0013.title: Map game swipes to directional-pad behavior

statement.en: Make a remote touch-surface swipe perform directional-pad behavior in a tvOS game.
statement.ja: tvOS gameではremote touch-surface swipeをdirectional-pad behaviorとして扱う。

conditions: The remote touch surface receives a swipe in a tvOS game.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0013.review_note: Recovered the game-side swipe mapping from the required behavior table.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0014.title: Map app presses to activation or deeper navigation

statement.en: Make a remote touch-surface press activate a control or navigate deeper in a tvOS app.
statement.ja: tvOS appではremote touch-surface pressでcontrolをactivateまたはより深くnavigateする。

conditions: The remote touch surface receives a press in a tvOS app.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0014.review_note: Recovered the app-side press mapping from the required behavior table.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0015.title: Map game presses to primary-button behavior

statement.en: Make a remote touch-surface press perform primary-button behavior in a tvOS game.
statement.ja: tvOS gameではremote touch-surface pressをprimary-button behaviorとして扱う。

conditions: The remote touch surface receives a press in a tvOS game.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0015.review_note: Recovered the game-side press mapping from the required behavior table.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0016.title: Map app Back presses to outward navigation

statement.en: Make Back return to the previous screen or exit to Home in a tvOS app.
statement.ja: tvOS appではBackでprevious screenへ戻るかHomeへ出る。

conditions: A person presses Back in a tvOS app.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0016.review_note: Recovered the app-side Back mapping from the required behavior table.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0017.title: Map game Back presses to pause or outward navigation

statement.en: Make Back pause or resume gameplay, navigate outward, or exit in a tvOS game.
statement.ja: tvOS gameではBackでgameplayをpauseまたはresumeし、外側へnavigateまたはexitする。

conditions: A person presses Back in a tvOS game.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0017.review_note: Recovered the game-side Back alternatives from the required behavior table.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0018.title: Map game Play/Pause presses to secondary behavior

statement.en: Make Play/Pause perform secondary-button behavior or skip an intro in a tvOS game.
statement.ja: tvOS gameではPlay/Pauseをsecondary-button behaviorまたはintro skipに使う。

conditions: A person presses Play/Pause in a tvOS game.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0018.review_note: Recovered the game-side Play/Pause mapping from the required behavior table.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0019.title: Open an EPG for guide or browse presses

statement.en: Open the app's EPG when a person presses a compatible remote's guide or browse button.
statement.ja: compatible remoteのguideまたはbrowse buttonが押されたらappのEPGを開く。

conditions: The live-viewing app provides an EPG.
exceptions: If the app has no EPG, the system routes the press to the device's default guide app.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0019.review_note: Activated the conditional EPG-opening behavior and preserved the system-routing fallback.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0020.title: Navigate an EPG with page buttons

statement.en: Use a compatible remote's page up and page down buttons to navigate an open EPG.
statement.ja: open EPGをcompatible remoteのpage upとpage down buttonでnavigateする。

conditions: A person is viewing the app's EPG.
exceptions: Siri Remote touch-surface upper and lower taps can also browse the EPG.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0020.review_note: Split EPG paging from EPG opening and retained the touch-surface alternative.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0021.title: Avoid repurposing EPG-browsing buttons

statement.en: Avoid assigning other actions to EPG-browsing buttons while the EPG is open.
statement.ja: EPGが開いている間はEPG-browsing buttonへ別のactionを割り当てない。

conditions: A person is browsing the app's EPG.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0021.review_note: Split the direct EPG-button repurposing avoidance from the positive mappings.

HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0022.title: Change channels with page buttons during playback

statement.en: During content playback, make a compatible remote's page up and page down buttons change channels.
statement.ja: content playback中はcompatible remoteのpage upとpage down buttonでchannelを変更する。

conditions: Channel-based content is playing rather than an EPG being browsed.
HIG-INPUTS-REMOTES-0022.review_note: Activated the playback-specific channel behavior and separated it from EPG paging.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0001.title: Offer alternatives to drag and drop

statement.en: Offer ways other than drag and drop to accomplish supported drag-and-drop actions.
statement.ja: 対応するdrag-and-drop actionを実行するためのdrag and drop以外の方法を提供する。

conditions: Alternative methods are important when drag and drop is inconvenient or impossible.
Menu commands can provide equivalent copy and move actions.
On iOS and iPadOS, identify sources and destinations for assistive technologies with the relevant accessibility APIs.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0001.review_note: Recorded the equivalent-action accessibility outcome and the source's menu and accessibility-API mechanisms.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0002.title: Support multi-item drag and drop when useful

statement.en: Support multi-item drag and drop when moving a group is useful.
statement.ja: item groupの移動が有用な場合はmulti-item drag and dropに対応する。

conditions: Apply on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS where the source supports multiple selection.
On iPadOS, people can add items without stopping an in-progress drag.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0002.review_note: Concretized the usefulness condition and recorded the page's platform and in-progress-addition context.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0003.title: Let people undo drag and drop

statement.en: Prefer letting people undo a drag-and-drop operation.
statement.ja: drag-and-drop operationをundoできるようにすることを優先する。

conditions: Ask for confirmation before completing an operation that can't be undone when doing so helps prevent mistakes.
When undo is unavailable, consider a way to reverse the result.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0003.review_note: Preserved Prefer strength and recorded the confirmation and result-reversal fallbacks.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0004.title: Consider multiple dragged-content representations

statement.en: Consider offering multiple representations of dragged content from highest to lowest fidelity.
statement.ja: dragged contentの複数表現をfidelityの高い順に提供することを検討する。

conditions: Ordering lets the destination choose the highest-fidelity representation it supports.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0004.review_note: Retained Consider as MAY and recorded the destination-negotiation purpose.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0005.title: Consider supporting spring loading

statement.en: Consider supporting spring loading for controls that can activate while content is dragged over them.
statement.ja: contentをdragしたままactivateできるcontrolでspring loadingへの対応を検討する。

conditions: Activation may use force click on a supported Mac trackpad or hover on iPad.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0005.review_note: Retained Consider as MAY and concretized the control activation behavior.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0006.title: Show a drag image throughout the drag

statement.en: Show a drag image after about three points of movement and keep it visible until the drop.
statement.ja: 約3 point移動した時点でdrag imageを表示し、dropまで表示を保つ。

conditions: A translucent representation distinguishes dragged content from its source and keeps destinations visible.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0006.review_note: Combined the source's start threshold and end state into one drag-image lifecycle.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0007.title: Indicate whether a destination accepts dragged content

statement.en: Show whether the current destination can accept the dragged content.
statement.ja: 現在のdestinationがdragged contentを受け入れられるか示す。

conditions: Use an insertion point or highlight for an accepting destination.
Use no visual feedback or an explicit not-allowed image for a rejecting destination.
Show destination cues only while content is above the destination.
When several destinations are possible, identify one at a time.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0007.review_note: Repaired generated wording and recorded accepting, rejecting, lifecycle, and multiple-destination states.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0008.title: Show progress for time-consuming transfers

statement.en: Provide feedback when dropped content takes time to transfer.
statement.ja: dropped contentのtransferに時間がかかる場合はfeedbackを提供する。

conditions: A progress indicator can communicate remaining time.
In a collection, list, or table, a placeholder can preserve the drop location.
The system may alert people about a time-consuming cross-app transfer.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0008.review_note: Concretized the transfer-delay state and recorded its progress, placeholder, and system-alert mechanisms.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0009.title: Show task initiation and progress after a drop

statement.en: When dropped content initiates a task, show that the task began and communicate its progress.
statement.ja: dropped contentがtaskを開始する場合、開始と進捗を示す。

conditions: Apply when content is dropped on a control that starts an action such as printing.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0009.review_note: Recorded both required feedback states from the supporting sentence.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0010.title: Apply destination styling when text styles differ

statement.en: When source and destination don't support the same text styles, apply the destination's style to dropped text.
statement.ja: sourceとdestinationが同じtext styleに対応しない場合、dropped textへdestinationのstyleを適用する。

conditions: The compatible-style preservation requirement is recorded separately.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0010.review_note: Narrowed the general lead to the incompatible-style branch so it doesn't duplicate the explicit Make sure requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0016.title: Support drag and drop throughout the app

statement.en: Support drag and drop throughout the app wherever practicable.
statement.ja: 可能な限りapp全体でdrag and dropに対応する。

conditions: System-provided text fields and text views include built-in support.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0016.review_note: Preserved the As much as possible qualification and recorded the system-component baseline.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0017.title: Define move and copy semantics within the app

statement.en: Define when a drag and drop within the app moves content and when it copies content.
statement.ja: app内のdrag and dropでcontentをmoveする場合とcopyする場合を定義する。

conditions: Moving is the general default within one container.
Copying is the general default between different containers.
Before changing a default, prefer expected behavior that minimizes frustration and data loss.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0017.review_note: Concretized the decision and preserved the two defaults plus the expectation and data-loss review.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0026.title: Treat every cross-app drag and drop as a copy

statement.en: Treat dragging and dropping content between apps as a copy.
statement.ja: app間でcontentをdrag and dropする場合はcopyとして扱う。

conditions: The source and destination are in different apps.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always platform contract for cross-app copy semantics.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0027.title: Provide continuous feedback throughout drag and drop

statement.en: Provide clear and continuous feedback throughout every drag-and-drop interaction.
statement.ja: すべてのdrag-and-drop interactionを通じて明確で継続的なfeedbackを提供する。

conditions: Drag and drop can produce multiple outcomes and people need to remain in control of the process.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0027.review_note: Classified the unqualified outcome as MUST because the source calls continuous process feedback crucial.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0028.title: Modify the drag image only when it adds clarity

statement.en: When it adds clarity, modify the drag image to help people predict the drop result.
statement.ja: 明確さが増す場合、drop結果を予測できるようdrag imageを変更する。

conditions: A change may preview the destination size or flock multiple dragged items.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0028.review_note: Activated the omitted conditional feedback and preserved clarity as its gate.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0029.title: Avoid distracting drag-image changes

statement.en: Avoid constantly and radically changing the drag image.
statement.ja: drag imageを絶えず大幅に変化させることを避ける。

conditions: Changes intended as feedback must not become distracting.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0029.review_note: Recovered the direct Avoid constraint without raising it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0030.title: Show feedback for an invalid or failed drop

statement.en: Provide visual feedback when a drop target is invalid or the drop fails.
statement.ja: drop targetがinvalidな場合やdropが失敗した場合はvisual feedbackを提供する。

conditions: Return the item to a visible source or use a clear nonlanding animation.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0030.review_note: Activated the omitted error-state rule and recorded both source-visible and source-unavailable techniques.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0031.title: Autoscroll a destination while dragging when necessary

statement.en: When necessary, scroll a destination's content while an item is dragged within it.
statement.ja: 必要な場合、itemをdestination内でdragしている間はcontentをscrollする。

conditions: Use this behavior for a scrolling container with substantial content.
Stop autoscrolling when the drag leaves the container.
System text views and text fields provide this behavior by default.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0031.review_note: Activated the omitted scrolling state and captured its container, exit, and system-default boundaries.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0032.title: Accept the richest supported dropped-content version

statement.en: When several versions are available, accept the richest version the app supports.
statement.ja: 複数versionが利用可能な場合、appが対応する最もrichなversionを受け入れる。

conditions: Fall back to a simpler representation when the richer native object is unsupported.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0032.review_note: Activated the omitted negotiation rule and preserved the supported-richest and fallback branches.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0033.title: Extract only relevant dropped content when necessary

statement.en: When necessary, extract only the relevant portion of dropped content.
statement.ja: 必要な場合、dropped contentから関連部分だけを抽出する。

conditions: Exclude unrelated fields when the destination expects a focused subset.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0033.review_note: Activated the omitted conditional extraction rule and recorded its data-minimization boundary.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0034.title: Check the Option key at drop time

statement.en: When a physical keyboard is attached, check the Option key state at drop time.
statement.ja: physical keyboardが接続されている場合、drop時にOption keyの状態を確認する。

conditions: Holding Option makes a same-container drag copy content.
Releasing Option before a same-container drop makes the operation move content.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0034.review_note: Activated the omitted keyboard contract and recorded both modifier states.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0035.title: Preserve compatible source styling in dropped text

statement.en: When source and destination support the same text styles, preserve the dropped text's original styling.
statement.ja: sourceとdestinationが同じtext styleに対応する場合、dropped textの元のstyleを維持する。

conditions: Preserve the original font, typeface, size, and other supported attributes.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0035.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure styling requirement and kept the incompatible-style branch separate.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0036.title: Update selection state after a drop

statement.en: After a drop, keep the dropped content selected in the destination and update source selection as needed.
statement.ja: drop後はdestinationでdropped contentのselectionを保ち、必要に応じてsource selectionを更新する。

conditions: For a same-container move, remove content from its original location.
For a same-container copy, deselect the content that remains at the original location.
For a drop into a different container, deselect the source content.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0036.review_note: Activated the omitted post-drop rule and preserved all three move, same-container copy, and different-container states.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0011.title: Support multiple simultaneous drag activities

statement.en: Let people perform multiple simultaneous drag activities in iOS and iPadOS.
statement.ja: iOSとiPadOSで複数のsimultaneous drag activityを実行できるようにする。

conditions: In iPadOS, people can sequentially collect items in one in-progress drag session.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0011.review_note: Recorded touch scope and separated the general capability from its three explicit implementation requirements.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0012.title: Consider dragging app content into the Finder

statement.en: Consider letting people drag content from a macOS app into the Finder.
statement.ja: macOS appからFinderへcontentをdragできるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: Finder output can support sharing and later reopening in the app.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0012.review_note: Retained MAY and separated the conditional reopenable-format requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0013.title: Allow dragging background selections

statement.en: Let people drag selected content from an inactive macOS window without activating it first.
statement.ja: inactiveなmacOS windowのselected contentを先にactivateせずdragできるようにする。

conditions: The inactive window contains a background selection.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0013.review_note: Repaired generated wording and recorded the background-selection state.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0014.title: Consider a multi-item drag badge

statement.en: Consider showing a numeric badge during a macOS multi-item drag.
statement.ja: macOSのmulti-item drag中にnumeric badgeの表示を検討する。

conditions: Show the dragged item count; update it when a destination accepts only a subset.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0014.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded both initial and destination-filtered badge counts.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0015.title: Consider pointer feedback for drop results

statement.en: Consider changing the macOS pointer to indicate the result of dropping content.
statement.ja: contentをdropした結果を示すmacOS pointerの変更を検討する。

conditions: Choose a context-appropriate copy, drag-link, disappearing-item, or operation-not-allowed pointer.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0015.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded all documented pointer alternatives.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0018.title: Allow single-motion selection and dragging

statement.en: Wherever practicable, let people select and drag macOS content in one motion.
statement.ja: 可能な限りmacOS contentを1 motionでselectしてdragできるようにする。

conditions: Avoid requiring a pause between selection and drag start.
exceptions: Multiple-item selection may require a separate selection step.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0018.review_note: Preserved the practicability qualifier and multiple-selection exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0019.title: Allow adding items during an iPadOS drag

statement.en: Let people add items while an iPadOS drag session is in progress.
statement.ja: iPadOS drag sessionの進行中にitemを追加できるようにする。

conditions: The experience supports the documented multiple-item drag interaction.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0019.review_note: Separated the first explicit implementation requirement from the general multi-drag recommendation.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0020.title: Show flocking feedback for added iPadOS drag items

statement.en: Show flocking feedback when people add items to an in-progress iPadOS drag.
statement.ja: 進行中のiPadOS dragへitemを追加するときflocking feedbackを表示する。

conditions: A person adds an item to an in-progress iPadOS drag.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0020.review_note: Separated the mandatory visual-feedback mechanism from the other multi-drag requirements.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0021.title: Accept multiple simultaneous iPadOS drops

statement.en: Accept multiple simultaneous drops for the documented iPadOS multi-item drag interaction.
statement.ja: iPadOSのmulti-item drag interactionで複数のsimultaneous dropを受け入れる。

conditions: The app supports collecting multiple items in one iPadOS drag session.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0021.review_note: Separated the mandatory multiple-drop acceptance from item addition and flocking feedback.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0022.title: Use a reopenable format for Finder drag output

statement.en: Present content dragged to the Finder in a format the app can reopen later.
statement.ja: Finderへdragするcontentを後でappが再度開けるformatで提供する。

conditions: The macOS app supports dragging content from the app into the Finder.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0022.review_note: Separated the conditional Be sure requirement from optional Finder export.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0023.title: Consider a clipping for temporary dragged content

statement.en: When necessary, consider using a clipping as a temporary container for dragged macOS content.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はdragged macOS contentのtemporary containerとしてclippingを検討する。

conditions: A temporary Finder container is appropriate for the dragged content.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0023.review_note: Recovered the qualified clipping option without raising its strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0024.title: Preserve background selection when dragging another item

statement.en: When possible, let people drag an individual item from an inactive macOS window without changing its background selection.
statement.ja: 可能な場合、inactive macOS windowのbackground selectionを変えず個別itemをdragできるようにする。

conditions: The dragged item is not part of the inactive window's existing selection.

HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0025.title: Launch the app for empty-space drops when possible

statement.en: When possible, launch the visionOS app to handle its content when people drop that content into empty space.
statement.ja: 可能な場合、visionOS appのcontentがempty spaceへdropされたときappをlaunchして処理する。

conditions: Associate an appropriate user activity with draggable app content so the app can open a handling window or scene.
HIG-PATTERNS-DRAG-AND-DROP-0025.review_note: Activated the practicability-qualified visionOS launch behavior and recorded its user-activity mechanism.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0001.title: Support full-screen mode when it fits the experience

statement.en: Support full-screen mode when it helps people concentrate on a task or become immersed in content.
statement.ja: taskへの集中やcontentへの没入に役立つ場合はfull-screen modeに対応する。

conditions: Consider it for games, media, and in-depth tasks that benefit from a distraction-free environment.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0001.review_note: Concretized the makes-sense condition with the source's concentration, immersion, and task examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0002.title: Let people choose when to exit full-screen mode

statement.en: Let people choose when to exit full-screen mode.
statement.ja: full-screen modeを終了する時期を利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: Do not end full-screen mode merely because people switch experiences or finish an immersive activity.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0002.review_note: Classified the unqualified exit-timing choice as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0003.title: Temporarily hide nonessential controls when content is primary

statement.en: When content is the primary focus, consider temporarily hiding nonessential toolbars and navigation controls.
statement.ja: contentが主なfocusの場合、nonessentialなtoolbarやnavigation controlの一時非表示を検討する。

conditions: Use this to create a distraction-free viewing or reading environment.
Restoration and essential-control visibility are recorded separately.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0003.review_note: Narrowed temporary hiding to primary-content contexts and separated restoration and essential-control requirements.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0012.title: Adjust the full-screen layout only when necessary

statement.en: When necessary, adjust layout proportions in full-screen mode while keeping essential content prominent.
statement.ja: 必要な場合、essential contentを目立たせたままfull-screen modeのlayout比率を調整する。

conditions: Use the extra space without changing which interface items appear.
Programmatic window resizing is recorded separately.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0012.review_note: Split the qualified layout adjustment from the direct resizing avoidance.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0013.title: Avoid programmatically resizing the full-screen window

statement.en: Avoid programmatically resizing a window for full-screen mode.
statement.ja: full-screen modeのためにwindowをprogrammatic resizeしない。

conditions: Adjust interface proportions instead when the larger window requires layout changes.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0013.review_note: Recovered the direct Don't clause at AVOID and preserved the layout alternative.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0014.title: Keep full-screen layout adjustments subtle

statement.en: When adjusting a full-screen layout, ensure the changes remain subtle and visually consistent.
statement.ja: full-screen layoutを調整する場合、変更を控えめでvisualに一貫したものにする。

conditions: Avoid visually jarring transitions between full-screen and non-full-screen modes.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0014.review_note: Recovered the conditional Be sure requirement and its consistency and transition constraints.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0015.title: Keep essential features accessible in full screen

statement.en: Keep essential features and controls accessible so people can finish their task without exiting full-screen mode.
statement.ja: full-screen modeを終了せずtaskを完了できるようessential featureとcontrolへaccessできる状態を保つ。

conditions: In a media experience, keep playback controls persistent or easy to reveal.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0015.review_note: Activated the omitted task-completion rule and recorded its media-control state.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0016.title: Preserve Dock access outside games

statement.en: Except in games, let people reveal the Dock in a full-screen iPadOS or macOS app.
statement.ja: gameを除き、full-screen iPadOS・macOS appでDockを表示できるようにする。

conditions: Games may defer an initial iPadOS swipe or hide the macOS Dock to prevent accidental reveals.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0016.review_note: Activated the Dock-access rule, narrowed platform scope, and preserved the game exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0017.title: Resume full-screen experiences where people left off

statement.en: After people switch away from a full-screen experience, help them resume where they left off when they return.
statement.ja: full-screen experienceから離れた後、戻ったときに中断位置からresumeできるようにする。

conditions: Preserve the relevant content or task position while the experience is inactive.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0017.review_note: Activated the omitted leave-and-return state transition.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0018.title: Pause full-screen games and slideshows when people leave

statement.en: When people leave a full-screen game or slideshow, pause it automatically so they don't miss content.
statement.ja: full-screen gameやslideshowから離れた場合、contentを見逃さないよう自動pauseする。

conditions: The full-screen experience advances content while unattended.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0018.review_note: Recovered the explicit needs-to pause requirement and preserved its missed-content rationale.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0019.title: Let people restore hidden controls

statement.en: Let people restore temporarily hidden controls with a familiar gesture or action.
statement.ja: 一時的に隠したcontrolをfamiliarなgestureやactionで復元できるようにする。

conditions: Familiar actions include tapping, swiping down, or moving the pointer to the top of the screen.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0019.review_note: Recovered the hidden-control restoration path and its familiar-action examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0020.title: Keep essential controls visible

statement.en: Keep controls visible when they are essential for navigation or completing tasks.
statement.ja: navigationやtask completionに不可欠なcontrolは表示を保つ。

conditions: Do not apply temporary control hiding to essential navigation or task actions.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0020.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure visibility requirement and its essential-control condition.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0004.title: Consider deferring full-screen exit gestures

statement.en: Consider requiring two swipes to exit a full-screen iOS or iPadOS app when one swipe causes unexpected exits.
statement.ja: 1 swipeで予期しないexitが起きる場合、full-screen iOSまたはiPadOS appのexitに2 swipeを要求することを検討する。

conditions: The default one-swipe exit behavior causes unexpected exits.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0004.review_note: Narrowed gesture deferral to the documented unexpected-exit condition and two-swipe option.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0005.title: Use the system macOS full-screen experience

statement.en: Use the system-provided macOS full-screen experience.
statement.ja: system-providedのmacOS full-screen experienceを使う。

conditions: Let system support accommodate all Mac display contexts, including camera-housing areas.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0005.review_note: Narrowed scope to macOS and recorded system-managed display accommodation.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0006.title: Always let people choose when to enter full screen

statement.en: Always let people choose when to enter full-screen mode on macOS.
statement.ja: macOSでfull-screen modeへ入る時点を常に利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: Do not enter full screen automatically on a person's behalf.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0006.review_note: Reconfirmed the existing Always-based MUST and recorded explicit user choice and input modalities.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0007.title: Retain default full-screen exit gestures

statement.en: Whenever possible, retain the familiar default full-screen exit gesture behavior in iOS and iPadOS.
statement.ja: 可能な限りiOSとiPadOSの馴染みあるdefault full-screen exit gesture behaviorを維持する。

conditions: The Home Screen indicator reappears near the bottom and permits a one-swipe exit.
exceptions: Consider gesture deferral only when the default produces unexpected exits.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0007.review_note: Separated the practicability-qualified default from the optional deferral exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0008.title: Avoid changing display mode for full-screen games

statement.en: Avoid changing the display mode when a macOS game enters full screen.
statement.ja: macOS gameがfull screenへ入るときdisplay modeを変更しない。

conditions: Preserve player control because automatic display-mode changes do not improve performance.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0008.review_note: Activated the direct don't guidance conservatively as AVOID.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0009.title: Prefer standard macOS full-screen controls

statement.en: Prefer standard macOS controls for entering full-screen mode.
statement.ja: full-screen modeへ入るにはstandard macOS controlを優先する。

conditions: Support the window button, View menu item, or Control-Command-F shortcut.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0009.review_note: Split the standard-control preference and recorded all three system entry methods.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0010.title: Avoid custom macOS window-mode menus

statement.en: Avoid offering a custom menu of macOS window modes.
statement.ja: customなmacOS window mode menuの提供を避ける。

conditions: Use standard full-screen entry mechanisms instead.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0010.review_note: Split the direct custom-menu avoidance from the positive standard-control preference.

HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0011.title: Consider a game full-screen toggle

statement.en: In a macOS game, consider a custom toggle for turning full-screen mode on and off.
statement.ja: macOS gameではfull-screen modeをon/offするcustom toggleを検討する。

conditions: The custom toggle supplements rather than replaces standard full-screen controls.
HIG-PATTERNS-GOING-FULL-SCREEN-0011.review_note: Separated the game-specific optional toggle without promoting its might-level strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0008.title: Prefer another device for tvOS signup or authentication

statement.en: Prefer letting people use another device to sign up or authenticate for a tvOS app.
statement.ja: tvOSアプリの登録や認証では、別のデバイスを使えるようにすることを優先する。

conditions: Configure associated domains when the app should let Apple TV safely suggest credentials from another device, including Sign in with Apple.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0008.review_note: Made the cross-device preference concrete and recorded the associated-domain mechanism without turning the capability into a requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0009.title: Minimize tvOS account data entry

statement.en: Minimize data entry in tvOS account flows.
statement.ja: tvOSのアカウントフローで入力する情報を最小限にする。

conditions: Ask only for the minimum information necessary because people generally use a remote rather than a keyboard.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0009.review_note: Narrowed the generic lead to tvOS account flows and recorded the remote-input rationale.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0011.title: Avoid repeated profile selection for shared tvOS accounts

statement.en: When people use a shared account on tvOS, avoid asking them to choose a profile whenever they become the current user.
statement.ja: tvOSの共有アカウントでは、現在のユーザーになるたびにプロフィール選択を求めることを避ける。

conditions: A shared account contains distinct user profiles.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0011.review_note: Recovered the direct avoidance guidance and kept it at AVOID because the source does not use an explicit prohibition.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0012.title: Consider sharing tvOS credentials with separate user profiles

statement.en: On tvOS 16 or later, consider sharing a shared account’s credentials across users while storing each person’s profile and user data separately.
statement.ja: tvOS 16以降では、各ユーザーのプロフィールとデータを分離したまま共有アカウントの資格情報を共有することを検討する。

conditions: The app supports a shared account on tvOS 16 or later.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0012.review_note: Recovered the platform capability as MAY and preserved the per-user data-separation condition.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0013.title: Consider using the current tvOS user profile automatically

statement.en: When the app supports shared credentials with separate profiles, consider automatically using the current tvOS user’s profile without another sign-in.
statement.ja: 共有資格情報と個別プロフィールをサポートする場合、追加のサインインなしで現在のtvOSユーザーのプロフィールを自動使用することを検討する。

conditions: The app implements the documented shared-credential model on tvOS 16 or later.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0013.review_note: Separated the current-profile capability and retained its optional can-level strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0014.title: Use another device for longer tvOS account data entry

statement.en: If tvOS account setup needs more than a small amount of information, ask people to continue on a website using another device.
statement.ja: tvOSのアカウント設定で少量を超える情報が必要な場合、別のデバイスからWebサイトで続けるよう案内する。

conditions: The flow needs more than a small amount of information.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0014.review_note: Recovered the conditional website handoff and retained recommendation strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0015.title: Show the email keyboard for tvOS account email entry

statement.en: When a tvOS account flow needs an email address, show the email keyboard so people can choose a recently entered address.
statement.ja: tvOSのアカウントフローでメールアドレスが必要な場合、最近入力したアドレスを選べるメールキーボードを表示する。

conditions: The flow requests an email address.

manual: Does the tvOS account flow show the email keyboard when it requests an email address?

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-ACCOUNTS-0015.review_note: Recovered the email-entry optimization, recorded remote and onscreen-keyboard context, and kept verification manual.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0009.title: Describe only the indicated control in a tooltip

statement.en: In a macOS or visionOS tooltip, describe only the control a person indicates interest in.
statement.ja: macOSまたはvisionOSのtooltipでは、利用者が関心を示したcontrolだけを説明する。

conditions: Do not expand the tooltip into help for nearby controls or a larger task.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0009.review_note: Made the tooltip scope explicit and recorded the exclusion of nearby controls and larger tasks.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0010.title: Keep tooltip content brief

statement.en: Keep macOS and visionOS tooltip content brief and direct.
statement.ja: macOSとvisionOSのtooltip内容を短く直接的にする。

conditions: Prefer a concise description of the control's action or task.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0010.review_note: Made the generic brevity lead concrete for macOS and visionOS tooltips.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0011.title: Use sentence case in tooltips

statement.en: Use sentence case for macOS and visionOS tooltip text.
statement.ja: macOSとvisionOSのtooltipテキストにはsentence caseを使う。

conditions: Sentence case supports a casual and approachable tone.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0011.review_note: Narrowed sentence-case guidance to the documented tooltip context.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0012.title: Consider context-sensitive tooltip text

statement.en: Consider changing a macOS or visionOS tooltip's text to match the control's current state.
statement.ja: macOSまたはvisionOSのtooltipテキストをcontrolの現在状態に合わせて変えることを検討する。

conditions: A control has multiple states that benefit from different explanations.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0012.review_note: Made the optional context-sensitive behavior concrete without elevating consider guidance.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0016.title: Consider showing macOS tooltips on pointer hover

statement.en: Consider showing a tooltip when a person holds the pointer over a control in an app running on a Mac.
statement.ja: Macで動作するアプリでは、control上にpointerを置いたときtooltipを表示することを検討する。

conditions: This capability also applies to iPhone and iPad apps running on a Mac.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0016.review_note: Recovered the macOS pointer-hover capability as MAY and recorded the app-on-Mac scope.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0017.title: Consider showing visionOS tooltips on gaze or pointer hover

statement.en: Consider showing a visionOS tooltip when a person looks at a control or holds the pointer over it.
statement.ja: visionOSでは、controlを見つめるかpointerを置いたときtooltipを表示することを検討する。

conditions: Use the platform tooltip behavior for the indicated control.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0017.review_note: Recovered the visionOS gaze and pointer-hover capabilities as MAY.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0018.title: Describe the action a tooltip control initiates

statement.en: Describe the action or task initiated by the control in its macOS or visionOS tooltip.
statement.ja: macOSまたはvisionOSのtooltipで、controlが開始するactionまたはtaskを説明する。

conditions: Focus the description on what using the control does.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0018.review_note: Recovered the missing action-description lead and made its tooltip target explicit.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0019.title: Prefer beginning tooltip descriptions with a verb

statement.en: Prefer beginning a macOS or visionOS tooltip description with a verb.
statement.ja: macOSまたはvisionOSのtooltip説明はverbで始めることを優先する。

conditions: A verb directly communicates the control's action or task.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0019.review_note: Separated the often-works-well writing preference and retained recommendation strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0020.title: Keep tooltip content within 60 to 75 characters when possible

statement.en: When possible, limit macOS and visionOS tooltip content to a maximum of 60 to 75 characters.
statement.ja: 可能な場合、macOSとvisionOSのtooltip内容を最大60〜75文字に収める。

conditions: Account for localization because translated text length often changes.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0020.review_note: Recovered the numeric target as practicability-qualified SHOULD rather than a hard MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0021.title: Consider sentence fragments for concise tooltips

statement.en: Consider using a sentence fragment to keep macOS and visionOS tooltip descriptions brief and direct.
statement.ja: macOSとvisionOSのtooltip説明を短く直接的にするためsentence fragmentの使用を検討する。

conditions: A fragment communicates the control's action clearly.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0021.review_note: Separated one optional brevity technique and retained consider-level strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0022.title: Consider omitting articles from concise tooltip text

statement.en: Consider omitting articles to keep macOS and visionOS tooltip descriptions brief and direct.
statement.ja: macOSとvisionOSのtooltip説明を短く直接的にするためarticleの省略を検討する。

conditions: Omission preserves a clear and natural description.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0022.review_note: Separated the second optional brevity technique and retained consider-level strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0023.title: Consider simplifying controls that need verbose tooltips

statement.en: If a control needs a large amount of tooltip text, consider simplifying the interface design.
statement.ja: controlのtooltipに大量のテキストが必要な場合、interface designの簡素化を検討する。

conditions: The control cannot be described briefly and directly.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0023.review_note: Recovered the conditional redesign prompt without promoting consider guidance.

HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0024.title: Omit ending punctuation from complete tooltip sentences

statement.en: For complete macOS and visionOS tooltip sentences, omit ending punctuation unless the app's style requires it.
statement.ja: macOSとvisionOSの完全なtooltip文では、アプリのstyleで必要な場合を除き文末句読点を省く。

conditions: The tooltip uses a complete sentence.
exceptions: Keep ending punctuation when required for consistency with the app's style.
HIG-PATTERNS-OFFERING-HELP-0024.review_note: Recovered the conditional punctuation guidance and preserved its style-consistency exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0007.title: Use system sound services for short sounds and vibrations

statement.en: Use system sound services to play short sounds and vibrations in iOS and iPadOS.
statement.ja: iOSとiPadOSで短いsoundやvibrationを再生するにはsystem sound serviceを使う。

conditions: The app needs short audio or vibration feedback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0007.review_note: Narrowed the system-service recommendation to iOS and iPadOS short feedback.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0008.title: Prefer meaningful sound in visionOS

statement.en: Prefer playing meaningful sound in visionOS, especially during immersive moments.
statement.ja: visionOSでは、特にimmersive momentで意味のあるsoundを再生することを優先する。

conditions: Use sound to aid navigation and explain spatial qualities rather than adding sound without purpose.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0008.review_note: Made the generic preference meaningful and retained recommendation strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0009.title: Design custom sounds for custom visionOS UI elements

statement.en: For custom visionOS UI elements, design sounds that provide feedback and enhance the app's spatial experience.
statement.ja: customなvisionOS UI elementには、feedbackを提供しspatial experienceを高めるsoundを設計する。

conditions: System-provided elements already use sound for location and interaction feedback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0009.review_note: Recorded the custom-element condition and the feedback and spatial purposes.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0010.title: Use Spatial Audio for intuitive visionOS experiences

statement.en: Use Spatial Audio to make a visionOS experience intuitive, engaging, and lifelike.
statement.ja: visionOSの体験を直感的で魅力的かつlifelikeにするためSpatial Audioを使う。

conditions: Spatial Audio can originate from ambient space or a specific object, especially in immersive contexts.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0010.review_note: Made the platform and experiential goals explicit.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0011.title: Consider multiple spatial origins for visionOS sounds

statement.en: Consider defining multiple spatial origins for stationary or moving visionOS sound sources.
statement.ja: 静止または移動するvisionOS sound sourceに複数のspatial originを定義することを検討する。

conditions: Spatial origin helps people locate the object that produces a sound.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0011.review_note: Made the spatial-source purpose concrete without elevating consider guidance.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0012.title: Consider varying repetitive visionOS sounds

statement.en: Consider varying visionOS sounds that people may perceive as repetitive over time.
statement.ja: 時間とともに反復的に感じられる可能性があるvisionOS soundの変化を検討する。

conditions: The same sound repeats often enough to feel mechanical or fatiguing.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0012.review_note: Narrowed the optional variation to repetitive visionOS sounds.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0013.title: Encode watchOS audio as 64 kbps HE-AAC

statement.en: Use 64 kbps HE-AAC encoding for watchOS media audio assets.
statement.ja: watchOSのmedia audio assetには64 kbps HE-AAC encodingを使う。

conditions: The format provides good audio quality with lower data requirements.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0013.review_note: Recovered the exact encoding format and bitrate from supporting prose.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0015.title: Account for macOS notification sounds mixing with other audio

statement.en: Account for macOS notification sounds mixing with other audio by default.
statement.ja: macOSのnotification soundが既定で他のaudioとmixされることを考慮する。

conditions: The app's audio can play at the same time as a notification sound.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0015.review_note: Recovered the macOS default as a platform constraint rather than a mandatory app behavior.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0016.title: Design tvOS audio for user-initiated playback

statement.en: Design tvOS audio for playback that people initiate through app or game interactions or device calibration.
statement.ja: tvOSのaudioは、appやgameの操作またはdevice calibrationで利用者が開始する再生として設計する。

conditions: tvOS plays audio only after one of the documented initiation paths.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0016.review_note: Converted the system behavior into a conservative platform design constraint.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0017.title: Avoid sounds for tvOS alerts and notifications

statement.en: Avoid adding sounds to tvOS alerts or notifications.
statement.ja: tvOSのalertやnotificationにsoundを追加することを避ける。

conditions: The system does not play sounds to accompany these components.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0017.review_note: Recovered the documented example conservatively as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0018.title: Avoid communicating important information using sound alone

statement.en: Avoid communicating important information using sound alone.
statement.ja: 重要な情報をsoundだけで伝えることを避ける。

conditions: Important information needs a non-audio path for people who cannot hear it.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0018.review_note: Recovered the every-platform accessibility guidance and retained direct avoid strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0019.title: Always provide non-audio ways to understand important information

statement.en: Always provide non-audio ways to help people understand important information.
statement.ja: 重要な情報を理解できるよう、音声以外の方法を常に提供する。

conditions: Important information would otherwise rely on sound alone.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0019.review_note: Recovered the every-platform accessibility MUST from the explicit Always directive.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0020.title: Account for Now Playing audio pausing when its window closes

statement.en: Account for Now Playing audio pausing automatically when people close its visionOS app window.
statement.ja: visionOSでNow Playing appのwindowを閉じるとaudioが自動停止することを考慮する。

conditions: The app is the current Now Playing app.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0020.review_note: Recovered the automatic pause behavior as a platform constraint.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0021.title: Consider visionOS audio ducking when gaze moves away

statement.en: Consider that audio from a non-Now Playing visionOS app can duck when people look toward another app.
statement.ja: Now PlayingではないvisionOS appのaudioが別のappへ視線を移すとduckされる可能性を考慮する。

conditions: The app is not the current Now Playing app.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0021.review_note: Recovered the can-level ducking behavior as an optional platform consideration.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0022.title: Create meaningful visionOS sounds for navigation

statement.en: Create meaningful visionOS sounds that aid navigation and help people understand the app's spatial qualities.
statement.ja: navigationを助け、appのspatial qualityを理解できる意味のあるvisionOS soundを作る。

conditions: Evaluate sound opportunities throughout the design process.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0022.review_note: Separated the concrete navigation and spatial-understanding purposes from the general preference.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0023.title: Consider combining ambient and object-specific Spatial Audio

statement.en: Consider combining ambient and object-specific Spatial Audio in a visionOS soundscape.
statement.ja: visionOSのsoundscapeでambient audioとobject-specific Spatial Audioを組み合わせることを検討する。

conditions: Ambient audio can anchor a virtual world while an object-specific source can localize a sound.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0023.review_note: Recovered the two optional Spatial Audio types without elevating consider guidance.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0024.title: Consider randomizing pitch and volume for repetitive sounds

statement.en: Consider randomizing pitch and volume during playback to vary a repetitive visionOS sound efficiently.
statement.ja: 反復するvisionOS soundを効率よく変化させるため、再生中のpitchとvolumeのrandomizeを検討する。

conditions: Variation can replace creating multiple sound files.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0024.review_note: Recovered the optional implementation technique and preserved its efficiency rationale.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0025.title: Decide whether visionOS sound is wearer-fixed or tracked

statement.en: Decide whether each visionOS sound needs to be fixed to the wearer or tracked with an object.
statement.ja: 各visionOS soundをwearer-fixedにするかobjectに追従させるか決定する。

conditions: Fixed sound stays directed at the wearer; tracked sound changes with an object's position.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0025.review_note: Recovered the missing fixed-versus-tracked design decision and its perceptual distinction.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0026.title: Prefer tracked visionOS sound for realistic object audio

statement.en: Prefer tracked visionOS sound when tying audio to an object enhances realism.
statement.ja: audioをobjectに結びつけることでrealismが高まる場合はtracked visionOS soundを優先する。

conditions: Changes in object distance or position should change what people hear.
exceptions: Use fixed sound when an experience should envelop the wearer regardless of gaze or object movement.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0026.review_note: Separated the tracked-sound preference and preserved the documented fixed-sound exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0027.title: Consider short foreground audio in watchOS apps

statement.en: Consider playing short audio clips while a watchOS app is active in the foreground.
statement.ja: watchOS appがforegroundでactiveな間に短いaudio clipを再生することを検討する。

conditions: The system manages watchOS audio playback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0027.review_note: Recovered the foreground playback capability as MAY.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0028.title: Consider longer background audio in watchOS apps

statement.en: Consider playing longer watchOS audio that continues when people lower their wrist or switch apps.
statement.ja: 手首を下げたりappを切り替えたりしても継続する長いwatchOS audioの再生を検討する。

conditions: Use the system-supported background audio capability.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0028.review_note: Recovered the background playback capability as MAY and recorded its continuation conditions.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0029.title: Consider a watchOS Now Playing view

statement.en: Consider presenting a watchOS Now Playing view for controlling current or recently played audio without leaving the app.
statement.ja: appを離れず現在または最近再生したaudioを操作できるwatchOS Now Playing viewの表示を検討する。

conditions: The system view displays the current source and selects the current or most recently used source automatically.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-AUDIO-0029.review_note: Recovered the missing optional Now Playing view and its source-selection behavior.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0001.title: Use system haptic patterns for documented meanings

statement.en: Use system-provided haptic patterns only for their documented meanings.
statement.ja: system-provided haptic patternは文書化された意味にだけ使う。

conditions: A standard pattern's meaning fits the interaction.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0001.review_note: Retained SHOULD and made the documented semantic contract explicit.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0002.title: Use haptics consistently

statement.en: Use haptics consistently throughout an app or game.
statement.ja: appまたはgame全体でhapticを一貫して使う。

conditions: Do not reuse an associated pattern for a conflicting positive or negative outcome.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0002.review_note: Retained the consistency recommendation and recorded its outcome-association constraint.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0003.title: Use haptics to complement other feedback

statement.en: Use haptics to complement visual or auditory feedback.
statement.ja: visualまたはauditory feedbackを補完するためhapticを使う。

conditions: Coordinate feedback channels so the combined experience remains coherent.
