HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0003.review_note: Retained the complement-not-replace recommendation and separated its supporting design details.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0004.title: Avoid overusing haptics

statement.en: Avoid overusing haptics.
statement.ja: hapticの過剰使用を避ける。

conditions: Use testing to balance feedback frequency before it becomes tiring or loses meaning.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0004.review_note: Retained direct Avoid strength without promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0005.title: Let people disable or mute haptics

statement.en: Let people turn off or mute haptics.
statement.ja: 利用者がhapticをオフまたはミュートできるようにする。

conditions: Expose an effective optional-haptics control.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0005.review_note: Made the optionality action concrete and kept the separate haptic-free experience outcome atomic.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0006.title: Evaluate haptic effects on device-feature experiences

statement.en: Evaluate how haptic vibrations may affect other device-feature experiences.
statement.ja: haptic vibrationが他のdevice featureの体験へ与える影響を評価する。

conditions: Physical vibration can affect nearby sensing or capture hardware.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0006.review_note: Converted the awareness lead into a review action and separated the explicit Ensure outcome.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0027.title: Prefer short haptics for discrete events

statement.en: In most apps, prefer short haptics that complement discrete events.
statement.ja: 多くのappでは、離散的なeventを補完する短いhapticを優先する。

conditions: Long-running app haptics can dilute feedback meaning and distract from tasks.
exceptions: A long-running haptic may enhance a gameplay flow.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0027.review_note: Recovered the omitted duration recommendation and preserved its game exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0028.title: Avoid repurposing system haptic meanings

statement.en: Avoid assigning a system haptic pattern a meaning that conflicts with its documented use.
statement.ja: system haptic patternを文書化された用途と矛盾する意味へ転用しない。

conditions: The documented use case does not fit the intended interaction.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0028.review_note: Recovered the direct semantic-misuse warning and retained AVOID strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0029.title: Use a generic or custom haptic when needed

statement.en: Use a generic or custom haptic when no documented system pattern fits.
statement.ja: 文書化されたsystem patternが適合しない場合はgenericまたはcustom hapticを使う。

conditions: Custom haptics are available only on supported platforms and devices.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0029.review_note: Separated the source-provided alternative from the misuse warning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0030.title: Maintain causal relationships for haptics

statement.en: Maintain a clear causal relationship between each haptic and the action that triggers it.
statement.ja: 各hapticとそれを発生させるactionの明確な因果関係を保つ。

conditions: People need to learn a stable association between pattern and experience.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0030.review_note: Recovered the source's important causal-association requirement as SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0031.title: Match haptic qualities to animation

statement.en: Match a haptic's intensity and sharpness to the animation it accompanies.
statement.ja: hapticのintensityとsharpnessを付随するanimationに合わせる。

conditions: Visual and tactile feedback occur together.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0031.review_note: Recovered the generally-want matching recommendation without raising it to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0032.title: Consider synchronizing sound with haptics

statement.en: Consider synchronizing sound with haptics.
statement.ja: soundとhapticの同期を検討する。

conditions: Audio-tactile synchronization would make combined feedback more coherent.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0032.review_note: Recovered the can-level synchronization option as MAY.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0033.title: Ensure the experience works without haptics

statement.en: Ensure people can still enjoy the app or game without haptics.
statement.ja: hapticがなくてもappまたはgameを楽しめるようにする。

conditions: Haptics are disabled, muted, unavailable, or imperceptible.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0033.review_note: Recovered the explicit make-sure haptic-free outcome and kept it separate from the optionality control.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0034.title: Ensure haptics do not disrupt device features

statement.en: Ensure haptic vibrations do not disrupt the camera, gyroscope, or microphone.
statement.ja: haptic vibrationがcamera、gyroscope、microphoneを妨げないようにする。

conditions: The experience uses or depends on vibration-sensitive device features.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0034.review_note: Recovered the explicit Ensure requirement and named all three documented device features.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0035.title: Use iOS Success haptics for completed actions

statement.en: Use an iOS Success haptic when a task or action completes.
statement.ja: taskまたはactionが完了したときiOS Success hapticを使う。

conditions: The outcome is successful rather than a warning or error.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0035.review_note: Recovered the Success pattern's documented meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0036.title: Use iOS Warning haptics for warning outcomes

statement.en: Use an iOS Warning haptic when a task or action produces a warning.
statement.ja: taskまたはactionでwarningが生じたときiOS Warning hapticを使う。

conditions: The outcome is a warning rather than success or error.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0036.review_note: Recovered the Warning pattern's documented meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0037.title: Use iOS Error haptics for errors

statement.en: Use an iOS Error haptic when an error occurs.
statement.ja: errorが発生したときiOS Error hapticを使う。

conditions: The outcome is an error rather than success or warning.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0037.review_note: Recovered the Error pattern's documented meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0038.title: Use Light Impact haptics for small objects

statement.en: Use an iOS Light Impact haptic for a collision between small or lightweight UI objects.
statement.ja: smallまたはlightweightなUI objectの衝突にはiOS Light Impact hapticを使う。

conditions: The physical metaphor involves small or lightweight objects.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0038.review_note: Recovered the Light Impact style's documented collision meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0039.title: Use Medium Impact haptics for medium objects

statement.en: Use an iOS Medium Impact haptic for a collision between medium-sized or medium-weight UI objects.
statement.ja: medium-sizedまたはmedium-weightなUI objectの衝突にはiOS Medium Impact hapticを使う。

conditions: The physical metaphor involves medium-sized or medium-weight objects.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0039.review_note: Recovered the Medium Impact style's documented collision meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0040.title: Use Heavy Impact haptics for large objects

statement.en: Use an iOS Heavy Impact haptic for a collision between large or heavyweight UI objects.
statement.ja: largeまたはheavyweightなUI objectの衝突にはiOS Heavy Impact hapticを使う。

conditions: The physical metaphor involves large or heavyweight objects.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0040.review_note: Recovered the Heavy Impact style's documented collision meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0041.title: Use Rigid Impact haptics for hard objects

statement.en: Use an iOS Rigid Impact haptic for a collision between hard or inflexible UI objects.
statement.ja: hardまたはinflexibleなUI objectの衝突にはiOS Rigid Impact hapticを使う。

conditions: The physical metaphor involves hard or inflexible objects.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0041.review_note: Recovered the Rigid Impact style's documented collision meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0042.title: Use Soft Impact haptics for flexible objects

statement.en: Use an iOS Soft Impact haptic for a collision between soft or flexible UI objects.
statement.ja: softまたはflexibleなUI objectの衝突にはiOS Soft Impact hapticを使う。

conditions: The physical metaphor involves soft or flexible objects.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0042.review_note: Recovered the Soft Impact style's documented collision meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0043.title: Use Selection haptics while values change

statement.en: Use an iOS Selection haptic while a UI element's value changes.
statement.ja: UI elementの値が変化している間はiOS Selection hapticを使う。

conditions: The interaction moves among changing selectable values.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0043.review_note: Recovered the specific Selection pattern meaning separately from the category rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0007.title: Use standard iOS components with built-in haptics

statement.en: Use standard iOS components such as toggles, sliders, and pickers when their built-in system haptics fit the interaction.
statement.ja: built-in system hapticが操作に適する場合、toggle、slider、pickerなどstandard iOS componentを使う。

conditions: The iPhone model supports haptic feedback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0007.review_note: Made the component examples and supported-device condition explicit.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0008.title: Use an iOS feedback generator when predefined haptics fit

statement.en: When appropriate, use an iOS feedback generator for a predefined Notification, Impact, or Selection haptic.
statement.ja: 適切な場合、predefinedのNotification、Impact、Selection hapticにiOS feedback generatorを使う。

conditions: A predefined haptic category matches the interaction's meaning.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0008.review_note: Recovered the conditional generator option and all three predefined categories.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0009.title: Use iOS Notification haptics for task outcomes

statement.en: Use an iOS Notification haptic to communicate the outcome of a task or action.
statement.ja: taskまたはactionの結果を伝えるためiOS Notification hapticを使う。

conditions: The interaction completes with an outcome such as a successful deposit or unlock.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0009.review_note: Recovered the Notification category's documented meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0010.title: Use iOS Impact haptics as physical metaphors

statement.en: Use an iOS Impact haptic as a physical metaphor that complements a visual event.
statement.ja: visual eventを補完するphysical metaphorとしてiOS Impact hapticを使う。

conditions: A visual event such as snapping or collision benefits from corresponding physical feedback.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0010.review_note: Recovered the Impact category's visual-metaphor meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0011.title: Use iOS Selection haptics while values change

statement.en: Use an iOS Selection haptic while the value of a UI element changes.
statement.ja: UI elementの値が変化している間はiOS Selection hapticを使う。

conditions: A person is moving among discrete selectable values.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0011.review_note: Recovered the Selection category's changing-value meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0012.title: Consider Magic Trackpad haptics for drag or force click

statement.en: When a Magic Trackpad is available, consider a macOS haptic pattern for a drag operation or force click.
statement.ja: Magic Trackpadが利用できる場合、drag操作またはforce clickにmacOS haptic patternを使うことを検討する。

conditions: Choose among Alignment, Level change, and Generic patterns according to their meanings.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0012.review_note: Recovered the hardware-conditional capability as MAY.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0013.title: Use macOS Alignment haptics for alignment and boundaries

statement.en: Use the macOS Alignment haptic for dragged-item alignment, preferred positions, dimensions, or range boundaries.
statement.ja: dragged itemのalignment、preferred position、dimension、range boundaryにはmacOS Alignment hapticを使う。

conditions: A Magic Trackpad is available during a drag or force-click interaction.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0013.review_note: Recovered the Alignment pattern and its table-defined scenarios.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0014.title: Use macOS Level change haptics for pressure transitions

statement.en: Use the macOS Level change haptic when moving between discrete pressure levels.
statement.ja: 離散的なpressure level間を移動するときmacOS Level change hapticを使う。

conditions: A force-click interaction has meaningful discrete pressure levels.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0014.review_note: Recovered the Level change pattern and its pressure-level meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0015.title: Use macOS Generic haptics only as a fallback

statement.en: Use the macOS Generic haptic only when Alignment and Level change patterns do not apply.
statement.ja: AlignmentとLevel change patternが適用できない場合にだけmacOS Generic hapticを使う。

conditions: A Magic Trackpad haptic is appropriate but neither specialized meaning fits.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0015.review_note: Recovered the Generic pattern's fallback-only meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0016.title: Use default Digital Crown haptic detents

statement.en: Use the default linear Digital Crown haptic detents on supported Apple Watch models.
statement.ja: 対応するApple Watchではdefaultのlinear Digital Crown haptic detentを使う。

conditions: Apple Watch Series 4 or later provides detents as people rotate the Digital Crown; some controls add item-based detents.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0016.review_note: Recovered the supported-model constraint and default Digital Crown behavior.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0017.title: Use watchOS Notification haptics for significant events

statement.en: Use the watchOS Notification haptic for a significant or unusual event that requires attention.
statement.ja: 注意が必要な重大または通常外のeventにはwatchOS Notification hapticを使う。

conditions: The system uses the same haptic for local and remote notifications.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0017.review_note: Recovered the Notification meaning and its system-notification equivalence.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0018.title: Use watchOS Up haptics above important thresholds

statement.en: Use the watchOS Up haptic when an important value increases above a significant threshold.
statement.ja: 重要な値がsignificant thresholdを上回ったときwatchOS Up hapticを使う。

conditions: The threshold crossing is important to the person.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0018.review_note: Recovered the Up haptic's threshold meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0019.title: Use watchOS Down haptics below important thresholds

statement.en: Use the watchOS Down haptic when an important value decreases below a significant threshold.
statement.ja: 重要な値がsignificant thresholdを下回ったときwatchOS Down hapticを使う。

conditions: The threshold crossing is important to the person.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0019.review_note: Recovered the Down haptic's threshold meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0020.title: Use watchOS Success haptics for successful completion

statement.en: Use the watchOS Success haptic when an action completes successfully.
statement.ja: actionが正常に完了したときwatchOS Success hapticを使う。

conditions: The action has reached a successful final outcome.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0020.review_note: Recovered the Success haptic's completion meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0021.title: Use watchOS Failure haptics for failed actions

statement.en: Use the watchOS Failure haptic when an action fails.
statement.ja: actionが失敗したときwatchOS Failure hapticを使う。

conditions: The action failed without the specific retry meaning.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0021.review_note: Recovered the Failure haptic's failure meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0022.title: Use watchOS Retry haptics for retryable failures

statement.en: Use the watchOS Retry haptic when an action fails but the person can retry it.
statement.ja: actionが失敗しても再試行できるときwatchOS Retry hapticを使う。

conditions: A retry action remains available.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0022.review_note: Recovered the Retry haptic's retryable-failure meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0023.title: Use watchOS Start haptics for controllable activities

statement.en: Use the watchOS Start haptic when a person starts a timer or another activity they can explicitly stop.
statement.ja: 利用者が明示的に停止できるtimerなどのactivityを開始したときwatchOS Start hapticを使う。

conditions: A matching Stop haptic usually follows when the activity ends.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0023.review_note: Recovered the Start haptic's controllable-activity meaning and usual pairing.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0024.title: Use watchOS Stop haptics for previously started activities

statement.en: Use the watchOS Stop haptic when stopping a timer or another activity the person previously started.
statement.ja: 利用者が以前開始したtimerなどのactivityを停止するときwatchOS Stop hapticを使う。

conditions: The activity began through an explicit person-controlled start.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0024.review_note: Recovered the Stop haptic's paired stopping meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0025.title: Use watchOS Click haptics for incremental progress

statement.en: Use the watchOS Click haptic to communicate progress at predefined increments or intervals.
statement.ja: predefinedのincrementまたはintervalでprogressを伝えるためwatchOS Click hapticを使う。

conditions: Each click corresponds to a meaningful progress increment.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0025.review_note: Recovered the Click haptic's incremental-progress meaning.

HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0026.title: Avoid overusing or overlapping watchOS Click haptics

statement.en: Avoid overusing watchOS Click haptics or allowing clicks to overlap.
statement.ja: watchOS Click hapticの過剰使用やclickの重なりを避ける。

conditions: Overuse diminishes utility and overlapping clicks can be confusing.
HIG-PATTERNS-PLAYING-HAPTICS-0026.review_note: Separated the direct overuse warning from the positive Click mapping and retained AVOID strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0001.title: Request ratings only after demonstrated engagement

statement.en: Ask for a rating only after people demonstrate engagement with the app or game.
statement.ja: 利用者がappまたはgameへのengagementを示した後にだけratingを依頼する。

conditions: Use meaningful signals such as launches, explored features, completed levels, or significant tasks.
HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0001.review_note: Preserved the stable ID on the refreshed paragraph trace and made the engagement threshold concrete.

HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0002.title: Avoid interrupting active tasks with rating requests

statement.en: Avoid interrupting people with a rating request while they perform a task or play a game.
statement.ja: task実行中またはgame play中にrating requestで利用者を中断しない。

conditions: A rating request would disrupt the current activity.
HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0002.review_note: Preserved the stable ID on the refreshed trace and retained direct Avoid strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0003.title: Avoid pestering people for ratings

statement.en: Avoid pestering people with repeated rating requests.
statement.ja: rating requestを繰り返して利用者を困らせない。

conditions: Repeated prompts can irritate people and reduce their opinion of the app.
HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0003.review_note: Preserved the stable ID on the refreshed trace and separated interval and renewed-engagement options.

HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0004.title: Prefer the system rating prompt

statement.en: Prefer the system-provided rating and review prompt.
statement.ja: system-providedのrating and review promptを優先する。

conditions: The system checks prior feedback and limits prompts to three occurrences per app within 365 days.
HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0004.review_note: Preserved the stable ID, narrowed scope to the three documented platforms, and recorded system frequency control.

HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0005.title: Weigh summary-rating reset tradeoffs

statement.en: Weigh rating currency against rating count before resetting the summary rating.
statement.ja: summary ratingをresetする前にratingの新しさと件数を比較検討する。

conditions: A reset better reflects the current version but can reduce the visible rating count.
HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0005.review_note: Recovered the omitted reset decision and retained recommendation strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0006.title: Avoid rating requests on first launch or during onboarding

statement.en: Avoid requesting a rating on first launch or during onboarding.
statement.ja: first launchまたはonboarding中のrating requestを避ける。

conditions: People have not had enough time to understand the app's value or form an opinion.
HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0006.review_note: Separated the explicit timing warning from the positive engagement rule and retained AVOID strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0007.title: Use natural breaks for rating requests

statement.en: Use natural breaks or stopping points for rating requests.
statement.ja: rating requestには自然なbreakまたはstopping pointを使う。

conditions: The request is less likely to burden or disrupt the person at that point.
HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0007.review_note: Recovered the source's positive placement alternative to the interruption warning.

HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0008.title: Consider waiting between rating requests

statement.en: Consider waiting at least one or two weeks between rating requests.
statement.ja: rating requestの間を少なくとも1〜2週間空けることを検討する。

conditions: Another request remains appropriate after the prior prompt.
HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0008.review_note: Recovered the source's example interval and preserved Consider-level strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0009.title: Consider renewed engagement before another request

statement.en: Consider requesting another rating only after people demonstrate additional engagement.
statement.ja: 利用者が追加のengagementを示した後にだけratingを再依頼することを検討する。

conditions: A prior request has already appeared.
HIG-PATTERNS-RATINGS-AND-REVIEWS-0009.review_note: Separated the second Consider-governed option without promoting it to SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0001.title: Provide broadly effective default settings

statement.en: Provide defaults that give the best experience to the largest number of people.
statement.ja: 最大多数の利用者に最良の体験を与えるdefault settingsを提供する。

conditions: Use device-aware defaults so most people can begin without setup adjustments.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0001.review_note: Preserved the stable ID on the refreshed trace and retained the Aim-level recommendation.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0002.title: Minimize offered settings

statement.en: Minimize the number of settings the app or game offers.
statement.ja: appまたはgameが提供するsetting数を最小限にする。

conditions: Too many options reduce approachability and make individual settings harder to find.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0002.review_note: Preserved the stable ID on the refreshed trace and made the settings target explicit.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0003.title: Expose settings in expected ways

statement.en: Make settings available in ways people expect.
statement.ja: 利用者が期待する方法でsettingを利用できるようにする。

conditions: Follow platform and input conventions for opening settings.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0003.review_note: Preserved the stable ID and separated the two documented keyboard conventions.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0004.title: Avoid requesting detectable setup information

statement.en: Avoid using settings to request setup information the app or game can detect.
statement.ja: appまたはgameが検出できるsetup informationをsettingで尋ねない。

conditions: Detect connected controllers, accessories, and current system appearance automatically when available.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0004.review_note: Preserved the stable ID and retained direct Avoid strength without promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0005.title: Respect systemwide settings

statement.en: Respect people's systemwide settings throughout the app or game.
statement.ja: appまたはgame全体で利用者のsystemwide settingsを尊重する。

conditions: Apply choices such as accessibility accommodations, scrolling behavior, and authentication methods.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0005.review_note: Preserved the stable ID and split the adjacent redundant-custom-version warning into an AVOID rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0018.title: Put general infrequent options in custom settings

statement.en: Put general, infrequently changed options in the app's or game's custom settings area.
statement.ja: generalで変更頻度の低いoptionをappまたはgameのcustom settings areaに置く。

conditions: Opening the separate area suspends the person's current activity.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0018.review_note: Recovered the general-settings placement rule and its infrequent-change constraint.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0019.title: Keep task-specific options in context

statement.en: When possible, put task-specific options in the screens they affect.
statement.ja: 可能な場合、task-specific optionを影響対象のscreen内に置く。

conditions: In-context controls keep options discoverable and show results without suspending the task.
exceptions: Game players may adjust a task approach through gameplay rather than a settings option.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0019.review_note: Recovered the contextual placement recommendation and preserved the game-specific note.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0020.title: Limit system Settings entries to rare options

statement.en: Add only the most rarely changed options to the system-provided Settings app.
statement.ja: 変更頻度が最も低いoptionだけをsystem-provided Settings appへ追加する。

conditions: The platform supports app- or game-specific entries in system Settings.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0020.review_note: Recovered the system-settings placement rule and its rarely-changed threshold.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0021.title: Consider a direct system Settings button

statement.en: Consider providing a button that opens the app's or game's system Settings entry.
statement.ja: appまたはgameのsystem Settings entryを直接開くbuttonの提供を検討する。

conditions: The experience exposes settings through the system-provided Settings app.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0021.review_note: Separated the direct-navigation option and retained Consider-level strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0022.title: Support Command-Comma for settings

statement.en: Support Command-Comma for opening app settings when a physical keyboard is connected.
statement.ja: physical keyboard接続時はCommand-Commaでapp settingsを開けるようにする。

conditions: The platform and app context support the standard shortcut.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0022.review_note: Recovered the standard app-settings keyboard convention without inventing a narrower platform list.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0023.title: Support Escape for game settings

statement.en: Support Escape for opening game settings when a physical keyboard is connected.
statement.ja: physical keyboard接続時はEscapeでgame settingsを開けるようにする。

conditions: The experience is a game and the platform supports the convention.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0023.review_note: Recovered the game-specific physical-keyboard convention as a separate rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0024.title: Avoid redundant custom systemwide settings

statement.en: Avoid including redundant custom versions of systemwide settings.
statement.ja: systemwide settingを重複するcustom versionとして含めない。

conditions: A custom duplicate could imply that the system choice does not apply or affects other apps.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0024.review_note: Separated the direct redundancy warning from the positive systemwide-settings rule and retained AVOID strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0006.title: Include a Settings item in the macOS App menu

statement.en: Include a Settings item in the macOS App menu.
statement.ja: macOSのApp menuにSettings項目を含める。

conditions: Choosing the item opens the app's or game's custom settings window.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0006.review_note: Repaired the generic generated statement and narrowed portability to the macOS platform section.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0007.title: Avoid settings buttons in macOS window toolbars

statement.en: Avoid adding settings buttons to a macOS window toolbar.
statement.ja: macOS windowのtoolbarにsettings buttonを追加しない。

conditions: Reserve toolbar space for essential commands people use frequently.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0007.review_note: Separated the toolbar-placement warning from the App-menu recommendation and retained AVOID strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0008.title: Put document-level settings in the macOS File menu

statement.en: Put document-level settings in the macOS File menu.
statement.ja: document-levelのsettingはmacOSのFile menuに置く。

conditions: The options affect the current document rather than the entire app.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0008.review_note: Recovered the separate menu location for document-scoped options.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0009.title: Dim macOS settings-window minimize and maximize buttons

statement.en: Dim the minimize and maximize buttons in a macOS settings window.
statement.ja: macOS settings windowのminimize buttonとmaximize buttonをdim表示する。

conditions: The standard keyboard command can quickly reopen the window.
The window already accommodates the current pane's size.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0009.review_note: Recovered both window-button states and their reopen and pane-sizing rationale.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0010.title: Use a noncustomizable macOS settings toolbar

statement.en: Use a noncustomizable toolbar in a macOS settings window.
statement.ja: macOS settings windowではcustomize不可のtoolbarを使う。

conditions: The toolbar identifies customization areas and supports navigation among them.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0010.review_note: Separated toolbar customizability from visibility and selection-state requirements.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0011.title: Keep the macOS settings toolbar visible

statement.en: Keep the toolbar in a macOS settings window visible.
statement.ja: macOS settings windowのtoolbarを表示したままにする。

conditions: A stable interface helps people find settings areas.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0011.review_note: Separated the persistent-visibility requirement from the shared toolbar sentence.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0012.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Always clause and kept it atomic from toolbar customizability and visibility.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0013.title: Match the macOS settings-window title to the current pane

statement.en: Match the macOS settings-window title to the currently visible pane.
statement.ja: macOS settings windowのtitleを現在表示中のpaneに合わせる。

conditions: The settings window contains multiple panes.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0013.review_note: Recovered the dynamic title-to-pane mapping and its multi-pane condition.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0014.title: Use App Name Settings for a single-pane settings window

statement.en: Use App Name Settings as the title of a single-pane macOS settings window.
statement.ja: single-paneのmacOS settings windowにはApp Name Settingsというtitleを使う。

conditions: The settings window doesn't contain multiple panes.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0014.review_note: Separated the documented single-pane title from the multi-pane dynamic-title rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0015.title: Restore the most recently viewed macOS settings pane

statement.en: Reopen a macOS settings window to the most recently viewed pane.
statement.ja: macOS settings windowを直近に表示したpaneで再度開く。

conditions: People may adjust related settings more than once.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0015.review_note: Recovered the last-viewed-pane restoration behavior and its repeat-adjustment rationale.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0016.title: Avoid relying on watchOS Settings for custom app settings

statement.en: Avoid relying on the system-provided watchOS Settings app for custom app or game settings.
statement.ja: customなappまたはgameのsettingをsystem-providedのwatchOS Settings appに依存させない。

conditions: watchOS apps and games don't add custom settings to the system Settings app.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0016.review_note: Recorded the platform limitation conservatively as AVOID rather than promoting descriptive wording to MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0017.title: Consider in-app access to essential watchOS options

statement.en: Consider exposing a few essential watchOS options in the main view or a More menu.
statement.ja: 少数のessentialなwatchOS optionをmain viewまたはMore menuで提供することを検討する。

conditions: Use the More menu alternative when people need to reconfigure objects.
HIG-PATTERNS-SETTINGS-0017.review_note: Recovered both source-provided in-app alternatives and preserved the conditional consider strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0001.title: Avoid irrelevant information during active workouts

statement.en: Avoid showing information that is unrelated to the active workout.
statement.ja: 進行中のworkoutに関係しないinformationを表示しない。

conditions: Keep workout selection and unrelated app areas out of the active-session flow.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0001.review_note: Preserved direct Avoid strength and separated the illustrative three-screen watchOS arrangement from the rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0002.title: Give active workouts a distinct visual appearance

statement.en: Give an active workout a distinct visual appearance.
statement.ja: active workoutにdistinctなvisual appearanceを与える。

conditions: Help people recognize an active session at a glance.
exceptions: Updating metrics and a unique metrics layout are documented techniques, not mandatory implementations.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0002.review_note: Preserved SHOULD and recorded the active-state purpose without turning optional metrics-screen techniques into requirements.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0003.title: Make workout controls easy to find and tap

statement.en: Make workout controls easy to find and tap.
statement.ja: workout controlを見つけやすくtapしやすくする。

conditions: Make pausing, resuming, and stopping a workout easy.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0003.review_note: Preserved the touch-oriented control recommendation and split the explicit feedback requirement into a separate MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0004.title: Explain recorded health data when sensors are unavailable

statement.en: When workout sensors are unavailable, explain which health information the app can still record.
statement.ja: workout sensorを利用できない場合もappが記録できるhealth informationを説明する。

conditions: Account for situations such as water preventing heart-rate measurements while other workout data remains available.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0004.review_note: Restored the unavailable-sensor condition and separated the system-language guidance for supported swim workout types.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0005.title: Provide an end-of-workout summary

statement.en: Provide a summary when a workout session ends.
statement.ja: workout session終了時にsummaryを提供する。

conditions: Confirm that the workout finished and display its recorded information.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0005.review_note: Preserved the completion summary recommendation and split the optional Activity rings enhancement.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0006.title: Ensure workout text remains legible during movement

statement.en: Ensure workout text remains legible while people are moving.
statement.ja: 利用者が動いている間もworkout textをlegibleに保つ。

conditions: Apply when a workout session requires movement.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0006.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure directive and split its three legibility techniques into atomic recommendations.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0007.title: Use Activity rings only for their documented purpose

statement.en: Use Activity rings only for their documented purpose.
statement.ja: Activity ringsをdocumented purposeにだけ使用する。

conditions: Preserve the colors and meanings defined by the Activity app and related Activity rings guidance.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0007.review_note: Replaced the vague correctness wording with the documented-purpose boundary without promoting the source's Use phrasing to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0008.title: Use workout sessions in watchOS fitness apps

statement.en: Use workout sessions to provide useful data and relevant controls in a watchOS fitness app.
statement.ja: watchOS fitness appではworkout sessionでuseful dataとrelevant controlを提供する。

conditions: The app offers an active fitness experience on Apple Watch.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0008.review_note: Recovered the omitted watchOS workout-session recommendation and narrowed its platform scope.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0009.title: Prioritize useful watchOS workout data

statement.en: Prioritize the workout data people are most likely to care about in active watchOS sessions.
statement.ja: activeなwatchOS sessionでは利用者が最も重視するworkout dataを優先する。

conditions: Useful examples include time, calories, distance, and relevant lap or interval controls.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0009.review_note: Separated the persistent active-session data priority from the general workout-session recommendation.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0010.title: Ensure clear workout start and stop feedback

statement.en: Ensure clear feedback indicates when a workout session starts or stops.
statement.ja: workout sessionの開始または停止をclear feedbackで示す。

conditions: Apply the feedback to both session-start and session-stop transitions.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0010.review_note: Recovered the embedded Be sure directive as an atomic MUST separate from control discoverability.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0011.title: Match system wording for unavailable swim sensor data

statement.en: For Swimming or Other workouts, use system-like wording to explain unavailable sensor data.
statement.ja: SwimmingまたはOther workoutでは利用できないsensor dataをsystemに近いwordingで説明する。

conditions: The watchOS app supports the Swimming or Other workout type.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0011.review_note: Recovered the conditional watchOS writing guidance without persisting the full system example text.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0012.title: Consider Activity rings in workout summaries

statement.en: Consider including Activity rings in an end-of-workout summary.
statement.ja: workout終了時のsummaryにActivity ringsを含めることを検討する。

conditions: Use rings to help people check their current activity progress.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0012.review_note: Separated the optional summary enhancement and retained Consider-level strength.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0013.title: Discard or confirm extremely brief workout sessions

statement.en: When a workout ends after a few seconds, discard its data or ask whether to record it.
statement.ja: workoutが数秒で終了した場合はdataを破棄するか記録するか確認する。

conditions: Treat both automatic discard and explicit confirmation as documented alternatives.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0013.review_note: Recovered the omitted brief-session rule and preserved its two alternative outcomes.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0014.title: Use large workout text during movement

statement.en: Use large font sizes when a workout session requires movement.
statement.ja: movementを伴うworkout sessionではlarge font sizeを使う。

conditions: Support the mandatory legibility outcome while people are moving.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0014.review_note: Separated the large-text technique from the Make sure legibility outcome and retained SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0015.title: Use high-contrast workout colors during movement

statement.en: Use high-contrast colors when a workout session requires movement.
statement.ja: movementを伴うworkout sessionではhigh-contrast colorを使う。

conditions: Support the mandatory legibility outcome while people are moving.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0015.review_note: Separated the contrast technique from the Make sure legibility outcome and retained SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0016.title: Keep important workout information easy to read

statement.en: Arrange workout text so the most important information remains easy to read during movement.
statement.ja: movement中も最重要のworkout informationを読みやすくなるようtextを配置する。

conditions: Prioritize information hierarchy within the mandatory movement-legibility outcome.
HIG-PATTERNS-WORKOUTS-0016.review_note: Separated information hierarchy from font size and contrast while retaining SHOULD.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0001.title: Prefer the system-provided media player

statement.en: Prefer the system-provided player for media playback.
statement.ja: media playbackにはsystem-provided playerを優先する。

conditions: Use its standard controls, accessibility features, AirPlay support, and familiar system experience.
exceptions: Consider a custom video player only when the system player cannot meet the app's needs.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0001.review_note: Preserved Prefer strength and separated the conditional custom-player option.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0002.title: Provide the highest possible AirPlay resolution

statement.en: Provide AirPlay content at the highest possible resolution.
statement.ja: AirPlay contentを可能な限り最高のresolutionで提供する。

conditions: Let AVFoundation select a device-appropriate resolution from the available HLS variants.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0002.review_note: Preserved the quality recommendation and split the explicit HLS playlist requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0003.title: Support AirPlay streaming and mirroring

statement.en: Support both AirPlay streaming and mirroring.
statement.ja: AirPlay streamingとmirroringの両方をsupportする。

conditions: Supporting both modes gives people more playback flexibility.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0003.review_note: Retained the two-mode recommendation and its flexibility rationale.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0004.title: Support AirPlay remote control events

statement.en: Support remote control events during AirPlay playback.
statement.ja: AirPlay playback中のremote control eventをsupportする。

conditions: Enable actions such as play, pause, and fast-forward from the lock screen, Siri, or HomePod.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0004.review_note: Recorded the documented remote-control surfaces and example actions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0005.title: Avoid stopping AirPlay in the background or on lock

statement.en: Avoid stopping AirPlay playback when the app enters the background or the device locks.
statement.ja: appがbackgroundへ移行した場合やdevice lock時にAirPlay playbackを停止しない。

conditions: Preserve playback while people use another app or put the source device to sleep.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0005.review_note: Retained direct Don't guidance at AVOID and separated the explicit automatic-mirroring restriction.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0006.title: Avoid interrupting existing playback with nonimmersive content

statement.en: Avoid interrupting another app's playback unless the app starts immersive content.
statement.ja: appがimmersive contentを開始する場合を除き他appのplaybackを中断しない。

conditions: Keep launch videos and autoplaying inline videos local while current external playback continues.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0006.review_note: Preserved the immersive-content exception and retained direct Don't guidance at AVOID.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0007.title: Keep the rest of the app usable during AirPlay

statement.en: Let people use other parts of the app during AirPlay playback.
statement.ja: AirPlay playback中もappの他部分を利用できるようにする。

conditions: Navigation away from the playback screen remains available.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0007.review_note: Preserved the navigation recommendation and split two explicit continuity requirements.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0008.title: Align AirPlay icon treatment with other technology icons

statement.en: Position and present the AirPlay icon consistently with other technology icons.
statement.ja: AirPlay iconのpositionとpresentationを他のtechnology iconと一貫させる。

conditions: If other technology icons appear within shapes, the AirPlay icon may use the same treatment.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0008.review_note: Replaced the generic paraphrase and preserved the conditional shape treatment.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0009.title: Avoid AirPlay branding in custom interactive elements

statement.en: Avoid using the AirPlay icon or name in custom buttons or interactive elements.
statement.ja: custom buttonやinteractive elementでAirPlay iconまたはnameを使わない。

conditions: Use the AirPlay icon and name only in noninteractive presentations.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0009.review_note: Retained direct Don't guidance at AVOID and recorded the noninteractive boundary.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0010.title: Capitalize AirPlay correctly

statement.en: Write AirPlay as one word with uppercase A and P.
statement.ja: AirPlayをuppercaseのAとPを持つ1語として表記する。

conditions: Use lowercase letters after the initial A and internal P.
exceptions: Use all uppercase when the surrounding designation style is exclusively uppercase.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0010.review_note: Recorded the exact capitalization pattern and its all-uppercase layout exception.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0011.title: Always use AirPlay as a noun

statement.en: Use AirPlay as a noun in every applicable reference.
statement.ja: 該当するすべてのreferenceでAirPlayをnounとして使う。

conditions: Do not use AirPlay as a verb.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0011.review_note: Retained MUST from the unqualified Always directive and recorded the noun-versus-verb boundary.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0012.title: Use approved compatibility terms with AirPlay

statement.en: Describe AirPlay relationships with terms such as works with, use, supports, or compatible.
statement.ja: AirPlayとのrelationをworks with、use、supports、compatibleなどで表現する。

conditions: Avoid wording that treats AirPlay as an app-owned feature or action.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0012.review_note: Recorded the documented relationship vocabulary without storing the full examples table.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0013.title: Optionally pair Apple with the AirPlay name

statement.en: Consider using the name Apple together with AirPlay when desired.
statement.ja: 必要に応じてAppleのnameをAirPlayと一緒に使うことを検討する。

conditions: The wording benefits from naming Apple explicitly.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0013.review_note: Corrected generated SHOULD to MAY because the source explicitly makes the Apple name optional.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0014.title: Mention AirPlay when it adds clarity

statement.en: Consider referring to AirPlay when it adds clarity or belongs in technical specifications.
statement.ja: clarityを加える場合やtechnical specificationではAirPlayへの言及を検討する。

conditions: The content is specific to AirPlay or the technical specification needs the technology name.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0014.review_note: Corrected generated SHOULD to MAY based on the source's conditional can-use wording.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0015.title: Consider a custom video player only when necessary

statement.en: Consider a custom video player only when the system-provided player cannot meet the app's needs.
statement.ja: system-provided playerがappのneedsを満たせない場合にだけcustom video playerを検討する。

conditions: Evaluate the system player's controls, accessibility features, consistency, and AirPlay support first.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0015.review_note: Recovered the conditional custom-player option and retained Consider-level strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0016.title: Include the full resolution range in HLS playlists

statement.en: Ensure each HLS playlist includes the full range of available content resolutions.
statement.ja: 各HLS playlistに利用可能なcontent resolutionの全範囲を含める。

conditions: Provide variants that let AVFoundation select a resolution appropriate for the playback device.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0016.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit needs-to requirement and kept it separate from the quality recommendation.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0017.title: Stream only expected content through AirPlay

statement.en: Use AirPlay to stream only the content people expect.
statement.ja: 利用者が期待するcontentだけをAirPlayでstreamする。

conditions: Exclude background loops and short videos that make sense only within the local app context.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0017.review_note: Recovered the omitted content-expectation boundary and retained SHOULD.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0018.title: Never mirror unrelated content without explicit choice

statement.en: Never mirror unrelated device content automatically while background AirPlay playback continues.
statement.ja: backgroundのAirPlay playback継続中に無関係なdevice contentを自動mirroringしない。

conditions: Require an explicit user choice before streaming other device content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0018.review_note: Recovered the crucial explicit-intent prohibition as a source-scoped MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0019.title: Keep the app functional while AirPlay is active

statement.en: Ensure the app remains functional while AirPlay is active.
statement.ja: AirPlay active中もappをfunctionalに保つ。

conditions: People may navigate away from the playback screen while streaming continues.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0019.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit needs-to-remain-functional requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0020.title: Prevent other videos from interrupting AirPlay

statement.en: Ensure other in-app videos do not interrupt active AirPlay playback after navigation.
statement.ja: navigation後に他のin-app videoがactive AirPlay playbackを中断しないようにする。

conditions: Apply after people leave the original playback screen.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0020.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Make sure directive and kept it separate from general app usability.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0021.title: Provide intuitive AirPlay entry in custom players

statement.en: Give a necessary custom media player an intuitive way to enter AirPlay.
statement.ja: 必要なcustom media playerにAirPlayへ入るintuitiveな方法を提供する。

conditions: The system-provided media player cannot meet the app's needs.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0021.review_note: Recovered the custom-player entry recommendation while preserving its fallback condition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0022.title: Match custom AirPlay buttons to system controls

statement.en: Ensure custom AirPlay buttons match system-provided controls in appearance and behavior.
statement.ja: custom AirPlay buttonのappearanceとbehaviorをsystem-provided controlに合わせる。

conditions: The app cannot use the system-provided media player.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0022.review_note: Recovered the first atomic MUST from the explicit Be sure directive.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0023.title: Show distinct states in custom AirPlay buttons

statement.en: Ensure custom AirPlay buttons show distinct starting, active, and unavailable states.
statement.ja: custom AirPlay buttonでstarting、active、unavailableのdistinct stateを示す。

conditions: The app cannot use the system-provided media player.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0023.review_note: Recovered the second atomic MUST from the Be sure directive's included state requirements.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0024.title: Use Apple-provided symbols for AirPlay controls

statement.en: Use only Apple-provided symbols in custom controls that initiate AirPlay.
statement.ja: AirPlayを開始するcustom controlではApple-provided symbolだけを使う。

conditions: Apply to custom media-player controls that start AirPlay.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0024.review_note: Recovered the Apple-symbol boundary and retained SHOULD rather than inventing an unsupported MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0025.title: Put the AirPlay icon in the custom player's lower-right

statement.en: Place the AirPlay icon in a custom player's lower-right corner on supported iOS and iPadOS versions.
statement.ja: support対象のiOSとiPadOSでcustom playerのlower-right cornerにAirPlay iconを置く。

conditions: Apply on iOS 16 and iPadOS 16 or later.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0025.review_note: Recovered the platform-versioned icon placement and narrowed its scope to iOS and iPadOS.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0026.title: Use the black AirPlay icon with matching light layouts

statement.en: Use the black AirPlay icon on light backgrounds when other technology icons are black.
statement.ja: 他のtechnology iconがblackならlight background上でblack AirPlay iconを使う。

conditions: The layout uses white or another light background.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0026.review_note: Recovered the black-icon background and neighboring-icon color conditions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0027.title: Use the white AirPlay icon with matching dark layouts

statement.en: Use the white AirPlay icon on dark backgrounds when other technology icons are white.
statement.ja: 他のtechnology iconがwhiteならdark background上でwhite AirPlay iconを使う。

conditions: The layout uses black or another dark background.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0027.review_note: Recovered the white-icon background and neighboring-icon color conditions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0028.title: Match a custom AirPlay icon color to other technology icons

statement.en: Use a custom AirPlay icon color only when other technology icons use the same color.
statement.ja: 他のtechnology iconが同色の場合にだけcustom AirPlay icon colorを使う。

conditions: Keep technology-icon color treatment consistent within the layout.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0028.review_note: Recovered the custom-color option and its same-color condition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0029.title: Pair the AirPlay icon and name consistently

statement.en: Place the AirPlay name beside or below its icon when other technologies use the same labeling pattern.
statement.ja: 他technologyが同じlabel patternならAirPlay nameをiconの横または下に置く。

conditions: Use the combined icon-and-name treatment only when the layout labels other technologies similarly.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0029.review_note: Recovered the conditional icon-and-name pairing and both permitted positions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0030.title: Use the layout font for the AirPlay name

statement.en: Use the layout's existing font when displaying the AirPlay name.
statement.ja: AirPlay nameの表示にはlayoutで使用中のfontを使う。

conditions: Apply when text accompanies the AirPlay icon.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0030.review_note: Separated font consistency from icon-and-name placement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0031.title: Avoid using the AirPlay icon as text

statement.en: Avoid placing the AirPlay icon within text or using it instead of the AirPlay name.
statement.ja: AirPlay iconをtext内に置いたりAirPlay nameの代わりに使ったりしない。

conditions: Keep the technology name textual when prose or labeling requires it.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0031.review_note: Recovered the direct Avoid clause and retained AVOID rather than promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0032.title: Emphasize the app identity over AirPlay

statement.en: Make AirPlay references less prominent than the app's name or main identity.
statement.ja: AirPlay referenceをappのnameやmain identityより目立たせない。

conditions: Preserve the app as the primary identity in the layout.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-AIRPLAY-0032.review_note: Recovered the omitted brand-hierarchy recommendation and its explicit prominence comparison.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0001.title: Keep appropriate personal information glanceable in Always On

statement.en: Keep nonsensitive personal information glanceable in Always On when it makes sense.
statement.ja: 適切な場合、sensitiveでないpersonal informationをAlways Onでglanceableに保つ。

conditions: Useful examples include workout updates on Apple Watch and timely travel or ride updates on iPhone.
exceptions: People can turn off Always On when they don't want information to remain visible.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0001.review_note: Preserved the source condition, clarified that sensitive content is excluded, and recorded examples and opt-out behavior.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0002.title: Keep important Always On content legible

statement.en: Keep important content legible in the Always On state.
statement.ja: Always On stateで重要なcontentをlegibleに保つ。

conditions: Use hierarchy and contrast to preserve prominence for important information.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0002.review_note: Narrowed the existing combined lead to the important-content legibility action.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0003.title: Maintain a consistent Always On layout

statement.en: Maintain a consistent layout throughout the Always On experience.
statement.ja: Always On experienceを通してlayoutを一貫させる。

conditions: Preserve spatial continuity as Always On begins, continues, and ends.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0003.review_note: Repaired the generic generated statement and recorded the full state-transition scope.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0004.review_note: Retained the privacy requirement at MUST because the source calls redaction crucial and gives sensitive financial and health examples.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0005.review_note: Recovered the separate notification privacy MUST from the explicit you need directive.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0006.title: Dim nonessential Always On content

statement.en: Dim nonessential content in the Always On state.
statement.ja: Always On stateではessentialでないcontentをdim表示する。

conditions: Secondary text, images, color fills, row backgrounds, and additional details can receive less prominence.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0006.review_note: Separated nonessential-content dimming from important-content legibility and preserved the documented targets.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0007.title: Consider simplifying rich imagery and color in Always On

statement.en: When Always On content uses rich images or large color areas, consider removing images and using dimmed colors.
statement.ja: Always On contentでrich imageや大きなcolor areaを使う場合、imageの削除とdimmed colorを検討する。

conditions: The imagery or color would otherwise compete with important information.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0007.review_note: Recovered the image-and-color option and preserved its conditional consider strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0008.title: Avoid distracting Always On interface changes

statement.en: Avoid distracting interface changes when Always On begins or ends and throughout the experience.
statement.ja: Always Onの開始時、終了時、experience中のdistractingなinterface changeを避ける。

conditions: Unnecessary iPhone changes can remain visible when the device lies face up.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0008.review_note: Separated the direct change warning and retained its start, duration, and end scope.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0009.title: Prefer unavailable appearance over removal in Always On

statement.en: When Always On begins, prefer transitioning an interactive component to an unavailable appearance instead of removing it.
statement.ja: Always On開始時はinteractive componentを削除せずunavailable appearanceへtransitionすることを優先する。

conditions: The component becomes unavailable while Always On is active.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0009.review_note: Recovered the preferred state transition and the explicit removal alternative.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0010.title: Keep Always On interface updates infrequent and subtle

statement.en: Aim to make Always On interface updates infrequent and subtle.
statement.ja: Always Onのinterface updateをinfrequentかつsubtleにする。

conditions: Pause granular updates when a less frequent meaningful update is sufficient.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0010.review_note: Recovered the update-frequency and subtlety guidance without strengthening the source's aim wording.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0011.title: Transition Always On motion gracefully to rest

statement.en: Transition motion gracefully to a resting state as Always On begins.
statement.ja: Always On開始時にmotionをresting stateへgracefulにtransitionする。

conditions: Smoothly finish the current motion to communicate the state change.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0011.review_note: Separated the positive transition behavior from the instant-stop warning.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0012.title: Avoid stopping motion instantly in Always On

statement.en: Avoid stopping motion instantly when Always On begins.
statement.ja: Always On開始時にmotionを即座に停止しない。

conditions: An abrupt stop can make people think something went wrong.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0012.review_note: Separated the embedded don't clause and retained it at AVOID rather than promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0013.title: Avoid relying on Always On on unsupported platforms

statement.en: Avoid relying on Always On in iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, or visionOS.
statement.ja: iPadOS、macOS、tvOS、visionOSではAlways Onに依存しない。

conditions: The documented Always On experience is supported on iOS and watchOS only.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-ALWAYS-ON-0013.review_note: Recorded unsupported platforms conservatively as AVOID rather than converting descriptive support text to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0001.review_note: Applied the explicit app-submission privacy-policy requirement and privacy priority.

statement.en: Use the CareKit simple style for a one-step task.
statement.ja: one-step taskにはCareKit simple styleを使う。

conditions: The default view has a title, subtitle, and completion button.
exceptions: Consider another style when the task needs additional content because the default simple view has no content stack.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0002.review_note: Recorded the one-step scope, default elements, and no-content-stack exception.

statement.en: Use the CareKit instructions style when a simple task needs informative text.
statement.ja: simple taskにinformative textが必要な場合はCareKit instructions styleを使う。

conditions: The task remains single-step but needs information such as medication timing.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0003.review_note: Preserved the conditional distinction from the simple task style.

statement.en: Use the CareKit log style to help people record events.
statement.ja: eventの記録を支援するためCareKit log styleを使う。

conditions: The task can add a timestamp each time a person logs an event.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0004.review_note: Recorded the event-logging purpose and automatic timestamp capability.

statement.en: Use the CareKit checklist style for a list of actions or steps in a multistep task.
statement.ja: multistep taskのactionまたはstep一覧にはCareKit checklist styleを使う。

conditions: Each item can include a description and a completion button; instructional text can appear below the list.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0005.review_note: Recorded item-level completion and optional instructional-text behavior.

statement.en: Use the CareKit grid style for a compact grid of buttons in a multistep task.
statement.ja: multistep taskをcompactなbutton gridで示すためCareKit grid styleを使う。

conditions: Use succinct button titles and the underlying collection view when custom grid UI is needed.
exceptions: Prefer the checklist style when each button needs additional description.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0006.review_note: Recorded compactness, title length, custom UI access, and the checklist alternative.

statement.en: Consider using color to reinforce the meaning of CareKit task items.
statement.ja: CareKit task itemの意味を補強するためcolorの使用を検討する。

conditions: Use color to improve at-a-glance categorization while another cue also conveys the meaning.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0007.review_note: Preserved optional color reinforcement and separated the color-only prohibition.

statement.en: Consider supplementing multistep or complex CareKit tasks with videos or images.
statement.ja: multistepまたはcomplexなCareKit taskをvideoやimageで補うことを検討する。

conditions: A visual demonstration can help people avoid mistakes.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0008.review_note: Preserved the task-complexity condition and error-prevention purpose.

statement.en: Consider highlighting narratives and trends in CareKit charts to illustrate progress.
statement.ja: progressを示すためCareKit chartでnarrativeやtrendを強調することを検討する。

conditions: A meaningful correlation can help people understand progress or adherence.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0009.review_note: Recorded the progress and adherence purpose without strengthening consider.

statement.en: Use distinct colors in CareKit charts.
statement.ja: CareKit chartではdistinctなcolorを使う。

conditions: Different data meanings need visually distinct categories.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0010.review_note: Kept the positive color distinction atomic from same-shade avoidance and contrast.

statement.en: Consider a concise CareKit chart legend when data colors aren't immediately clear.
statement.ja: data colorがすぐ理解できない場合は簡潔なCareKit chart legendを検討する。

conditions: The legend clearly and succinctly describes each represented data type.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0011.review_note: Preserved the unclear-color condition and optional legend strength.

statement.en: Consider using color to categorize CareKit care-team members.
statement.ja: CareKitのcare-team memberを分類するためcolorの使用を検討する。

conditions: Color helps people identify team-member categories at a glance.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0012.review_note: Preserved the optional at-a-glance categorization purpose.

statement.en: Minimize CareKit notifications.
statement.ja: CareKit notificationを最小限にする。

conditions: Use notifications sparingly across care plans with varying numbers of daily tasks.
When possible, consider combining multiple items into one notification.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0013.review_note: Recorded workload variation, sparing delivery, and conditional coalescing.

statement.en: Consider a CareKit notification detail view for information and immediate actions.
statement.ja: 情報表示と即時actionのためCareKit notification detail viewを検討する。

conditions: People can act without leaving the current context to open the app.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0014.review_note: Recorded both the information and in-context action purposes.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0015.review_note: Retained the symbol-relevance requirement separately from decorative and corporate-logo avoidance.

statement.en: Clearly identify the time units used in CareKit charts.
statement.ja: CareKit chartで使用するtime unitを明確に示す。

conditions: Show seconds, minutes, hours, days, weeks, months, or years in value labels, an axis label, or elsewhere on the chart.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0017.review_note: Recorded every documented unit and allowed label location.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0018.review_note: Applied the explicit permission-before-access MUST and privacy priority.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0019.review_note: Applied the separate all-sources data-protection MUST and privacy priority.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0020.title: Request HealthKit access only when needed

statement.en: Request HealthKit data access only when the app needs it in the current context.
statement.ja: current contextでappが必要とするときだけHealthKit data accessを要求する。

conditions: Request relevant data during the related action rather than immediately after launch.
Because permissions can change, make a request each time access is needed.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0020.review_note: Recorded need, contextual timing, launch avoidance, and mutable-permission behavior.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0021.title: Add descriptive messages to the standard HealthKit permission screen

statement.en: Add descriptive intent messages to the standard HealthKit permission screen.
statement.ja: standard HealthKit permission screenにintentを説明するmessageを追加する。

conditions: People expect the system-provided screen when approving health-data access.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0021.review_note: Recorded the standard-screen expectation and app-intent purpose.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0022.title: Explain HealthKit data need and sharing benefits succinctly

statement.en: Use a few succinct sentences to explain why health information is needed and how sharing benefits people.
statement.ja: health informationが必要な理由とsharingのbenefitを少数の簡潔な文で説明する。

conditions: The text appears in the standard HealthKit permission experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0022.review_note: Recovered both required message dimensions and the succinct-copy constraint.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0023.title: Avoid custom replicas of the HealthKit permission screen

statement.en: Avoid custom screens that replicate the standard HealthKit permission screen's behavior or content.
statement.ja: standard HealthKit permission screenのbehaviorまたはcontentを複製するcustom screenを避ける。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0023.review_note: Separated the custom-screen prohibition and retained AVOID strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0024.review_note: Applied the system-only HealthKit sharing requirement and privacy priority.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0025.title: Avoid in-app screens that alter HealthKit data flow

statement.en: Avoid adding in-app screens that affect the flow of HealthKit data.
statement.ja: HealthKit dataのflowに影響するin-app screenを追加しない。

conditions: Additional controls can confuse people about global health-data access.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0025.review_note: Separated the additional-screen warning from system-only management.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0026.title: Consider permitted motion data for useful treatment context

statement.en: When useful for treatment and permitted by the person, consider using device motion data in CareKit.
statement.ja: treatmentに有用で利用者のpermissionがある場合、CareKitでdevice motion dataの使用を検討する。

conditions: Motion data can describe activity, step count, pace, and stair movement.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0026.review_note: Recovered both treatment usefulness and explicit permission as prerequisites.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0027.title: Consider permitted photos for care-team progress sharing

statement.en: With the person's permission, consider camera and photo access for sharing treatment progress with a care team.
statement.ja: 利用者のpermissionがある場合、treatment progressをcare teamと共有するためcameraとphotoへのaccessを検討する。

conditions: Images provide useful progress evidence such as monitoring injury healing.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0027.review_note: Recovered explicit permission, care-team sharing, and treatment-progress purpose.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0028.title: Consider appropriate ResearchKit content in CareKit

statement.en: When appropriate, consider using ResearchKit surveys, tasks, and charts in CareKit.
statement.ja: 適切な場合、CareKitでResearchKitのsurvey、task、chartの使用を検討する。

conditions: The ResearchKit content relates to the care experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0028.review_note: Recovered all three content types and preserved the appropriateness condition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0029.title: Consider ResearchKit informed consent for data permission

statement.en: Consider the ResearchKit informed-consent module when requesting permission to collect and share data.
statement.ja: dataの収集と共有へのpermissionを求めるときResearchKit informed-consent moduleを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0029.review_note: Separated the informed-consent option from ResearchKit content integration.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0030.title: Use each CareKit view for its intended purpose

statement.en: Use each CareKit view type for its intended content and interaction purpose.
statement.ja: 各CareKit view typeを意図されたcontentとinteractionの目的に使う。

conditions: Consistent view semantics help preserve a coherent CareKit experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0030.review_note: Recovered the view-category contract above the purpose table.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0031.title: Use CareKit task views for care actions and logging

statement.en: Use CareKit task views for prescribed actions and for logging symptoms or other patient data.
statement.ja: prescribed actionおよびsymptomやpatient dataのloggingにはCareKit task viewを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0031.review_note: Recovered both task purposes from the view-category table.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0032.title: Use CareKit chart views to show treatment progress

statement.en: Use CareKit chart views for graphical data that helps people understand treatment progress.
statement.ja: treatment progressの理解を助けるgraphical dataにはCareKit chart viewを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0032.review_note: Recovered the chart purpose from the view-category table.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0033.title: Use CareKit contact views for details and communication

statement.en: Use CareKit contact views for contact information, communication actions, and location maps.
statement.ja: contact information、communication action、location mapにはCareKit contact viewを使う。

conditions: Supported communication includes phone, message, and email.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0033.review_note: Recovered contact display, three communication methods, and map linking from the table.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0034.review_note: Applied the task table's required title field as an atomic MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0035.review_note: Applied the task table's required schedule field as an atomic MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0036.title: Consider instructions for CareKit task details

statement.en: Consider CareKit task instructions for detailed guidance, recommendations, and warnings.
statement.ja: 詳細なguidance、recommendation、warningにはCareKit task instructionを検討する。

conditions: The task information table marks instructions as optional.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0036.review_note: Recovered the optional instructions field and all three documented content types.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0037.title: Consider a group ID for related CareKit tasks

statement.en: Consider a group ID when related CareKit tasks need meaningful grouping.
statement.ja: 関連CareKit taskを意味のある方法でgroupingする場合はgroup IDを検討する。

conditions: The task information table marks the group ID as optional.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0037.review_note: Recovered the optional grouping field and its semantic-grouping purpose.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0038.review_note: Applied the explicit color-only MUST_NOT and accessibility priority.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0039.title: Keep CareKit task descriptions accurate and simple

statement.en: Keep CareKit task and step descriptions accurate and simple.
statement.ja: CareKit taskとstepのdescriptionをaccurateかつsimpleに保つ。

conditions: Prefer familiar names and remove repeated words when task context already clarifies meaning.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0039.review_note: Recovered the accuracy-simplicity balance, familiar-name example, and contextual brevity.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0040.title: Keep CareKit chart labels clear and succinct

statement.en: Keep CareKit chart labels clear, short, and nonrepetitive.
statement.ja: CareKit chart labelをclear、short、nonrepetitiveに保つ。

conditions: Put shared units in an axis label instead of repeating them on every data point.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0040.review_note: Recovered label clarity, brevity, repetition avoidance, and the shared-unit example.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0041.title: Avoid same-color shades for different CareKit chart meanings

statement.en: Avoid using different shades of one color for different CareKit chart meanings.
statement.ja: 異なるCareKit chartの意味に同一colorの異なるshadeを使わない。

conditions: Use distinct color categories instead.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0041.review_note: Separated the general same-shade warning from positive distinct-color and contrast rules.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0042.review_note: Applied the explicit chart-contrast MUST and accessibility priority.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0043.title: Consolidate large CareKit chart data sets

statement.en: Group and organize large CareKit chart data sets for clarity and readability.
statement.ja: large CareKit chart data setをclarityとreadabilityのためgroupingしorganizeする。

conditions: Too much visible data can shrink individual points and make the chart unreadable.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0043.review_note: Recovered grouping, organization, clarity, and data-point readability.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0044.title: Offset data when necessary for proportional CareKit charts

statement.en: When necessary, offset or restructure CareKit chart data so all points remain readable.
statement.ja: 必要な場合、すべてのpointがreadableになるようCareKit chart dataをoffsetまたはrestructureする。

conditions: A significant difference between small and large data points harms proportional readability.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0044.review_note: Preserved the necessary-only condition and both documented remedies.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0045.title: Consider SF Symbols for custom CareKit grid items

statement.en: Consider SF Symbols for custom items in a CareKit grid view.
statement.ja: CareKit grid viewのcustom itemにはSF Symbolsを検討する。

conditions: Custom symbols represent unique content or meaningful task groups.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0045.review_note: Replaced the deprecated SF Symbols capability fragment with the actual conditional consider guidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0046.title: Avoid decorative or corporate-logo custom care symbols

statement.en: Avoid purely decorative custom care symbols and corporate logos used as custom symbols.
statement.ja: purely decorativeなcustom care symbolやcustom symbolとしてのcorporate logoを避ける。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0046.review_note: Separated both prohibited symbol types from the positive relevance requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0047.title: Keep CareKit branding refined and unobtrusive

statement.en: Keep CareKit branding refined, subtle, and unobtrusive.
statement.ja: CareKit brandingをrefined、subtle、unobtrusiveに保つ。

conditions: Use color and communication style without distracting from the care plan or resembling advertising.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0047.review_note: Recovered subtle brand channels and the care-plan distraction risk.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0048.title: Avoid relying on CareKit on unsupported platforms

statement.en: Avoid relying on CareKit in macOS, tvOS, visionOS, or watchOS.
statement.ja: macOS、tvOS、visionOS、watchOSではCareKitに依存しない。

conditions: The documented CareKit experience is supported on iOS and iPadOS only.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-CAREKIT-0048.review_note: Recorded unsupported platforms conservatively as AVOID rather than promoting descriptive support text to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0018.title: Consider an optional tvOS Game Center dashboard image

statement.en: Consider an optional image at the top of the tvOS Game Center dashboard to highlight the game's aesthetic.
statement.ja: gameのaestheticを強調するためtvOS Game Center dashboard上部のoptional imageを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0018.review_note: Corrected the generated SHOULD to MAY because the source explicitly describes the dashboard image as optional.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0019.title: Avoid invoking unavailable Game Center system UI on watchOS

statement.en: Avoid trying to invoke system-provided Game Center UI on watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSでsystem-provided Game Center UIをinvokeしようとしない。

conditions: GameKit features and APIs remain available, but watchOS has no invocable system Game Center UI.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0019.review_note: Replaced the vague awareness rule with the actionable platform limitation and kept it at AVOID.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0026.title: Use a simple recognizable tvOS dashboard image

statement.en: Use a simple, easily recognizable tvOS Game Center dashboard image that looks good at a distance.
statement.ja: 距離があっても見やすいsimpleでrecognizableなtvOS Game Center dashboard imageを使う。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0026.review_note: Recovered simplicity, recognition, and distance-viewing requirements.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0027.title: Consider a game logo for the tvOS dashboard image

statement.en: Consider the game's logo or word mark for the tvOS Game Center dashboard image.
statement.ja: tvOS Game Center dashboard imageにはgameのlogoまたはword markを検討する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0027.review_note: Recovered both optional brand-artwork choices and preserved consider strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0028.title: Avoid the app icon as the tvOS dashboard image

statement.en: Avoid using the app icon as the tvOS Game Center dashboard image.
statement.ja: app iconをtvOS Game Center dashboard imageとして使わない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0028.review_note: Separated the embedded don't clause and retained it at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0029.title: Size the tvOS dashboard image to 600×180 points

statement.en: Use a 600×180-point tvOS dashboard image, corresponding to 1200×360 pixels at @2x.
statement.ja: tvOS dashboard imageを600×180 point、@2xで1200×360 pixelにする。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GAME-CENTER-0029.review_note: Recovered both point and @2x pixel dimensions from the table.
