statement.en: Ensure windows adapt fluidly across supported sizes for multitasking and multiwindow workflows.
statement.ja: multitaskingとmultiwindow workflowのため、windowを対応sizeへ滑らかに適応させる。

conditions: Support every window size available in the app's scoped platform context.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0001.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure lead and its multitasking and multiwindow scope.

statement.en: Open a new window when it helps people multitask or preserve context.
statement.ja: multitaskやcontext維持に役立つ場面で新しいwindowを開く。

conditions: Avoid excessive windows that create clutter or confusing navigation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0002.review_note: Concretized the right-moment test and split the default-window anti-pattern.

statement.en: Consider giving people an option to view content in a new window.
statement.ja: contentを新しいwindowで表示するoptionの提供を検討する。

conditions: A context-menu or File-menu command can provide the option without making it default behavior.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0003.review_note: Preserved both Consider clauses as one MAY choice and recorded the documented command locations.

statement.en: Avoid creating custom window interface elements in place of system-provided UI.
statement.ja: system-provided UIの代わりにcustom window interface elementを作らない。

conditions: Avoid custom frames or controls and don't imitate the system appearance without matching its behavior.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0004.review_note: Preserved the direct Avoid lead at AVOID and recorded both frame/control and imitation failure modes.

statement.en: Use the term window for app windows in user-facing content.
statement.ja: user-facing contentではapp windowをwindowと呼ぶ。

conditions: Use window regardless of type; implementation terms such as scene can confuse people.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0005.review_note: Recorded the user-facing terminology rule and its type-independent scope.

statement.en: Avoid opening new windows by default unless doing so suits the app.
statement.ja: appに適する場合を除き、新しいwindowをdefaultで開かない。

conditions: Default window creation should provide a clear multitasking or context-preservation benefit.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0023.review_note: Recovered the explicit default-window anti-pattern as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0007.title: Consider a gesture for opening iPadOS content in a new window

statement.en: Consider letting people use a gesture to open iPadOS content in a new window.
statement.ja: gestureでiPadOS contentを新しいwindowへ開けるようにすることを検討する。

conditions: A pinch gesture can expand an item into a new window.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0007.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the documented pinch interaction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0009.title: Avoid critical content or actions in a macOS bottom bar

statement.en: Avoid placing critical information or actions in a macOS window's bottom bar.
statement.ja: macOS windowのbottom barにcritical informationやactionを置かない。

conditions: People can relocate a window so its bottom edge becomes hidden.
exceptions: Use a bottom bar only for a small amount of directly related information.
Use an inspector when more information needs presentation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0009.review_note: Restored the truncated bottom-edge risk and recorded both limited-use and inspector alternatives.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0010.title: Prefer a visionOS window for familiar interfaces and tasks

statement.en: Prefer a visionOS window for familiar interfaces and tasks.
statement.ja: familiar interfaceやtaskにはvisionOS windowを優先する。

exceptions: Consider a volume for bounded 3D content such as a game board.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0010.review_note: Recorded the familiar-interface rationale and bounded-3D volume alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0011.title: Minimize empty space in the initial visionOS window size

statement.en: Choose an initial visionOS window size that minimizes empty areas.
statement.ja: empty areaを最小化するinitial visionOS window sizeを選ぶ。

conditions: A visionOS window defaults to 1280×720 pt and initially appears about two meters away.
At two meters, its apparent width is about three meters.
Excess empty space enlarges the window and obscures other spatial content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0011.review_note: Recorded the default size, initial placement, apparent width, and spatial-obstruction rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0012.title: Match the initial visionOS window shape to its content

statement.en: Choose an initial visionOS window shape that suits its content.
statement.ja: contentに合うinitial visionOS window shapeを選ぶ。

conditions: Wide content suits wide windows; vertically extended content suits taller windows.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0012.review_note: Repaired the generic Aim paraphrase and recorded the content-shape relationship.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0013.title: Set minimum and maximum sizes for each visionOS window

statement.en: Choose minimum and maximum sizes that keep each visionOS window usable.
statement.ja: 各visionOS windowがusableな状態を保つminimum sizeとmaximum sizeを選ぶ。

conditions: Keep layouts from overlapping when small or becoming unusable when large.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0013.review_note: Recorded the resize range and its small-overlap and large-usability failure modes.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0014.title: Minimize 3D content depth in a visionOS window

statement.en: Minimize the depth of 3D content displayed in a visionOS window.
statement.ja: visionOS window内の3D contentのdepthを最小化する。

conditions: The system clips 3D content that extends too far from the window surface.
exceptions: Use a volume for content that needs greater depth.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0014.review_note: Recorded the system clipping behavior and volume alternative.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0015.title: Prefer a visionOS volume for rich 3D content

statement.en: Prefer a visionOS volume for rich 3D content.
statement.ja: rich 3D contentにはvisionOS volumeを優先する。

exceptions: Prefer a window for familiar, UI-centric interfaces.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0015.review_note: Recorded the volume and window content-type distinction.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0016.title: Place 2D volume content for viewing from multiple angles

statement.en: Place 2D content in a visionOS volume so it works from multiple viewing angles.
statement.ja: visionOS volume内の2D contentを複数angleから見ても機能する位置へ置く。

conditions: Use an attachment to pin 2D content to a specific 3D area.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0016.review_note: Recorded the perspective-change risk and attachment technique.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0017.title: Consider high-value volume content in a visionOS ornament

statement.en: Consider presenting high-value visionOS volume content in an ornament.
statement.ja: high-valueなvisionOS volume contentをornamentで表示することを検討する。

conditions: In visionOS 2 or later, an ornament can reduce clutter and elevate important controls.
An attachment anchor keeps the ornament viewer-relative while people move around the volume.
Avoid placing an ornament on the toolbar or tab-bar edge.
Prefer only one additional ornament to avoid overshadowing volume content.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0017.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded version, anchor, edge, and ornament-count constraints.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0018.title: Align a visionOS volume for its interaction pattern

statement.en: Choose a visionOS volume alignment that supports its interaction pattern.
statement.ja: interaction patternを支えるvisionOS volume alignmentを選ぶ。

conditions: Floor-parallel alignment suits content with little interaction.
Viewer-facing tilt can keep interactive content usable while the viewer reclines.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0019.title: Retain the visionOS window glass background

statement.en: Retain the default glass background in a visionOS window.
statement.ja: visionOS windowのdefault glass backgroundを維持する。

conditions: Glass adapts to lighting and communicates window scale and position.
Removing glass reduces legibility and perceived relationships between UI elements.
An opaque background obscures surroundings and can make the window feel constricting.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0019.review_note: Recovered the omitted Retain lead and recorded the glass-material rationale.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0020.title: Generally use dynamic scaling for a visionOS volume

statement.en: Generally use dynamic scaling for visionOS volume content.
statement.ja: visionOS volume contentには通常dynamic scalingを使う。

conditions: Dynamic scaling preserves legibility and interaction at greater viewing distances.
exceptions: Use fixed scaling for real-world objects when preserving physical scale matters.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0020.review_note: Recovered the qualified Use lead and preserved the fixed-scaling exception.

HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0021.title: Use the default visionOS baseplate to reveal volume edges

statement.en: Use the default visionOS baseplate appearance to help people discern a volume's edges.
statement.ja: default visionOS baseplate appearanceでvolumeのedgeを認識しやすくする。

conditions: In visionOS 2 or later, the system adds a gentle glow when people look at the baseplate.
The glow helps expose edges and the resize control when content doesn't fill the volume.
exceptions: Full-bleed content or a custom baseplate may not need the default glow.
HIG-COMPONENTS-WINDOWS-0021.review_note: Recovered the omitted Take advantage lead and recorded the glow behavior and exceptions.

statement.en: Prefer clearly defined edges in app-icon foreground layers.
statement.ja: app icon foreground layerでは明確なedgeを優先する。

conditions: Avoid soft or feathered shape edges so system highlights and shadows render clearly.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0001.review_note: Recorded the system-effect rationale and preserved Prefer at SHOULD.

statement.en: Design an app-icon background that stands out and emphasizes foreground content.
statement.ja: 目立ちながらforeground contentを強調するapp icon backgroundを設計する。

conditions: Icon Composer usually makes a custom imported background image unnecessary.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0002.review_note: Separated both explicit conditional background requirements from the general design recommendation.

statement.en: Prefer vector graphics for layers imported into Icon Composer.
statement.ja: Icon Composerへimportするlayerにはvector graphicを優先する。

conditions: Vector SVG or PDF artwork scales cleanly across icon sizes.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0003.review_note: Preserved Prefer at SHOULD and split outline preparation and PNG fallback.

statement.en: Keep primary app-icon content centered so system masking doesn't truncate it.
statement.ja: system maskingで切れないようprimary app icon contentを中央に保つ。

conditions: Pay particular attention to visionOS and watchOS circular icons; use Apple production-template grids for placement.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0004.review_note: Recorded masking and the two circular-platform contexts.

statement.en: Provide a visually consistent app-icon design across supported platforms.
statement.ja: support対象platform間で視覚的に一貫したapp icon designを提供する。

conditions: Consistency helps people find the app and avoid mistaking platform variants for different apps.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0005.review_note: Recorded recognition and cross-platform identity as the consistency outcomes.

statement.en: Consider basing an app-icon design on filled, overlapping shapes.
statement.ja: filledでoverlapするshapeを基礎にしたapp icon designを検討する。

conditions: Transparency and blurring can make overlapping foreground shapes feel dimensional.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0006.review_note: Preserved Consider as MAY and recorded the depth-producing context.

statement.en: Include app-icon text only when it is essential to the experience or brand.
statement.ja: experienceまたはbrandに不可欠な場合だけapp iconにtextを含める。

conditions: Icon text doesn't support accessibility or localization and can be unreadable, cluttered, or redundant.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0007.review_note: Recorded the accessibility, localization, size, and redundancy limits and split two atomic text rules.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0008.title: Prefer illustrations to photos in app icons

statement.en: Prefer illustrations to photos in app icons.
statement.ja: app iconではphotoよりillustrationを優先する。

conditions: Illustrations can emphasize selected features and work better across appearances, sizes, and layers.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0008.review_note: Repaired the mixed-strength lead by retaining the photo preference separately from the UI-replication AVOID.

statement.en: Avoid replicas of Apple hardware products in app icons.
statement.ja: app iconでApple hardware productのreplicaを避ける。

conditions: Apple hardware product designs are copyrighted.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0009.review_note: Kept the direct Don't guidance at AVOID because it isn't an explicit Never or must-not prohibition.

statement.en: Let the system apply blurring and other visual effects to app-icon layers.
statement.ja: app icon layerへのblurその他のvisual effectはsystemに任せる。

conditions: System effects are dynamic; custom static effects can interfere with them.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0010.review_note: Recorded dynamic-system behavior and split the conditional custom-effect MUST.

statement.en: Create app-icon layer groups when effects need to apply to multiple layers together.
statement.ja: 複数layerへまとめてeffectを適用する場合はapp icon layer groupを作る。

conditions: Use grouping only when it fits the design; Icon Composer adds group-level Liquid Glass controls.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0011.review_note: Made the design-fit condition explicit without requiring grouping for every icon.

statement.en: Keep an app icon's core visual features consistent across appearance variants.
statement.ja: appearance variant間でapp iconのcore visual featureを一貫させる。

conditions: Apply across default, dark, clear, and tinted appearances.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0012.review_note: Recorded the full appearance set and split the element-swapping anti-pattern.

statement.en: Design dark, clear, and tinted icons to fit beside system app icons and widgets.
statement.ja: system app iconやwidgetに馴染むdark、clear、tinted iconを設計する。

conditions: Keep every variant visible, legible, and recognizable; darker and tinted contexts are more subdued.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0013.review_note: Expanded the appearance context and recorded visibility, legibility, and recognition outcomes.

statement.en: Use the light app icon as the basis for the dark icon.
statement.ja: light app iconをdark iconの基礎に使う。

conditions: Choose complementary colors that reflect the default design; color backgrounds generally provide strong contrast.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0014.review_note: Recorded the color relationship and split the excessive-brightness anti-pattern.

statement.en: Consider offering alternate app icons on supported platforms.
statement.ja: support対象platformでalternate app iconの提供を検討する。

conditions: People choose alternate icons in app settings; every alternate and appearance variant remains subject to app review.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0015.review_note: Preserved Consider as MAY, narrowed platform availability, and split identity requirements.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0019.title: Use Display P3 app-icon color only on supported platforms

statement.en: Use Display P3 app-icon color only on iOS, iPadOS, macOS, tvOS, and watchOS.
statement.ja: Display P3 app icon colorはiOS、iPadOS、macOS、tvOS、watchOSだけで使う。

conditions: App icons also support sRGB color and Gray Gamma 2.2 grayscale; Display P3 isn't listed for visionOS.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0019.review_note: Reclassified the supported color-space capability from generated SHOULD to MAY and preserved its platform exclusion.

statement.en: Use varying opacity in foreground layers to increase app-icon depth and liveliness.
statement.ja: foreground layerのopacityを変えてapp iconのdepthとlivelinessを高める。

conditions: Importing opaque layers and adjusting transparency in Icon Composer supports preview and iteration.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0020.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized Vary lead and recorded the recommended workflow.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0021.title: Ensure app-icon gradients respond to system lighting

statement.en: When using an app-icon background gradient, ensure it responds well to system lighting effects.
statement.ja: app icon background gradientを使う場合、system lighting effectへ適切に反応させる。

conditions: The requirement applies only when the background uses a gradient.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0021.review_note: Recovered the conditional Ensure requirement without applying it to solid backgrounds.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0022.title: Ensure imported app-icon backgrounds are full-bleed and opaque

statement.en: When importing an app-icon background layer, ensure it is full-bleed and opaque.
statement.ja: app icon background layerをimportする場合はfull-bleedかつopaqueにする。

conditions: Icon Composer solid colors and gradients usually avoid the need for an imported background.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0022.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure requirement and preserved the no-import default.

statement.en: Outline app-icon artwork and convert icon text to outlines before import.
statement.ja: import前にapp icon artworkをoutline化し、icon textをoutlineへ変換する。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0023.review_note: Recovered the vector-preparation action as a separate rule.

statement.en: Prefer PNG for app-icon mesh gradients and raster artwork.
statement.ja: app iconのmesh gradientとraster artworkにはPNGを優先する。

conditions: PNG is a lossless fallback when vector graphics aren't appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0024.review_note: Recovered the documented raster fallback and retained Prefer at SHOULD.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0025.title: Create unmasked app-icon layers in the platform layout shape

statement.en: Create unmasked app-icon layers in the layout shape required by the target platform.
statement.ja: target platformが求めるlayout shapeでmaskなしのapp icon layerを作る。

conditions: Use square layers for iOS, iPadOS, macOS, visionOS, and watchOS; use rectangular layers for tvOS.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0025.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized Produce lead and recorded every platform shape mapping.

statement.en: Avoid applying predefined masking to app-icon layers.
statement.ja: app icon layerにpredefined maskingを適用しない。

conditions: Premasking harms specular highlights and can produce jagged edges after system masking.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0026.review_note: Recovered the masking anti-pattern as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0027.title: Use a simple, recognizable app-icon design

statement.en: Use a simple, recognizable app-icon design with a minimal number of shapes.
statement.ja: 最小限のshapeでsimpleかつrecognizableなapp icon designを作る。

conditions: Center one concept that captures the app or game; prefer a simple background that emphasizes it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0027.review_note: Recovered the previously omitted simplicity lead and recorded its concept, detail, and background criteria.

statement.en: Avoid nonessential action words and context-specific terms in app icons.
statement.ja: app iconでnonessentialなaction wordやcontext-specific termを避ける。

conditions: Examples include “Watch,” “Play,” “New,” and “For visionOS.”
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0028.review_note: Recovered the text anti-pattern as AVOID while preserving essential brand text.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0029.title: Keep tvOS app-icon text above other layers

statement.en: When a tvOS app icon includes text, ensure it appears above the other layers.
statement.ja: tvOS app iconにtextを含める場合は他のlayerより上に配置する。

conditions: Keep text above parallax layers so the system doesn't crop it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0029.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure tvOS text-layer requirement.

statement.en: Avoid replicating standard UI components or app screenshots in an app icon.
statement.ja: app iconでstandard UI componentやapp screenshotを複製しない。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0030.review_note: Split the direct UI-replication anti-pattern from the illustration preference.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0031.title: Ensure app-icon artwork avoids fragile lines and corners

statement.en: Ensure app-icon artwork avoids extremely thin lines and sharp corners.
statement.ja: app icon artworkで極端に細いlineやsharp cornerを避ける。

conditions: Thin lines and sharp corners lose detail and crispness at small sizes and low resolutions.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0031.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure to avoid requirement as a positive MUST outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0032.title: Ensure custom app-icon effects don't conflict with system effects

statement.en: When using custom app-icon effects, ensure they appear as expected and don't conflict with system effects.
statement.ja: custom app icon effectを使う場合は意図どおり表示されsystem effectと競合しないようにする。

conditions: Test intentionally in Icon Composer, Device Hub, or on a physical device.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0032.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure verification outcome without requiring custom effects.

statement.en: Avoid swapping app-icon elements between appearance variants.
statement.ja: appearance variant間でapp icon elementを入れ替えない。

conditions: Element swaps can make the app harder to find after people change appearances.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0033.review_note: Recovered the variant-swapping anti-pattern as AVOID.

statement.en: Avoid excessively bright images in dark app icons.
statement.ja: dark app iconで過度にbrightなimageを避ける。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0034.review_note: Recovered the direct dark-appearance anti-pattern as AVOID.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0035.title: Keep alternate app icons related to the app experience

statement.en: When offering alternate app icons, ensure each remains closely related to the app's content and experience.
statement.ja: alternate app iconを提供する場合、各iconをapp contentとexperienceに密接に関連させる。

conditions: The app offers alternate icons on a supported platform.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0035.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure identity requirement and narrowed supported platforms.

statement.en: Avoid alternate app icons that people might mistake for another app.
statement.ja: 別のappと誤認される可能性があるalternate app iconを避ける。

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0036.review_note: Recovered the identity-confusion anti-pattern as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0037.title: Create 1024×1024 layered app-icon layouts for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS

statement.en: Create square 1024×1024 px layered app-icon layouts for iOS, iPadOS, and macOS.
statement.ja: iOS、iPadOS、macOS向けにsquareの1024×1024 px layered app icon layoutを作る。

conditions: The system masks the square layout to a rounded rectangle and supports default, dark, clear, and tinted appearances.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0037.review_note: Recovered the complete iOS, iPadOS, and macOS specification row as SHOULD.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0038.title: Create an 800×480 layered parallax app-icon layout for tvOS

statement.en: Create a rectangular 800×480 px layered parallax app-icon layout for tvOS.
statement.ja: tvOS向けにrectangularの800×480 px layered parallax app icon layoutを作る。

conditions: The system masks the landscape layout to a rounded rectangle.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0038.review_note: Recovered the complete tvOS specification row as SHOULD.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0039.title: Create a 1024×1024 layered 3D app-icon layout for visionOS

statement.en: Create a square 1024×1024 px layered 3D app-icon layout for visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOS向けにsquareの1024×1024 px layered 3D app icon layoutを作る。

conditions: The system masks the square layout to a circle.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0039.review_note: Recovered the complete visionOS specification row as SHOULD.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0040.title: Create a 1088×1088 layered app-icon layout for watchOS

statement.en: Create a square 1088×1088 px layered app-icon layout for watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOS向けにsquareの1088×1088 px layered app icon layoutを作る。

conditions: The system masks the square layout to a circle.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0040.review_note: Recovered the complete watchOS specification row as SHOULD.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0016.title: Keep tvOS app-icon content inside a safe zone

statement.en: Include a safe zone that keeps tvOS app-icon content visible during focus effects.
statement.ja: focus effect中もtvOS app-icon contentが見えるsafe zoneを設ける。

conditions: The system may crop icon edges while the focused icon scales and moves.
Safe-zone size varies with image size, layer depth, and motion.
The system crops foreground layers more than background layers.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0016.review_note: Recorded the focus-cropping behavior and the variables that affect safe-zone size.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0017.title: Avoid concave shapes in a visionOS app-icon background

statement.en: Avoid shapes intended to look concave or hollow in a visionOS app-icon background.
statement.ja: visionOS app-icon backgroundでconcaveまたはhollowに見せるshapeを避ける。

conditions: System shadows and specular highlights can make the shape protrude instead of recede.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0017.review_note: Recorded the system-effect reversal that makes concave background shapes misleading.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0018.title: Avoid a black watchOS app-icon background

statement.en: Avoid using black for a watchOS app-icon background.
statement.ja: watchOS app-icon backgroundにblackを使わない。

conditions: Lighten a black background so the icon doesn't blend into the display background.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-APP-ICONS-0018.review_note: Recorded the display-background blending risk and lightening mitigation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0001.title: Use the brand’s voice and tone consistently in displayed writing

statement.en: Use the brand’s voice and tone consistently in all displayed writing.
statement.ja: 表示するすべてのwritingでbrandのvoiceとtoneを一貫して使う。

conditions: Match word choice, punctuation, emoji, and sentence structure to the intended brand character.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0001.review_note: Removed the generated voice-input modality because brand voice describes writing style, not spoken interaction.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0002.title: Consider expressing the brand with an accent color

statement.en: Consider choosing an accent color that expresses the brand.
statement.ja: brandを表現するaccent colorの選択を検討する。

conditions: The system can apply an app accent color to interface icons, buttons, and text.
On macOS, a person’s chosen accent color can replace the color specified by the app.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0002.review_note: Preserved Consider as MAY and recorded the macOS user-choice override.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0003.title: Consider a custom font when it is strongly associated with the brand

statement.en: Consider using a custom font when it is strongly associated with the brand.
statement.ja: brandと強く関連する場合はcustom fontの使用を検討する。

conditions: The separate custom-font accessibility requirement applies whenever a custom font is used.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0003.review_note: Preserved Consider as MAY and separated the conditional accessibility MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0004.title: Ensure branding defers to content

statement.en: Ensure brand assets and styling defer to the content people care about.
statement.ja: brand assetやstylingより人が重視するcontentを優先する。

conditions: Don't consume content space with an element whose only function is displaying a brand asset.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0004.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Ensure directive and recorded the content-space outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0005.title: Use standard platform patterns consistently

statement.en: Use standard platform patterns consistently so a stylized interface retains familiar behavior.
statement.ja: stylized interfaceでもfamiliarなbehaviorを保つようstandard platform patternを一貫して使う。

conditions: Place interface components where people expect and use standard symbols for common actions.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0005.review_note: Repaired the generic generated statement and recorded the two documented pattern examples.

statement.en: Avoid using a launch screen as a branding opportunity.
statement.ja: launch screenをbranding opportunityとして使わない。

conditions: Launch screens minimize perceived startup time and disappear too quickly to convey information.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0006.review_note: Kept the direct Avoid guidance at AVOID and separated the optional welcome-screen alternative.

statement.en: Follow Apple’s trademark guidelines when referring to Apple brands.
statement.ja: Apple brandを参照する場合はApple trademark guidelineに従う。

conditions: The linked trademark guidelines contain requirements beyond this HIG page.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0007.review_note: Retained the general Follow lead at SHOULD and split the page's explicit must-not prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0008.title: Ensure custom fonts remain legible and support text accessibility

statement.en: When using a custom font, ensure it remains legible at all sizes and supports Bold Text and larger type.
statement.ja: custom fontを使う場合、すべてのsizeでlegibleにしBold Textとlarger typeをsupportする。

conditions: The requirement applies only when the experience uses a custom font.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0008.review_note: Recovered the conditional Be sure accessibility requirement without requiring a custom font.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0009.title: Keep branding refined and unobtrusive

statement.en: Keep branding refined and unobtrusive so it doesn't distract people from content.
statement.ja: contentから注意をそらさないrefinedでunobtrusiveなbrandingにする。

conditions: Apply alongside the mandatory outcome that branding defers to content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0009.review_note: Recovered the source's Aim recommendation separately from the Ensure-based MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0010.title: Avoid displaying logos throughout an app or game

statement.en: Avoid displaying a logo throughout an app or game unless it is essential for context.
statement.ja: contextに不可欠な場合を除きappやgame全体でlogoを表示し続けない。

conditions: Prefer using the space for valuable information and controls.
exceptions: A logo can appear where it is essential to provide context.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0010.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized Resist lead as qualified AVOID.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0011.title: Consider a branded welcome or onboarding screen instead of a launch screen

statement.en: Consider presenting branding content in an initial welcome or onboarding screen instead of a launch screen.
statement.ja: launch screenではなく最初のwelcomeまたはonboarding screenでbranding contentを示すことを検討する。

conditions: The experience needs to introduce branding content at startup.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0011.review_note: Recovered the source's might-consider alternative as MAY.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0012.title: Never include Apple trademarks in app names or images

statement.en: Never include Apple trademarks in app names or images.
statement.ja: app nameやimageにApple trademarkを含めない。

conditions: Apply to every app name and image that refers to Apple brands.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-BRANDING-0012.review_note: Recovered the explicit must-not prohibition separately from the general trademark-guidelines recommendation.

statement.en: Avoid using the same or similar color to communicate different meanings.
statement.ja: 異なる意味を伝えるために同じまたは似たcolorを使わない。

conditions: Use color consistently for information such as status and interactivity.
Don't style noninteractive text like an interactive borderless button.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0001.review_note: Recorded the status and interactivity context and retained direct Avoid guidance at AVOID.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0002.title: Ensure colors work in light, dark, and increased-contrast contexts

statement.en: Ensure every app color remains distinguishable and usable in light, dark, and increased-contrast contexts.
statement.ja: すべてのapp colorをlight、dark、increased-contrast contextで区別でき使用可能にする。

conditions: iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and tvOS provide both light and dark appearances.
Use the separate custom-color variant requirement whenever the app defines a custom color.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0002.review_note: Retained the explicit Make sure MUST and separated system-color preference from custom-color asset requirements.

statement.en: Test the app's color scheme under varied lighting conditions.
statement.ja: さまざまなlighting conditionでappのcolor schemeをtestする。

conditions: Include bright and dim surroundings.
For visionOS, include different physical-wall and object colors and reflected light.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0003.review_note: Recorded physical-lighting and visionOS surroundings as required test contexts without raising Test to MUST.

statement.en: Test the app's colors on different target devices and display configurations.
statement.ja: 異なるtarget deviceとdisplay configurationでapp colorをtestする。

conditions: Include relevant True Tone displays, multiple HD and 4K TVs for tvOS, and P3 and sRGB profiles on Mac.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0004.review_note: Recorded the documented device and display-profile coverage.

statement.en: Consider how artwork and translucent interface elements affect nearby colors.
statement.ja: artworkやtranslucent interface elementが周囲のcolorへ与える影響を検討する。

conditions: Adjust nearby colors when needed to preserve continuity and avoid overpowering or underwhelming interface elements.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0005.review_note: Preserved Consider as MAY and recorded both artwork and translucency contexts.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0006.title: Avoid relying on color alone to convey meaning

statement.en: Avoid relying on color alone to distinguish objects, indicate interactivity, or communicate essential information.
statement.ja: objectの区別、interactivity、essential informationをcolorだけに依存して伝えない。

conditions: The separate accessibility MUST requires an equivalent noncolor channel.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0006.review_note: Repaired the truncated title and separated the explicit Be sure alternative-channel requirement.

statement.en: Avoid colors and combinations that make app content difficult to perceive.
statement.ja: app contentを知覚しにくくするcolorやcolor combinationを避ける。

conditions: Check foreground-background contrast and combinations that may be indistinguishable to people with color-vision differences.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0007.review_note: Recorded both contrast and color-vision conditions and retained Avoid at AVOID.

statement.en: Consider how each color may be interpreted in supported countries and cultures.
statement.ja: 各colorがsupport対象の国や文化でどう解釈されるか検討する。

conditions: A color can carry opposite meanings in different cultures.
The separate Make sure rule requires the final palette to send the intended message.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0008.review_note: Preserved Consider as MAY and separated the explicit intended-message outcome.

statement.en: Avoid hard-coding documented system color values.
statement.ja: document化されたsystem color valueをhard-codeしない。

conditions: System values can vary by release and environment; use platform color APIs instead.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0009.review_note: Recorded API use and value variability while keeping direct Avoid guidance at AVOID.

statement.en: Avoid redefining the semantic meanings of dynamic system colors.
statement.ja: dynamic system colorのsemantic meaningを再定義しない。

conditions: Use each dynamic system color for its intended purpose so appearance changes remain consistent.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0010.review_note: Narrowed the generated page-wide scope to the four platforms identified by the source.

statement.en: Apply color sparingly to Liquid Glass and to symbols or text on it.
statement.ja: Liquid Glassおよびその上のsymbolやtextへのcolor適用を控えめにする。

conditions: Reserve color for elements that benefit from emphasis, such as status indicators and primary actions.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0011.review_note: Recorded the emphasis qualification and split primary-action treatment and multiple-control avoidance.

statement.en: Avoid control-label colors that are too similar to a colorful content background.
statement.ja: colorfulなcontent backgroundと似すぎたcontrol-label colorを避ける。

conditions: For visually rich content, prefer monochromatic toolbars and tab bars or an accent color with sufficient differentiation.
A brand accent can be effective over primarily monochromatic content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0012.review_note: Recorded both content-dependent alternatives and retained Avoid at AVOID.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0013.title: Ensure content and control colors maintain sufficient contrast

statement.en: Ensure colors in the content layer and controls maintain sufficient contrast.
statement.ja: content layerとcontrolのcolor間で十分なcontrastを維持する。

conditions: Avoid overlapping similar content and control colors when possible.
The separate resting-state rule applies to intermittently scrolling content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0013.review_note: Replaced the vague generated Be aware statement with the paragraph's explicit Make sure contrast outcome.

statement.en: Apply color profiles to images so displays can reproduce their colors as intended.
statement.ja: displayが意図どおりcolorを再現できるようimageへcolor profileを適用する。

conditions: sRGB produces accurate colors on most displays.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0014.review_note: Recorded the cross-display color-management outcome and sRGB baseline.

statement.en: Use wide color to enhance the visual experience on compatible displays.
statement.ja: compatible displayでvisual experienceを高めるためwide colorを使う。

conditions: Wide color can improve photos, video, visual data, and status indicators.
Apply the separate P3 export and wide-color display rules when producing wide-color assets.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0015.review_note: Recorded compatible-display outcomes and split precise production guidance.

statement.en: Provide color-space-specific image and color variants when needed for visual fidelity.
statement.ja: visual fidelityに必要な場合はcolor-space固有のimageとcolor variantを提供する。

conditions: Provide variants when similar P3 colors become indistinguishable or P3 gradients clip on sRGB displays.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0016.review_note: Recorded the two documented P3-to-sRGB failure conditions.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0024.title: Prefer system colors with appearance and contrast variants

statement.en: Prefer system colors that already provide light, dark, and increased-contrast variants.
statement.ja: light、dark、increased-contrast variantを備えたsystem colorを優先する。

conditions: Use system colors when possible because they adapt automatically to supported appearances and accessibility settings.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0024.review_note: Recovered the qualified system-color preference separately from mandatory color outcomes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0025.title: Ensure custom colors supply appearance and contrast variants

statement.en: When defining a custom color, ensure it supplies light and dark variants plus an increased-contrast option for each.
statement.ja: custom colorを定義する場合、lightとdark variantおよび各variantのincreased-contrast optionを用意する。

conditions: Each increased-contrast option needs substantially greater visual differentiation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0025.review_note: Recovered the conditional Make sure custom-color asset requirement.

statement.en: Prefer system-provided color controls when the app lets people choose colors.
statement.ja: appで人がcolorを選ぶ場合はsystem提供のcolor controlを優先する。

conditions: Built-in color pickers provide a consistent experience and shared saved-color access.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0026.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized conditional Prefer lead.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0027.title: Provide noncolor alternatives whenever color conveys information

statement.en: Whenever color conveys information, ensure the same information is available through noncolor cues.
statement.ja: colorでinformationを伝える場合、同じinformationをnoncolor cueでも利用できるようにする。

conditions: Use cues such as text labels or glyph shapes so people with color-vision differences can understand objects and states.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0027.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure accessibility requirement as a separate MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0028.title: Ensure colors send the intended message across supported cultures

statement.en: Ensure app colors send the intended message in every supported country and culture.
statement.ja: support対象のすべての国と文化でapp colorが意図したmessageを伝えるようにする。

conditions: Evaluate differing cultural meanings before finalizing the palette.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0028.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure outcome separately from the Consider research prompt.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0029.title: Emphasize primary actions with Liquid Glass background color

statement.en: When emphasizing a primary action with color, apply it to the Liquid Glass background rather than its symbol or text.
statement.ja: colorでprimary actionを強調する場合、symbolやtextではなくLiquid Glass backgroundへ適用する。

conditions: Apply only when a primary action benefits from color emphasis.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0029.review_note: Recovered the conditional primary-action treatment as SHOULD.

statement.en: Avoid adding color to the backgrounds of multiple Liquid Glass controls.
statement.ja: 複数のLiquid Glass controlのbackgroundへcolorを追加しない。

conditions: Reserve colored backgrounds for the small number of controls that truly need emphasis.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0030.review_note: Recovered the direct Refrain guidance conservatively as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0031.title: Ensure resting content remains legible beneath controls

statement.en: When colorful content can scroll beneath controls, ensure its default or resting state remains clearly legible.
statement.ja: colorful contentがcontrolの下をscrollする場合、defaultまたはresting stateで明確なlegibilityを維持する。

conditions: Apply especially at the initial top position of scrollable content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0031.review_note: Recovered the second explicit Make sure outcome from the content-layer paragraph.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0032.title: Use the documented Display P3 export settings when wide color is appropriate

statement.en: When wide color is appropriate, use Display P3 at 16 bits per channel and export images as PNG.
statement.ja: wide colorが適切な場合、Display P3をchannelあたり16 bitで使いimageをPNGとしてexportする。

conditions: Apply to wide-color image assets intended for compatible displays.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0032.review_note: Recovered the conditional production specification as SHOULD.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0033.title: Use a wide-color display to create wide-color assets

statement.en: Use a wide-color display when designing wide-color images or selecting Display P3 colors.
statement.ja: wide-color imageのdesignまたはDisplay P3 colorの選択にはwide-color displayを使う。

conditions: The team is designing wide-color images or selecting Display P3 colors.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0033.review_note: Recovered the explicit need-to production prerequisite as a conditional MUST.

statement.en: Use grouped background colors for grouped iOS and iPadOS table views.
statement.ja: grouped iOSまたはiPadOS table viewではgrouped background colorを使う。

conditions: Use systemGroupedBackground and its secondary and tertiary variants.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0034.review_note: Recovered the grouped-table branch of the documented background-set choice.

statement.en: Use system background colors for iOS and iPadOS views that aren't grouped table views.
statement.ja: grouped table view以外のiOSまたはiPadOS viewではsystem background colorを使う。

conditions: Use systemBackground and its secondary and tertiary variants.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0035.review_note: Recovered the otherwise branch of the documented background-set choice.

statement.en: Use primary iOS and iPadOS background colors for the overall view.
statement.ja: overall viewにはprimary iOSまたはiPadOS background colorを使う。

conditions: Apply within either the system or grouped dynamic background-color set.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0036.review_note: Recovered the first structured hierarchy row.

statement.en: Use secondary iOS and iPadOS background colors to group content within the overall view.
statement.ja: overall view内でcontentをgroup化するためsecondary iOSまたはiPadOS background colorを使う。

conditions: Apply within either the system or grouped dynamic background-color set.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0037.review_note: Recovered the second structured hierarchy row.

statement.en: Use tertiary iOS and iPadOS background colors to group content within secondary elements.
statement.ja: secondary element内でcontentをgroup化するためtertiary iOSまたはiPadOS background colorを使う。

conditions: Apply within either the system or grouped dynamic background-color set.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0038.review_note: Recovered the third structured hierarchy row.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0017.title: Consider a limited tvOS palette coordinated with the app logo

statement.en: Consider a limited tvOS color palette that coordinates with the app logo.
statement.ja: app logoと調和する限定的なtvOS color paletteを検討する。

conditions: Use color subtly to communicate brand while deferring to content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0017.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the content-first branding rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0018.title: Avoid indicating tvOS focus with color alone

statement.en: Avoid using color as the only indication of tvOS focus.
statement.ja: tvOS focusをcolorだけで示さない。

conditions: Use subtle scaling and responsive animation as primary focus cues.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0018.review_note: Recorded the noncolor focus cues from the supporting prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0019.title: Use color sparingly on visionOS glass

statement.en: Use color sparingly in visionOS, especially on glass material.
statement.ja: visionOS、特にglass materialではcolorを控えめに使う。

conditions: Physical and virtual colors visible through glass can reduce colorful content legibility.
Use color to emphasize important information or relationships between interface parts.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0019.review_note: Recorded the glass-transmission legibility risk and intended emphasis cases.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0020.title: Prefer visionOS color in bold text and large areas

statement.en: Prefer using color in bold visionOS text and large areas.
statement.ja: visionOSではbold textとlarge areaでcolorを使うことを優先する。

conditions: Color in lightweight text or small areas can be harder to perceive and understand.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0020.review_note: Recorded the lightweight-text and small-area perception risk.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0021.title: Use watchOS background color to communicate information

statement.en: Use watchOS background color to support content or communicate additional information.
statement.ja: watchOS background colorでcontentを支え、追加informationを伝える。

conditions: Background color can establish place and help people recognize key content.
exceptions: Don't use background color solely as visual decoration.
Avoid full-screen color in workout or audio views that remain visible for long periods.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0021.review_note: Recorded the communication purpose and both decoration and long-duration restrictions.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0022.title: Balance brightness in fully immersive visionOS experiences

statement.en: Balance brightness levels to preserve visual comfort in a fully immersive visionOS experience.
statement.ja: fully immersive visionOS experienceではbrightness levelを均衡させてvisual comfortを保つ。

conditions: High contrast can cause discomfort after people's eyes adapt to low light.
Make content fully bright only when the surrounding visual context is also bright.
exceptions: Avoid bright flashing or moving objects against very dark backgrounds.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0022.review_note: Recovered the contextual Help lead and recorded the adaptation and contrast constraints.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0023.title: Account for tinted-mode graphic complications

statement.en: Account for people preferring tinted mode in watchOS graphic complications.
statement.ja: watchOS graphic complicationでtinted modeを好む人を考慮する。

conditions: Tinted mode applies one wearer-selected color to images, gauges, and text.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-COLOR-0023.review_note: Recovered the omitted Recognize lead and recorded the system's single-color behavior.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0001.title: Create recognizable, highly simplified interface icons

statement.en: Create recognizable, highly simplified interface icons.
statement.ja: recognizableで高度にsimplifiedされたinterface iconを作る。

conditions: Use simple, universal, familiar metaphors that communicate quickly.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0001.review_note: Recorded simplicity, recognizability, and metaphor familiarity as one design outcome.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0002.title: Maintain visual consistency across interface icons

statement.en: Ensure interface icons use consistent size, detail, stroke weight, and perspective.
statement.ja: interface iconのsize、detail、stroke weight、perspectiveを一貫させる。

conditions: Adjust dimensions when visual weight makes nominally equal icons appear inconsistent.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0002.review_note: Raised the rule to MUST from the supporting prose's explicit need-to requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0003.title: Provide selected-state icon assets only when necessary

statement.en: Provide a selected-state interface-icon asset only when necessary.
statement.ja: 必要な場合に限りselected-state interface-icon assetを用意する。

conditions: Standard system controls update selected icons automatically.
Create a selected-state asset only for custom controls that need one.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0003.review_note: Recorded the system-provided behavior and limited custom assets to necessary cases.

statement.en: Use inclusive imagery in interface icons.
statement.ja: interface iconにinclusiveなimageryを使う。

conditions: Apply the separate gender-neutral and cross-cultural recognition rules.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0004.review_note: Retained the general inclusive-imagery rule and split two concrete outcomes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0005.title: Include icon text only when essential

statement.en: Include text in an interface icon only when it is essential for meaning.
statement.ja: 意味を伝えるためにessentialな場合に限りinterface iconへtextを含める。

conditions: Use separate rules for character localization, passages, and right-to-left layouts.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0005.review_note: Retained the qualified recommendation and split the source's localization outcomes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0006.title: Provide alternative text for custom interface icons

statement.en: Provide alternative text labels for custom interface icons.
statement.ja: custom interface iconにalternative text labelを提供する。

conditions: Enable VoiceOver to describe each custom icon.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0006.review_note: Retained this unqualified accessibility requirement as MUST.

statement.en: Avoid using replicas of Apple hardware products in interface icons.
statement.ja: interface iconでApple hardware productのreplicaを使わない。

conditions: Use the separate official-resource rule when Apple hardware must appear.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0007.review_note: Retained direct Avoid guidance as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0008.title: Design simple macOS document-icon imagery

statement.en: Design simple macOS document-icon images that clearly communicate the document type.
statement.ja: document typeを明確に伝えるsimpleなmacOS document-icon imageを設計する。

conditions: Prefer uncomplicated shapes and a reduced palette of distinct colors.
Keep the design recognizable down to 16×16 px.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0008.review_note: Recorded the shape, palette, and minimum rendered-size constraints.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0009.title: Consider simplifying small macOS document icons

statement.en: Consider reducing complexity in small versions of a macOS document icon.
statement.ja: small versionのmacOS document iconではcomplexity低減を検討する。

conditions: Use fewer or thicker details at intermediate sizes.
Remove details that become unclear at 16×16 px.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0009.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the source's size-specific simplification techniques.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0010.title: Avoid important content beneath the document-icon fold

statement.en: Avoid important content in the top-right corner of a macOS document-icon background.
statement.ja: macOS document-icon backgroundのtop-right cornerにimportant contentを置かない。

conditions: The system masks the image and draws a white folded corner over it.
Background assets: 512×512 px at 1× or 1024×1024 px at 2×.
Background assets: 256×256 px at 1× or 512×512 px at 2×.
Background assets: 128×128 px at 1× or 256×256 px at 2×.
Background assets: 32×32 px at 1× or 64×64 px at 2×.
Background assets: 16×16 px at 1× or 32×32 px at 2×.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0010.review_note: Recorded the fold-mask obstruction and every documented background asset size.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0011.title: Keep most center imagery inside a 10% margin

statement.en: Define a 10% margin and keep most macOS document center imagery within it.
statement.ja: 10% marginを定義し、macOS document center imageの大半を内側へ収める。

conditions: Let the image occupy about 80% of its canvas.
A 256×256 px canvas yields an approximately 205×205 px main-image area.
exceptions: Extend small parts into the margin when optical alignment needs it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0011.review_note: Recorded the 10% margin, 80% occupancy, numeric example, and optical-alignment exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0012.title: Consider a familiar-object center image for a document icon

statement.en: When a familiar object conveys a document type or app connection, consider using it as the center image.
statement.ja: familiar objectがdocument typeやapp connectionを伝える場合、center imageへの使用を検討する。

conditions: Keep the center image simple, unambiguous, and recognizable at every size.
Make the center-image canvas half the overall document-icon size.
Center assets: 256×256 px at 1× or 512×512 px at 2×.
Center assets: 128×128 px at 1× or 256×256 px at 2×.
Center assets: 32×32 px at 1× or 64×64 px at 2×.
Center assets: 16×16 px at 1× or 32×32 px at 2×.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0012.review_note: Restored the truncated condition and recorded every center-image size.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0014.title: Specify a succinct document term when the extension is unclear

statement.en: When a file extension is unfamiliar, specify a succinct term that clarifies the macOS document type.
statement.ja: file extensionがunfamiliarな場合、macOS document typeを明確にする簡潔なtermを指定する。

conditions: The system otherwise shows the file extension at the document icon's bottom edge.
Use a term short enough to remain legible after automatic scaling.
The system capitalizes every letter by default.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0014.review_note: Recovered the omitted Specify lead and recorded the extension, scaling, and capitalization behavior.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0013.title: Add icon padding when optical alignment needs it

statement.en: When necessary, add padding to a custom interface icon to achieve optical alignment.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はcustom interface iconにpaddingを加えてoptical alignmentを実現する。

conditions: Use padding especially when an asymmetric icon's visual center differs from its geometric center.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0013.review_note: Recorded the asymmetric-icon condition and retained the conditional recommendation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0015.title: Use vector formats for custom interface icons

statement.en: Use a vector format such as PDF or SVG for a custom interface icon.
statement.ja: custom interface iconにはPDFやSVGなどのvector formatを使う。

conditions: Vector assets scale without separate files for each resolution.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0015.review_note: Retained the conditional recommendation and separated the stronger PNG consequence.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0016.title: Match icon weight to adjacent text

statement.en: Match the weight of interface icons to adjacent text.
statement.ja: interface iconのweightを隣接するtextに合わせる。

exceptions: Allow deliberate differences when emphasizing either the icon or the text.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0016.review_note: Activated the previously unrecognized general guidance and retained its emphasis exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0017.title: Prefer gender-neutral human figures in icons

statement.en: Prefer gender-neutral human figures in interface icons.
statement.ja: interface iconではgender-neutralなhuman figureを優先する。

conditions: Avoid representing one gender when the concept does not require it.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0018.title: Avoid culturally unclear icon imagery

statement.en: Avoid icon imagery that can be hard to recognize across cultures or languages.
statement.ja: cultureやlanguageをまたいで認識しにくいicon imageryを避ける。

conditions: Check imagery across the app's target cultures and languages.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0018.review_note: Recovered direct Avoid guidance as AVOID, not MUST_NOT.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0019.title: Localize individual characters in interface icons

statement.en: Localize individual characters that appear in interface icons.
statement.ja: interface iconに表示するindividual characterをlocalizeする。

conditions: Apply when an icon uses an individual character to convey meaning.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0019.review_note: Recovered the explicit Be sure localization requirement as MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0020.title: Represent text passages abstractly in icons

statement.en: Use an abstract representation when an interface icon depicts a passage of text.
statement.ja: interface iconでtext passageを表す場合はabstract representationを使う。

conditions: Avoid reproducing literal passages of text in the icon.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0021.title: Flip text-passage icons for right-to-left contexts

statement.en: Provide a flipped text-passage icon for right-to-left contexts.
statement.ja: right-to-left context向けにtext-passage iconのflipped versionを用意する。

conditions: Apply when layout direction changes for right-to-left localization.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0022.title: Supply multiple versions of PNG interface icons

statement.en: Supply multiple versions for each PNG-based interface icon.
statement.ja: PNG-based interface iconごとに複数のversionを用意する。

conditions: PNG assets do not scale across resolutions.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0022.review_note: Recovered the explicit need-to requirement and its raster-format condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0023.title: Consider a custom SF Symbol for a custom icon

statement.en: Consider creating a custom SF Symbol for a custom interface icon.
statement.ja: custom interface iconにはcustom SF Symbolの作成を検討する。

conditions: Match the symbol's scale to adjacent text.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0023.review_note: Recovered the optional custom-symbol branch and its scale constraint.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0024.title: Use official resources when depicting Apple hardware

statement.en: When depicting Apple hardware, use only Apple Design Resources images or product SF Symbols.
statement.ja: Apple hardwareを表す場合はApple Design Resourcesのimageまたはproduct SF Symbolだけを使う。

conditions: Apply only when the interface must depict Apple hardware.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0024.review_note: Recovered the conditional official-resource guidance without promoting it to MUST.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0025.title: Consider documented SF Symbols for common actions

statement.en: Consider using the documented SF Symbols to represent common actions and items.
statement.ja: common actionやitemを表すためdocumented SF Symbolの使用を検討する。

conditions: The source lists 53 mappings across nine action categories.
Keep mappings source-linked; do not persist the full source tables.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-ICONS-0025.review_note: Recovered the optional standard-symbol guidance and preserved its mapping tables as structured context.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0007.title: Expose visual element relationships to VoiceOver

statement.en: Specify element grouping, order, and links so VoiceOver communicates relationships that are otherwise visual.
statement.ja: elementのgrouping、order、linkを指定し、visual-onlyな関係をVoiceOverへ伝える。

conditions: Audit relationships conveyed only through proximity, alignment, or other visual context.
Respect the reading order of the active language and locale.
Group related images with their respective captions.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-VOICEOVER-0007.review_note: Recovered the omitted Specify lead and recorded visual-context, reading-order, and grouping requirements.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use dimmed passthrough to focus attention

statement.en: Use dimmed passthrough to focus attention on content without hiding other experiences.
statement.ja: 他の体験を隠さずcontentへ注意を向けるため、dimmed passthroughを使う。

conditions: Use it in the Shared Space or a Full Space.
Passthrough uses black tint by default and can use a custom tint.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the attention purpose, supported spaces, and default or custom tint behavior.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use mixed immersion for unbounded 3D experiences

statement.en: Use mixed immersion in a Full Space for unbounded 3D content blended with passthrough.
statement.ja: Full Spaceでunbounded 3D contentをpassthroughと組み合わせるにはmixed immersionを使う。

conditions: Mixed immersion has no system-defined movement boundary.
Nearby content becomes semi-opaque when a person approaches a physical object.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the Full Space scope, absent boundary, and automatic physical-object response.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use progressive immersion to blend an environment with surroundings

statement.en: Use progressive immersion when a custom environment should partially replace passthrough.
statement.ja: custom environmentでpassthroughを部分的に置き換える場合はprogressive immersionを使う。

conditions: Support portrait or landscape content where appropriate.
People adjust immersion within a 120–360 degree default range or a specified custom range.
The system defines an approximately 1.5-meter boundary.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded partial replacement, orientation, adjustable range, and movement-boundary context.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use full immersion for a fully virtual environment

statement.en: Use full immersion for a 360-degree custom environment that completely replaces passthrough.
statement.ja: passthroughを完全に置き換える360-degree custom environmentにはfull immersionを使う。

conditions: The system defines an approximately 1.5-meter boundary when the experience starts.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded complete passthrough replacement and the system-defined movement boundary.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Offer multiple ways to use an immersive app or game

statement.en: Offer multiple ways to use an immersive app or game.
statement.ja: immersive appやgameに複数の利用方法を用意する。

conditions: Support accessibility features people use to personalize interaction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded user choice and accessibility personalization as coequal design constraints.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Prefer launching in the Shared Space or mixed immersion

statement.en: Prefer launching in the Shared Space or mixed immersion.
statement.ja: Shared Spaceまたはmixed immersionでの起動を優先する。

conditions: Preserve switching among running experiences.
Let people choose when to increase immersion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded cross-app switching and user control over increased immersion.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Guide attention to key moments at every immersion level

statement.en: Help people engage with key moments at every level of immersion.
statement.ja: immersion levelにかかわらず、key momentへ利用者の注意を導く。

conditions: Start with subtle cues and strengthen them only for a documented reason.
Cues can include dimming, tinting, motion, scale, and Spatial Audio.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the cue types and subtle-first escalation strategy.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Prefer subtle passthrough tint colors

statement.en: Prefer subtle passthrough tint colors in visionOS 2 and later.
statement.ja: visionOS 2以降ではsubtleなpassthrough tint colorを優先する。

conditions: Coordinate surroundings and visible hands with the experience.
exceptions: Avoid bright or dramatic tints that distract people or reduce immersion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded the version scope, coordination purpose, and distracting-tint restriction.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Protect visual comfort in a Full Space

statement.en: Protect people’s visual comfort in a Full Space.
statement.ja: Full Spaceで利用者のvisual comfortを守る。

conditions: Prefer placing 3D content within the field of view.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated the general comfort prompt from the explicit comfortable-motion requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Choose immersion that supports expected movement

statement.en: Choose an immersion style that supports the movement people may make.
statement.ja: 利用者が行う可能性のあるmovementに対応するimmersion styleを選ぶ。

conditions: Minor movements include shifting weight, turning, and changing between sitting and standing.
Use mixed immersion when people may move beyond the approximately 1.5-meter boundary.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded expected movement and the boundary-dependent mixed-style fallback.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid requiring movement in progressive or full immersion

statement.en: Avoid requiring movement in progressive or fully immersive experiences.
statement.ja: progressiveまたはfully immersiveな体験でmovementを求めない。

conditions: Provide interaction methods that work without physical movement.
exceptions: Bring virtual content closer instead of requiring a person to approach it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded disability and physical-space constraints with a no-movement alternative.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Adopt ARKit when blending content with surroundings

statement.en: Adopt ARKit when custom content needs information about a person’s surroundings.
statement.ja: custom contentで利用者の周囲情報が必要な場合はARKitを採用する。

conditions: Use surroundings or hand-position data only for the scoped experience.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated the ARKit choice from the explicit permission requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Design smooth, predictable immersion transitions

statement.en: Design smooth, predictable transitions between immersion styles.
statement.ja: immersion style間をsmoothかつpredictableに遷移させる。

conditions: Use gentle transitions that let people visually track changes.
exceptions: Avoid sudden or jarring transitions that can disorient people.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded visual tracking and the disorientation risk.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Let people choose when to change immersion

statement.en: Let people choose when to enter or exit a more immersive experience.
statement.ja: よりimmersiveな体験へ入る時と出る時を利用者が選べるようにする。

conditions: Provide a clear action for entering and exiting immersion.
exceptions: Avoid requiring system controls to reduce immersion.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded explicit entry and exit actions and the system-control restriction.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Prefer familiar virtual-hand characteristics

statement.en: Prefer virtual hands that match familiar positions, gestures, and interactions.
statement.ja: familiarな位置、gesture、interactionに一致するvirtual handsを優先する。

conditions: Support natural interaction and sustained immersion in virtual worlds.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded position and gesture matching as the familiar-characteristics basis.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use caution with oversized virtual hands

statement.en: Use caution when virtual hands are larger than the viewer’s hands.
statement.ja: virtual handsを利用者の手より大きくする場合は注意する。

conditions: Avoid obscuring content or making interaction feel clumsy.
Keep virtual hands proportional to the surrounding space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded content visibility, interaction precision, and spatial-proportion risks.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Minimize distracting environmental content

statement.en: Minimize environmental content that distracts from the primary task.
statement.ja: primary taskから注意をそらすenvironmental contentを最小限にする。

conditions: Avoid excessive movement and high-contrast detail around primary content.
Use higher-quality assets in important areas and quieter assets elsewhere.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded task focus and the source's quality and dimming hierarchy techniques.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Make environmental objects’ interactivity understandable

statement.en: Help people distinguish interactive objects in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentでinteractive objectを判別できるようにする。

conditions: Use object proximity to support expectations about reach and interaction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded proximity as the documented cue for likely interactivity.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Keep environmental animation subtle

statement.en: Keep animation in a custom environment small and gentle.
statement.ja: custom environmentのanimationをsmallかつgentleに保つ。

conditions: Enrich the environment without distracting people or causing discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated subtle-animation guidance from the explicit field-of-view-edge prohibition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Create an expansive custom environment

statement.en: Create an expansive custom environment regardless of the place it depicts.
statement.ja: 描く場所にかかわらずexpansiveなcustom environmentを作る。

conditions: Avoid spatial restriction that can cause discomfort or claustrophobia.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded spatial comfort and claustrophobia as the expansion rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Use Spatial Audio to create environmental atmosphere

statement.en: Use Spatial Audio to create atmosphere in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentのatmosphereを作るためSpatial Audioを使う。

conditions: Avoid excessive repetition or looping in the soundscape.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated atmospheric audio guidance from the conditional other-audio requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Help people feel grounded in a custom environment

statement.en: Help people feel grounded in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentで利用者がgroundedだと感じられるようにする。

conditions: Use a ground plane to provide a stable spatial reference.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Separated the grounding goal from the explicit ground-plane requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Minimize asset redundancy in a custom environment

statement.en: Minimize repeated assets and models in a custom environment.
statement.ja: custom environmentでassetやmodelの繰り返しを最小限にする。

conditions: Frequent repetition can make an environment feel less realistic.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded realism as the reason to limit repeated assets.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Reserve immersion for meaningful moments and content

statement.en: Reserve immersion for meaningful tasks, moments, and content.
statement.ja: immersionをmeaningfulなtask、moment、contentに限定する。

conditions: Keep tasks in the Shared Space when immersion adds little value.
Let people remain aware of surroundings and other software when appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recorded task-level proportionality and continued access to surroundings and other software.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid obscuring passthrough in mixed immersion

statement.en: When using mixed immersion, avoid obscuring too much passthrough.
statement.ja: mixed immersionではpassthroughを過度に遮らない。

conditions: Preserve enough physical context for people to understand and navigate their surroundings.
exceptions: Use progressive or full immersion when virtual objects must substantially obscure passthrough.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the conditional AVOID lead and its safer immersion-style alternative.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Indicate an immersive exit control’s purpose

statement.en: Indicate the purpose of an immersive-experience exit control.
statement.ja: immersive experienceのexit controlが何を行うか示す。

conditions: Differentiate reducing immersion from quitting the experience.
exceptions: Before quitting, consider pause or return controls that let people save progress.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the omitted Indicate lead and recorded both possible exit outcomes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Fade virtual hands when hand tracking is interrupted

statement.en: When hand tracking is interrupted, fade virtual hands out and reveal the viewer’s hands.
statement.ja: hand trackingが中断したらvirtual handsをfade outし、利用者自身の手を表示する。

conditions: Fade virtual hands back in when tracking returns.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the conditional fade lead and its tracking-return transition.

conditions: Prevent motion from causing distraction, confusion, or discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered explicit comfortable-motion guidance from the supporting paragraph.

conditions: The experience uses ARKit data to blend custom content with a person’s surroundings.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit permission requirement from the ARKit supporting paragraph.

conditions: An immersive experience provides an exit control.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit outcome-clarity requirement from the exit-control supporting paragraph.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.title: Avoid frozen virtual hands during tracking interruption

statement.en: Avoid leaving virtual hands frozen or unresponsive when hand tracking is interrupted.
statement.ja: hand tracking中断時にvirtual handsをfrozenまたはunresponsiveな状態で残さない。

conditions: Reveal the viewer’s hands while virtual hands are unavailable.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the direct prohibition and kept it at conservative AVOID strength.

conditions: The experience displays animation in a custom environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit field-of-view-edge motion prohibition.

conditions: People can play other audio while they use the environment.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the conditional soundscape-volume requirement from supporting prose.

conditions: The app or game presents a custom environment in a Full Space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-00.review_note: Recovered the explicit ground-plane requirement from supporting prose.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0007.title: Aim to support portrait and landscape on iOS

statement.en: Aim to support both portrait and landscape orientations on iOS.
statement.ja: iOSではportraitとlandscapeの両orientationへの対応を目指す。

conditions: Let people discover a single supported orientation by rotating the device.
exceptions: A task-specific experience may support only portrait or only landscape.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0007.review_note: Recorded the preferred dual-orientation support and the single-orientation exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0008.title: Prefer a full-bleed iOS game interface

statement.en: Prefer a full-bleed interface for an iOS game.
statement.ja: iOS gameではfull-bleed interfaceを優先する。

conditions: Accommodate hardware corner radius, sensor housing, and Dynamic Island.
exceptions: When necessary, consider an optional letterboxed or pillarboxed view.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0008.review_note: Recorded hardware accommodation and the optional fitted-view fallback.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0009.title: Avoid full-width iOS buttons

statement.en: Avoid full-width buttons in iOS interfaces.
statement.ja: iOS interfaceではfull-width buttonを避ける。

conditions: Inset buttons from screen edges using system-defined margins.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0009.review_note: Separated the default AVOID guidance from the explicit necessary-button exception requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0010.title: Test iPadOS layouts at common window sizes

statement.en: Test iPadOS layouts at common system window sizes and provide smooth transitions.
statement.ja: iPadOS layoutを一般的なsystem window sizeでtestし、smoothなtransitionを提供する。

conditions: Test halves, thirds, and quadrants on multiple devices.
Cover the supported minimum-to-maximum window-size range.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0010.review_note: Recorded the system arrangements, device coverage, and full resizing range.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0011.title: Consider a convertible tab bar for iPadOS navigation

statement.en: Consider a convertible tab bar for adaptive iPadOS navigation.
statement.ja: adaptiveなiPadOS navigationにはconvertible tab barを検討する。

conditions: Let people switch between tab-bar and sidebar presentations when appropriate.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0011.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the user-switchable adaptive presentation.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0012.title: Avoid critical macOS content at a window’s bottom edge

statement.en: Avoid controls and critical information at the bottom of a macOS window.
statement.ja: macOS windowのbottomにcontrolやcritical informationを置かない。

conditions: People may move the bottom edge below the screen.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0013.title: Avoid the macOS camera housing area

statement.en: Avoid displaying content within the macOS camera housing area.
statement.ja: macOSのcamera housing area内にcontentを表示しない。

conditions: The camera housing occupies the window’s top-edge region.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0013.review_note: Recorded the exact display-feature obstruction scope.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0014.title: Design tvOS layouts for varied television sizes

statement.en: Design tvOS layouts to work well across varied television sizes.
statement.ja: tvOS layoutをさまざまなtelevision sizeで適切に表示できるよう設計する。

conditions: tvOS shows the same interface rather than automatically adapting it to every display.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0014.review_note: Recorded the nonadaptive display behavior and cross-size requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0015.title: Pad tvOS focusable elements for their focused size

statement.en: Include padding between tvOS focusable elements that accommodates their focused size.
statement.ja: focus時のsizeを収めるpaddingをtvOS focusable element間に設ける。

conditions: UIKit focus effects enlarge elements when they receive focus.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0015.review_note: Separated general focus padding from the explicit important-information non-overlap rule.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0016.title: Add vertical spacing around titled tvOS grid rows

statement.en: Include additional vertical spacing around titled tvOS grid rows.
statement.ja: title付きtvOS grid rowの上下に追加のvertical spacingを設ける。

conditions: Separate a title from the preceding unfocused row.
Separate the title from the following unfocused items.
