HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0016.review_note: Recorded both title-spacing relationships despite the inherited final-grid section path.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0017.title: Use consistent tvOS grid spacing

statement.en: Use consistent spacing in tvOS grids.
statement.ja: tvOS gridでconsistentなspacingを使う。

conditions: 2 columns: 860 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
3 columns: 560 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
4 columns: 410 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
5 columns: 320 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
6 columns: 260 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
7 columns: 217 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
8 columns: 184 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
9 columns: 160 pt width, 40 pt horizontal, 100 pt minimum vertical.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0017.review_note: Preserved every official tvOS grid width and spacing row from the structured tables.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0018.title: Keep partially hidden tvOS grid content symmetrical

statement.en: Keep partially hidden tvOS grid content symmetrical across screen edges.
statement.ja: 部分的に隠れるtvOS grid contentをscreen edge間でsymmetricalにする。

conditions: Use equal widths for partially hidden offscreen content on both sides.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0018.review_note: Recorded the equal-width technique for directing attention to fully visible content.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0019.title: Consider centering important visionOS content and controls

statement.en: Consider centering the most important visionOS content and controls.
statement.ja: 最も重要なvisionOS contentとcontrolを中央に置くことを検討する。

conditions: Centering can improve discovery and interaction, especially in large windows.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0019.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the large-window discoverability rationale.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0020.title: Keep visionOS window content within its bounds

statement.en: Keep visionOS window content within its XY-plane bounds.
statement.ja: visionOS window contentをXY-planeのbounds内に保つ。

conditions: Leave areas outside the window clear for sharing, resizing, moving, and closing controls.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0020.review_note: Recorded every system-control area affected by out-of-bounds 2D or 3D content.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0021.title: Make visionOS interactive components comfortable to look at

statement.en: Make visionOS interactive components easy and comfortable to look at.
statement.ja: visionOS interactive componentを見つけやすくcomfortableに見ることができるようにする。

conditions: Provide space for visual identification and the system hover effect.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0021.review_note: Separated the usability goal from the explicit enough-space requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0022.title: Extend watchOS content edge to edge

statement.en: Extend watchOS content from one screen edge to the other.
statement.ja: watchOS contentをscreenの端から端まで広げる。

conditions: Treat the Apple Watch bezel as natural visual padding.
exceptions: Consider minimizing padding between elements to preserve usable space.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0022.review_note: Recorded bezel padding and the space-preserving inner-padding option.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0023.title: Avoid too many side-by-side watchOS controls

statement.en: Avoid placing more than two or three watchOS controls side by side.
statement.ja: watchOS controlを横に2個または3個より多く並べない。

conditions: Use at most three glyph buttons or two text buttons in a row as the general rule.
exceptions: Two short text buttons can work side by side when the screen does not scroll.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0023.review_note: Recorded glyph and text limits plus the short-label non-scrolling exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0024.title: Support watchOS autorotation for shareable views

statement.en: Support autorotation in watchOS views people may show to others.
statement.ja: 他者へ見せる可能性のあるwatchOS viewでautorotationをsupportする。

conditions: Examples include showing an image or presenting a QR code to a reader.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0024.review_note: Recorded the wrist-away sharing scenarios that justify autorotation.

conditions: The iOS app or game supports only landscape orientation.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit two-direction landscape requirement.

conditions: A full-width button is necessary despite the general guidance to avoid it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0027.review_note: Recovered the explicit hardware-curvature and safe-area requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0028.title: Hide the iOS status bar only when it adds value

statement.en: Hide the iOS status bar only when doing so adds value or enhances the experience.
statement.ja: 価値を加えるか体験を高める場合にだけiOS status barを隠す。

conditions: Keep useful status information visible in ordinary app contexts.
exceptions: Deep game or media experiences may benefit from hiding it.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0028.review_note: Recovered the omitted Hide lead and preserved its narrow value-based condition.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0029.title: Defer compact iPadOS layouts while the full layout fits

statement.en: While an iPadOS window resizes, defer compact layout until the full layout no longer fits.
statement.ja: iPadOS windowのresize中はfull layoutが収まらなくなるまでcompact layoutへの切替を遅らせる。

conditions: Design the full-screen layout first.
For complex layouts, hide tertiary columns as width narrows.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0029.review_note: Recovered the contextual Defer lead and recorded the tertiary-column technique.

conditions: A person resizes the window between its minimum and maximum supported sizes.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0031.title: Adhere to the tvOS screen safe area

statement.en: Keep primary tvOS content within the screen safe area.
statement.ja: primary tvOS contentをscreen safe area内に保つ。

conditions: Inset primary content 60 points vertically and 80 points horizontally.
exceptions: Only deliberately flowing or partially displayed offscreen content may extend outside.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0031.review_note: Recovered the Adhere lead and preserved all safe-area measurements and exceptions.

conditions: A focus effect enlarges the element.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0032.review_note: Recovered the explicit important-information non-overlap requirement.

conditions: The interface uses a tvOS grid whose items enlarge on focus.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0033.review_note: Recovered the explicit row-and-column focus-spacing requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0034.title: Use an ornament for visionOS controls outside a window

statement.en: When controls do not belong inside a visionOS window, place them in an ornament.
statement.ja: controlがvisionOS window内に属さない場合はornamentへ配置する。

conditions: Keep controls visually associated with the window without obstructing system controls.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0034.review_note: Recovered the conditional Use lead and recorded the system-control separation purpose.

conditions: Prevent the system hover effect from obscuring other content.
The source gives 60-point center spacing as an example, not an unconditional minimum.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-LAYOUT-0035.review_note: Recovered the explicit spacing requirement while keeping 60 points as an example.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0008.title: Keep large virtual-object motion comfortable

statement.en: Keep people comfortable when showing movement of large virtual objects in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSでlarge virtual objectのmovementを見せるとき利用者のcomfortを保つ。

conditions: Large objects may fill much of the field of view and obscure passthrough.
exceptions: Increase translucency or reduce contrast so movement is easier to perceive comfortably.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0008.review_note: Recorded field-of-view coverage, passthrough occlusion, and both comfort techniques.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0009.title: Consider fades for relocating a visionOS object

statement.en: When object relocation communicates nothing useful, consider hiding the movement with fades.
statement.ja: object relocationが有用な情報を伝えない場合、fadeでmovementを隠すことを検討する。

conditions: Fade the object out before relocation and back in afterward.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0009.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the no-useful-information condition and two fade phases.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0010.title: Consider a stationary reference for visionOS motion

statement.en: Consider giving people a stationary frame of reference around visionOS motion.
statement.ja: visionOS motionの周囲にstationaryなreference frameを設けることを検討する。

conditions: Contain visual movement within an area that does not move.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0010.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the stationary containment that reduces discomfort.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0011.title: Avoid sustained object oscillation in visionOS

statement.en: Avoid showing visionOS objects that oscillate continuously.
statement.ja: visionOSでobjectが継続的にoscillateする表示を避ける。

conditions: Avoid frequencies around 0.2 Hz because people can be especially sensitive to them.
exceptions: When oscillation is needed, keep amplitude low and consider translucency.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0011.review_note: Recorded the 0.2 Hz sensitivity and both mitigation options.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0013.title: Avoid visionOS motion at field-of-view edges

statement.en: Wherever practicable, avoid motion at the edges of a person’s visionOS field of view.
statement.ja: 可能な限りvisionOSのfield of view端でmotionを表示しない。

conditions: Peripheral motion can distract people or create a false sense of self or environmental movement.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0013.review_note: Preserved the practicability qualifier and peripheral-vision comfort rationale.

conditions: An immersive visionOS experience needs to show an object moving in peripheral vision.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-MOTION-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit brightness-matching requirement within the edge-motion exception.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0001.title: Avoid head-anchored visionOS content

statement.en: Avoid anchoring visionOS content to the wearer’s head.
statement.ja: visionOS contentを利用者のheadにanchorしない。

conditions: Head anchoring can feel confining and reduce the apparent stability of surroundings.
exceptions: Anchor content in a person’s space so they can look around naturally.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0001.review_note: Recorded the confinement and stability risks plus the spatial-anchor alternative.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0002.title: Communicate virtual-content depth accurately

statement.en: Provide visual cues that accurately communicate virtual-content depth.
statement.ja: virtual contentのdepthを正確に伝えるvisual cueを提供する。

conditions: Missing or conflicting real-world depth cues can cause visual discomfort.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0002.review_note: Recorded the real-world cue consistency and visual-comfort requirement.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0003.title: Use visionOS depth to communicate hierarchy

statement.en: Use visionOS depth to communicate hierarchy and prominence.
statement.ja: visionOS depthでhierarchyとprominenceを伝える。

conditions: Use depth changes to distinguish foreground elements from surrounding content.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0003.review_note: Recorded prominence and depth-change perception as the hierarchy mechanisms.

conditions: Prefer depth for large, important interface elements.
Review repeated depth changes because refocusing can be tiring.
exceptions: Avoid depth that reduces legibility or usability on small objects.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0004.review_note: Replaced generic conditions with the source's value, scale, legibility, and refocusing limits.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0005.title: Consider fixed scale for life-size virtual objects

statement.en: Consider fixed scale when a virtual object must look like its physical counterpart.
statement.ja: virtual objectをphysical counterpartと同じように見せる場合はfixed scaleを検討する。

conditions: Use fixed scale sparingly and prefer it for noninteractive objects.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0005.review_note: Retained MAY and recorded the life-size, sparse-use, and noninteractive conditions.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0006.title: Avoid too many visionOS windows

statement.en: Avoid displaying too many visionOS windows at once.
statement.ja: visionOS windowを一度に過剰表示しない。

conditions: Preserve visibility of surroundings and avoid overwhelm or constriction.
HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0006.review_note: Recorded surroundings visibility, comfort, and multiwindow relocation costs.

HIG-FOUNDATIONS-SPATIAL-LAYOUT-0007.title: Prioritize standard indirect visionOS gestures

statement.ja: Wallet pass thumbnailをrounded artwork corner付きtransparent PNGとしてexportする。

conditions: Use thumbnail.png at 60–90 pt wide and 90 pt high.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0055.review_note: Recovered the thumbnail format and shape as an exact asset contract.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0056.title: Keep pass background content in the safe area

statement.en: Position Wallet pass background content within the documented safe area.
statement.ja: Wallet pass background contentをdocumented safe area内に配置する。

conditions: Account for the bottom material strip on poster generic and poster event passes.
Account for a barcode when the pass includes one.
Preview placement in Pass Designer.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0056.review_note: Classified the documented safe area as a pass-layout contract and preserved both obstructions.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0057.title: Ensure the displayed order price matches the confirmed price

statement.en: Ensure the price shown in a Wallet order matches the final price the customer confirmed.
statement.ja: Wallet orderに表示するpriceをcustomerが確認したfinal priceと一致させる。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0057.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure financial-accuracy requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0058.title: Provide the required merchant contact link

statement.en: Provide at least a link to the merchant's website or landing page in Wallet order contact options.
statement.ja: Wallet orderのcontact optionに少なくともmerchant websiteまたはlanding pageへのlinkを提供する。

conditions: Additional options can include Messages for Business, phone, email, and a support page.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0058.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit at-minimum need-to requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0059.title: Provide an available carrier tracking link

statement.en: Provide a carrier tracking link whenever one is available.
statement.ja: carrier tracking linkが利用可能な場合は提供する。

conditions: Apply whether detailed interim carrier statuses are available or only a shipped status can be reported.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0060.title: Provide a fallback identity-verification method

statement.en: Provide another identity-verification method when Verify with Apple Wallet isn't available.
statement.ja: Verify with Apple Walletを利用できない場合は別のidentity-verification methodを提供する。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0060.review_note: Recovered the availability fallback as a required completion path.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0061.title: Never request identity verification before the person is ready

statement.en: Never request Wallet identity verification before a person starts the requiring process or while they merely create an account.
statement.ja: 利用者が必要なprocessを開始する前や単にaccountを作成している間はWallet identity verificationを要求しない。

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-WALLET-0061.review_note: Raised the direct don't instruction to MUST_NOT under privacy and explicit user intent.

statement.en: Choose or apply an action sheet — not an alert — to offer choices related to an intentional action in the documented context.
statement.ja: 該当する状況ではan action sheet — not an alert — to offer choices related to an intentional actionを採用する。

conditions: An alert can confirm or cancel a destructive action but doesn't offer additional related choices.
Alerts are generally unexpected and communicate a problem or situational change.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0001.review_note: Recorded the intentional-action condition and the alert distinction.

conditions: Action sheets interrupt the current task.
Avoid unnecessary use so people continue to pay attention when one appears.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0002.review_note: Recorded interruption and attention as the reasons for sparing use.

statement.en: Aim for an action-sheet title that fits on one line.
statement.ja: action sheet titleが1行に収まるようにする。

conditions: Long titles are harder to scan and may truncate or require scrolling.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0003.review_note: Retained the qualified Aim wording at SHOULD.

statement.en: Include an action-sheet message only when the title and action context aren't sufficient.
statement.ja: titleとaction contextだけでは不十分な場合にだけaction sheet messageを含める。

conditions: Usually the title and current-action context explain the available choices.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0004.review_note: Preserved the contextual only-if recommendation without promoting it to MUST.

statement.en: Make destructive action-sheet choices visually prominent.
statement.ja: destructiveなaction sheet choiceをvisually prominentにする。

conditions: Use the destructive button style.
Place destructive buttons at the top of the action sheet.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0005.review_note: Recorded both style and placement techniques.

statement.en: On iOS and iPadOS, use an action sheet instead of a menu for choices related to an action.
statement.ja: iOSとiPadOSでactionにrelatedするchoiceにはmenuではなくaction sheetを使う。

conditions: People expect an action sheet after an action that may need clarifying choices.
People expect a menu only after choosing to reveal it.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0006.review_note: Upgraded confidence after reconfirming the complete iOS and iPadOS component-choice context.

conditions: More buttons increase choice time and effort.
Scrolling can cause an inadvertent button tap.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0007.review_note: Upgraded confidence and preserved both usability risks.

statement.en: Avoid more than four watchOS action-sheet buttons, including Cancel.
statement.ja: watchOS action sheetではCancelを含め4個を超えるbuttonを避ける。

conditions: The watchOS Cancel button is required.
Aim for no more than three additional choices so all options remain visible.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0008.review_note: Upgraded confidence, retained AVOID, and recorded the required Cancel plus three-additional-choice target.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0009.title: Provide Cancel when a choice may destroy data

statement.en: When necessary, provide a Cancel button that lets people reject a choice that may destroy data.
statement.ja: 必要な場合はdataを破壊する可能性があるchoiceを拒否できるCancel buttonを提供する。

conditions: SwiftUI confirmation dialogs include a Cancel button by default.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0009.review_note: Activated the conditional Cancel-button lead without turning the if-necessary qualifier into a mandate.

HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0010.title: Place the Cancel button in its platform position

statement.en: Place an action sheet's Cancel button in the expected platform position.
statement.ja: action sheetのCancel buttonをplatformで期待される位置に配置する。

conditions: Use the bottom of the action sheet generally.
Use the sheet's upper-left corner in watchOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-ACTION-SHEETS-0010.review_note: Recovered the cross-platform placement sentence and preserved the watchOS exception.

conditions: Prefer common, important, straightforward tasks that can finish without leaving the current context.
Opening the app can help complete a multistep task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0001.review_note: Recorded both the preferred in-context task and multistep app-opening path.

conditions: The request omits optional information.
When one option is most likely, consider making it the default and offer a short alternative list.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0002.review_note: Recorded the optional-information condition, likely default, and alternative path.

conditions: A phrase that is hard to say aloud is likely hard to remember or say correctly.
Ask for absolutely required additional information in a subsequent step.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0003.review_note: Recorded the spoken-memory test and subsequent-step fallback.

conditions: Consider occasional in-app tips when people perform common actions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0004.review_note: Recorded the source's discoverability technique without requiring a particular tip frequency.

conditions: Account for AirPods, HomePod, and other contexts where onscreen content isn't visible.
The separate critical-information rule records the accessibility MUST.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0005.review_note: Kept general response detail at SHOULD and separated the critical-information requirement.

conditions: Provide natural phrase variants that are easy to remember.
The separate activation-phrase rule requires the app name.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0006.review_note: Recorded memorability and natural variants while separating the explicit app-name requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0007.title: Consider app schemas for common functionality

statement.en: Consider app schemas instead of individual App Shortcuts for common functionality on supported devices.
statement.ja: supported device上のcommon functionalityにはindividual App Shortcutの代わりにapp schemaを検討する。

conditions: The app operates in a common domain area supported by app schemas.
Use App Shortcuts for unique features or custom content that app schemas don't cover.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0007.review_note: Corrected SHOULD to MAY from the explicit consider wording and preserved the uncovered-feature branch.

conditions: Offer predictable, familiar values because people may not see the option list.
The separate parameter rule records the single-optional-value limit.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0008.review_note: Activated the flexibility lead and separated the parameter-count contract.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0009.title: Use snippets for static information or dialog options

statement.en: Use a snippet when an App Shortcut response needs a custom view for static information or dialog options.
statement.ja: App Shortcut responseでstatic informationまたはdialog option用custom viewが必要な場合はsnippetを使う。

conditions: Suitable examples include local weather and order confirmation.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0009.review_note: Recovered the snippet response-mode recommendation from descriptive prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0010.title: Use a Live Activity for changing time-spanning information

statement.en: Use a Live Activity when App Shortcut information remains relevant and changes over time.
statement.ja: App Shortcut informationが一定期間relevantで変化する場合はLive Activityを使う。

conditions: Suitable examples include timers and countdowns that last until an event completes.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0010.review_note: Recovered the Live Activity response-mode recommendation from descriptive prose.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0011.title: Use lowercase for individual shortcuts

statement.en: Use lowercase when referring to an individual shortcut rather than App Shortcuts or the Shortcuts app.
statement.ja: App ShortcutsやShortcuts appではなくindividual shortcutを指す場合はlowercaseを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0011.review_note: Activated the separate individual-shortcut editorial convention.

conditions: Place the most generally useful shortcuts first for initial Spotlight and Shortcuts ordering.
After use begins, the system prioritizes frequently used shortcuts.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0012.review_note: Activated the iOS and iPadOS ordering lead and preserved initial versus learned ordering.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0013.title: Require at least one action in every App Shortcut

statement.en: Ensure every App Shortcut includes at least one action.
statement.ja: 各App Shortcutに少なくとも1つのactionを含める。

conditions: Actions represent the steps people perform to accomplish a task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0013.review_note: Recovered the one-or-more-actions App Shortcut structure contract as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0014.title: Limit an app to 10 App Shortcuts

statement.en: Provide no more than 10 App Shortcuts in an app.
statement.ja: 1つのappで提供するApp Shortcutを10件以下にする。

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit system-supported maximum as a platform-contract MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0015.title: Limit an App Shortcut to one optional parameter

statement.en: Include no more than one optional value or parameter in an App Shortcut.
statement.ja: 1つのApp Shortcutに含めるoptional valueまたはparameterを1つ以下にする。

conditions: Include the parameter only when it makes sense for the task.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0015.review_note: Recovered the single-optional-parameter platform constraint as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0016.title: Include all critical information in full App Shortcut dialogue

statement.en: Include all critical App Shortcut response information in the full dialogue text.
statement.ja: App Shortcut responseのcritical informationをすべてfull dialogue textに含める。

conditions: People may receive the response on an audio-only device or be unable to see the screen.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0016.review_note: Raised the direct critical-information requirement to an audio-accessibility MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0017.title: Include the app name in every activation phrase

statement.en: Include the app name in every App Shortcut activation phrase.
statement.ja: 各App Shortcut activation phraseにapp nameを含める。

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0017.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit You have to requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0018.title: Always title-case App Shortcuts and the Shortcuts app

statement.en: Always use title case when referring to App Shortcuts or the Shortcuts app.
statement.ja: App ShortcutsまたはShortcuts appを指す場合は常にtitle caseを使う。

conditions: Apply to the named feature and app, not individual shortcuts.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0018.review_note: Recovered MUST from the unqualified Always editorial directive.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0019.title: Ensure Shortcuts remains plural

statement.en: Ensure the word Shortcuts remains plural when naming App Shortcuts or the Shortcuts app.
statement.ja: App ShortcutsまたはShortcuts appの名称ではShortcutsをpluralのままにする。

conditions: Apply to the named feature and app, not individual shortcuts.
HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0019.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit Make sure naming directive.

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0020.title: Represent every iOS and iPadOS App Shortcut

statement.en: Represent every iOS and iPadOS App Shortcut with an SF Symbol or a directly linked item's preview image.
statement.ja: 各iOS/iPadOS App ShortcutをSF Symbolまたはdirectly linked itemのpreview imageで表現する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-APP-SHORTCUTS-0020.review_note: Recovered the per-shortcut iOS and iPadOS representation contract as MUST.

statement.en: Prefer keeping a box relatively small compared with its containing view.
statement.ja: boxをcontaining viewと比べて比較的小さく保つことを優先する。

conditions: As a box approaches the containing view's size, grouping becomes less clear and other content can feel crowded.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BOXES-0001.review_note: Retained the explicit Prefer guidance at SHOULD and recorded the documented grouping and crowding risks.

statement.en: Consider using padding and alignment for additional grouping within a box.
statement.ja: box内の追加groupingにはpaddingとalignmentの使用を検討する。

conditions: Prefer padding and alignment over nested boxes when extra grouping is needed.
Nested borders can make an interface feel busy and constrained.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BOXES-0002.review_note: Retained the explicit Consider guidance at MAY and recorded nested-box visual complexity.

statement.en: Provide a succinct introductory title when it helps clarify a box's contents.
statement.ja: boxの内容を明確にできる場合は簡潔なintroductory titleを提供する。

conditions: A title can explain the relationship among the contents.
A title can help VoiceOver users predict the content within the box.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BOXES-0003.review_note: Retained the conditional Provide recommendation at SHOULD and recorded its VoiceOver benefit.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BOXES-0004.title: Write a brief phrase that describes the box contents

statement.en: When a box needs a title, write a brief phrase that describes its contents.
statement.ja: boxにtitleが必要な場合は内容を説明する短いphraseを書く。

conditions: Apply only when a box title is needed.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BOXES-0004.review_note: Activated the conditional title-writing lead and retained it at SHOULD.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BOXES-0005.title: Use sentence-style capitalization in box titles

statement.en: Use sentence-style capitalization in a box title.
statement.ja: box titleにはsentence-style capitalizationを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-BOXES-0005.review_note: Recovered the separate capitalization recommendation from the title-writing context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-BOXES-0006.title: Avoid ending punctuation in box titles

statement.en: Avoid ending punctuation in a box title.
statement.ja: box titleの末尾句読点を避ける。

exceptions: In a settings pane, append a colon to the box title.
HIG-COMPONENTS-BOXES-0006.review_note: Recovered the direct Avoid guidance at AVOID and preserved the settings-pane colon exception.

statement.en: Offer controls for high-value actions people can perform without launching the app.
statement.ja: appを起動せず実行できるhigh-value actionにcontrolを提供する。

conditions: A control can start a Live Activity so people can follow progress without navigating into the app.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0001.review_note: Recorded the high-value, no-launch task boundary and retained SHOULD.

statement.en: Choose a descriptive symbol that suggests a control's behavior.
statement.ja: controlのbehaviorを示唆するdescriptive symbolを選ぶ。

conditions: A control may appear without its title or value.
The separate symbol-only rule records the minimum information requirement.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0002.review_note: Retained symbol selection at SHOULD and separated the symbol-only information contract.

statement.en: Use symbol animations to highlight control state changes.
statement.ja: controlのstate changeを強調するためsymbol animationを使う。

conditions: Apply the separate toggle-transition and duration-action animation rules as relevant.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0003.review_note: Retained the general animation recommendation and separated its state-specific clauses.

statement.en: Help people provide additional information the system needs to perform a control action.
statement.ja: control actionの実行にsystemが必要とする追加情報を利用者が提供できるようにする。

conditions: A control may need a specific target, such as the light a toggle operates.
People can reconfigure a control later.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0004.review_note: Recorded the configuration purpose and later reconfiguration path.

statement.en: Provide hint text for a control assigned to the Action button.
statement.ja: Action buttonに割り当てるcontrolにhint textを提供する。

conditions: The system displays the hint when a person presses the Action button before the press-and-hold action runs.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0005.review_note: Narrowed the Action-button hint guidance to iPhone and recorded its press versus press-and-hold timing.

section_path: Camera experiences on a locked device

statement.en: Use the same camera UI in the app and its locked-device camera experience.
statement.ja: appとlocked-device camera experienceで同じcamera UIを使う。

conditions: Shared UI preserves familiarity and makes the post-capture transition into the app seamless.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0006.review_note: Narrowed the locked-camera UI recommendation to iPhone and recorded transition continuity.

section_path: Camera experiences on a locked device

statement.en: Provide instructions for adding the control that launches the locked-device camera experience.
statement.ja: locked-device camera experienceを起動するcontrolの追加方法を案内する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0007.review_note: Narrowed the camera-control setup instruction to its iPhone context.

statement.en: Require authentication before a control performs an action that affects security.
statement.ja: securityに影響するactionをcontrolが実行する前にauthenticationを要求する。

conditions: Security-affecting examples include locking or unlocking a home door and starting a car.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0008.review_note: Raised the explicit Require security directive to MUST.

statement.en: Hide sensitive control information while the device is locked.
statement.ja: deviceがlockedの間はsensitiveなcontrol informationを隠す。

conditions: Personal or security-related title and value information can be redacted by the system.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0009.review_note: Raised the locked-device privacy and security safeguard to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0010.title: Update controls at each relevant state-change trigger

statement.en: Update a control after interaction, when its action completes, or through a remote push notification.
statement.ja: interaction後、action完了時、またはremote push notificationでcontrolを更新する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0010.review_note: Activated the missed update lead and preserved all three documented update triggers.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0011.title: Accurately reflect control state

statement.en: Update control contents to accurately reflect the current state.
statement.ja: control contentsを更新してcurrent stateを正確に反映する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0011.review_note: Recovered the state-accuracy clause as a separate SHOULD rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0012.title: Show when a control action is in progress

statement.en: Show when a control action is still in progress.
statement.ja: control actionが進行中であることを示す。

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0012.review_note: Recovered the in-progress state clause separately from general state accuracy.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0013.title: Ensure a control symbol conveys its action without text

statement.en: Ensure a control symbol conveys enough information about its action when no title or value appears.
statement.ja: titleやvalueが表示されない場合もcontrol symbolだけでactionを十分に伝える。

conditions: Controls can appear as symbols only on the Lock Screen and in other compact placements.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0013.review_note: Raised the explicit needs-to symbol-only communication contract to MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0014.title: Provide symbols for both toggle states

statement.en: Provide a symbol for both the on and off states of a control toggle.
statement.ja: control toggleのonとoffの両stateにsymbolを提供する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0014.review_note: Recovered the two-state symbol recommendation and kept it at SHOULD.

statement.en: Animate the transition between a control toggle's on and off states.
statement.ja: control toggleのon/off state間のtransitionをanimateする。

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0016.title: Animate duration-based controls while their action runs

statement.en: Animate a duration-based control button continuously while its action runs.
statement.ja: duration-based control buttonをaction実行中は継続してanimateする。

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0017.title: Stop control animation when the action completes

statement.en: Stop a duration-based control's animation when its action completes.
statement.ja: duration-based controlのaction完了時にanimationを停止する。

conditions: Apply to the duration-based animation started while the action was running.

statement.en: Select a control tint color that works with the app's brand.
statement.ja: app brandに合うcontrol tint colorを選ぶ。

conditions: The system uses the tint for a toggle's on-state symbol.
For an Action-button control, the system also tints its Dynamic Island symbol and value.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0018.review_note: Activated the tint lead and recorded both system-applied uses.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0019.title: Prompt for required control configuration on first add

statement.en: When a control requires configuration, prompt people to complete it when they first add the control.
statement.ja: controlにconfigurationが必要な場合は初回追加時に完了するようpromptする。

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0019.review_note: Recovered the conditional first-add configuration prompt.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0020.title: Use verbs in Action-button hint text

statement.en: Use verbs to construct Action-button hint text.
statement.ja: Action buttonのhint textをverbで構成する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0020.review_note: Recovered the Action-button hint-writing recommendation and narrowed it to iPhone.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0021.title: Include a placeholder for variable control information

statement.en: When a control's title or value varies, include placeholder information that explains what the control does.
statement.ja: controlのtitleまたはvalueが変化する場合は動作を説明するplaceholder informationを含める。

conditions: The system displays the placeholder in the controls gallery and before assignment to the Action button.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0021.review_note: Activated the conditional placeholder lead and recorded its discovery contexts.

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0022.title: Ensure locked-device redaction covers sensitive symbol state

statement.en: When a control's symbol state is sensitive, specify that locked-device redaction must cover it.
statement.ja: controlのsymbol stateがsensitiveな場合はlocked-device redactionの対象に指定する。

conditions: When enabled, the system redacts title and value and displays the symbol in its off state.
HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0022.review_note: Raised the conditional symbol-state privacy setting to MUST when redaction is needed.

section_path: Camera experiences on a locked device

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0023.title: Ensure authentication for locked-camera tasks beyond capture

statement.en: Ensure people authenticate and unlock the device before completing a locked-camera task beyond capture.
statement.ja: captureを超えるlocked-camera taskの完了前にauthenticationとdevice unlockを要求する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-CONTROLS-0023.review_note: Recovered the explicit must-authenticate-and-unlock iOS platform contract.

statement.en: Use a disclosure control to hide details until they become relevant.
statement.ja: detailがrelevantになるまでdisclosure controlで隠す。

conditions: Use progressive disclosure to keep essential information easy to find without overwhelming people.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0001.review_note: Retained the progressive-disclosure recommendation at SHOULD.

statement.en: Provide a descriptive label for a disclosure triangle.
statement.ja: disclosure triangleにdescriptive labelを提供する。

conditions: The separate label-meaning rule records what the label must communicate.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0002.review_note: Retained the descriptive-label recommendation and separated its explicit meaning requirement.

statement.en: Place a disclosure button near the content it shows and hides.
statement.ja: disclosure buttonを表示・非表示にするcontentの近くに置く。

conditions: The separate relationship rule records the expanded-choice association.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0003.review_note: Retained proximity at SHOULD and separated the relationship outcome.

statement.en: Use no more than one disclosure button in a single view.
statement.ja: 1つのviewでdisclosure buttonを1個以下にする。

conditions: Multiple disclosure buttons add complexity and can confuse people.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0004.review_note: Kept the one-button limit at SHOULD because the source frames it as complexity guidance, not a hard platform limit.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0005.title: Keep likely controls at the top of the disclosure hierarchy

statement.en: Place the controls people are most likely to use at the top of the disclosure hierarchy so they remain visible.
statement.ja: 利用頻度が高いcontrolをdisclosure hierarchy上部に置いて常時表示する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0005.review_note: Recovered the hierarchy-ordering recommendation and its always-visible outcome.

statement.en: Hide more advanced disclosure functionality by default.
statement.ja: よりadvancedなdisclosure functionalityをdefaultで隠す。

HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0007.title: Ensure disclosure-triangle labels identify their content

statement.en: Ensure a disclosure-triangle label indicates what the control discloses or hides.
statement.ja: disclosure triangleのlabelで表示・非表示になるcontentを示す。

conditions: A suitable label can describe the hidden content, such as Advanced Options.
HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0007.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure label-meaning directive.

HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0008.title: Establish the disclosure button's content relationship

statement.en: Establish a clear relationship between a disclosure button and the expanded choices it reveals.
statement.ja: disclosure buttonと表示されるexpanded choiceの関係を明確にする。

HIG-COMPONENTS-DISCLOSURE-CONTROLS-0008.review_note: Recovered the explicit control-to-expanded-content relationship recommendation.

HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0001.title: Ensure gauge labels describe the value and range endpoints

statement.en: Ensure succinct gauge labels describe the current value and both endpoints of the range.
statement.ja: 簡潔なgauge labelでcurrent valueとrangeの両endpointを示す。

conditions: Not every gauge style displays every label.
VoiceOver reads visible labels so people can understand the gauge without seeing the screen.
HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0001.review_note: Raised the value-and-endpoint label requirement to an accessibility MUST because VoiceOver depends on the visible labels.

statement.en: Consider a path gradient when it helps communicate a gauge's purpose.
statement.ja: gaugeのpurposeを伝えやすくする場合はpath gradientを検討する。

conditions: A temperature gauge can map a red-to-blue spectrum to hot-to-cold values.
HIG-COMPONENTS-GAUGES-0002.review_note: Retained the explicit Consider guidance at MAY.

statement.en: Use a label for a small amount of text that people don't need to edit.
statement.ja: 利用者が編集する必要のない少量のtextにはlabelを使う。

conditions: Use the separate text-field or text-view rules when the amount or editability differs.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0001.review_note: Retained the small, uneditable-text component choice at SHOULD.

statement.en: Prefer system fonts in labels.
statement.ja: labelではsystem fontを優先する。

conditions: Labels using system fonts support Dynamic Type by default where available.
The separate legibility rule applies to custom fonts and adjusted styles.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0002.review_note: Retained the explicit Prefer guidance at SHOULD and recorded its Dynamic Type benefit.

statement.en: Use system-provided label colors to communicate relative text importance.
statement.ja: textのrelative importanceを伝えるためsystem-provided label colorを使う。

conditions: Apply the separate primary, secondary, tertiary, and quaternary color meanings.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0003.review_note: Retained system color selection at SHOULD and separated all four structured meanings.

statement.en: Make useful label text selectable and copyable.
statement.ja: 有用なlabel textを選択・copyできるようにする。

conditions: Useful information can include an error message, location, or IP address.
Selection lets people paste the information elsewhere.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0004.review_note: Recorded selection, copying, and the documented useful-information examples.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0005.title: Use a text field for a small amount of editable text

statement.en: Use a text field when people need to edit a small amount of text.
statement.ja: 利用者が少量のtextを編集する必要がある場合はtext fieldを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0005.review_note: Recovered the small editable-text component choice.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0006.title: Use a text view for large amounts of text

statement.en: Use a text view to display a large amount of text, whether it is editable or not.
statement.ja: 編集可否にかかわらず大量のtext表示にはtext viewを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0006.review_note: Recovered the large-text component choice and preserved optional editability.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0007.title: Ensure custom label styling remains legible

statement.en: Ensure label text remains legible after adjusting its style or using custom fonts.
statement.ja: label styleの調整やcustom font使用後もtextのlegibilityを保つ。

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0007.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure accessibility requirement as MUST.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0008.title: Use primary label colors for primary information

statement.en: Use the primary system label color for primary information.
statement.ja: primary informationにはprimary system label colorを使う。

conditions: Use label on iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS.
Use labelColor on macOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0008.review_note: Recovered the structured primary-color meaning and both platform API names.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0009.title: Use secondary label colors for supplemental text

statement.en: Use the secondary system label color for a subheading or supplemental text.
statement.ja: subheadingやsupplemental textにはsecondary system label colorを使う。

conditions: Use secondaryLabel on iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS.
Use secondaryLabelColor on macOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0009.review_note: Recovered the structured secondary-color meaning and both platform API names.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0010.title: Use tertiary label colors for unavailable items

statement.en: Use the tertiary system label color for text that describes an unavailable item or behavior.
statement.ja: unavailable itemやbehaviorを説明するtextにはtertiary system label colorを使う。

conditions: Use tertiaryLabel on iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS.
Use tertiaryLabelColor on macOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0010.review_note: Recovered the structured tertiary-color meaning and both platform API names.

HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0011.title: Use quaternary label colors for watermark text

statement.en: Use the quaternary system label color for watermark text.
statement.ja: watermark textにはquaternary system label colorを使う。

conditions: Use quaternaryLabel on iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS.
Use quaternaryLabelColor on macOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0011.review_note: Recovered the structured quaternary-color meaning and both platform API names.

statement.en: Consider using system date and timer text components in watchOS complications.
statement.ja: watchOS complicationではsystem date/timer text componentの使用を検討する。

conditions: watchOS automatically fits the presentation to available space.
The system updates the date or timer content without further app input.
HIG-COMPONENTS-LABELS-0012.review_note: Recovered the watchOS-specific Consider guidance and both system-managed benefits.

statement.en: Use a pop-up button for a flat list of mutually exclusive options or states.
statement.ja: mutually exclusiveなoptionまたはstateのflat listにはpop-up buttonを使う。

conditions: The selection affects the content or surrounding view.
Use the separate pull-down-button rules when actions, multiple selection, or a submenu are needed.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0001.review_note: Retained the mutually exclusive flat-list component choice at SHOULD.

statement.en: Provide a useful default selection for a pop-up button.
statement.ja: pop-up buttonに有用なdefault selectionを用意する。

conditions: Before people choose, the button displays the default item.
When possible, choose a default that most people are likely to want.
After selection, the button can identify the current choice.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0002.review_note: Retained the default-selection recommendation and recorded its before- and after-selection behavior.

statement.en: Give people a way to predict a pop-up button's options without opening it.
statement.ja: pop-up buttonを開かずにoptionを予測できる手掛かりを提供する。

conditions: An introductory label or a button label can describe the button's effect and give option context.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0003.review_note: Replaced the generic statement and recorded both documented labeling techniques.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0004.title: Consider a pop-up button when space is limited

statement.en: Consider a pop-up button when space is limited and all options don't need to remain visible.
statement.ja: spaceが限られ、全optionを常時表示する必要がない場合はpop-up buttonを検討する。

conditions: Pop-up buttons provide a space-efficient way to present a wide array of choices.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0004.review_note: Restored the complete truncated Consider guidance and retained it at MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0005.title: Use a pull-down button for a list of actions

statement.en: Use a pull-down button instead of a pop-up button to offer a list of actions.
statement.ja: action listにはpop-up buttonではなくpull-down buttonを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0005.review_note: Corrected the list item to preserve its parent pull-down-button component-choice context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0006.title: Use a pull-down button for multiple selection

statement.en: Use a pull-down button instead of a pop-up button when people can select multiple items.
statement.ja: 複数itemを選択できる場合はpop-up buttonではなくpull-down buttonを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0006.review_note: Corrected the list item to preserve its parent pull-down-button component-choice context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0007.title: Use a pull-down button for a submenu

statement.en: Use a pull-down button instead of a pop-up button when the menu includes a submenu.
statement.ja: submenuを含む場合はpop-up buttonではなくpull-down buttonを使う。

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0007.review_note: Corrected the list item to preserve its parent pull-down-button component-choice context.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0010.title: Include a Custom option only when additional items are useful

statement.en: When necessary, include a Custom option for additional pop-up menu items that are useful only in some situations.
statement.ja: 一部の状況でのみ有用な追加itemが必要な場合はpop-up menuにCustom optionを含める。

conditions: A Custom option can avoid clutter from items or controls people need only occasionally.
HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0010.review_note: Recovered the qualified Custom-option guidance at SHOULD without turning it into an unconditional requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0011.title: Consider explanatory text below pop-up menu options

statement.en: Consider displaying explanatory text below a pop-up menu's options when it helps people understand them.
statement.ja: pop-up menuのoption理解に役立つ場合はlist下部のexplanatory textを検討する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-POP-UP-BUTTONS-0011.review_note: Recovered the optional explanatory-text technique from supporting prose.

statement.en: Use a segmented control for closely related choices that affect an object, state, or view.
statement.ja: object、state、viewに影響する密接に関連したchoiceにはsegmented controlを使う。

conditions: An inspector can use one for one or more attributes.
A toolbar can use one for actions that affect the current view.
On macOS, a segmented control can support single choice, multiple choices, or momentary actions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0001.review_note: Retained the component-choice recommendation and recorded its selection and action contexts.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0002.title: Consider segmented controls for persistent grouping or selection state

statement.en: Consider a segmented control when persistent grouping or a clear selection state is important.
statement.ja: groupingの維持やselection stateの明示が重要な場合はsegmented controlを検討する。

conditions: The grouping persists across view sizes and placements.
The grouping can help people identify selected controls at a glance.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0002.review_note: Restored the complete Consider meaning and retained it at MAY.

statement.en: Keep every segment's control type consistent within a segmented control.
statement.ja: 1つのsegmented control内で各segmentのcontrol typeを統一する。

conditions: Don't assign actions within a control whose other segments represent selection state.
Don't show selection state within a control whose other segments perform actions.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0003.review_note: Recorded both inverse consistency failures without elevating the Don't clauses to MUST_NOT.

statement.en: Prefer either text or images, not both, within one segmented control.
statement.ja: 1つのsegmented controlではtextまたはimageのどちらか一方を優先する。

conditions: Mixing text-only and image-only segments can make the interface feel disconnected and confusing.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0004.review_note: Retained Prefer at SHOULD and recorded the mixed-content usability risk.

statement.en: Use nouns or noun phrases for segment labels.
statement.ja: segment labelにはnounまたはnoun phraseを使う。

conditions: The separate writing rule requires each label to describe its segment and use title-style capitalization.
A control whose segments display text labels doesn't need introductory text.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0005.review_note: Retained the label-grammar recommendation and recorded the introductory-text exception.

statement.en: As much as possible, keep content similarly sized across segments.
statement.ja: 可能な限り各segmentのcontent sizeを揃える。

conditions: Equal segment widths can look unbalanced when content fills some segments but not others.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0012.review_note: Retained the source qualification and distinguished content size from segment-frame size.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0013.title: Limit the number of segments in a control

statement.en: Limit the number of segments in a segmented control.
statement.ja: segmented control内のsegment数を制限する。

conditions: Too many segments are difficult to parse and slow to navigate.
Aim for about five to seven at most in a wide interface.
Aim for about five at most on iPhone.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0013.review_note: Recovered the omitted lead and preserved both approximate, platform-sensitive targets at SHOULD.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0014.title: Keep segment frame sizes consistent

statement.en: In general, keep segment frame sizes consistent within a segmented control.
statement.ja: 原則としてsegmented control内のsegment frame sizeを揃える。

conditions: Equal segment widths make the control feel balanced.
The separate content-size rule applies inside each segment.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0014.review_note: Recovered the general frame-size guidance and distinguished it from content sizing.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0015.title: Keep segmented-control icon and title widths consistent

statement.en: To the extent possible, keep icon and title widths consistent across segments.
statement.ja: 可能な範囲で各segmentのiconとtitleの幅を揃える。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0015.review_note: Recovered the qualified supporting recommendation as a separate content-width rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0016.title: Write descriptive segment labels in title style

statement.en: Write text that describes each segment and uses title-style capitalization.
statement.ja: 各segmentを説明するtextをtitle-style capitalizationで書く。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0016.review_note: Recovered the omitted label-description and capitalization guidance.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0017.title: Avoid using segmented controls on watchOS

statement.en: Avoid using segmented controls on watchOS.
statement.ja: watchOSでsegmented controlを使わない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0017.review_note: Recovered the explicit unsupported-platform limitation at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0018.title: Provide a tooltip for every macOS segment when tooltips are used

statement.en: If a macOS app includes tooltips, provide one for every segment in a segmented control.
statement.ja: macOS appでtooltipを使う場合はsegmented controlの各segmentにtooltipを提供する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0018.review_note: Separated the conditional per-segment tooltip action from optional introductory text.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0019.title: Supply descriptive text for icon-segment tooltips in visionOS

statement.en: Supply descriptive text for the tooltip of each icon-based visionOS segment.
statement.ja: visionOSのicon-based segmentごとにtooltip用のdescriptive textを提供する。

conditions: The system displays the tooltip when people look at the segmented control.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SEGMENTED-CONTROLS-0019.review_note: Recovered the app-supplied descriptive-text dependency without raising descriptive source language to MUST.

statement.en: Display only one sheet at a time from the main interface.
statement.ja: main interfaceから同時に表示するsheetは1つだけにする。

conditions: Closing a sheet should return people to its parent view or window.
Before an action in one sheet presents another, close the first sheet.
When necessary, the first sheet can reappear after the second is dismissed.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0001.review_note: Retained the one-sheet recommendation and recorded the nested-sheet replacement sequence.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0002.title: Use a nonmodal view for supplementary items that affect the parent task

statement.en: Use a nonmodal view for supplementary items that affect the main task in the parent view.
statement.ja: parent viewのmain taskに影響するsupplementary itemにはnonmodal viewを使う。

conditions: Consider a split view in visionOS.
Consider a panel in macOS.
A nonmodal sheet can provide this workflow in iOS and iPadOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0002.review_note: Restored the complete component-choice intent and all supported-platform alternatives.

statement.en: Provide an alternative to the Done button in a sheet.
statement.ja: sheetのDone buttonに代わるexit actionを提供する。

conditions: Cancel or Close dismisses without saving changes.
Back moves to a previous step or parent hierarchy and doesn't dismiss the sheet.
The separate pairing rule records the conditional Always requirement.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0003.review_note: Retained the general alternative-exit recommendation separately from the explicit pairing requirement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0014.title: Consider alternatives to sheets for complex or prolonged flows

statement.en: For a complex or prolonged flow, consider an alternative to a sheet.
statement.ja: 複雑または長時間のflowにはsheet以外の手段を検討する。

conditions: Consider a full-screen modal view in iOS or iPadOS.
Consider a new window or full-screen mode in macOS.
Consider a Full Space in visionOS.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0014.review_note: Repaired the generated wording and preserved the platform-specific alternatives at MAY.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0015.title: Always pair Done with Cancel or Back

statement.en: When a sheet provides a Done button, always pair it with either Cancel or Back.
statement.ja: sheetにDone buttonを設ける場合は、必ずCancelまたはBackと組み合わせる。

conditions: Cancel provides dismissal without confirming or saving changes.
Back provides navigation to a previous step.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0015.review_note: Recovered the conditional Always requirement as an atomic MUST.

statement.en: Avoid showing Cancel, Done, and Back together in one sheet.
statement.ja: 1つのsheetでCancel、Done、Backを同時に表示しない。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0016.review_note: Recovered the explicit three-button avoidance separately from the positive pairing rule.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0017.title: Place single-view Cancel on the leading toolbar edge

statement.en: Place Cancel on the leading edge of the top toolbar in a single-view iOS or iPadOS sheet.
statement.ja: single-viewのiOSまたはiPadOS sheetではCancelをtop toolbarのleading edgeに置く。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0017.review_note: Recovered the current single-view platform placement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0018.title: Place single-view Done on the trailing toolbar edge

statement.en: When present, place Done on the trailing edge of a single-view iOS or iPadOS sheet's top toolbar.
statement.ja: single-viewのiOSまたはiPadOS sheetでDoneを表示する場合はtop toolbarのtrailing edgeに置く。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0018.review_note: Recovered the conditional single-view Done placement.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0019.title: Place first-step Cancel on the leading edge

statement.en: On the first step of a multistep iOS or iPadOS sheet, place Cancel on the leading edge when Back is absent.
statement.ja: multistepのiOSまたはiPadOS sheetの最初のstepではBackがないためCancelをleading edgeに置く。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0019.review_note: Recovered the first-step Cancel placement and Back-absence condition.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0020.title: Keep first-step Done trailing and inactive

statement.en: When present on the first step of a multistep iOS or iPadOS sheet, place Done on the trailing edge and keep it inactive.
statement.ja: multistepのiOSまたはiPadOS sheetの最初のstepでDoneを表示する場合はtrailing edgeに置き、inactiveにする。

conditions: The inactive state communicates that the task isn't complete.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0020.review_note: Recovered placement and state as one source-sentence contract.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0021.title: Replace Cancel with Back on subsequent steps

statement.en: On subsequent steps of a multistep iOS or iPadOS sheet, replace Cancel with Back.
statement.ja: multistepのiOSまたはiPadOS sheetの2step目以降ではCancelをBackに置き換える。

conditions: Back lets people navigate to the previous step.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0022.title: Activate Done on the final confirmation step

statement.en: On the final confirmation step of a multistep iOS or iPadOS sheet, make Done active.
statement.ja: multistepのiOSまたはiPadOS sheetの最終confirmation stepではDoneをactiveにする。

conditions: Done acknowledges task completion and dismisses the sheet.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0022.review_note: Recovered the final-step activation and completion meaning.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0023.title: Consider the medium detent for progressive disclosure on iPhone

statement.en: Consider the medium detent for progressive disclosure in an iPhone sheet.
statement.ja: iPhone sheetでprogressive disclosureを行う場合はmedium detentを検討する。

conditions: The medium detent can show the most relevant items without resizing.
exceptions: Avoid the medium detent when the content is more useful at full height.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0023.review_note: Recovered the embedded Consider guidance and narrowed its scope to iPhone.

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0024.title: Prefer SF Symbols for a changed watchOS sheet label

statement.en: If changing a watchOS sheet's default label, prefer an SF Symbol that represents the action.
statement.ja: watchOS sheetのdefault labelを変更する場合はactionを表すSF Symbolを優先する。

HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0025.title: Avoid hierarchical-looking watchOS sheet labels

statement.en: Avoid a watchOS sheet label that implies hierarchical navigation.
statement.ja: hierarchical navigationを示すようなwatchOS sheet labelを避ける。

conditions: A top-leading label that looks like a page or app title can obscure how to dismiss the sheet.
HIG-COMPONENTS-SHEETS-0025.review_note: Recovered the misleading-label avoidance and its dismissal-discoverability risk.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0001.title: Start live playback with at most one tap

statement.en: Let people start live playback with one tap or without an extra tap when appropriate.
statement.ja: 適切な場合、live playbackを1 tapまたは追加tapなしで開始できるようにする。

conditions: Minimize the interval between opening the app and playing live content.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0001.review_note: Concretized the playback-start rule and retained its at-most-one-tap outcome at SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0002.title: Make live items look live

statement.en: Ensure live items look live through playback or a clear visual marker.
statement.ja: playbackまたは明確なvisual markerによりlive itemがliveに見えるようにする。

conditions: Use a badge, symbol, sash, or equivalent indicator when an item isn't already playing.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0002.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit Make sure directive and recorded the nonplaying-item fallback.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0003.title: Consider showing live-program progress

statement.en: Consider indicating how much of an in-progress live program remains.
statement.ja: 進行中live programの残り時間を示すことを検討する。

conditions: A progress bar or equivalent indicator can show where playback begins.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0003.review_note: Retained the explicit Consider strength and clarified the remaining-content information.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0004.title: Make supported live-content actions easy to use

statement.en: Make supported actions such as record, restart, and download easy to use alongside playback.
statement.ja: record、restart、downloadなど対応するactionをplaybackとともに使いやすくする。

conditions: Playback priority, action order, and repeat-broadcast information are recorded separately.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0004.review_note: Narrowed the general action rule and separated stronger and independently testable clauses.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0005.title: Consider a content footer for in-playback browsing

statement.en: Consider a content footer when people need to browse channels without leaving live playback.
statement.ja: live playbackを離れずchannelを閲覧する必要がある場合はcontent footerを検討する。

conditions: If used, the footer requirements are recorded as separate rules.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0005.review_note: Retained the optional footer choice without weakening its conditional Be sure requirements.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0006.title: Provide immediate channel-change feedback

statement.en: Provide immediate visual feedback when people change channels.
statement.ja: channel変更時に即時のvisual feedbackを提供する。

conditions: Confirm the selected channel immediately, including while its stream is loading.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0006.review_note: Raised the source's explicitly essential channel-selection feedback outcome to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0007.title: Keep live audio aligned with the viewing context

statement.en: Keep audio matched to the live content while people browse within the live-viewing context.
statement.ja: live-viewing context内を閲覧中はaudioを再生中live contentに合わせる。

conditions: Browsing within the live tab can continue while the live content plays in the background.
Leaving the live tab is recorded separately.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0007.review_note: Separated the expected in-context audio behavior from the explicit stop requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0008.title: Make large EPGs easy to browse

statement.en: Help people page, scroll, or jump through a large EPG easily.
statement.ja: 大規模なEPGをpage、scroll、jumpで容易に閲覧できるようにする。

conditions: Quick-access channel groups are recorded separately as an optional enhancement.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0008.review_note: Concretized effortless browsing with the source's three navigation mechanisms.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0009.title: Keep current content available while browsing the EPG

statement.en: Let people browse the EPG without leaving their current content.
statement.ja: 現在のcontentを離れずにEPGを閲覧できるようにする。

conditions: Continue playback in picture-in-picture or in the background when appropriate.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0009.review_note: Retained the browse-without-leaving outcome and recorded the documented playback options.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0010.title: Start and stop recording from the info panel

statement.en: Let people start and stop recording live content from its info panel.
statement.ja: live contentのinfo panelからrecordingを開始・停止できるようにする。

conditions: The app supports cloud DVR while live-streaming.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0010.review_note: Bound the recording action to live-stream info-panel context.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0011.title: Record future programs from a detail view

statement.en: Let people record a future program from a view that provides its details.
statement.ja: programの詳細を提供するviewから将来のprogramをrecordingできるようにする。

conditions: Single-program and future-episode choices are recorded separately.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0011.review_note: Retained the future-program recording location and separated the recording-scope choice.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0012.title: Offer precise recording choices

statement.en: Let people specify precisely which episodes, programs, or team games to record.
statement.ja: recordingするepisode、program、team gameを正確に指定できるようにする。

conditions: Offer the choices that fit the content type and supported DVR capabilities.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0012.review_note: Concretized adaptation with the source's episode, program, and team examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0013.title: Provide content actions in the cloud DVR area

statement.en: In a cloud DVR detail view, let people play or delete content and adjust recording settings when applicable.
statement.ja: cloud DVR detail viewでcontentをplay・deleteし、該当する場合はrecording settingを調整できるようにする。

conditions: The app supports the corresponding content-specific action.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0013.review_note: Replaced the generic generated statement with the concrete DVR detail-view actions.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0014.title: Consider a cloud DVR management control

statement.en: Consider a control for managing cloud DVR retention settings.
statement.ja: cloud DVRのretention settingを管理するcontrolを検討する。

conditions: Management can include deleting viewed or older recordings.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0014.review_note: Retained the explicit Consider strength and narrowed the control to management settings.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0015.title: Keep a content footer legible and distinct

statement.en: When using a content footer, ensure its treatment keeps text legible and items distinct from playing content.
statement.ja: content footerを使う場合、textの可読性とitemの再生contentからの区別を保つtreatmentにする。

conditions: Use a subtle treatment such as darkening rather than obscuring the playing content.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0015.review_note: Raised the first Be sure footer item to an accessibility MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0016.title: Identify the currently playing footer thumbnail

statement.en: When using a content footer, ensure people can identify the thumbnail for the currently playing content.
statement.ja: content footerを使う場合、再生中contentのthumbnailを識別できるようにする。

conditions: Use a badge, tinted progress bar, or equivalent state indicator.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0016.review_note: Raised the second Be sure footer item to a current-state identification MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0017.title: Match content-footer categories to the EPG

statement.en: When using a content footer, ensure its categories match the electronic program guide.
statement.ja: content footerを使う場合、そのcategoryをelectronic program guideと一致させる。

conditions: The app provides both a content footer and an EPG.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0017.review_note: Raised the third Be sure footer item to a cross-view consistency MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0018.title: Use predictable content-footer gestures

statement.en: When using a content footer, ensure people can invoke and dismiss it in a simple, predictable way.
statement.ja: content footerを使う場合、単純で予測可能な方法で表示・dismissできるようにする。

conditions: Use an inverse action for dismissal when an action such as swiping up invokes the footer.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0018.review_note: Raised the fourth Be sure footer item to a predictable-interaction MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0019.title: Feature live content prominently

statement.en: Feature live content prominently and make it quick to access.
statement.ja: live contentを目立たせ、素早くaccessできるようにする。

conditions: Placing live content first can reduce playback startup to one tap.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0019.review_note: Concretized prominence and access speed without duplicating the global prioritization rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0020.title: Prioritize live content

statement.en: Prioritize and elevate live content throughout a live-viewing app.
statement.ja: live-viewing app全体でlive contentを優先して目立たせる。

conditions: Apply the requirement throughout the live-viewing experience.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0020.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit need-to elevate and prioritize statement.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0021.title: Draw attention to live content on every screen

statement.en: On every screen, draw people's attention to live content.
statement.ja: すべてのscreenでlive contentへ注意を向けられるようにする。

conditions: Use hierarchy and placement appropriate to each screen.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0021.review_note: Preserved the all-screen scope while keeping the plain imperative at SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0022.title: Distinguish live content from VOD at a glance

statement.en: On every screen, ensure people can distinguish live content from VOD content at a glance.
statement.ja: すべてのscreenでlive contentとVOD contentを一目で区別できるようにする。

conditions: The app presents live and video-on-demand content.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0022.review_note: Recovered the explicit Make sure outcome and retained its every-screen scope.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0023.title: Keep playback as the primary action

statement.en: Keep playback as the primary action for live content.
statement.ja: live contentではplaybackをprimary actionにする。

conditions: Additional supported actions remain secondary to playback.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0023.review_note: Recovered MUST from the explicit always-needs-to primary-action clause.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0024.title: Order live-content actions consistently

statement.en: Display supported live-content actions in the same order throughout the app.
statement.ja: 対応するlive-content actionをapp全体で同じ順序に表示する。

conditions: Use a stable order such as Watch, Start Over, Record, and Favorite.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0024.review_note: Recovered the separate cross-app action-order directive.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0025.title: Show future broadcasts of current content

statement.en: When currently playing content airs again, show the schedule so people can plan their viewing.
statement.ja: 再生中contentが再放送される場合、視聴を計画できるようscheduleを表示する。

conditions: The currently playing content has known future broadcast times.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0025.review_note: Recovered the conditional repeat-broadcast information rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0026.title: Stop live audio outside the live-viewing context

statement.en: Stop live-content audio when people navigate away from the app's live tab.
statement.ja: appのlive tabから離れた場合はlive-content audioを停止する。

conditions: Navigating away from the live tab ends the live-viewing context.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit audio-needs-to-stop state transition as MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0027.title: Make current EPG information easy to spot

statement.en: When the EPG opens, make the current program, channel, and time easy to spot and current playback easy to resume.
statement.ja: EPGを開いたとき、現在のprogram、channel、timeを見つけやすくし、現在のplaybackへ戻りやすくする。

conditions: People first open the EPG.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0027.review_note: Recovered the explicit current-information needs-to-be-easy-to-spot requirement as MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0028.title: Consider quick-access EPG channel groups

statement.en: Consider a My Channels or Favorites group for frequently viewed EPG content.
statement.ja: 頻繁に見るEPG content向けにMy ChannelsまたはFavorites groupを検討する。

conditions: The EPG contains enough content for a personalized shortcut group to help.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0028.review_note: Recovered the embedded Consider option without promoting it.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0029.title: Group EPG content into familiar categories

statement.en: Group EPG content into familiar categories that help people find it.
statement.ja: EPG contentを見つけやすい馴染みあるcategoryにgroup化する。

conditions: Categories can include Movies, TV Shows, Kids, Sports, and Popular.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0029.review_note: Activated the omitted EPG organization rule and kept footer matching separate.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0030.title: Offer single-program and future-episode recording choices

statement.en: Let people choose whether to record only a selected program or all future episodes.
statement.ja: 選択したprogramだけか今後すべてのepisodeをrecordingするか選べるようにする。

conditions: The selected future program belongs to an episodic series.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0030.review_note: Recovered the atomic recording-scope choice from the supporting sentence.

HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0031.title: Help prevent cloud DVR storage exhaustion

statement.en: Help people avoid running out of cloud DVR space through automatic storage management.
statement.ja: automatic storage managementによりcloud DVRの容量不足を避けられるようにする。

conditions: Automatic management can overwrite the oldest or already viewed content.
HIG-PATTERNS-LIVE-VIEWING-APPS-0031.review_note: Recovered the source's ideal storage-management outcome at SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0001.title: Restrict Time Sensitive notifications to current events

statement.en: Use the Time Sensitive interruption level only for an event happening now or within an hour.
statement.ja: Time Sensitive interruption levelは現在発生中または1時間以内に発生するeventだけに使う。

conditions: The notification is relevant in the moment and requires immediate attention.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0001.review_note: Raised the only restriction and supporting Make sure time window to a bounded platform-contract MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0002.title: Never mark marketing notifications Time Sensitive

statement.en: Never use the Time Sensitive interruption level for a marketing notification.
statement.ja: marketing notificationにTime Sensitive interruption levelを決して使わない。

conditions: Marketing permission does not allow a notification to break through Focus or scheduled delivery.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0002.review_note: Retained the explicit Never prohibition and clarified that consent doesn't create an exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0003.title: Provide in-app notification settings

statement.en: Provide an in-app settings screen where people can change their notification choices.
statement.ja: notificationの選択を変更できるin-app settings screenを提供する。

conditions: The app requests permission for informational or marketing notifications.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0003.review_note: Retained MUST from the Make sure lead and the supporting must-also-provide clause.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0004.title: Get permission before sending notifications

statement.en: Get permission before sending any notification.
statement.ja: notificationを送信する前にpermissionを取得する。

conditions: The system lets people later change or silence this permission in settings.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0004.review_note: Recovered the general notification permission requirement from the explicit You need to statement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0005.title: Identify the notification types the app sends

statement.en: Identify the types of notifications the app or game can send before configuring Focus behavior.
statement.ja: Focus behaviorを設定する前にappまたはgameが送信できるnotification typeを特定する。

conditions: Classify direct communications separately from other notification tasks.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0005.review_note: Recovered the sequencing step but kept its plain first-identify wording at SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0006.title: Use communication notifications for direct communications

statement.en: When supporting direct communications such as calls or messages, use communication notifications.
statement.ja: callやmessageなどdirect communicationに対応する場合はcommunication notificationを使う。

conditions: The notification represents a direct communication.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0006.review_note: Classified the conditional system notification-type mapping as a platform contract.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0007.title: Adopt SiriKit intents for communication notifications

statement.en: Adopt SiriKit intents when supporting communication notifications.
