statement.ja: communication notificationに対応する場合はSiriKit intentを採用する。

conditions: SiriKit intents let people customize communication-notification behavior with Siri.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0007.review_note: Classified the source's implementation path for communication notifications as a conditional platform contract.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0008.title: Specify an interruption level for every noncommunication notification

statement.en: Specify a system-defined interruption level for every noncommunication notification.
statement.ja: すべてのnoncommunication notificationにsystem-defined interruption levelを指定する。

conditions: The system uses the level to determine when to deliver the alert.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0008.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit You need to specification requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0009.title: Get an entitlement for Critical notifications

statement.en: Get the required entitlement before sending a Critical notification.
statement.ja: Critical notificationを送信する前にrequired entitlementを取得する。

conditions: Critical notifications can override Ring/Silent, scheduled delivery, and Focus.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0009.review_note: Retained MUST from the explicit you must get an entitlement requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0010.title: Represent each notification's urgency accurately

statement.en: Assign an interruption level that accurately represents each notification's urgency.
statement.ja: 各notificationのurgencyを正確に表すinterruption levelを割り当てる。

conditions: Do not use a high urgency level for low-priority information.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0010.review_note: Raised the source's explicitly essential urgency-accuracy outcome to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0011.title: Don't send marketing notifications without explicit agreement

statement.en: Don't send marketing or promotional notifications unless people explicitly agree to receive them.
statement.ja: 明示的な同意がない限りmarketingまたはpromotional notificationを送信しない。

conditions: The person has not explicitly opted in to the marketing information.
exceptions: Sending is allowed after explicit agreement, subject to the separate Time Sensitive prohibition.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0011.review_note: Raised the explicit don't-unless consent boundary to a privacy MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0012.title: Get explicit permission for marketing notifications

statement.en: Get people's explicit permission before sending promotional or marketing notifications.
statement.ja: promotionalまたはmarketing notificationを送信する前に明示的なpermissionを取得する。

conditions: The app wants to send promotional or marketing information.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0012.review_note: Raised the supporting must-receive-explicit-permission clause to a privacy MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0013.title: Describe marketing-notification content before consent

statement.en: Before asking for marketing-notification consent, describe the types of information the app wants to send.
statement.ja: marketing-notification consentを求める前にappが送信するinformation typeを説明する。

conditions: Use an alert, modal view, or other clear permission interface.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0013.review_note: Classified the pre-consent disclosure as a privacy and explicit-intent MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0014.title: Provide clear marketing opt-in and opt-out choices

statement.en: Give people a clear way to opt in to or out of marketing notifications.
statement.ja: marketing notificationへopt inまたはopt outする明確な方法を提供する。

conditions: Present the choice in the marketing-permission interface.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0014.review_note: Classified the clear bidirectional consent choice as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0015.title: Use noncommunication notifications for other tasks

statement.en: Use noncommunication notifications for notification tasks that aren't direct communications.
statement.ja: direct communication以外のnotification taskにはnoncommunication notificationを使う。

conditions: The notification doesn't represent a direct communication such as a call or message.
HIG-PATTERNS-MANAGING-NOTIFICATIONS-0015.review_note: Classified the complementary all-other-tasks notification mapping as a platform contract.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0001.title: Keep modal tasks simple and short

statement.en: Keep modal tasks simple, short, and streamlined.
statement.ja: modal taskをsimple、short、streamlinedに保つ。

conditions: Avoid making people lose track of the task or context they suspended.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0001.review_note: Replaced the generic paraphrase and retained the source's Aim strength at SHOULD.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0002.title: Consider full-screen modality for in-depth tasks

statement.en: Consider a full-screen modal style for in-depth content or a complex task.
statement.ja: in-depth contentまたはcomplex taskにはfull-screen modal styleを検討する。

conditions: It can suit media, camera views, document markup, or photo editing by minimizing distractions.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0002.review_note: Retained the explicit Consider strength and the documented content and task contexts.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0003.title: Provide an obvious modal dismissal path

statement.en: Always give people an obvious way to dismiss a modal view.
statement.ja: modal viewをdismissする明確な方法を常に提供する。

conditions: Follow familiar platform conventions for button placement or dismissal gestures.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0003.review_note: Retained the explicit Always dismissal requirement as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0004.title: Make the modal task identifiable

statement.en: Make a modal view's task easy to identify.
statement.ja: modal viewのtaskを容易に識別できるようにする。

conditions: Use a title, description, or guidance that helps people keep their place in the app.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0004.review_note: Concretized task identification with the source's title and supporting-text options.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0005.title: Dismiss one modal view before presenting another

statement.en: Let people dismiss a modal view before presenting another modal view.
statement.ja: 別のmodal viewを表示する前に現在のmodal viewをdismissできるようにする。

conditions: Avoid simultaneous modal views that add clutter and cognitive load.
exceptions: An alert may appear above other content, but the separate single-alert rule still applies.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0005.review_note: Retained the general modal sequencing guidance and recorded the alert overlay exception.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0006.title: Consider modality for critical information and action

statement.en: Consider modality when it can help people receive critical information and act when necessary.
statement.ja: 重要なinformationの受領と必要なactionにmodalityが役立つ場合は使用を検討する。

conditions: The source presents this as one outcome modality can provide, not as an unconditional directive.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0006.review_note: Corrected MUST to MAY after restoring the governing Presenting content modally can context.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0007.title: Consider modality for confirming or modifying an action

statement.en: Consider modality when it can help people confirm or modify their most recent action.
statement.ja: 直前のactionのconfirmまたはmodifyにmodalityが役立つ場合は使用を検討する。

conditions: The source lists this as one possible benefit of modal presentation.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0007.review_note: Restored the can-governed optionality of the overview purpose list.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0008.title: Consider modality for a distinct narrow task

statement.en: Consider modality for a distinct, narrowly scoped task when it helps preserve the previous context.
statement.ja: previous contextを保ちながらdistinctでnarrowly scopedなtaskを行う場合はmodalityを検討する。

conditions: The source lists this as one possible benefit of modal presentation.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0008.review_note: Restored the can-governed optionality and kept the previous-context condition.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0009.title: Consider modality for immersion or concentration

statement.en: Consider modality when it can provide immersion or help people concentrate on a complex task.
statement.ja: immersionの提供またはcomplex taskへの集中に役立つ場合はmodalityを検討する。

conditions: The source lists this as one possible benefit of modal presentation.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0009.review_note: Restored the can-governed optionality of the overview purpose list.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0010.title: Use modality only for a clear benefit

statement.en: Present content modally only when it provides a clear benefit.
statement.ja: 明確なbenefitがある場合だけcontentをmodallyに表示する。

conditions: Use modality when it helps people focus or make choices that affect content or the device.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0010.review_note: Concretized the only-when boundary without promoting the plain imperative to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0011.title: Avoid an app-within-an-app modal experience

statement.en: Avoid making a modal experience feel like an app within the app.
statement.ja: modal experienceがapp内の別appのように感じられる設計を避ける。

conditions: Deep modal view hierarchies can make it difficult to retrace steps.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0011.review_note: Classified the direct take-care-to-avoid guidance at AVOID rather than MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0012.title: Use one path through required modal subviews

statement.en: If a modal task must contain subviews, provide a single path through the hierarchy.
statement.ja: modal taskにsubviewが必要な場合はhierarchy内に単一のpathを提供する。

conditions: The modal task cannot remain a single view.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0012.review_note: Recovered the conditional hierarchy path separately from the dismissal-button avoidance.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0013.title: Confirm before closing when data could be lost

statement.en: When necessary, get confirmation before closing a modal view to help avoid data loss.
statement.ja: 必要な場合、data lossを避けるためmodal viewを閉じる前にconfirmationを取得する。

conditions: Closing the modal view could discard user-generated content.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0013.review_note: Activated the qualified confirmation guidance without raising it to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0014.title: Explain potential modal data loss

statement.en: When closing a modal view could lose user-generated content, explain the situation.
statement.ja: modal viewを閉じるとuser-generated contentを失う可能性がある場合、その状況を説明する。

conditions: The person dismisses with either a gesture or a button.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0014.review_note: Recovered the first conditional Be sure data-loss requirement as MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0015.title: Provide ways to resolve potential modal data loss

statement.en: When closing a modal view could lose user-generated content, give people ways to resolve it.
statement.ja: modal viewを閉じるとuser-generated contentを失う可能性がある場合、解決方法を提供する。

conditions: A resolution can include saving the content before dismissal.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0015.review_note: Recovered the second conditional Be sure data-loss requirement as MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0016.title: Never show multiple alerts simultaneously

statement.en: Never display more than one alert at the same time.
statement.ja: 同時に複数のalertを表示しない。

conditions: An alert may overlay other content or another type of modal view.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0016.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never alert-stacking prohibition as MUST_NOT.

HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0017.title: Avoid controls mistaken for modal dismissal

statement.en: Avoid buttons people might mistake for the control that dismisses the modal view.
statement.ja: modal viewをdismissするcontrolと誤認されるbuttonを避ける。

conditions: The modal task contains a hierarchy of subviews.
HIG-PATTERNS-MODALITY-0017.review_note: Recovered the nested-modal button ambiguity separately at AVOID.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0001.title: Make printing discoverable in standard locations

statement.en: Make the print action discoverable by placing it in standard system locations.
statement.ja: print actionをstandard system locationに置いて見つけやすくする。

conditions: Examples include the macOS File menu and an iOS or iPadOS toolbar action that opens an action sheet.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0001.review_note: Replaced the generic statement and recorded the platform discovery examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0005.title: Show a print action only when printing is possible

statement.en: Present a print action only when printing is possible.
statement.ja: printingが可能な場合だけprint actionを表示する。

conditions: Printing is unavailable when there is no printable onscreen content or no printer is available.
Platform and custom-control states are recorded separately.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0005.review_note: Concretized the availability boundary and separated the three unavailable-state behaviors.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0006.title: Use the system view for relevant print options

statement.en: When relevant options are supported by the printer, present them in the system-provided print view.
statement.ja: relevant optionをprinterがsupportする場合、system-provided print viewに表示する。

conditions: Relevant options can include page range, copy count, and double-sided printing.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0006.review_note: Recorded both the relevance and printer-support conditions and the system-view mechanism.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0017.title: Dim unavailable macOS File menu printing

statement.en: When printing is unavailable, dim the Print item in the macOS File menu.
statement.ja: printingが利用できない場合、macOS File menuのPrint itemをdim表示する。

conditions: There is no printable onscreen content or no printer is available.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0017.review_note: Recovered the macOS unavailable state as an atomic platform rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0018.title: Remove unavailable iOS and iPadOS printing

statement.en: When printing is unavailable, remove the Print action from the iOS or iPadOS action sheet.
statement.ja: printingが利用できない場合、iOSまたはiPadOS action sheetからPrint actionを削除する。

conditions: There is no printable onscreen content or no printer is available.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0018.review_note: Recovered the iOS and iPadOS unavailable state as an atomic platform rule.

HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0019.title: Hide or dim an unavailable custom print button

statement.en: When printing is unavailable, hide or dim a custom print button.
statement.ja: printingが利用できない場合、custom print buttonをhideまたはdim表示する。

conditions: The app implements a custom print button.
HIG-PATTERNS-PRINTING-0019.review_note: Recovered the custom-control unavailable state separately from system locations.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0001.title: Use one primary search location

statement.en: Aim to make the app's content searchable from one clearly identified location.
statement.ja: appのcontentを明確に識別できる1か所から検索できるようにする。

conditions: Distinct sections may also offer local search when it helps people focus on section-specific content.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0001.review_note: Retained the source's Aim strength and recorded the local-search exception for distinct sections.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0002.title: Provide search suggestions

statement.en: Provide recent-search and predictive suggestions to help people search faster and type less.
statement.ja: recent searchとpredictive suggestionを提供し、より速く少ない入力で検索できるようにする。

conditions: Show recent searches before typing and predictive suggestions while people type.
Review search-history privacy separately.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0002.review_note: Concretized both suggestion states without merging the separate privacy requirement.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0003.title: Make app content searchable in Spotlight

statement.en: Make the app's content searchable in Spotlight by indexing it with descriptive metadata.
statement.ja: descriptive metadataでindex化し、appのcontentをSpotlightで検索できるようにする。

conditions: Index content that people may want to find outside the app.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0003.review_note: Concretized the Spotlight indexing mechanism and narrowed it to supported search platforms.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0004.title: Use Spotlight for advanced in-app file search

statement.en: Use Spotlight for advanced file-search capabilities within the app when appropriate.
statement.ja: 適切な場合、app内のadvanced file-search capabilityにSpotlightを使う。

conditions: Examples include searching the current selection or displaying custom search results.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0004.review_note: Preserved the contextual boundary and the source's advanced-search examples.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0005.title: Prefer system open and save views

statement.en: Prefer system-provided open and save views for systemwide file search.
statement.ja: systemwide file searchにはsystem-providedのopen viewとsave viewを優先する。

conditions: The system views include a built-in search field.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0005.review_note: Recorded the built-in search capability that supports the system-view preference.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0006.title: Provide metadata and Spotlight import for custom files

statement.en: Define metadata for custom file types and supply a Spotlight File Importer plug-in.
statement.ja: custom file typeのmetadataを定義し、Spotlight File Importer plug-inを提供する。

conditions: The app handles custom file types.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0006.review_note: Combined the source paragraph's metadata definition and importer mechanism for custom files.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0007.title: Clearly display the current search scope

statement.en: Clearly display the current search scope.
statement.ja: 現在のsearch scopeを明確に表示する。

conditions: Communicate scope with a descriptive placeholder, scope bar, title, or another clear label.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0007.review_note: Concretized the supported scope-labeling mechanisms without promoting the plain imperative to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0008.title: Give important search a primary position

statement.en: If search is important, give it a primary position in the app or view.
statement.ja: searchが重要な場合、appまたはview内のprimary positionに配置する。

conditions: Examples include a toolbar search item or a dedicated search tab.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0008.review_note: Activated the conditional placement guidance and preserved its importance threshold.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0009.title: Review privacy before showing search history

statement.en: Before displaying search history, consider whether it could expose private information.
statement.ja: search historyを表示する前にprivate informationが露出しないか検討する。

conditions: Search history may be visible to someone other than the person who created it.
The clearing action is recorded separately.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0009.review_note: Retained consideration strength for the privacy review instead of raising it to MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0010.title: Let people clear displayed search history

statement.en: When displaying search history, provide a way for people to clear it.
statement.ja: search historyを表示する場合、消去する方法を提供する。

conditions: The app displays search history.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0010.review_note: Classified the conditional clearing action as a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0011.title: Provide Quick Look for custom file types

statement.en: If the app produces custom file types, implement a Quick Look generator for previews.
statement.ja: appがcustom file typeを生成する場合、preview用のQuick Look generatorを実装する。

conditions: Preview support helps people inspect custom files in Spotlight and other apps.
HIG-PATTERNS-SEARCHING-0011.review_note: Activated the conditional Quick Look guidance and narrowed it to supported search platforms.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0001.title: Design AI experiences responsibly

statement.en: Orient AI design toward inclusion, care, and privacy.
statement.ja: AI designをinclusion、care、privacyに沿って進める。

conditions: Account for input sensitivity, variable output, unanticipated requests, and real-world use.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0001.review_note: Concretized responsible design using the source's inclusion, care, and privacy outcomes.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0002.title: Keep people in control of AI

statement.en: Keep people in control of AI decisions and the overall experience.
statement.ja: AIのdecisionとoverall experienceをpeopleのcontrol下に保つ。

conditions: Honor in-scope requests with clear expected output and handle sensitive content carefully.
Specific agency controls are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0002.review_note: Retained the general control principle and separated its explicit user-control outcomes.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0003.title: Ensure inclusive AI experiences

statement.en: Ensure the AI experience produces inclusive results for everyone.
statement.ja: AI experienceがすべての人にinclusiveなresultを生成するようにする。

conditions: Account for model bias, stereotypes, personal attributes, and cultural characteristics.
Assumption and testing actions are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0003.review_note: Retained the explicit Ensure inclusion outcome as an accessibility and inclusion MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0004.title: Use generative AI for clear value

statement.en: Offer generative features only where they provide clear, specific value.
statement.ja: 明確で具体的なvalueを提供する場所だけでgenerative featureを提供する。

conditions: Value can include time savings, better communication, or enhanced creativity.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0004.review_note: Concretized the value threshold without promoting the plain recommendation to MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0005.title: Ensure a good unavailable and opt-out experience

statement.en: Ensure a good experience when generative features are unavailable or people opt out.
statement.ja: generative featureが利用不可またはopt outされた場合も良好なexperienceを確保する。

conditions: Distinguish essential AI experiences from complementary features.
The optional non-AI fallback is recorded separately.
exceptions: A reasonable non-AI substitute may not exist when AI is essential to the experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0005.review_note: Revalidated the Ensure outcome against the updated source and preserved its essential-AI exception.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0006.title: Identify where the app uses AI

statement.en: Clearly identify when and where the app uses AI.
statement.ja: appがAIを使う時点と場所を明確に示す。

conditions: Support informed choice and accurate expectations.
Misrepresentation and regulatory alignment are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0006.review_note: Retained the broad disclosure recommendation at SHOULD and split the explicit Never and Ensure clauses.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0007.title: Choose a model for capability and privacy

statement.en: Choose a model type that fits the feature's needs and protects people's privacy.
statement.ja: featureのneedsに合い、peopleのprivacyを保護するmodel typeを選ぶ。

conditions: Compare on-device privacy, speed, and offline use with server capacity and context size.
Mandatory privacy safeguards are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0007.review_note: Applied the updated model-choice context without turning every server-model choice into a prohibition.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0008.review_note: Raised the pre-use permission action to a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0009.title: Choose datasets intentionally

statement.en: Choose or create datasets intentionally because they shape model behavior.
statement.ja: model behaviorを形作るためdatasetを意図的に選択・作成する。

conditions: Account for representation, provenance, licenses, people's choices, bias, misinformation, testing, and evaluation.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0009.review_note: Concretized the dataset-design principle and separated its license and personal-data requirements.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0010.title: Consider consequences before consequential AI tasks

statement.en: Before an irreversible or potentially problematic AI task, consider the consequences.
statement.ja: irreversibleまたはproblematicなAI taskの前にconsequenceを検討する。

conditions: Consider added work or stress if the action is wrong or cannot be reversed.
Automation, confirmation, and policy requirements are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0010.review_note: Kept the lead's Consider strength and separated its stronger action-control clauses.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0011.title: Let people refine or revert AI results

statement.en: Make generated results easy to refine or revert.
statement.ja: generated resultをrefineまたはrevertしやすくする。

conditions: Place controls such as Edit, Undo, Retry, or Adjust near generated content.
Correction acknowledgment is recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0011.review_note: Focused the compound lead on refinement and reversal and separated the feedback outcome.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0012.title: Help people improve blocked requests

statement.en: When a request is blocked or produces an undesirable result, help people improve it.
statement.ja: requestがblockedまたはundesirable resultを生成した場合、改善を支援する。

conditions: Coach the next attempt and, when possible, consider example requests.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0012.review_note: Recorded the recovery path and preserved the example-request qualifier.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0013.title: Test for harmful AI outcomes

statement.en: Reduce unexpected and harmful outcomes through thoughtful design and thorough testing.
statement.ja: thoughtful designとthorough testingでunexpected・harmful outcomeを減らす。

conditions: Test accidental and purposeful misuse, sensitive topics, out-of-scope requests, ambiguous prompts, and incorrect results.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0013.review_note: Concretized the misuse and edge-case test space without claiming every harm can be eliminated.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0014.title: Avoid replicating copyrighted content

statement.en: Strive to avoid generating replicas of copyrighted content.
statement.ja: copyrighted contentのreplica生成を避けるよう努める。

conditions: Use protective base models, carefully curated inputs, preapproved prompts, or explicit nonimitation instructions where helpful.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0014.review_note: Corrected the avoid-oriented legal guidance from SHOULD to AVOID without promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0015.title: Consider specific generation feedback

statement.en: Consider giving specific, reassuring status feedback while content is generated.
statement.ja: content generation中にspecificでreassuringなstatus feedbackを提供することを検討する。

conditions: Describe actual work instead of using a vague status message.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0015.review_note: Retained explicit Consider strength and the source's specificity rationale.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0016.title: Consider alternate AI results

statement.en: Consider offering meaningfully different versions of generated results.
statement.ja: meaningfully differentなgenerated resultのversion提供を検討する。

conditions: Choose a single result or multiple versions based on the feature's design.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0016.review_note: Retained optionality and the single-versus-multiple result decision.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0017.title: Consider ongoing model improvement

statement.en: Consider how to improve the model over time.
statement.ja: modelを継続的に改善する方法を検討する。

conditions: Plan for feedback, new data, enhanced capability, fine-tuning, retesting, and prompt engineering.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0017.review_note: Retained Consider strength and recorded the documented improvement mechanisms.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0018.title: Let people share AI-output feedback

statement.en: Let people share feedback about generated outputs.
statement.ja: generated outputについてfeedbackを共有できるようにする。

conditions: Use feedback to address unexpected outcomes and concerns and to recognize positive experiences.
Voluntariness and placement are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0018.review_note: Concretized feedback purpose and separated the explicit Always voluntariness requirement.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0019.title: Design AI features for change

statement.en: Design AI features to remain flexible as models and capabilities evolve.
statement.ja: modelとcapabilityの進化に合わせてflexibleであり続けるAI featureを設計する。

conditions: Consider separating the model from the user experience so the implementation can change without degrading the experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0019.review_note: Recorded the model-swapping architecture example as adaptability support rather than a mandate.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0020.review_note: Classified the personal-information disclosure outcome as a privacy and informed-consent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0021.title: Set accurate AI capability expectations

statement.en: Set clear expectations about what an AI feature can and can't do.
statement.ja: AI featureができること・できないことへの明確なexpectationを設定する。

conditions: Use brief onboarding or curated examples where useful.
Disclose known limitations up front and explain how to get better results and why inferior results occur.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0021.review_note: Activated the omitted transparency lead and recorded capability, limitation, and recovery context.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0022.title: Evaluate model capabilities early

statement.en: Evaluate a model's capabilities and availability early in the design process.
statement.ja: design processの早期にmodelのcapabilityとavailabilityを評価する。

conditions: Inspect available models and data hands-on.
Account for device compatibility, network access, battery level, and required system features.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0022.review_note: Activated the omitted evaluation lead and restored both capability and availability constraints.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0023.title: Teach people how to use generative features

statement.en: Guide people toward using a generative feature successfully.
statement.ja: generative featureを成功して使えるようpeopleをguideする。

conditions: Consider diverse predefined example inputs that reveal what the feature can do.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0023.review_note: Activated the omitted input-guidance lead and retained example inputs as a technique.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0024.title: Address AI hallucinations

statement.en: Raise awareness of hallucinations and reduce their likelihood and impact.
statement.ja: hallucinationへのawarenessを高め、その可能性とimpactを減らす。

conditions: Scope generation carefully and communicate that AI output can be wrong.
Factual and harmful-use avoidances are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0024.review_note: Activated the omitted hallucination lead and split its specific safety avoidances.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0025.title: Design for generation latency

statement.en: Account for generative-model processing time in the experience.
statement.ja: experience内でgenerative modelのprocessing timeを考慮する。

conditions: Provide a loading experience or generate in the background while people use another part of the app.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0025.review_note: Activated the omitted latency lead and restored its loading and background-generation responses.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0026.title: Ensure people control AI decisions

statement.en: Ensure people remain in charge of AI decision making and the overall experience.
statement.ja: AI decision makingとoverall experienceをpeopleのcontrol下に保つ。

conditions: The AI can manipulate or create content.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0026.review_note: Recovered the explicit Ensure agency outcome as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0027.review_note: Classified the explicit rejection and reversal controls as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0028.title: Consider a non-AI fallback

statement.en: When possible, consider offering a non-AI fallback.
statement.ja: 可能な場合はnon-AI fallbackの提供を検討する。

conditions: The AI feature complements rather than defines the core experience.
exceptions: A reasonable non-AI substitute may not exist when AI is essential.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0028.review_note: Recovered the qualified fallback separately so its Consider strength isn't raised by the parent Ensure rule.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0029.title: Ask instead of inferring personal characteristics

statement.en: Ask people for needed personal or cultural information instead of solely inferring it.
statement.ja: 必要なpersonal・cultural informationは一方的にinferせずpeopleに尋ねる。

conditions: The feature generates images or descriptions of people or otherwise depends on personal attributes.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0029.review_note: Recovered the source's bias-reduction technique without promoting the example to MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0030.title: Clarify stereotype-prone assumptions

statement.en: Seek clarity before making personal assumptions that may lead to common stereotypes.
statement.ja: common stereotypeにつながるpersonal assumptionを行う前にclarityを求める。

conditions: Examples include assumptions about gender identities or relationship types.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0030.review_note: Recovered the explicit assumption check and preserved recommendation strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0031.title: Test AI results across diverse people

statement.en: Test the AI feature across diverse people to identify and correct stereotypes.
statement.ja: diverseなpeopleでAI featureをtestし、stereotypeを特定・修正する。

conditions: Use testing to support the separate inclusive-results requirement.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0031.review_note: Recovered the testing action separately from the mandatory inclusive outcome.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0032.title: Never present AI as human-authored

statement.en: Never mislead people into believing AI interactions or content are human-authored.
statement.ja: AI interactionやcontentをhuman-authoredだと誤認させない。

conditions: Apply to both interactive AI and content people view.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0032.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never deception prohibition as MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0033.title: Ensure regional AI disclosure compliance

statement.en: Ensure AI disclosure aligns with applicable regulations in every region where the app is offered.
statement.ja: app提供地域ごとの適用regulationにAI disclosureを一致させる。

conditions: Review the regions where the app is offered.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0033.review_note: Recovered the explicit Ensure legal-disclosure outcome as MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0034.title: Always weigh model privacy

statement.en: Always weigh privacy alongside model capability and performance.
statement.ja: model capabilityとperformanceとともにprivacyを常に評価する。

conditions: Apply when choosing between on-device and server-based models.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0034.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always privacy requirement as MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0035.review_note: Classified the server-processing privacy safeguard as a privacy MUST without claiming all processing must be local.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0036.review_note: Retained the source sentence's making-sure disclosure outcome as a privacy MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0037.review_note: Classified post-permission data minimization as a privacy MUST and split the Always opt-out clause separately.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0038.review_note: Classified the source's explicit-permission condition as a privacy MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0039.review_note: Classified informed personal-data choice as a privacy and explicit-user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0040.review_note: Classified consent-request clarity as an informed-permission MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0041.review_note: Classified model-training use disclosure as a privacy and informed-consent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0042.title: Use diverse model datasets

statement.en: When teaching or evaluating an AI model, choose datasets with diverse subject-matter representation.
statement.ja: AI modelのteaching・evaluationではdiverseなsubject-matter representationを含むdatasetを選ぶ。

conditions: Apply to training from scratch and customization of an existing model.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0042.review_note: Recovered the diversity action separately from the general dataset-design principle.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0043.title: Trace dataset provenance

statement.en: Identify where model data comes from and how it was gathered.
statement.ja: model dataの由来と収集方法を特定する。

conditions: Review provenance before selecting or using the dataset.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0043.review_note: Recovered dataset provenance as a separate reviewable action.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0044.title: Ensure dataset licenses

statement.en: Ensure relevant licenses cover every dataset item the developer doesn't own.
statement.ja: developerが所有しないすべてのdataset itemをrelevant licenseでcoverする。

conditions: Apply before using nonowned data to train, customize, teach, or evaluate a model.
People's data choices are recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0044.review_note: Recovered the explicit Ensure license outcome as a legal MUST and split the privacy choice.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0045.title: Communicate that AI output can be wrong

statement.en: Clearly communicate that AI-generated content can contain errors.
statement.ja: AI-generated contentがerrorを含む可能性を明確に伝える。

conditions: Generative models can present incorrect details as plausible facts.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0045.review_note: Recovered the error-warning action at SHOULD; specific harmful contexts remain separate avoidances.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0046.title: Avoid unverified factual generation

statement.en: Avoid requesting factual output unless the model has verified, up-to-date information for the task.
statement.ja: modelがtask向けのverified・up-to-date informationを持たない場合、factual outputのrequestを避ける。

conditions: Review whether the model's information is appropriate for the specific factual task.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0046.review_note: Recovered the explicit Avoid guidance without promoting it to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0047.title: Avoid harmful hallucination contexts

statement.en: Avoid AI-generated content where a hallucination could misinform and harm someone.
statement.ja: hallucinationが誤情報とharmを生む状況でAI-generated contentを使うことを避ける。

conditions: Evaluate the consequence of a plausible but incorrect output.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0047.review_note: Preserved the source's Avoid strength for the explicit harm scenario rather than overstating it as Never.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0048.title: Avoid destructive AI automation

statement.en: Avoid automating destructive or hard-to-undo actions.
statement.ja: destructiveまたはhard-to-undoなactionのautomationを避ける。

conditions: Examples include deleting photos or making a purchase on someone's behalf.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0048.review_note: Recovered the explicit Avoid automation guidance without raising examples to MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0049.title: Confirm significant AI actions

statement.en: Generally, ask for confirmation before performing a significant action on someone's behalf.
statement.ja: someoneのbehalfでsignificant actionを行う前に、通常はconfirmationを求める。

conditions: Apply when the AI performs rather than merely suggests the action.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0049.review_note: Recovered confirmation and retained the source's Generally qualifier at SHOULD.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0050.review_note: Classified adherence to applicable model and regulatory policy as a legal and platform-contract MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0051.title: Acknowledge AI-output corrections

statement.en: When people adjust or personalize AI output, clearly signal that the change took effect.
statement.ja: AI outputをadjustまたはpersonalizeした場合、changeの反映を明確に示す。

conditions: Feedback should help people form an accurate mental model and build trust.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0051.review_note: Recovered the correction-feedback action separately from result refinement and reversal.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0052.title: Explain generation failures and next steps

statement.en: When generation fails, describe what happened plainly and offer a clear next step.
statement.ja: generation失敗時は、発生内容をplain languageで説明し、明確なnext stepを提供する。

conditions: Apply to status feedback when something goes wrong.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0052.review_note: Recovered the failure state and its two-part explanation and recovery response.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0053.title: Test every model update

statement.en: Thoroughly test and refine every model update for unexpected behavior.
statement.ja: すべてのmodel updateをthoroughly test・refineし、unexpected behaviorを特定・修正する。

conditions: Apply to base-model changes, fine-tuning, retraining, prompt changes, and other model updates.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0053.review_note: Recovered update-specific testing and kept conservative SHOULD strength.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0054.title: Always keep AI feedback voluntary

statement.en: Always make providing feedback about AI output voluntary.
statement.ja: AI outputへのfeedback提供を常にvoluntaryにする。

conditions: Do not make feedback a condition for continuing the experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0054.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always user-intent requirement as MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0055.title: Place feedback controls without interruption

statement.en: Place AI feedback controls in a clear location that doesn't interrupt the experience.
statement.ja: AI feedback controlをexperienceをinterruptしない明確なlocationに置く。

conditions: Respect people's time and keep the feedback affordance easy to find.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-GENERATIVE-AI-0055.review_note: Recovered the feedback placement and interruption constraint as a separate usability rule.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0001.review_note: Raised the conditional full-photo outcome to MUST from the supporting make-sure sentence.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0002.title: Keep Live Photo content intact

statement.en: Preserve Live Photo content and its cross-app experience.
statement.ja: Live Photo contentとcross-app experienceを保持する。

conditions: Use consistent visual treatment and interaction across apps.
The separate-media avoidance is recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0002.review_note: Concretized content integrity and separated the direct disassembly avoidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0003.title: Use still photos in unsupported environments

statement.en: In an environment that doesn't support Live Photos, show a traditional still representation.
statement.ja: Live Photos非対応環境ではtraditional still representationを表示する。

conditions: Do not imitate the supported Live Photos experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0003.review_note: Concretized the still representation and separated the replication avoidance.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0004.title: Distinguish Live Photos from still photos

statement.en: Make Live Photos easy to distinguish from still photos.
statement.ja: Live Photoをstill photoと容易に区別できるようにする。

conditions: Prefer a hint of movement and implement a custom motion effect where appropriate.
Use the separate badge rule when movement isn't possible.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0004.review_note: Recorded movement as the preferred identification technique and the badge fallback separately.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0005.title: Keep Live Photo badge placement consistent

statement.en: If Live Photo badges are shown, place them consistently on every photo.
statement.ja: Live Photo badgeを表示する場合、すべてのphotoで一貫した位置に置く。

conditions: A corner is typically an effective location.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0005.review_note: Restored the badge-present condition and kept the corner placement as a preference.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0006.title: Show Live Photo download and readiness state

statement.en: Clearly indicate when a Live Photo is downloading and when it becomes playable.
statement.ja: Live Photoのdownload中とplayableになった時点を明確に示す。

conditions: Show progress during download and a completion indication afterward.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0006.review_note: Concretized both loading and ready states from the supporting sentence.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0007.title: Support informed Live Photo sharing

statement.en: Design Live Photo sharing around content preview and a still-photo option.
statement.ja: content previewとstill-photo optionを中心にLive Photo sharingを設計する。

conditions: The app supports photo sharing.
The preview and still-photo option are mandatory rules recorded separately.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0007.review_note: Activated the omitted sharing lead as an umbrella pattern without weakening its atomic requirements.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0008.review_note: Classified the documented alternative as a conditional user-intent and content-integrity MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0009.title: Avoid disassembling Live Photos

statement.en: Avoid presenting a Live Photo's frames or audio separately.
statement.ja: Live Photoのframeまたはaudioを個別に提示することを避ける。

conditions: Preserve the integrated sound-and-motion experience.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0009.review_note: Recovered the direct Don't guidance at AVOID rather than overstating it as Never.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0010.review_note: Classified complete-content preview as a privacy and explicit-sharing-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0011.title: Always offer still-photo sharing

statement.en: Always offer a way to share a Live Photo as a traditional still photo.
statement.ja: Live Photoをtraditional still photoとしてshareする方法を常に提供する。

conditions: The app supports sharing Live Photos.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0011.review_note: Recovered the explicit Always sharing option as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0012.title: Avoid imitating Live Photos where unsupported

statement.en: Avoid imitating the supported Live Photos experience in an unsupported environment.
statement.ja: unsupported environmentでsupported Live Photos experienceを模倣することを避ける。

conditions: Show the separate still representation instead.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0012.review_note: Recovered the direct Don't guidance at AVOID and retained the still fallback.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0013.title: Use a badge when movement isn't possible

statement.en: When movement can't identify a Live Photo, show a system-provided badge above it.
statement.ja: movementでLive Photoを識別できない場合、system-provided badgeを上に表示する。

conditions: The badge may include text or appear without text.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0013.review_note: Recovered the conditional system-badge fallback without making motion mandatory.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0014.title: Never use a video-like playback button

statement.en: Never use a Live Photo playback button that people could interpret as video playback.
statement.ja: video playbackと解釈され得るLive Photo playback buttonを使わない。

conditions: Use motion or the system-provided Live Photo badge for identification.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0014.review_note: Recovered the explicit Never playback-control prohibition as MUST_NOT.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0015.title: Avoid Live Photos on watchOS

statement.en: Avoid offering Live Photos on unsupported watchOS.
statement.ja: unsupportedのwatchOSでLive Photosを提供することを避ける。

conditions: Apple HIG records Live Photos as unsupported in watchOS.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0015.review_note: Recovered the platform limitation as an unsupported-platform AVOID rule.

HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0016.title: Avoid Live Photo capture in visionOS

statement.en: Avoid offering Live Photo capture in visionOS.
statement.ja: visionOSでLive Photo captureを提供することを避ける。

conditions: People can view Live Photos in visionOS but can't capture them.
HIG-TECHNOLOGIES-LIVE-PHOTOS-0016.review_note: Recovered the visionOS view-only limitation as an unsupported-capability AVOID rule.
